title: Mirabel Garlick
paragraphs: Professor Mirabel Garlick (fl.
1890 ) was an English Muggle-born witch , who taught Herbology at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the late 19th century .
Biography
Early life
Garlick was born in London and grew up in a household full of Muggles .
She did not feel at home until she was a student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , where she was sorted into Hufflepuff house.
It was at Hogwarts that she finally 'blossomed' and discovered her extraordinary affinity for magical plants.
During her first year , she met the seventh-year Sirona Ryan , forming a lifelong friendship.
They met before Mirabel's first week had even finished, as Mirabel felt she did not fit in with the other first years and felt Hogwarts was not the right place for her.
Mirabel went to the Three Broomsticks Inn , where Sirona worked as a waitress, and considered writing a letter to her parents about how she wished to withdraw from the school.
Sirona approached her while she was huddled in a corner, staring at her empty bit of parchment , and sat with her.
Mirabel grew enamoured with Sirona's confidence with who she was, and this inspired Mirabel to be more confident in herself as well.
In her seventh year , she was awarded the Hogwarts Herbology Award in recognition of her exemplary skill in the field of Herbology .
Teaching career
Mirabel teaching Herbology at Hogwarts

Shortly after her graduation, she became the Professor of Herbology at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , taking over from her predecessor after the man had had his eyes gouged out by a Bowtruckle , among other plant-related injuries.
Her sunny demeanour and flowery language charmed colleagues and students alike, prompting some students to worry she might one day leave them for another greenhouse.
During the 1890-1891 school year , she had high hopes for Hufflepuff's chances at Quidditch alone with Dinah Hecat , although she had not yet learned the rules.
Regardless, Headmaster Phineas Nigellus Black had cancelled Quidditch for the year due to an injury during last spring's final.
Later that year, she gave extracurricular tuition to the new fifth year student on how to use the Levitation Charm and the Knockback Jinx .
She also gave her fifth-year class an assignment to write a twenty inch essay on dittany and its uses .

Mirabel Garlick was not present at the battle that ensued in the Keepers' Caverns at the end of the school year with Ranrok 's invasion of the school, though she was present at the memorial ceremony for her fallen colleague, Eleazar Fig , that occurred after Hogwarts' victory in the conflict.
Physical description
Garlick had red hair in braided ponytails and light skin.
She wore a green hat adorned with flowers and a green dress.
Personality and traits
Mirabel Garlick was marked by her kind and caring nature, as well as her sunny demeanour, which helped endear her to virtually all who knew her.
A great lover of plants, she often used flowery language , calling her students " roses ".
Her memories of her experiences studying at Hogwarts allowed her to be especially empathetic with the fifth-year student , to whom she gave extra lessons and with whom she shared her story.
Based on her belief that people "bloom differently according to their own plan", Mirabel was objectively supportive and overtly optimistic.
Magical abilities and skills
Relationships
Sirona Ryan
Sirona Ryan

Professor Garlick had a close friendship with Sirona Ryan , a part-time waitress and later proprietor of the Three Broomsticks Inn , whom she met when she was a first-year student at Hogwarts , and Sirona was in her seventh year .
Their friendship bloomed when Sirona's confidence and charm inspired Mirabel to be more confident herself, finding the ability to accept who she was.
Indeed, by the time Mirabel matured and became the Professor of Herbology at the school, she and Sirona had formed a lifelong friendship.
Dorothy Sprottle
Dorothy Sprottle
Professor Garlick appeared to have a good relationship with Dorothy Sprottle , who was also on good terms with their mutual friend, Sirona Ryan .
Mirabel would keep in touch with Dorothy, but would seldom visit her.
Nevertheless, she enjoyed the company of Dorothy and her husband, Aidan , " for their delightful conversation and, I am unashamed to admit, their incomparable Cauldron Cakes . "
A letter sent to Professor Garlick in the 1890-1891 school year by Sirona Ryan indicated that Dorothy had been asking after Mirabel and that it had been " far too long " since her last visit.
Eleanor Everleigh
Professor Garlick's appeared to have some form of warm friendship with Eleanor Everleigh , the aunt of Lenora Everleigh , one of Mirabel's Hufflepuff students.
The two exchanged letters, with Mirabel sending Eleanor her presumably homegrown, sweet strawberries .
Eleanor remarked that everything Mirabel cultivated, "from Bitteroot to berries", was of high quality.
Hogwarts students and staff

Mirabel Garlick appeared to have a very good working relationship with her fellow professors , as she could be seen having a friendly discussion with Dinah Hecat about the 1890-1891 school year's cancelled Quidditch season.
Meanwhile, the students under Professor Garlick had a very high opinion of her, with Lenora Everleigh in particular completely adoring her.

However, there are exceptions, as pure-blood supremacists among the students held Garlick in contempt due to her Muggle-born status, and some students disliked Herbology and handling the magical plants it pertains to.
When the new fifth-year student attended Hogwarts, Mirabel gave them private tuition on the Levitation Charm and the Knockback Jinx .
Notes and references

title: Noreen Blainey
paragraphs: Nurse Noreen Blainey was a Muggle-born witch and the matron at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the late 19th century .
Biography
Early life
Noreen was born into a Muggle family in the 19th century .
In her youth, she attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , and was Sorted into Hufflepuff House .
Hogwarts career
Shortly after her graduation from Hogwarts, Noreen returned to the school and became the new matron of the school's Hospital Wing .
Due to her lack of work experience, however, by 1890 , Madam Blainey was still learning the ropes while working to bring the hospital up to code.
In the late 1880s , she was asked by Sebastian Sallow and/or Solomon Sallow to find a cure for Anne Sallow 's curse ; however, she could not find a way to cure it.
In the 1890-1891 school year , she was seen chastising a student who had brought a sheep into the Hospital Wing, claiming it was a transfigured form of his friend George .
She believed it was just a normal sheep and asked the student if George had gone through the steps required to become an Animagus .
She was then alarmed when the sheep stepped off the bed and began to eat her bubotubers , and asked the student to get it away.
George appeared shortly afterwards, confused at the scene, leading Noreen to send them both out.
Personality and traits
Noreen made up for her lack of experience with her fortitude.
Magical abilities and skills
Notes and references

title: Mahendra Pehlwaan
paragraphs: Mahendra Pehlwaan (b. 1874/1875 ) was a Muggle-born wizard and a Ravenclaw student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the late 19th century .
Personality and traits
Mahendra had a penchant for sticking to the rules.
Notes and references

title: Kellen Carrion
paragraphs: Kellen M. Carrion was a Muggle-born wizard poacher who Long Shouren worked for before the 2010s .
Biography
Early life
In his youth, Kellen attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , where he was Sorted into Ravenclaw House .
Prior to his seventh year , he was expelled from Hogwarts for an unknown reason.
The British Auror Office also ordered that his wand be destroyed under the supervision of British Ministry of Magic officials.
Despite this order, Kellen managed to either keep his original wand or secure a replacement.
Moreover, Kellen also scribbled the phrase "Hogwarts was never enough for me" on his expulsion notice .
Early activities
At some point, Kellen formed a group of wizard poachers .
As their boss, they illegally poached magical beasts.
When Long Shouren left his village in China at the age of seventeen to travel the world, he met Kellen and impressed him with his knowledge of dragons .
At first, Shouren did not know that Kellen and his group were poachers.
He was unhappy once he realised and, after years of begrudgingly helping, he decided to leave.
However, Kellen told Shouren that he owed them, so he could not leave until he helped steal a dragon egg .
Shouren agreed, but only so he could get the egg and flee with it in order to protect it from Kellen and his group.
They chased him while he tried to run, but gave up and abandoned him for dead when the mother of the egg, a huge dragon , arrived.
Shouren survived the attack, although at the cost of his arm.
At some point, Kellen embarked on a mission with fellow poacher Qui LeBlanc on the orders of Zara Fishlock .
Working with the Ministry
In the early 2010s , Kellen was working with, although not for, the British Ministry of Magic , where he had powerful friends who could protect him.
He was asked to help investigate the recent theft of three dragon eggs .
He suspected Long Shouren was involved and tracked him down to Hogwarts , where he was helping to teach Care of Magical Creatures .
He arrived during a lesson taught by Rubeus Hagrid , where he talked to a student about the theft, who disagreed with him that Shouren was a thief.
Kellen figured out they were involved because they smelled like a hatchling.
When Hagrid interrupted, Kellen asked him to let Shouren know he wanted to talk to him.
Hagrid agreed, but thought he was a "strange fella".
Kellen later met up with his poacher group , including Qui LeBlanc , in the Forbidden Forest .
They waited in the forest for the student to bring the dragon eggs to Shouren.
Kellen hid near Hagrid's Hut , where he saw the student with a baby dragon .
He tampered with the Dragon Paddock , freeing the Antipodean Opaleye within it, so he could talk to the student without Hagrid there.
They confronted the student about the baby dragon, calling Shouren a liar and demanding they give him the dragon.
The dragon soon became upset, and the student told Kellen that she didn't appear to like him.
He replied that he felt the same way about her.
The student refused to let him have the dragon, which started to make Kellen angry.
Hagrid returned and confronted him.
Kellen tried to tell him they were helping a criminal, but Hagrid responded that Kellen was the criminal.
He threatened Hagrid, pointing out that he had powerful friends at the Ministry, but Hagrid retorted that he did as well.
Kellen attacked the duo, during which the dragon flew away.
Hagrid held Kellen off while the student chased her.
Kellen escaped Hagrid and tracked down the student and the dragon.
He claimed that they thought they were brave, like Shouren did, to which the student replied that Shouren had changed and was a good person.
However, Kellen pointed out that they were a thief now that Shouren had involved them in his illegal activities.
He demanded they hand over the dragon or face the consequences.
The student tried to subdue Kellen with the Stunning Spell , but he managed to get back up.
However, Shouren appeared when Kellen told them that there was no value in caring for beasts.
He told Kellen that he didn't use to think like that, and that he used to be fond of them.
Kellen agreed that he did a long time ago, but he paid for it with flesh and blood.
Shouren responded that Kellen taught him the innocent shouldn't pay for their mistakes, which made him very angry.
He shouted at Shouren that he taught him many things, but he still betrayed him.
Shouren tried to appeal to Kellen to change like he had, but he thought it was pointless and told Shouren to get the student to hand over the hatchling.
When they refused, he challenged Shouren to a duel, telling him he had never been beaten before.
However, Shouren managed to defeat Kellen, although he spared his life, telling him that he did so because he thought anyone could change, even him.
Kellen left the Hogwarts grounds soon after, with Shouren claiming that he had a lot to answer for at the Ministry.
Shouren believed that, this time, Kellen wouldn't be able to talk his way out of his situation and that he wouldn't be able to continue working with the Ministry.
However, despite his crimes, Kellen maintained at least some of his connections at the Ministry and eventually became a Ministry informant, receiving the title of Special Temporary Investigator.
Meanwhile, his poacher group resumed operations, targeting magical creatures with less Ministry protection in less well-guarded areas.
They planned on targeting creatures in a remote area to which few wizards had ever travelled.

In response, Hogwarts Headmistress Minerva McGonagall worked with Shouren to set up an official expedition to the site to both investigate the rare magical fauna and flora and runic inscriptions at the site and protect the creatures there from Kellen's poacher group.

McGonagall and Shouren were soon able to recruit Professors Neville Longbottom , Horace Slughorn , and Clodagh Dromgoole for the expedition with the aid of the same Hogwarts student that Kellen had previously confronted, who also joined the preparations for the expedition at Shouren's request.

Kellen became aware of Shouren's return to Hogwarts and his plans for the expedition, so he attempted to either inhibit the expedition's progress or stop it altogether to enable his poachers' plans to proceed.
He prepared an abundance of wanted posters for Shouren, painting him as a fugitive with twelve active charges against him and promising a reward for any information leading to his capture.

He was also able to swap out a potion brewed by Slughorn for one that he and his group had previously used to punish the disobedient, which temporarily incapacitated Shouren during a training session for the expedition in the Room of Requirement .

Although Slughorn was immediately able to recognize that the potion wasn't part of his brew the moment he smelled it, a Ministry investigation team arrived at Hogwarts shortly afterwards and demanded to see McGonagall, claiming that the school was harboring a dangerous criminal.

The student was able to use the Room of Requirement's magic to produce an Invisibility Cloak , which enabled them to hide Shouren for long enough that the Ministry investigation was unable to find him.
Shouren was soon moved to his tent , which McGonagall had cloaked with Concealment Charms , to keep him away from the Ministry's eyes.
Shouren eventually regained consciousness after a few days and began recovering with the aid of the potion's antidote .

While he recovered, he met with the student, and, after Shouren informed them that the tampered potion was not part of Slughorn's brew, the two shared their belief that Kellen was responsible for both the potion tampering and the Ministry investigation.
Kellen next plotted to draw out Shouren by tampering with a nearby stream, resulting in several creatures and pets in both the Forbidden Forest and Hogsmeade becoming poisoned.
Shouren, Longbottom, Slughorn, Dromgoole, and the student attempted to help the creatures, but Slughorn still required some fresh Mandrakes to brew a Mandrake Restorative Draught .
The student and Longbottom attempted to head to Greenhouse Three to collect the Mandrakes, but were confronted by Kellen as soon as they stepped outside of the forest.
Supported by a team of Aurors , Kellen informed the student and Longbottom that they were there because Hogwarts was harboring a wanted criminal who was responsible for harming magical creatures.
At that moment, McGonagall and Slughorn arrived at the scene, with McGonagall claiming that Kellen had no evidence for his accusation.
Moreover, Slughorn stated that he had evidence that one of his potions had been tampered with, accusing Kellen of having both access and motive to do so.

Slughorn claimed that he had set up precautions for those who stole from the Potions Storeroom , while McGonagall stated that the Ministry should investigate something for which they had actual proof.

The student explained that the poisoned creatures were showing symptoms identical to those Shouren displayed after being poisoned by the tampered potion, although they kept Shouren's involvement secret.
The student accused Kellen of being responsible for poisoning the forest's creatures, to which Kellen offered to cooperate with the investigation into the situation.

However, before Kellen and his team could head up to Hogwarts Castle to further sort out the situation, Kellen quickly turned around and cast a spell towards the creatures, which was suddenly blocked by Shouren's umbrella.
Shouren, who had arrived at the scene alongside Dromgoole, asserted that Kellen wouldn't threaten another innocent being while he still stood.

Having successfully forced Shouren out of hiding, Kellen yelled to the rest of his team that Shouren was a fugitive and claimed that he had likely used the Imperius Curse on McGonagall to turn her against the Ministry.
He then released a flurry of wanted posters for Shouren that blew around the Hogwarts grounds, falling into the hands of many at the castle and Hogsmeade, before leaving the scene on his broomstick .

Shouren realised that Kellen had lured him out on purpose and that he was attempting to stop their expedition, knowing that there must be something at the remote site that Kellen didn't want them to discover.

However, this knowledge reaffirmed the expedition's participants' conviction, with Shouren, having been convinced to stay at Hogwarts despite his reservations, heading to Hogsmeade to help treat the affected creatures there, while the others helped treat the creatures in the forest.

The student, Shouren, Longbottom, Slughorn, and Dromgoole later met at the Hog's Head Inn to plan how they would deal with Kellen's attempts to inhibit their expedition and how they could help Hogsmeade.
However, a Hogsmeade resident eventually tipped off Kellen regarding Shouren's presence in the village, and a group of villagers attempted to force their way into the Hog's Head.
Aberforth Dumbledore quickly smuggled them out through the passageway connecting the inn to Hogwarts.
However, before they could get very far from the Hog's Head, Kellen arrived and restrained Aberforth before ordering Shouren to come out from the tunnel if he didn't want Hogsmeade to pay the price.
Shouren attempted to send the others back to Hogwarts while he confronted Kellen alone and held him off, but the others eventually convinced him to allow them to help confront Kellen.
When they came back outside, they found Kellen with the restrained Aberforth in front of a crowd of Hogsmeade villagers.
Kellen attempted to inflame the villagers by claiming that Shouren was a fugitive who had been harming their creatures.
However, several of the villagers recognised Shouren, claiming that he had helped save several of their creatures from poisoning.
Kellen responded that Shouren had only healed them after making them sick himself, claiming that Shouren was only attempting to buy the villagers' sympathy.
Shouren claimed that Kellen had never owned up to his own crimes and that he was always quick to point fingers at anyone other than himself.
In response, Kellen began to threaten Shoruen by raising his wand .

However, before he could do anything, he was knocked out by Glenna Golding , the student's great-aunt, who had seen him threatening the student through the Hog's Head window and swung at Kellen with a long-handled frying pan in response.
The student quickly explained that Kellen was the one actually responsible for making the creatures ill, with Glenna expressing her support due to Shouren having helped heal her Kneazle , Marlowe .
The rest of the villagers in the crowd followed Glenna's example and stated their support for Shouren before being invited into the Hog's Head by the freed Aberforth.
However, Kellen quickly recovered and managed to slip away while everyone was distracted.
Despite his escape, the expedition eventually continued unimpeded.
Kellen eventually returned to his poacher group, whom he told about the many creatures he had seen within the Forbidden Forest.

This information peaked the interest of fellow poacher Zara Fishlock , who schemed to use Kellen's information to turn the Forbidden Forest into a private magical creature hunting ground, although she was unsuccessful.
Zara Fishlock's coup
At some point after Kellen's attempts to stop the expedition to the remote site had been prevented, Zara Fishlock plotted to take over Kellen's poacher group .
During a hunt for a group of creatures in the Hebrides , including a Hebridean Black , Fishlock set up Kellen, forcing him to flee while she took full control of the entirety of the group.

With his leverage and followers now gone, Kellen transfigured a list of names of individuals that Fishlock had kidnapped as part of her and Linus Dytrope 's attempt to experiment with turning humans into creatures into a bookmark using a complex transfiguration charm .
In the process, Kellen bound the word " dragon " to the charm, meaning that only saying the word in front of the bookmark could easily reverse the transfiguration.
Kellen hid the bookmark in his copy of A History of Magic and brought it with him as he went on the run.
Knowing that Fishlock had connections in the British Ministry of Magic , Kellen attempted to seek refuge at Hogwarts , as it was the only place he could trust to be neutral ground.

He briefly hid in the Forbidden Forest nearby Hogwarts Castle , with his presence agitating the Hebridean Black and the other creatures that had fled to Hogwarts following the poacher group's attack on them.

After three days of being unable to feed the agitated Hebridian Black or treat her wounds from the poachers' attack, Rubeus Hagrid informed the student whom Kellen had previously confronted, along with their friends Robyn Thistlethwaite and Kevin Farrell , about the situation.
While investigating, the student discovered that the dragon had been marked with a Tracking spell , which, when broken, revealed a series of large footprints pointing deeper into the forest.
While Hagrid kept an eye on the dragon, Robyn and Kevin returned to the castle to get help from Headmistress Minerva McGonagall while the student followed the footprints into the forest.
After following the footprints deep into the forest, the student eventually heard a noise behind them.
When they turned around to look for the source of the noise, their wand was knocked from their hands as Kellen revealed himself.
Kellen recognised the student from their previous interactions, but he refused to answer their questions as to why he was there or what he had done to the dragon .

After a discussion regarding Long Shouren 's departure from Kellen's group and the paths he and Kellen had taken, the student eventually forced Kellen to explain that he had not returned to Hogwarts for another hunt, but was instead seeking shelter.
The student did not initially believe Kellen's claims based on their previous encounters, so Kellen attempted to throw them off balance by claiming that Shouren had appeared behind them.
When the student instinctually turned to look, Kellen cast a spell at them, which they were narrowly able to dodge.
Kellen then forced the student to take him back to the castle, as he sought an audience with Headmistress McGonagall.
Upon encountering McGonagall, Kellen attempted to speak with her, but McGonagall claimed that Kellen was no longer permitted to set foot on Hogwarts grounds.
At that moment, Kellen revealed that the student was alongside him, attempting to use their safety as a bargaining chip.

To the surprise of both McGonagall and the student, Kellen attempted to surrender himself to Hogwarts, claiming that they could take him into custody for whatever charge they wanted, including breaking into Hogwarts grounds, taking a student hostage, or poisoning a Hebridean Black.
The student corrected Kellen that the Hebridean Black had not been poisoned, noticing that Kellen was willing to be charged for a crime he had not actually committed.

Kellen modified the potential charge to agitating the Hebridean Black in response, but McGonagall replied that Hogwarts was a school, not a holding facility, and suggested that the Ministry would be a more suitable place for Kellen to answer for his crimes.
However, Kellen continued, claiming that the school had to have an unused classroom or dungeon in which he could be held.
He offered to tell McGonagall what he knew about why the creatures had appeared at the school and why the Hebridean Black was agitated if he could be held at Hogwarts for a while.
McGonagall agreed to discuss his proposition in private, sending the student to reassure their friends that they were alright.
The student discussed Kellen's arrival at Hogwarts with Robyn and Kevin.

Robyn wondered if Kellen planned to poison the dragon and pick off it and the rest of the creatures with his ring in the forest, but the student explained that Kellen was alone, with no other poachers being seen on the school grounds beside him.
Kevin guessed that the other poachers might have been unable to get past McGonagall's defensive wards .
Robyn produced an Extendable Ear and convinced the student and Kevin to attempt to eavesdrop on Kellen and McGonagall's discussion.
While Kevin distracted Argus Filch , the student was able to sneak the Extendable Ear under the door of the classroom in which Kellen and McGonagall were talking.

They overheard McGonagall asserting that harboring Kellen would put the school's students at risk, to which Kellen again claimed that he would only need to be held there temporarily while offering to swear an Unbreakable Vow to not harm a single student while at Hogwarts and to hand over his wand for safekeeping.

When McGonagall again denied Kellen's request, he tried to use her connection with Shouren, claiming that she could contact Shouren so that he could confirm for her the value and danger of the list he was carrying with him and that the list concerned the entire British wizarding world .
McGonagall again attempted to direct Kellen towards the Ministry, claiming that they had procedures in place to assess such dangerous intelligence and to offer protection when warranted.
In response, Kellen angrily declared that sending him to the Ministry would be tantamount to killing him herself, although McGonagall claimed that she couldn't help him.
The student brought the information they had overheard back to Robyn and Kevin.

The three discussed how McGonagall could not allow Kellen to stay on Hogwarts grounds, claiming that sheltering him could damage Hogwarts's reputation for years and that they could not risk future dangerous people seeking shelter at the school.
Following this discussion, Robyn and Kevin headed to the Quidditch pitch for Robyn's Quidditch practise while the student attempted to return to their dormitory for a brief rest.
However, before they could reach their dormitory, they were overtaken by a sudden wave of dizziness before falling unconscious.
The student awoke in the Shrieking Shack , where they discovered that they had been kidnapped and tied up by Kellen.

When Kellen found that they were awake, he learned that they were aware of his conversation with McGonagall and claimed that, with him holding the student hostage, McGonagall would be forced to cooperate.

The student attempted to convince Kellen that McGonagall would not be willing to help someone who endangered a Hogwarts student, but Kellen stuck to his plans, claiming that there was nowhere else he could safely hide and that he needed to get Hogwarts on his side like Shouren had.

Fearing for their life, the student pleaded with Kellen not to hurt them, claiming that harming them would destroy his last chance of Hogwarts ever helping him and that he had now become a kidnapper who could cross a line he couldn't come back from.
This enraged Kellen, who claimed that the student was calling him a madman or a murderer.
The student attempted to calm him down, but Kellen furiously stated that the student believed that he deserved to be thrown in Azkaban without question and that his past actions damned him forever.
The student explained that they had just been afraid and spoke without thinking before claiming that Kellen was also being controlled by his fear, reiterating that they could still help him.
The student asked Kellen to tell them whom he was running from and offered to speak to McGonagall on his behalf if he would untie them.

Instead, Kellen muttered his surprise that no one had come looking for the student yet, claiming that he thought the Hogwarts staff would look after a student that had just been kidnapped by a poacher more closely and that Hogwarts was no longer what it used to be.
Upon hearing Kellen mention Shouren again, the student offered to contact him if Kellen told them whom he was running from, claiming that Kellen was running out of options.

Kellen asserted that the student should think twice about threatening a poacher, but the student reiterated that they were his only chance of getting a message to either McGonagall or Shouren and that they were the only one willing to help him, asking him to choose between accepting a temporary ally or making an enemy of the entire world.

When Kellen continued to argue, the student claimed that they were, in a sense, in the same boat as Kellen, stating that, if they helped a poacher hide at Hogwarts while the school was also sheltering several magical creatures and had requested Ministry assistance, they risked being exposed as the one who let him into the school should he be discovered.

Although Kellen attempted to claim that the student would be protected regardless due to their closeness with McGonagall, the student asserted that McGonagall might not expect them to have been kidnapped twice in a single day and that they were attempting to protect themselves as well as Kellen.

The student reminded Kellen that they were the only one who could help him and that, while he could kill them if he still didn't trust them, he would be throwing away the only hope he had left of securing the protection he sought if he did so.

Although he was initially angered that the student had seemingly called him impulsive, Kellen eventually managed to calm down and accept that the student had spoken without thinking, offering to untie them so that they could send a letter to Shouren.
However, he threatened to kill them immediately should they attempt to run.
Kellen whistled to call in an owl that the student could use to send the letter, with the student hurriedly writing a letter addressed to McGonagall, which Kellen was too rattled to notice.
The student again attempted to convince Kellen to tell them whom he was running from, to which Kellen again refused, claiming that they would both be killed if word got out that he had talked.

The student attempted to reassure Kellen while they waited for a reply, claiming that they were close to the safety of Hogwarts and trying to convince Kellen to breathe and rest to save his strength for later.
Kellen agreed, but claimed that it didn't matter, as they would be found regardless, before being startled by noises from his surroundings.
In an attempt to keep Kellen steady until their letter could reach someone, the student attempted to keep him talking.

They explored the shack and found Kellen's Hogwarts expulsion notice, a Daily Prophet article containing a list of missing-persons from London , with some names having been crossed out, a letter from Zara Fishlock and Kellen's hastily written and scratched out response, a smudged contract regarding joint transfiguration research between a group of poachers and a Linus Dytrope, and a bell that was enchanted to ring if someone approached the shack, discussing each of these objects with Kellen.
They eventually came across Kellen's copy of A History of Magic , recognising his initials on the inside cover.
The student attempted to flip through the book, resulting in the bookmark Kellen had hidden there falling out.
Kellen shouted at the student, who instinctively caught the bookmark in response, demanding that they put the book down.
The student flinched in surprise and dropped the bookmark, which Kellen quickly picked up himself.
They apologised for dropping it, to which Kellen responded that the bookmark was more important then they knew.
The student noticed that, despite the book's age, it had been kept in good shape.
While Kellen attempted to claim that the book was simply something he read to pass the time, the student noticed that its pages were well worn from frequent use.
Seeking to keep Kellen talking, the student attempted to use the book as a pretext to discuss the essay they were working on for History of Magic .
They flipped through the book's pages, finding an abundance of handwritten notes in the margins.

The student claimed that whoever had owned the book had read it from cover to cover more than once, to which Kellen responded that one needed to learn from both books and experiences, claiming that some creatures, especially dragons, were "history in the flesh."
Kellen and the student discussed the student's knowledge of dragons from Shouren, with Kellen offering to teach the student even more if they both survived their current situation.
Attempting to fill the time, Kellen asked the student what the topic of their essay was.

The student explained that their essay was focused on heroic traits in British magical history, to which Kellen responded that those traits were not exclusive to heroes before stating that the topic was more interesting than the essays he had to write during his time at Hogwarts.

The student was surprised that Kellen had once attended Hogwarts, with Kellen revealing he was a member of Ravenclaw House , although he had never graduated, despite the common perception of poachers as dull brutes.
Kellen asserted that, even if given another chance, he would still choose the same life, but the student claimed that someone should try to better themselves if they got the chance.
Kellen chided the student for being idealistic, but they asserted that Kellen's notes seemed to agree with them, reading out a few of the notes before Kellen cut them off.
The student attempted to bring the conversation back to who was hunting Kellen, claiming that it couldn't be a member of Kellen's gang, as no other poachers had been seen in the area.

The student theorised that someone had managed to turn Kellen's gang against him, realising that, to both do so and be able to reach Kellen while he was at Hogwarts, they had to be someone very powerful.
The student realised that Kellen was running from someone with Ministry connections, which Kellen confirmed.
Kellen claimed that Hogwarts was the only place strong enough to protect him, questioning if the school would ever work with a poacher like him.
At that moment, the enchanted bell began to ring, signaling that someone was approaching the Shrieking Shack.
Kellen realised that Fishlock had found him.
Seeing the student raise their wand to help, Kellen told the student to put it down, claiming that they would only slow him down.
Kellen ordered the student to take the book with the bookmark hidden inside and hide in a nearby cabinet, telling them not to come out until he opened the door.
He also told them that, when they did come out, they should use the bookmark however they thought best.
Before the student entered the cabinet, Kellen realised that he had never learned the student's name.
Upon learning their name, he expressed an interest in reading their History of Magic essay once it had been completed before securing the student in the cabinet.

Fishlock entered the Shrieking Shack shortly afterward, with Kellen asserting that Fishlock had nothing to gain from hunting him and demanding to be allowed to leave with the little dignity he had left.
However, Fishlock claimed that she could not let a loose end like Kellen walk free.
Kellen asserted that Fishlock had set him up during their hunt in the Hebrides, but Fishlock claimed that the creatures would soon be recaptured and that she had more pressing matters to attend to.

Kellen then revealed his knowledge of her plan with Linus Dytrope to attempt to turn humans into creatures, claiming that several people on the Ministry's missing-persons list had been kidnapped as part of this process.
Fishlock replied that, with the knowledge he had of her plans, she couldn't let Kellen leave.

Kellen attempted to suggest working out a deal with Fishlock to keep his knowledge of her plans a secret, but Fishlock responded that the best way for him to keep her secret would be for her to kill him.
Fishlock quickly cast a spell at Kellen in an attempt to kill him, although he managed to survive, albeit barely, with his pulse being present, but faint.
Shortly afterwards, Fishlock discovered the student in the cabinet.

Knowing that killing them would risk exposing her actions to McGonagall, she placed them under the Imperius Curse , making them believe that Kellen had kidnapped them and forced them into the cabinet after casting Langlock on them and that Fishlock had been the one to rescue them on behalf of McGonagall.
Fishlock left the Shrieking Shack before McGonagall arrived, having received the student's letter.
McGonagall found both the student and Kellen unconscious and took the student to the Hospital Wing .
Meanwhile, Kellen was brought to St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries for treatment.
However, the Healers there thought it was unlikely that Kellen would ever wake again.

Fishlock attempted to manipulate the situation to recapture the creatures being sheltered at Hogwarts, claiming that she would take them into her custody and bring them to a new habitat she had had constructed for them.
In the process, she returned Kellen's copy of A History of Magic to the student, along with the bookmark it contained.
However.
the student eventually managed to break free from Fishlock's Imperius Curse after falling unconscious while attempting to rescue some of the sheltered creatures from a fire.

After realising the significance of the bookmark and successfully reversing its transfiguration with the word "dragon", they were able to use it alongside the other evidence Kellen left behind to force the Ministry to further investigate the claims against Fishlock, enabling the creatures to be safely returned to their habitats in the Hebrides once they had all healed from their injuries.
However, shortly afterwards, an associate of Fishlock's managed to break into St Mungos and captured Kellen, bringing him to a secret location.

There, Fishlock displayed the restrained Kellen in front of the other members of the poaching ring before murdering him with the Killing Curse , claiming that any members of the ring who opposed her would share his fate.
With Kellen dead, Fishlock officially took full control over the interests of his poaching ring, with all of Kellen's former subordinates swearing allegiance to her.
Physical description
Kellen was a very large wizard with "goat-like features".
In his youth, he had light brown hair.
In the 2010s , he had long grey hair.
He was often mistaken for a werewolf .
He had a deep, resonating voice.
Personality and traits
Kellen was a focused wizard who was quick to anger, though he wished he was not.
He disliked human companionship and preferred to be alone.
He could be rather depressing, with one of his dislikes being laughter.
Kellen liked being mistaken for a werewolf because he could use it to his advantage.
His hobbies included building cages and contraptions, flight, and studying birds .
Possessions
Etymology
Carrion refers to the decaying flesh or carcass of a dead animal.
Notes and references

title: Mary Cattermole
paragraphs: Mary Elizabeth Cattermole (fl.
1997) was an English Muggle-born witch .
She lived at 27 Chislehurst Gardens , Great Tolling , Evesham with her husband and children.
She was described as small with dark hair that she wore in a neat bun.
Biography
She was the daughter of a Muggle greengrocer and his wife .
She married Ministry of Magic employee Reginald Cattermole , with whom she had two daughters, Maisie and Ellie , and one son, Alfred .
Dolores Umbridge interrogating Mary in the Muggle-Born Registration Commission court room
In 1997 , Mary was falsely accused of stealing the wand of a pure-blood or half-blood witch or wizard, and was brought before a trial by the Muggle-Born Registration Commission.
She was trembling as she entered the courtroom , shuddering in the presence of the Dementors .
She was interrogated by Dolores Umbridge and Yaxley , who derided her Muggle-born background.

Umbridge informed Mary that her wand had been confiscated when she arrived at the Ministry, and wanted to know what wizard or witch she supposedly took the wand from, as Mary was not a real witch in her eyes.

She would have been convicted and sent to Azkaban if not for the help of Harry Potter , Hermione Granger ( disguised as Albert Runcorn and Mafalda Hopkirk respectively) and Ronald Weasley (disguised as her husband, Reginald) assisting her and a group of Muggle-borns who had been brought in for questioning escape the Ministry.
After Harry stunned Umbridge and Yaxley, Umbridge's Persian cat Patronus vanished, and Mary was nearly attacked by the present Dementors before Harry repelled them with his own Patronus.
Harry advised Mary and Reg to take their children and flee the country while Voldemort was still in power .
It is unknown if Mary and Reginald managed to escape successfully, or what happened to them and their children after the war.
Ron was not hopeful of their escape, as he had the impression that Reginald was not very quick-witted.
Physical description
Mary was a woman with dark brown hair , blue eyes and fair skin.
Magical abilities and skills
Possessions
Etymology
Mary Cattermole as depicted in LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7

"Mary" is the English form of Maria, which was the Latin form of the New Testament Greek names Μαριαμ ( Mariam ) and Μαρια ( Maria ) (the spellings are interchangeable) which in turn come from the Hebrew name מִרְיָם ( Miryam ).
The meaning is not known for certain, but there are several theories including "sea of bitterness", "rebelliousness", and "wished for child".
It is also possible that the source of the name lies in ancient Egyptian, and was derived from mry "beloved" or mr "love".
Notes and references

title: Karen Crowley
paragraphs: Karen Crowley was an American witch and a professor at Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry during the early 21st century .
Biography
Karen was born to an unknown No-Maj family in the United States of America .
During her youth, Karen accidentally turned her cat into a coffee cup, which was when she realised she had magical abilities.
She likely attended Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for her education and became a professor there at some point after her graduation.

In the 2011-2012 school year , Karen came to Hogwarts Castle via a Balloon Carriage for the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup , which three of her students ( Viggo Victor , Zack Johnson , and Violet Williams ) would be attending.
Notes and references

title: Donaghan Tremlett
paragraphs: Donaghan Tremlett (b. 1972 ) was a Muggle-born wizard , who played bass for the popular wizarding band, the Weird Sisters .
Biography
Early life
Donaghan Tremlett was born in 1972 to Muggle parents .
He started playing the bass guitar at some point in his childhood, and was noted to be talented at it during his Hogwarts years.
Donaghan began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1983 or 1984 .
During his Hogwarts years, he saw the Weird Sisters perform their song Do the Hippogriff during their first concert and auditioned to become the new bass player of the band.
Donaghan became a member of the band, replacing Jacob's sibling , as he could actually play the bass without the use of magic .
He wouldn't participate in any of the band's other concerts during their school years however.
Donaghan's favourite Quidditch team was the Kenmare Kestrels .
Later life
Donaghan Tremlett playing at the Yule Ball

On Christmas Day in 1994 , the band attended the Yule Ball at Hogwarts, where they played classic hits like " Magic Works " and " This Is the Night ", as well as a new song titled " Do the Hippogriff ".
Donaghan married an individual in September 1995 .
The wedding was mentioned in the Daily Prophet on 7 September .
The Funeral of Albus Dumbledore that Donaghan attended
In June 1997 , Donaghan attended the funeral of Albus Dumbledore , and was one of several familiar people Harry Potter noticed among the crowd.
After the Ministry of Magic was taken over by Lord Voldemort in September 1997, Donaghan, as a Muggle-born , presumably faced charges before the Muggle-Born Registration Commission .
He may have been sent to Azkaban , or else gone into hiding, like many others of his heritage.
Physical description
Donaghan was described as "hairy" and, like all members of the Weird Sisters, wore "artfully torn" black robes when onstage.
Notes and references

title: Ben Copper
paragraphs: Ben Copper was an English Muggle-born wizard who began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1984 and was sorted into Gryffindor House .
After graduating from Hogwarts, he began working as an Obliviator for the Magical Congress of the United States of America .
Biography
Ben Copper was born to Muggle parents in Great Britain in late 1972 or 1973 .
A ghost also resided at his home, and Ben was the only one who could see it, being a wizard.
His first spell was charming his mother's teapot to whistle his favourite song.
He was rather delighted at first, but when it wouldn't stop, he tried everything he could and ended up burying it in the flower garden.
At some point, a very kind witch delivered him his Hogwarts acceptance letter .
She sat them down and did her best to explain everything about magic and the wizarding world to him and his parents.
Hogwarts years (1984-1991)
The 1984 Sorting Ceremony , with Ben standing in front of Tulip Karasu
Ben began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1984 .
On journey on the Hogwarts Express , he was tormented the entire time by Merula Snyde , who kept threatening him and calling him a " Mudblood ".
Ben thanked Jacob's sibling for standing up to Merula after their first encounter.
He was later sorted into Gryffindor .
As a result of Merula's bullying, he spent his first days at Hogwarts following her around, hoping this would prevent her from sneaking up on him, or give him a chance to run away if she did.
This made him adept in finding hiding places at Hogwarts.
As a Muggle-born , he found the wizarding world new and scary.
His fears made him think that he did not belong in Gryffindor.
One of his fears was flying , which Jacob's sibling later helped him overcome.
Ben became particularly skilled in Charms .
Due to Merula's bullying, Ben asked the prefect to teach him how to duel with the help of Jacob's sibling.
Jacob's sibling duelled Ben, under the prefect's supervision, in order to help teach him to duel.
Jacob's sibling selected either Ben or Penny Haywood to accompany them to the locked room in which there was cursed ice .
Ben went missing at the beginning of the 1985-1986 school year .

Having last been seen on the Hogwarts Express, Rowan Khanna and Jacob's sibling went looking for him in the Artefact Room , where they found a note with a code written by a person named R, instructing the reader to go to one of the Hogwarts common rooms and untransfigured a Black Quill to a note with the next hint.
They believed that the note was intended for Ben.
Ben was later found on a fifth-floor corridor, later to be known as the Icy Corridor , trapped in cursed ice , and was freed by Professors McGonagall and Snape , and taken to the Hospital Wing .
He told his friends that he couldn't remember how he got to the corridor.
After being released from the Hospital Wing, Ben assisted Jacob's sibling in finding dragon horns for Hagrid 's Fire-Breathing Potion .
Ben kept some powdered dragon horn in the Artefact Room, where he recurrently used to hide from Merula and other students.

When Jacob's sibling and Bill Weasley unsuccessfully attempted to enter the Vault of Ice , Jacob's sibling helped Ben learn to make Burn-Healing Paste in Potions in preparation for their next try at the vaults.
In his third year, Ben took Care of Magical Creatures , Arithmancy and the Muggle Studies as electives.
During the 1986-1987 school year , Ben helped Jacob's sibling, who was helping Rubeus Hagrid , look for Fang in the Artefact Room .
Ben discovered the Marauder's puzzle hidden within the walls of the Gryffindor common room and asked Jacob's sibling for help in solving it.

Together the pair collected bursting mushrooms , wartcap powder , Salamander blood , and brewed a Fire Protection Potion before finally placing the parchment containing the Marauder's puzzle into the Gryffindor common room fireplace to complete the puzzle.
Around Hallowe'en this year, Ben helped Jacob's sibling investigate the Pumpkin Johnny attacks after getting into an argument with Merula about whether or not pumpkins could be scary.
Ben Copper disguised as R's messenger

During the 1987-1988 school year , Ben sent a fake letter to Jacob's sibling telling them to meet Silvanus Kettleburn , which was actually a bait to lure them to the Courtyard , where, while wearing a red cloak and using a Disillusionment Charm to conceal his face, attacked them with the Full Body-Bind Curse and told them to stay away from the Cursed Vaults , the Forbidden Forest and Patricia Rakepick , further adding that "death is coming to Hogwarts" and that may come to them as well if they disobey.
He then told them that someone would eventually remove the binding curse, but it is unknown who did so.
After freed, Jacob's sibling only told about this incident to a few friends.
Ben Copper exposed as the cloaked figure in red
He later confronted Jacob's sibling in the Courtyard when they were about to go meet Hagrid before heading to the Forest Vault .

He told them that "death" had come for them and duelled them, gaining the upper hand before being prevented from killing Jacob's sibling by Madam Rakepick who knocked Ben back with the Blasting Curse , before Jacob's sibling removed the Disillusionment Charm hiding Ben's face with the General Counter-Spell , exposing him to his shocked friend.
He claimed he could not remember anything and claimed to Jacob's sibling that he would never attack them.

Jacob's sibling then told Madam Rakepick to send him to either Madam Pomfrey in the Hospital Wing, Argus Filch or to the Headmaster's Office to let Headmaster Dumbledore found out the truth before going off to meet Hagrid.
Ben bravely duelling Patricia Rakepick in the Forbidden Forest
After Patricia Rakepick 's unforgivable betrayal in the Buried Vault , a new Ben Copper was reborn.
He wanted to became protector not protectee, so in the summer vacations he tried so hard to not be the old coward Ben, so he became more "Foolish" than "Fearless".
As he admitted, his parents just might have been afraid of him.
His recklessness might have been a reason of Rowan Khanna 's death by the hands of the evil dark witch, Rakepick.

Sometime during the 1989-1990 school year , Ben, along with Jacob's sibling and Merula Snyde , went into the Forest Grove to intercept a possible meeting between Jacob and R , unknowingly being followed from a close distance behind them by their friend, Rowan Khanna .
During the search, a swarm of Dementors showed up, and circled the group.
The three began to cast Patronuses , but they were unsuccessful, as there were too many Dementors.
The Dark Witch Patricia Rakepick then Apparated into the vicinity and cast a powerful Patronus Charm, which warded off all of the dementors.
She then engaged in a duel with the students, which was watched by Rowan.
At some point in the duel, she cast a Killing Curse at Ben, intending to kill him.
However, Rowan sacrificed their life by jumping in front of Ben, ending their life and saving those of their friends.
Ben greatly grieved over the loss, prompting him to want to join Jacob's sibling and Merula in forming an organisation to combat R .
The three then created the group and met up with members in the Hog's Head Inn , where Ben suggested " Circle of Khanna " as a group name, which was agreed upon by the group.
Following the formation of the group, Ben tirelessly worked to improve his skills in combat, greatly wanting to avenge Rowan by fighting R.
During the 1990-1991 school year , his seventh-year , Ben continued studying Muggle Studies with Professor Sikander as the subject's new teacher.

Later in the year, Jacob's sibling found him in Flourish and Blotts , where he was there studying for his upcoming N.E.W.T.s and to remember Rowan Khanna, whom he still missed dearly, as they loved going to the bookshop.
After Hogwarts (1991-)

Soon after graduating from Hogwarts, he was employed at the Magical Congress of the United States of America , training to become an Obliviator in the Federal Bureau of Covert Vigilance and No-Maj Obliviation .
Personality and traits
Ben was very insecure about his capabilities.
He also feared that people would judge him because of his Muggle-born status.
It is also shown that his nervousness is his greatest hold back with his magic, since he was able to completely trounce, and almost kill, Jacob's sibling while not even thinking about it.
Late in his fifth year, Ben got a desire to be more brave.
In his sixth year, Ben had a notable change in personality.
He was no longer openly scared of everything and considered himself to be a better person than before.
He also saw himself as more grown-up, not attending the Start-of-Term Feast because he considered it to be for kids.

Ultimately, however, the real reason behind his change of personality was to protect his friends, even if he became distant towards them and focused more on his training, and he showed how much he cared for them when he bravely fought Rakepick and stood up even after being knocked down to protect Jacob's sibling and Merula to the point that Rakepick acknowledged how far Ben had grew and proved himself a true Gryffindor.
He was devastated by Rowan's death to the point of being left numb and even more determined to improve his skills to protect his remaining friends.
Magical abilities and skills
While noted for his gift in charms, Ben Copper was seldom counted among one of the more powerful or skilful students in Jacob's sibling's band of friends, let alone at Hogwarts as a whole.

It would turn out, however, that only his lack of confidence held him back, seen as how Ben, when not restricted by it, used magic far beyond his educational level, being able to defeat Jacob's sibling, a powerful witch or wizard themselves for their age in a duel to the death and likely would, if not for the timely (perhaps planned) arrival of Patricia Rakepick, have killed them.

title: Hrithvi Sharma
paragraphs: Hrithvi Sharma was a Muggle-born witch who attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the early 2010s .
She also worked in Zonko's Joke Shop .
Biography
Hrithvi was born in the non-magic world to Muggle parents.
When she was growing up, she liked to prank her younger brother in the bath.
However, before she knew about magic , she had to be more creative with her pranks.
After finding out she was a witch at the age of eleven, she thought those who grew up in the wizarding world were very lucky.
She attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and was Sorted into Hufflepuff house.
At some point, she accidentally set off a dungbomb in the Great Hall , resulting in dinner having to be moved to the courtyard .
She received detention for two weeks, but she thought it was almost worth it because of the look on Argus Filch 's face.
In December 2010 , Hrithvi spoke to a student outside of Zonko's, wondering if they were interested in buying something there for levity like other customers.
The student wondered if that was because of the supposed werewolf problem in the village.
Hrithvi agreed with them, but she didn't think there were any werewolves in the village outside of a few strays howling at night.
When Robyn Thistlethwaite accidentally set off dungbombs in Zonko's while talking to Bilton Bilmes and created a mess, Hrithvi barred her.
She later noticed her in the shop, under the Disillusionment Charm in an attempt to make herself invisible, after she triggered Ever-Bashing Boomerangs into action.
She told Robyn if she had known how much she would buy in the shop, she wouldn't have barred her.
When Robyn asked for a discount, Hrithvi told her she would absolutely not be getting one.
Etymology
Hrithvi is a name of Indian origin meaning right guidance, happy, and scholar.
Notes and references

title: Eunon Blackwood
paragraphs: Eunon Blackwood (né Wood ) (fl.
15th century ) was a Muggle-born Dark wizard and horticulturalist responsible for planting hedge mazes throughout the Highlands of Scotland .
Biography
Eunon Wood was born into a Muggle branch of the Wood family , but his magical ability was misunderstood by his Muggle parents , both impressing yet infuriating them.
He joined the family trade of hedge trimming, where he was able to control blackthorn bushes with his mind and create beautiful designs with ease.
He attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , where he was Sorted into Hufflepuff house.
There, he met Artemisia Black , a disowned member of the Noble and Most Ancient House of Black .
Their life was discussed in A Horticultural History of the Blackwood Maze , Part One .
Artemisia played a pivotal role in Eunon's growth as a wizard, but also his descent into darkness.

They both fed off of each other's disdain toward Muggles , and as Eunon changed, so did his work: the hedges he nurtured grew "vicious and volatile" according to A Horticultural History of the Blackwood Maze, Part Two .
Eventually the pair were wed in what is described as a curious affair, as Artemisia's Muggle father and Eunon's Muggle family were in attendance.

It is said that his family would have avoided the wedding if not for rumours of Artemisia's large dowry, which unbeknownst to them only consisted of a single golden medallion bewitched with the Gemino curse .

According to A Horticultural History of the Blackwood Maze, Part Three , to celebrate his union with Artemisia, Eunon erected the most magnificent maze he ever created, claimed to have been inspired by the Greek wizard Daedalus .
All who attended the wedding were invited to venture into the maze in search of riches ostensibly hidden within.
According to legend, witches and wizards who attended the wedding recognised something in Eunon and stayed back.
Those who entered did not return, but the terror of Eunon's creation did not end there.
Thousands of Scottish Muggles were lost in the Blackwood maze over the years that followed, blissfully unaware of magic and blinded by the greed induced by the promise of gold .
As a twist of fate, they gave birth to a daughter, Lysandra , who turned out to be a Squib .
After a violent dispute with her mother, the sixteen-year-old denounced her to Muggle witch-hunters who burned Artemisia at the stake.
Following her death, both Eunon and Lysandra mysteriously disappeared as well as the labyrinth from their house of Stonehaven , although Eunon's creation sometimes reappeared randomly.

title: Johannes Jonker
paragraphs: Johannes Jonker was an American No-Maj born wizard .
He, along with Shikoba Wolfe , Thiago Quintana , and Violetta Beauvais , was one of four wandmakers who served North America in the early 20th century .
Biography
Jonker was born to No-Maj parents .
His father was a successful cabinet maker, which presumably gave him early experience with wood-working, and allowed him to become a skilled wandmaker in his own right.
Jonker's wands were in great demand and could be easily identified by the mother-of-pearl inlay they typically contained.
Jonker experimented with several different wand cores before settling on hair of the Wampus cat as his preferred kind.
By 1926 , he was a known wandmaker and listed on the Magical Congress of the United States of America 's Wand permit application form .

title: Garrick Ollivander's mother
paragraphs: Mrs Ollivander was a Muggle-born witch .
With her husband , she had at least one child, Garrick , who inherited the family's ancient wand -making business in Diagon Alley .
Notes and references

title: Haywood sisters' mother
paragraphs: Mrs Haywood was a Muggle-born witch .
She presumably married a Muggle man , and had at least two children, Penny and Beatrice Haywood bringing them up with a knowledge of both the wizarding and Muggle worlds.
Most of what Jacob's sibling knows about her is learned from Penny with at least one fact learned from Beatrice.
She took her husband flying on a broomstick once, which scared him too much to try again.
Once, her daughters snuck a Knarl home, and she discovered it and was not pleased.
During her daughters' childhood, she would take them to a pumpkin patch every October.
She was very afraid of Lord Voldemort and would still cast protective enchantments daily even after the end of the First Wizarding War .

During the 1988-1989 school year after Beatrice disappeared and was found trapped in a portrait within her first few days at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , she along with her husband were upset about it and considered withdrawing Penny from Hogwarts.
Her relationship with Beatrice appeared to be affected after her personality changed, in the aftermath of her ordeal, which led her to think her daughter was going through a phase.

title: Kevin Entwhistle
paragraphs: Kevin Entwhistle (c. 1980 ) was a Muggle-born wizard who began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1991 .
He was in the same year as Harry Potter and was Sorted into either Hufflepuff or Ravenclaw house.
