title: Full Body-Bind Curse
paragraphs: The Full Body-Bind Curse ( Petrificus Totalus ), also known as the Body Freezing Spell , was a curse that temporarily paralysed the opponent.
It was often used by inexperienced or young wizards and witches in duelling .
This curse could be found in Curses and Counter-Curses by Vindictus Viridian .
History
During the 1986-1987 school year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , Professor Filius Flitwick taught his third-years how to cast this particular spell in Charms class .
Effects
An individual paralysed with this curse
When used on a living subject, the victim's arms and legs snapped together, and they would fall down, stiff as a board.
However, the person's abilities to hear, see (albeit just straight forward), feel, and think still worked properly.
Technically, the spell also worked on inanimate objects, but its effects were usually imperceptible, because the object was not moving in the first place.
The effects of the Full-Body Bind Curse could be undone by use of the General Counter-Spell , the healing spell Episkey , an Anti-Paralysis Potion or the Reparifors spell.
The effects can also be undone by the death of the caster.
Despite the incantation , the Full Body-Bind Curse was fundamentally different from Petrification , which was highly advanced Dark Magic and which could not be reversed by a simple counter-curse .

A sufficiently powerful witch or wizard could use a single cast of this charm to freeze multiple opponents, as was demonstrated when Jules Egwu froze Diego Caplan and two other students whilst participating in a three-on-three duel alongside Jacob's sibling and Nymphadora Tonks .
Harry Potter also demonstrated this against the Inferi, toppling six or seven at once.
Known uses
Successful
Unsuccessful
Known practitioners
Etymology
The root of this curse's incantation seems to be the Latin words petra , "rock", ficus , "making or doing something" and totus , "whole" or "entire".
Also, pertrificus seems to come from the word "petrify", meaning to turn into stone, or describes a manner in which someone takes on the characteristics of a stone.
Totalus likely comes from "Total", meaning complete or wholly.
Following this, the spell likely means, entirely petrify .
Notes and references

title: Hardening Charm
paragraphs: The Hardening Charm ( Duro ) was a charm that turned an object to stone.
History
During the 1986-1987 school year , the Hardening Charm was taught to third-year students in Transfiguration class at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
Jacob's sibling briefly used this spell on a Jumbo Dungbomb , as a part of Tulip Karasu 's plan to prank on Merula Snyde , Barnaby Lee , and Ismelda Murk .
The spell was mentioned on the 1990-1991 school year N.E.W.Ts .

During the Battle of Hogwarts on 2 May 1998 , Hermione Granger cast this spell at a tapestry, turning it into stone and wounding the two Death Eaters who were pursuing her, Harry Potter , and Ron Weasley .
Known practitioners
Etymology
Duro is Latin for "I harden" or "I stiffen"; the same term is Spanish and Portuguese for "hard" or "rough"; it makes sense given J. K. Rowling's relation to the language.
Notes and references

title: Transformation
paragraphs: Transformation or Transubstantial Transfiguration was the name given to a branch of Transfiguration that focused on altering the physical features of an object.
It is not to be confused with Trans-Species Transformation , though that was a type of transformation.
Nature

Transformation was the first branch of Transfiguration that students would learn at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , beginning with the match to needle spell in the first year and progressing from there.

Transformation contained the following sub-groups, all of which overlapped with each other to varying degrees: Human Transfiguration , defined by and named for the target being a human being; Switches , which simultaneously exchanged features between organism; and the aforementioned Trans-Species Transformations , which referred to transformations that changed organisms from one species to another.
Danger
A poorly performed Transfiguration spell, in which the object if half-transformed
Due to the applied, precise nature of Transfiguration magic, there was a large potential for it to go disastrously wrong, even for the experts.

If transformation was done improperly, the Transfigured object could become half-Transfigured or permanently stuck in one state (whether fully or partially Transfigured); for example, Viktor Krum half-Transfigured himself once into a shark in the Second Task of The Triwizard Tournament in 1994 (although he was not stuck in that form, so it may have been intentional).
Methods
Transformation could be achieved in a number of different ways, namely: Transforming Spells , Animagi , Metamorphmagi , and Lycanthropy .
Transforming spells
Known practitioners
Notes and references

title: Transmogrifian Torture
paragraphs: The Transmogrifian Torture ( incantation unknown ) was a curse which presumably tortured its victims to death overtime.
History
On 31 October 1992 , Professor Gilderoy Lockhart claimed that this was the curse that must have killed Mrs Norris , before it was revealed that she had only been petrified .
Etymology

Transmogrifian comes from the English " transmogrify ", meaning "to change or alter greatly, often to grotesque effect", possibly implying that the curse changes the shape of the victim to cause pain.
Notes and references

title: Human
paragraphs: Human is a term referring to a species, for which the Latin name is Homo sapiens , which are omnivorous beings that originated in Africa .

In the wizarding world , human groups consisted of wizards and witches , Squibs and Muggles and some humans had children with non-human beings such as Veela , giants , and goblins , producing half-breeds .
These half-breeds were looked down upon by some people.
Description
Humans come in various shapes and sizes, and are one of the most variable species in the world in terms of physique.
They are also claimed to be the most intelligent beings on Earth.
In Christianity , it was believed that all of humans are descendants of Adda , the first human.
Physical description
Humans can be distinguished in terms of physical appearance, based on their appearance differences range in terms of:
Categories
In the wizarding world , humans were usually placed in one of these categories based on whether they can use magic or not:
Special authorities
Permission to carry a wand
Humans, unlike other magical species, were allowed to carry wands.
The British Ministry of Magic 's logo - a symbol of the authority of humans
Non-human species were not permitted by the British Ministry of Magic to carry wands .
This led to Barty Crouch Snr 's house-elf Winky being freed, and started much aggression between goblins and humans over the rights to use wands.
Why only humans reserved the right to own a wand is unknown.
Humans were the only beings that were known to create wands.
This is similar to how goblins were the only beings that could make true impenetrable armour or weapons, such as Godric Gryffindor's Sword .
It is unknown if there were any dangers of non-humans carrying a wand, since Muggles were known not to be able to use wands, due to the fact that they had no magical power to channel through it.
Knowingly giving a wand to a Muggle would likely violate the International Statute of Wizarding Secrecy .
Ministry of Magic
As humans were supposedly the smartest race in the world, they claimed rights over all magic laws.
These were created and enforced by the Ministries of Magic of various magical countries around the world.
Here, human wizards and witches had authority over all other beings .
Variations
Part-Veela Fleur Delacour
In the wizarding world, many variations of humans existed, (often known as half-breeds ) and many of them were the result of a human having a child with a non-human parent.
They were permitted to carry wands and practise human-based magic, despite part of their heritage being non-human.
Variations of part-humans included:
Notes and references

title: Cockatrice
paragraphs: A cockatrice was a magical creature , resembling a rooster with a lizard 's tail.
History
During the 1792 Triwizard Tournament , one of the tasks involved capturing a cockatrice.
Unfortunately, the cockatrice broke free, and went on a rampage that injured the Heads of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , Beauxbatons Academy of Magic , and the Durmstrang Institute .
The incident led to the cancellation of the Triwizard Tournament until its revival in 1994 .
By the 1990s , the French National Quidditch team emblem sported a white cockatrice holding a broomstick on a blue and beige background.
Etymology
The cockatrice takes its name from both cock (rooster) and crocodile (old French, cocatris ).
Notes and references

title: Poppy Pomfrey
paragraphs: Madam Poppy Pomfrey was a British or Irish witch and the matron at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
She was a very competent Healer , having been in the position for, at least, the last quarter of the 20th century .

Madam Pomfrey was very possessive of the patients in her care while in the Hospital Wing , and their visitors upset her somewhat, as she frequently insisted they must rest and demanded the visitors leave.
She was proficient in her area of expertise ( healing magic ) and able to take care of some ailments " in a heartbeat ".

She fought in the Battle of Hogwarts , the final battle of the Second Wizarding War , during which she personally dispatched at least one Death Eater in a duel, and was seen after the battle treating the wounded and attending to the dead.
Not much is known about Madam Pomfrey's life after the final battle.
By 2014 , she had retired or was thinking of retiring, since Hannah Abbott reportedly applied for the position of Matron at Hogwarts.
Regardless, either because she did not retire or because she was pulled out of retirement, Madam Pomfrey was working at Hogwarts in 2020 .
Biography
Matron at Hogwarts

Madam Pomfrey began her career at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry sometime before 1971 , being trusted in that year by Headmaster Albus Dumbledore to escort new Gryffindor student Remus Lupin , who was infected with lycanthropy due to a bite from Fenrir Greyback , to the Whomping Willow every full moon.
At some point before 1 November 1981 , Madam Pomfrey complimented Dumbledore on a set of earmuffs he had recently acquired.
The compliment made him blush in such a manner that would only be rivalled when Professor McGonagall compared his magical prowess favourably against those of Voldemort .
Jacob's sibling approaching Madam Pomfrey in the Hospital Wing

During the 1985-1986 school year , in addition to treating Ben Copper , Rowan Khanna , and Bill Weasley , all of whom at various times throughout the year was injured by the cursed ice spreading throughout the castle, an assortment of injuries caused by Quidditch , duelling , classroom accidents, and general clumsiness, including a student transfigured into a teapot , kept Pomfrey very busy.
The same year, she asked a student to be her assistant, impressed with their bedside manner when Ben, their friend, was injured.
Some of the duties she tasked said assistant with was researching sleepwalking and and fixing relatively minor injuries in a heartbeat using Episkey , a spell she asked them to learn earlier.
During the 1987-1988 school year , in addition to caring for students stricken by the sleepwalking curse , Madam Pomfrey took time to teach her assistant the Bandaging Charm .
In the next school year , treated an injured Rowan Khanna in the Hospital Wing, who had fallen victim to the Imperius Curse , much to her correct assumption.
She explained the nature of the curse to her assistant during their visit, while Professor Rakepick and Professor Snape were too present.
Following an argument between the two rival Professors , she told the two of them to take their arguing outside like bickering children.

Towards the end of the school year, when her assistant and their friends arrived in the Great Hall via Portkey following their expedition into the Buried Vault , Madam Pomfrey took a severely injured Merula Snyde up to the Hospital Wing, as she had been tortured with Rakepick's Cruciatus Curse .
Madam Pomfrey petrified by the statue curse
During the 1989-1990 school year , Poppy Pomfrey dedicated much of her time treating two students who had been petrified as a result of the statue curse as well as treating other students.
She had help from a few students, including Chiara Lobosca and Cedric Diggory .
At some point during the school year, Madam Pomfrey herself was petrified.
Eventually, by 1991, she was cured and continued to be the matron at Hogwarts.

During the 1990-1991 school year , an infestation of doxies swarmed Hogwarts Castle and left many students bitten with venomous doxy bites, making them seek treatment in the Hospital Wing, where Madam Pomfrey cared for them.

As Madam Pomfrey and the Hospital Wing were overwhelmed with students suffering from doxy bites, she enlisted her assistant and the help of some seventh-year students to help her look after the injured students: Chiara Lobosca , Victor Ketsueki and Penny Haywood .
The assistant later helped Madam Pomfrey treat a student with stomach ache in the Hosptial Wing as part of their assignment in learning how to become a Healer with St Mungo's .
In 1991 , Madam Pomfrey was able to mend Neville Longbottom 's broken arm in "about a minute" after he had injured himself during Flying class .
In 1992 , Ron Weasley was required to go to Madam Pomfrey after visiting Rubeus Hagrid and being bitten by the dragon Norberta .
Ron told her that he had been bitten by a dog, but Madam Pomfrey had doubts about his honesty due to the unusual colour of the purple, green, and black wound.
However, she did not press him and treated him regardless.
Madam Pomfrey with first-year Harry Potter at the Hospital Wing

Later on in the year, after Harry Potter fought Professor Quirrell in the Hogwarts dungeons for possession of the Philosopher's Stone , he spent three days unconscious in the hospital wing under Madam Pomfrey's care.

She was reluctant for Harry to have any visitors, even Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger , as she thought that Harry needed bed rest, but she allowed headmaster Albus Dumbledore to visit Harry time to time, saying that the reason he was allowed to visit was because he was the Headmaster.
Pomfrey seeing to an injured Harry Potter after a disastrous Quidditch match
In 1992, Madam Pomfrey administered Skele-Gro on Harry to regrow the bones in his arm after Gilderoy Lockhart 's attempt to fix a Quidditch-caused broken bone failed disastrously.

Pomfrey was annoyed that Harry had not been brought straight to her in the first place, as re-growing bones is a much more difficult task than mending bones, which she claimed she could do "in a heartbeat".

In the same year, Hermione Granger ended up in the hospital wing for a month after an accident in an unauthorised high-level Potion-making ( Polyjuice Potion ) left her half-feline; apparently the group felt comfortable letting Madam Pomfrey to treat her since she would not ask too many questions and just get on with the job in hand.
Hermione was allowed visitors, but it bothered Madam Pomfrey somewhat.
Madam Pomfrey attending Hermione Granger's bedside after she was Petrified
Hogwarts was also facing potential closure as a monster had been attacking Muggle-born students around the school and Petrifying them as a result.

It was Madam Pomfrey's job to make sure that these students were found and treated to the best of her ability, though she could not cure students without Pomona Sprout 's Mandrake Restorative Draught , which took weeks to brew.
She refused to allow any students to visit the victims, in fear of the attacker returning to finish them, but allowed Harry and Ron to visit Hermione with Professor McGonagall 's permission.
Dumbledore, Pomfrey and Sprout at the End-of-Term Feast
Eventually, they managed to get the potion made and cured the victims - Hermione Granger, Colin Creevey , Penelope Clearwater , Justin Finch-Fletchley , Nearly Headless Nick , and Mrs Norris .

At the end of the year, Madam Pomfrey and Professor Sprout sat at the staff table and Albus Dumbledore asked the whole school to thank them both for their efforts in helping all petrified students, as well as applauding in Lockhart's departure and Hagrid's return.
Pomfrey and Pomona Sprout seated at the High Table in the Great Hall

During the 1993-1994 school year , Hogwarts found itself under the questionable protection of the Dementors of Azkaban , horrible creatures whose mere presence was enough to induce the worst feelings and sensations in people.

When one took it upon itself to inspect the Hogwarts Express for the escaped criminal Sirius Black , it caused many students great distress and actually caused Harry Potter to pass out due to recalling his mother's death.
Madam Pomfrey was summoned to Minerva McGonagall's office to see if Harry was alright and administer treatment.

While inspecting the boy, she exchanged a significant look with Professor McGonagall and expressed her disapproval of setting Dementors around the school, anticipating many more collapses all over the place due to the effect they had on people, particularly those who were 'delicate'.
Madam Pomfrey recommended some chocolate , but was surprised and very pleased to hear that he had already been given some by the new Defence Against the Dark Arts professor, Remus Lupin .

During the 1993 Quidditch match between Gryffindor and Hufflepuff , Madam Pomfrey tended to the injured, including Harry Potter, who fell over fifty feet due to Dementors being on the pitch, a Hufflepuff team member, and Angelina Johnson who was injured after the tail of her broomstick caught fire .
At the end of 1994, Harry, Ron, and Hermione all had endured injuries following the events that took place when Sirius Black returned to Hogwarts and revealed Peter Pettigrew to be alive.
The three all woke up in the hospital wing, Ron having broken his leg, and both Harry and Hermione having passed out from the Dementor attack, along with Sirius Black.
Madam Pomfrey was not surprised to have the three in her care again.
Pomfrey with fellow staff members in the Great Hall
Whilst in the Hospital Wing, Hermione, at Dumbledore's hint, used her Time-Turner to go back in time with Harry to three hours previously.
They rescued Sirius Black on Buckbeak the hippogriff to prevent him from being administered the Dementor's Kiss .
They managed to get back in time without Madam Pomfrey realising what they had done, something that would have caused dire consequences.

Madam Pomfrey also spoke approvingly of Remus Lupin's use of chocolate to relieve the effects of a Dementor's presence on students, commenting that Hogwarts has " finally got a Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher who knows his remedies ", as the previous DADA predecessors were not particularly good teachers with any real expertise.
When several students, including Fred and George Weasley , S. Fawcett , and Summers " decided to age themselves up a little " in order to be eligible to enter the 1994 Triwizard Tournament .
Madam Pomfrey subsequently had to remove the beards which they had grown in attempting to cross Dumbledore's Age Line .
She was most annoyed by the students actions and treated them with regret.
She felt that the Triwizard Tournament would bring the school nothing but grief.

During the same school year, it was Madam Pomfrey's job to tend to the injuries that the four Triwizard Champions - Harry Potter, Viktor Krum , Fleur Delacour , and Cedric Diggory - received during the course of the tournament, and expressed distaste for the dragons for the first task.
Snape using his Dark Mark as proof that Voldemort had returned
She was also responsible for later taking the body of Cedric Diggory to the Hospital Wing after he had been murdered by Peter Pettigrew under the order of Lord Voldemort during the last task.

Later, after being questioned by Albus Dumbledore on the details of the incident, Harry was sent to the hospital where Madam Pomfrey prescribed a Dreamless Sleep Potion for him, in order for him to get some rest.

Madam Pomfrey was also present when Minister for Magic Cornelius Fudge visited the wing; the Minister refused to believe that Voldemort returned, causing ex- Death Eater Professor Snape to reveal his restored Dark Mark as proof.
Second Wizarding War
In 1996, Hogwarts was under the control of the Ministry .
Albus Dumbledore had escaped after facing potential imprisonment in Azkaban and Dolores Umbridge had taken over as Headmistress.

Minerva McGonagall , Madam Pomfrey's close friend, was hit by four Stunning Spells to the chest by Aurors while Umbridge was trying to sack and remove Hagrid from Hogwarts, very nearly killing her in the process.
Madam Pomfrey was deeply shocked by this attack and was unable to help McGonagall.
She transferred her to St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries where she could receive better treatment by qualified healers.

Also, after the Dumbledore's Army 's traitor, Marietta Edgecombe , was struck with Hermione Granger's Dumbledore's Army parchment jinx , Madam Pomfrey could not do the slightest in improving the pustules instilled on Marietta's face.
Marietta was stuck with this reminder of her betrayal into the next school year, where not even a heavy layer of makeup could fully obscure the marks.

That school year, she also healed Alicia Spinnet 's eyebrows after they were jinxed by Miles Bletchley , and also administered a Calming Draught to Hannah Abbott after she had burst into tears during a Herbology class over anxiety surrounding her upcoming O.W.L.s .
Madam Pomfrey considered resigning in protest after the attack on McGonagall, but did not as she cared and feared for the students too much.

She subsequently helped treat the assorted injuries that Luna Lovegood , Neville Longbottom , Ginny Weasley , Hermione Granger, and Ron Weasley sustained during the battle in the Department of Mysteries , including a broken ankle, broken nose, and the effects of an unknown curse on Hermione, which if cast verbally could have been fatal.
She also cared for Umbridge at this time in the hospital wing, who was very shaken after nearly being killed by Centaurs after a skimrish with them in the Forbidden Forest .
In 1997, Madam Pomfrey examined Katie Bell after she had been cursed by an Opal Necklace .
She could not help Bell and transferred her to St Mungo's for specialist treatment.
Poppy attending to Ron Weasley after he was poisoned
Madam Pomfrey later tended to Ron after he had almost been poisoned after drinking a glass of mead , which had been laced by Draco Malfoy in an attempt to kill Dumbledore.

She also helped Harry after his skull was cracked open by a Bludger which had been hit by Cormac McLaggen (whom she had presumably treated when he foolishly ate a pound of toxic Doxy eggs the previous year) during a Quidditch match; the injury was mended in an instant, but she kept him in overnight so as to ensure he did not undergo anything strenuous, which included taking revenge on McLaggen for his actions.
She also treated Draco Malfoy after he was struck by Harry's Sectumsempra curse , shortly after Severus Snape gave the victim emergency treatment before bringing him to the matron.
Poppy raising her wand with students
Later in the year, the Death Eaters attacked Hogwarts.
Several students and Aurors were caught up in the Battle of the Astronomy Tower , a battle which resulted in the death of headmaster Albus Dumbledore.

Madam Pomfrey tended to the wounds and injuries of those in the battle; Bill Weasley was injured the worst of all, as werewolf Fenrir Greyback in human form had savaged and bitten him, causing Bill to be badly scarred.
Madam Pomfrey noted that there is no cure for werewolf bites and scars.

Lupin, being a werewolf himself, assumed that Bill would not take the form of a true werewolf since he might not be entirely infected with Lycanthropy due to Greyback being in a human form when the attack happened, though he could develop lupine qualities.
Since it was an unique case, neither Madam Pomfrey nor the others knew what would become of Bill when he awoke.
When he woke up, the only change was that he developed a liking for raw meat.
The funeral of Albus Dumbledore
Shortly afterwards, Madam Pomfrey was one of the hundreds of witches and wizards who attended the Funeral of Albus Dumbledore .
During the funeral she paid her respects to the passing of a great wizard, friend, and colleague.
She was devastated by his death, being brought to tears after Harry Potter told her of his demise at the hands of former colleague and DADA teacher Severus Snape .
Madam Pomfrey and others were shocked after seeing Harry's "dead" body
Following the death of former headmaster Albus Dumbledore, Lord Voldemort took control of Hogwarts and the Ministry of Magic .

He had appointed Severus Snape as Headmaster, along with cruel Death Eaters Amycus and Alecto Carrow as Defence Against the Dark Arts (renamed simply Dark Arts) and Muggle Studies professors respectively.
Detentions and punishments imposed on students by the Carrows were severe.
Students were noted to be in and out of the Hospital Wing often.
In particular, Seamus Finnigan 's face was unrecognisable with bruises.
Pomfrey witnessing Harry Potter's final defeat of Lord Voldemort and the end of the Second Wizarding War
Later on in the year, Harry, Ron, and Hermione returned to Hogwarts in search of the final Horcrux in Hogwarts, triggering a battle.
Before the battle started, she and Argus Filch were tasked with the evacuation of students from the castle by Minerva McGonagall .

The staff and students defended the school against Voldemort and his Death Eater army bravely whilst Harry searched for the Horcrux, with Poppy herself engaging and defeating a female Death Eater in the Great Hall.
During the battle's one hour-armistice, Pomfrey attended to the injuries of the wounded and also the dead in the Great Hall .
At the end of the Battle of Hogwarts , many students and staff alike were injured or dead.
After the battle, Madam Pomfrey tended to all the wounded.
Later life
After the battle, Madam Pomfrey continued her work at Hogwarts.

In the 2010-2011 school year , she cared for Neville Longbottom, who had become a professor of Herbology at Hogwarts, as well as a Slytherin girl, Cassandra Vole , who was infected by the Mysterious Malady .
In the following school year , when Kevin Farrell was injured by Viggo Victor during the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup , he was taken to the Hospital Wing to be cared for by Pomfrey.

Later, following the competition, Gawrloc , the half-giant who served as the final obstacle in the last challenge held in the Forbidden Forest , was also brought under Pomfrey's care after being injured by the competitors.
By 2014 , Madam Pomfrey had retired or was thinking of retiring, since Hannah Abbott reportedly applied for the position of Matron at Hogwarts.

In 2019 , during the Calamity , she assisted prospective members of the then recently established Statute of Secrecy Task Force seeking a career as either a Magizoologist or a Professor , whom she taught a rudimentary variation of the Mending Charm , hoping it would help them in the field.
Eventually, she would later teach the same members some advanced concepts relating to this spell, allowing them to improve its effectiveness.

She also instructed them how to refine the Reviving Charm they learned from Rosmerta and, upon being helped in tending to a student with a painful Quidditch injury, gave them practical advice on pain management to be applied to increase resilience.
Regardless, either because she decided not to leave or because she ended her retirement, she was working at Hogwarts in 2020 .

In an alternate reality created when Albus Potter travelled back in time to 1994 and broke his arm in the process, Madame Pomfrey placed him in an induced sleep for twenty-four hours so that the arm could be reset.
Unsure of what else to prescribe, she recommended eating lots of chocolate .
Personality and traits
Madam Pomfrey was described by her students as being exceptionally kind, but even more so strict.
She was very obsessive, lining up her patients' sweet boxes in neat rows, and was intensely worried about all of the students under her care, believing even feasts to be risky.
Working in a school where magical accidents were almost an undeniable certainty, she appeared to have resigned herself to treating whoever came her way.
Indeed, she never asked questions about how her patients received their ailments or questioning the sometimes ludicrous stories they told her, but instead immediately set to fixing them up.
She had a tendency to burst into tears at moments where great sorrow was appropriate, but she was capable of controlling herself if need be.

She also has her standards and loyalty, as she would have resigned in protest when Minerva McGonagall was shot down by four Stunning Spells from a cowardly Ministry attack, were she not worried for the students.
Relationships
Hogwarts professors
Poppy raising her wand with students
She appeared to have a good friendship with Albus Dumbledore , the Headmaster of Hogwarts.
She was apparently in immense grief at the wand raising after Dumbledore's death.
Madam Pomfrey seemed to be comfortable around Minerva McGonagall , the Deputy Headmistress , too.
Madam Pomfrey and Professor Sprout worked together to help the petrified students.
She had known Remus Lupin since he was a student and continued to have a good relationship with him when he returned to teach in the 1993-1994 school year .
Magical abilities and skills
Possessions
Pomfrey's wand
Etymology
Notes and references

title: Ireland
paragraphs: Ireland is an island in the northern Atlantic Ocean located off of the western coast of Great Britain .
Magical government
The political boundaries and governance of Ireland in the wizarding world were uncertain.
It may have been a single political entity under the jurisdiction of the British Ministry of Magic .
A delegate from Ireland was a member of the International Confederation of Wizards , and participated in the meeting held at the Magical Congress of the United States of America on 6 December 1926 .
Magical education
In the early Middle Ages, Maeve , a witch queen, taught several young witches and wizards in the magical arts.
Later, Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry was founded in Scotland, and Irish witches and wizards were accepted there.
Magical sports and games
Quidditch
One of the ancient broom games played before the climax of the evolution of Quidditch , Aingingein flourished in Ireland.
The game became the subject of many Irish ballads in which Fingal the Fearless took a significant role (being alleged champion of the game).

Modern game of Quidditch was well established in 14th century in Ireland which is proven by Zacharias Mumps 's account - he describes the game between the Irish from Cork and Englishmen from Lancashire , in which Irish team demonstrates tricks with Quaffle at that time unknown in England and beats the English soundly.
In 1994 , the Irish National Quidditch team won the 422nd Quidditch World Cup , defeating the Bulgarian National Quidditch team in the final match.

title: Matron
paragraphs: Cole , the Wool's Orphanage matron in the 1930s
A matron was a woman responsible for the care and supervision of others, particularly in institutional settings such as schools, hospitals, or boarding houses.

In both the wizarding and Muggle worlds, a matron's duties typically included overseeing the health, well-being, and daily routines of those under her care, providing medical assistance, and ensuring discipline and order within the institution.
Matrons were often seen as authority figures who combined administrative responsibilities with nurturing roles.
Hospital matron
The Hospital Wing at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry was run by a matron .
Orphanage matron
Wool's Orphanage
Mrs Cole was the matron at Wool's Orphanage in the 1930s .
She was present when Tom Riddle received a visit from Albus Dumbledore in 1937 , where she explained that Tom was unlike most children she knew.
Although she appeared caring, she was also very sharp in a way that could be thought as inconvenient.
Notes and references

title: Healer
paragraphs: A Healer was a qualified witch or wizard who tended to the sick and injured using healing magic .
They were the wizarding world equivalent of a Muggle doctor .

St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries (which was the primary hospital to England 's wizarding community ) was one such place where a Healer may have worked tending to the sick and injured.
Nature
Healers and Mediwizards were the wizarding world equivalent of Muggle doctors and nurses.
St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries was one of the most well known places where Healers worked.
It was founded by Healer Mungo Bonham in the 17th century .
They treated magical diseases such as Dragon Pox , spattergroit , and vanishing sickness and injuries.
Healers at St Mungo's wore lime green robes with the sign of a bone and a wand .
Healers could work in a variety of places.
At Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , there was a Hospital Wing run by the matron.
Madam Poppy Pomfrey was the matron from 1971 until at least 2014 .
Healers at Hogwarts tended to the sick and wounded at the school, but transferred anyone they did not have the resources to treat, to St Mungo's.
Healing magic
Healing magic was a branch of magic used by Healers and Mediwizards to treat the sick or wounded.
There were many different types of spells in this branch of magic, that had a variety of effects.
There were also a vast group of potions that were dedicated to healing as well.
Magical medication was also implemented and was normally related to healing potions, but things such as chocolate were also a type of medication.
Some of these described below were:
Requirements
To become a Healer, one had to have excellent academic credentials.

In Great Britain and Ireland , they needed at least five N.E.W.T.s, with a high mark of either ' Outstanding ' or ' Exceeds Expectations ' at: Potions , Transfiguration , Herbology , Charms , and Defence Against the Dark Arts .
Known Healers
Notes and references

title: Hospital Wing
paragraphs: The Hospital Wing was a part of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
It was run by Madam Poppy Pomfrey , the school's matron , from at least 1971 .
The students and staff who suffered mishaps and injuries during the school year were sent or brought to the Hospital Wing for treatment.
Poppy would prefer there be six visitors at one time for one person.
There was a room adjacent belonging to the matron.
The Hospital Wing was well equipped to deal with all kinds of magical and mundane injuries, from broken limbs to regrowing lost bones .
Only in the most severe cases were the patients sent to St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries for further treatment, such as when Katie Bell touched a cursed Opal Necklace in 1996 .
Overview
The Hospital Wing in 1992
Located on the first floor, and later one or two floors up, the Hospital Wing was where Hogwarts residents went to have their medical needs met.
Within the Hospital Wing were many rows of beds with white sheets, privacy screens, and bedpans, which Ronald Weasley once had to scrub as the result of a detention from Professor Snape .
The entrance had double doors.
Madam Pomfrey's office was part of the Hospital Wing complex.
Just outside of the Hospital Wing stood a copper statue of a unicorn over a fountain.
The fountain was said to give an air of serenity and calm to the Hospital Wing.
History
1991-1992 school year
In 1991, Ron Weasley suffered a dragon bite.
Dragons were closely monitored by the British Ministry of Magic , so Ron did not feel comfortable explaining what had bit him, but Madam Pomfrey simply treated the injury as best she could.
Ron made a full recovery.
Harry Potter's first Hospital Wing stay
In 1992, Harry woke up in the Hospital Wing following his encounter with Professor Quirrell and Voldemort.
He had a long discussion with Professor Dumbledore regarding the power of sacrificial love.
Madam Pomfrey was upset that Dumbledore had ignored her instructions, and allowed Harry to attend the Leaving Feast .
She had wanted to keep Harry a little longer for observation.
1992-1993 school year
Dumbledore visiting a Petrified Colin Creevey in the Hospital Wing
In 1992 , Harry was once again in the hospital wing overnight, this time because Lockhart had (while trying to mend his broken arm) completely removed the bones in his arm.
He was joined by Colin Creevey , who had apparently been Petrified by the monster within the Chamber of Secrets .
In 1993, Hermione ended up in the Hospital Wing because of a failed transformation using Polyjuice Potion .
Because this was a potion that's use was restricted, Hermione could not say what caused her to halfway transform into a cat, but Madam Pomfrey simply treated her.
Harry and Ron visiting Hermione in the Hospital Wing after she was Petrified
Justin Finch-Fletchley , Nearly Headless Nick , Penelope Clearwater , and Hermione ended up Petrified and were moved to the Hospital Wing.
Harry and Ron visited her during her time in the wing, often leaving flowers at her bedside.
Lockhart, who had erased his own memory due to a backfiring Memory Charm , was also taken to the Hospital Wing before being moved to St Mungo's .
1993-1994 school year
The presence of Dementors , and the effect they had on Harry, made him a repeat visitor of Madam Pomfrey's.
After an encounter with a Dementor on the Hogwarts Express Harry avoided a stay in the Hospital Wing solely because of Remus Lupin 's quick actions.
Draco Malfoy was injured in 1993 by a Hippogriff during a Care of Magical Creatures lesson.
His wound was quickly healed, but he malingered.
Malfoy also used "continuing pain" from the injury as an excuse to get others to do his work for him.
Harry in the Hospital Wing after falling off his broom due to Dementors
A flock of Dementors invaded the Quidditch pitch during a match, causing Harry to fall from an extreme height.
This resulted in a stay in the Hospital Wing for him.
The events in the Shrieking Shack also resulted in Hospital Wing visits for Harry, Ron, and Hermione.
While they were there, Dumbledore arranged for Harry and Hermione to rescue Buckbeak and Sirius Black with a time-turner .
After they completed their task and returned to the ward, Snape burst in and expressed outrage at Black's escape in front of Minister for Magic Cornelius Fudge .
During the school year, Professor Lupin appeared ill several times.
He was also absent from several lessons; students suspected that he ought to be in the Hospital Wing.
He was actually in his office during those time, as his " illness " was not something Madam Pomfrey could treat.
1994-1995 school year
Harry recovering in the Hospital Wing surrounded by his friends
Viktor Krum (the Durmstrang champion) was stunned while guarding Bartemius Crouch Snr , and was sent to Madam Pomfrey to recuperate.
Harry ended up in the Hospital Wing following the Third Task, but rather than it being related to the Tournament, it was because of his duel with Voldemort and therefore he needed to recover.
While in the Hospital Wing, Minister Fudge denied Voldemort's return, and Professor Dumbledore assigned missions to various people in order to deal with his return.
It was in the Hospital Wing that Sirius revealed himself, and was forced into a grudging alliance with Snape.
1995-1996 school year
Skiving Snackboxes from Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes (notably Puking Pastilles and Fever Fudge ) were used repeatedly by students wanting to escape Umbridge's class.
These snackboxes caused projectile vomiting and raging fever, respectively, students who used them most likely ended up in the Hospital Wing.
Early in the year, Katie Bell caught a Quaffle to the face during a Quidditch practice.
In an attempt to fix the resulting nosebleed, Fred Weasley accidentally gave her a Blood Blisterpod .
He and George shortly escorted her to the Hospital Wing.
Another student who ended up in the Hospital Wing was Montague , who had been forced into an old, broken Vanishing Cabinet and reappeared jammed into a toilet a day later.
Harry was trying to find Professor McGonagall, who had previously been hit with multiple Stunners as Umbridge attempted to dismiss Hagrid .
Madam Pomfrey, while spooning some blue potion into Montague, told Harry that Professor McGonagall had been transferred to St Mungo's .
Following the Battle of the Department of Mysteries , Hermione, Ron, Neville, Ginny, and Luna were injured and required Madam Pomfrey's ministrations.
All save Ron and Hermione were released shortly after.
Dolores Umbridge was also there for treatment, following her confrontation with the Centaurs in the Forbidden Forest .
1996-1997 school year
In 1996, Katie Bell accidentally handled a cursed necklace .
Her stay in the Hospital Wing was brief; she was injured beyond Madam Pomfrey's skill and was quickly sent to St Mungo's.
Later in the year, Ron was accidentally poisoned and ended up in the Hospital Wing for several days.
Lavender Brown complained to Harry that Ron was always asleep whenever she visited, and Ron admitted to Harry that he was doing it on purpose.
Ron in the Hospital Wing after being poisoned
Harry also ended up in the hospital wing at the same time as Ron, having received a skull fracture from a poorly aimed Bludger during a Quidditch match.
While in the Hospital Wing Harry realised he could have Kreacher tail Malfoy, something he had been trying to do himself with little success.
Snape took Malfoy to the Hospital Wing after Harry (to avoid being hit with the Cruciatus curse ) injured him with Sectumsempra .
Following the Battle of the Astronomy Tower , Aurors , members of the Order of the Phoenix , and the students who had been involved were all brought to the Hospital Wing for treatment.
Harry heard news of the battle from the five members of Dumbledore's Army who had responded to his call (Ron, Hermione, Ginny, Luna, and Neville).
While in the ward, Harry explained why Dumbledore trusted Snape, as he then understood it.

It was there that Fleur Delacour affirmed that her wedding to Bill Weasley would not be derailed by anything as trivial as a disfiguring injury, which healed the potential rift between herself and Molly , which also made Remus Lupin's objections to dating Tonks start to dissolve.
