title: Ministry of Magic
paragraphs: A Ministry of Magic was the primary governing body of the magical community in many countries.
Headed by a Minister for Magic , a Ministry of Magic was responsible for regulating and enforcing laws for the magical community, as well as keeping said community hidden from the Muggle world .

In Great Britain , at least, the term "Ministry of Magic" seemed to be synonymous with "form of wizarding government", since the term was, on occasion, loosely applied to also refer to the Wizards' Council that preceded the British Ministry .
Known countries with Ministries of Magic
Alternative magical governing bodies
There were alternative magical governing bodies known to the international magical community such as the Council of Magic , the Argentinian one being a case in point.
The Magical Congress of the United States of America was another example.
It is unknown precisely what distinguishes those magical governing bodies from a Ministry of Magic.
Notes and references

title: Amycus Carrow
paragraphs: Professor Amycus Carrow was a Dark wizard , brother of Alecto Carrow and a Death Eater .
Amycus fought in the First Wizarding War along with his sister.
They did not search for Lord Voldemort after his first downfall but were forgiven after Voldemort's return in 1995 and joined the Death Eater ranks in the Second Wizarding War .
After the fall of the Ministry of Magic in 1997 , Amycus was made the Dark Arts professor, which replaced the previous subject of Defence Against the Dark Arts .
His sister was stationed at Hogwarts as well, as the new Muggle Studies professor.
He and his sister were also made Deputy Headmasters , serving under Headmaster Severus Snape .
Together, the pair created an atmosphere of fear and cruelty towards those students they disliked, whilst allowing those whom they liked to enjoy special privileges.
In the evening of 1 May 1998 , shortly before the Battle of Hogwarts , he was tortured by Harry Potter when he spat in Professor McGonagall's face.
He was then Imperiused and tied up in Ravenclaw Tower by McGonagall herself.

After the battle, he managed to escape custody with his sister, Corban Yaxley , and Walden Macnair and briefly attempted to free Dolores Umbridge and use a Time-Turner to bring back Voldemort's regime, but was recaptured and sent to Azkaban along with the others for their crimes.
Biography
Early life
Amycus Carrow was born sometime before 1981 into the pure-blood or half-blood Carrow family , somewhere in the British Isles .
At some point before his instruction in the magical arts, he acquired a wand.
He attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in his youth and was a member of Slytherin house.
He seemed to have been acquainted with Albus Dumbledore .
First Wizarding War
A wanted poster of Amycus Carrow
Amycus and his sister supported Lord Voldemort and became Death Eaters during the First Wizarding War .
After Voldemort's downfall in 1981 , they did not search for their master, believing that Voldemort was gone forever, and managed to avoid imprisonment in Azkaban .
Despite all this, the Carrows were among those who, after Voldemort 's return , resumed their Death Eater activities.
The two siblings were fairly active during the Second Wizarding War .
Second Wizarding War

Amycus and his sister were, most likely, among the Death Eaters that were summoned by Lord Voldemort to the churchyard at Little Hangleton on 24 June 1995 , as their absence wasn't noted by Voldemort himself.
Amycus and Alecto among other Death Eaters atop the Astronomy Tower
In the evening of 30 June 1997 , Amycus and his sister participated in the assault on Hogwarts Castle , orchestrated by Draco Malfoy , that resulted in the death of Albus Dumbledore .

When the Death Eaters arrived at the top of the Astronomy Tower , where Dumbledore was trapped, Amycus tried to make fun of the Headmaster and turned suddenly violent when Dumbledore hypothesised that he, Amycus, might not reach his old age.
When Severus Snape arrived at the scene, Amycus hurriedly said that Draco was not able to kill Dumbledore, and Snape cast the Killing Curse that ended the Headmaster 's life.
On Snape's orders, he and his sister quickly left the Tower panting excitedly.
On the corridors below, Amycus duelled Ginny Weasley , sending multiple Cruciatus Curses at her.
Harry Potter shot an Impediment Jinx that made him slam into the opposite wall.
Amycus and Alecto retreated after Snape with their arms over their heads under blasts by Minerva McGonagall .
As brother and sister descended the Marble Staircase , Harry took a shortcut and arrived at the grounds before them.
Amycus is present at the Death Eater meeting held in Malfoy Manor
As the two Death Eaters closed in after him, one of them cast a spell that sent Harry to the ground.
Harry hit one of them, who stumbled and fell, tripping up the other, with another Impediment Jinx .
The two siblings then ran to the gates and Disapparated beyond the school boundaries.
That summer, the Carrows attended a Death Eater meeting at Malfoy Manor concerning plans to capture or kill Harry Potter and take over the Ministry of Magic .
It is possible that he was one of the Death Eaters who stood watch outside 12 Grimmauld Place , as one of them was said to be a "pallid, podgy man", a description that matched Amycus.
Headmaster Severus Snape with Deputy Heads Alecto (left) and Amycus Carrow (right)
On 1 August 1997 , the Death Eaters managed to stage a coup over the Ministry of Magic , thus gaining influence over all wizarding Britain .

A month later, on 1 September , Amycus and Alecto were made Defence Against the Dark Arts and Muggle Studies , respectively, as well as Deputy Headmasters under newly appointed Headmaster Severus Snape .
The Defence Against the Dark Arts curriculum was changed so that it was now simply " Dark Arts ".
Amycus had his seventh-years practise the Cruciatus Curse on students given detentions .
His syllabus also apparently covered the usage of the Killing Curse and Fiendfyre .
As Deputy Headmasters, the Carrows were put in charge of all punishment.
The members of faculty were obliged to report any rule-breaking student to them, although they did not if they could avoid it.
Punishments given out by the Carrows included torture via the Cruciatus Curse as well as chaining students and corporal punishment in the form of beatings and slashes with knives.
Amycus watching over the students of Hogwarts
Dumbledore's Army , led by Neville Longbottom , led the resistance against the Carrows.
Amycus made a particularly deep gash in his cheek after he refused to use the Cruciatus Curse on students in detention.

The group, now made illicit after the reenactment of the Educational Decree Number Twenty-Four , used to sneak into the corridors at night and put up graffiti on the walls with messages like " Dumbledore's Army, Still Recruiting ".
Michael Corner was caught releasing a first-year the Carrows had chained up and was violently tortured.
Once the Carrows realised they had no hold over Neville, particularly after the Death Eaters' failed attempt to abduct his grandmother , they planned to kill him or send him to Azkaban .

As the Carrows chased him, Neville chose the Room of Requirement as a hideout, and the rest of Dumbledore's Army soon followed his footsteps and moved into the room as the Carrows tried to hunt them down.

By the evening of 1 May 1998 , news of Harry Potter , Ronald Weasley and Hermione Granger 's break-in of Gringotts Wizarding Bank reached the student body; Terry Boot was beaten up by the Carrows for yelling about it in the Great Hall over dinner.

That same day, as Lord Voldemort became aware that Harry, Hermione, and Ron were hunting down and destroying his Horcruxes , he instructed Amycus and Alecto that Harry might try to get into the Castle and Ravenclaw Tower .
At the Carrows' urgent request, Professor Flitwick , Head of Ravenclaw House , let Alecto into the common room, where she stood guard.
His sister was keeping watch when Harry arrived with Luna Lovegood .
Alecto immediately touched her Dark Mark , letting Voldemort and all the Death Eaters know that they had got him.
Alecto was immediately Stunned by Luna, but Amycus demanded Minerva McGonagall to let him into the Tower.
Once inside, he saw his unconscious sister but no sign of Harry, as both he and Luna were hidden beneath his Invisibility Cloak .

Aware that they were going to feel Voldemort's wrath if they did not hand him Harry, Amycus planned to pass it off on the students, and when Professor McGonagall objected calling Amycus a coward in the process, he spat in her face.

This show of disrespect for both sentient life and McGonagall enraged Harry to the point of disregarding stealth and revealing himself by throwing a Cruciatus Curse at Amycus with such force that he slammed into the wall.

Minerva McGonagall then bewitched him with the Imperius Curse to carry his unconscious sister, then used a spell to conjure a net, and the siblings were tied up and hoisted into the air, where they were left dangling beneath the ceiling.
Neither Amycus nor his sister fought in the Battle of Hogwarts , as both of them were kept tied-up at Ravenclaw Tower .

However, the siblings managed to escape after the death of their master, avoiding immediate arrest, with the reformed Ministry of Magic under Kingsley Shacklebolt listing Amycus as one of the many remaining Death Eaters on the run.

Sometime after the Battle of Hogwarts , during the trial of Dolores Umbridge , Amycus infiltrated the British Ministry of Magic alongside Alecto and fellow escaped Death Eaters Corban Yaxley and Walden Macnair to help Umbridge escape.
However, Harry Potter , Ron Weasley , Hermione Granger , and Umbridge's former house-elf , Higgledy , arrived at the scene and started fighting Amycus and his fellow Death Eaters.
During the conflict, Umbridge reached the Time Room and attempted to use a Time Turner to travel back in time and restore Lord Voldemort's reign.
However, the plan went awry when Umbridge foolishly tried to repair a broken Time-Turner, destroying it in a massive explosion and ruining the Death Eater plot.
One of the four Death Eater infiltrators was sucked into the explosion and was potentially killed, although it is unclear if this individual was Amycus.

With their plans foiled, the three remaining Death Eaters, which may have included Amycus, were captured by Hermione and Higgledy while Umbridge was taken by Harry and Ron to her hearing, where she was sentenced to Azkaban .
If Amycus was one of the three captured Death Eaters, he was also sentenced to Azkaban shortly afterwards.
Physical description
Amycus Carrow was squat and lumpy, with a lopsided leer and a wheezy giggle, much like his sister.
Hunched, he had a pallid, doughy face and tiny eyes.
He also had a "pig-like" face.
As a Death Eater, he bore the Dark Mark on his left inner forearm.
Personality and traits
Amycus was an extremely sadistic man who enjoyed punishing and torturing students, ordering them to perform the Cruciatus Curse on students given detention.
Indeed, Neville even claimed that Amycus "made Umbridge look tame".
He had no qualms teaching students such deadly magic, despite potentially lethal consequences, such as Vincent Crabbe 's usage of Fiendfyre backfiring on him.

He was extremely insolent and offensive, banging hard on the door to Ravenclaw Tower when he failed to solve the riddle to open it, putting his face close to Minerva to command her support, and ended up spitting in her face.
He was also very hot-tempered, as seen by his responding with violence without warning.

He was also a coward, however, as Amycus planned to blame the Ravenclaw students for allegedly forcing Alecto to press her Dark Mark so that they would be punished by Voldemort instead of himself and his sister.
This demonstrated a sense of naivety, as Voldemort would have likely known he was lying either through Legilimency or simply because the lie was somewhat unbelievable.
He did show genuine concern for his sister when he found her unconscious, suggesting that he did care about her at least.
He was also incredibly arrogant as he demanded that McGonagall would support him.

Despite this lack of bravery in fear of being punished by the Dark Lord, according to Nymphadora Tonks , Carrow appeared to be prepared to fight to the death during the Battle of the Astronomy Tower , resulting in aggressiveness that overwhelmed the Order of the Phoenix .

Moreover, Amycus did not seem to be very bright, as he was unable to answer the riddle to get into Ravenclaw Tower when asked by the eagle knocker on the door or to give a reason why Harry Potter would go into Ravenclaw Tower when he was of Gryffindor House , when asked by Minerva McGonagall .
He also did not seem very suspicious about Severus Snape's true loyalties, suggesting that he truly believed that Snape was on their side.

Carrow

title: Alecto Carrow
paragraphs: Professor Alecto Carrow was a Dark witch , Death Eater and the sister of Amycus Carrow .
Alecto fought in the First Wizarding War along with her brother.
They did not search for Lord Voldemort after his first downfall, but were forgiven after Voldemort's return in 1995, and joined the Death Eater ranks once more in the Second Wizarding War .

After the fall of the Ministry of Magic in 1997 , Alecto was made Professor of Muggle Studies ; she taught the thinking that Muggles are lesser than Wizardkind , and likely taught the pureblood -philosophy as well.
When Severus Snape became Headmaster of Hogwarts, she was appointed as Deputy Headmistress , alongside her brother (who was appointed as Deputy Headmaster ).
She loved to punish and torture the students who opposed them.
On the eve of 1 May 1998 , shortly before the Battle of Hogwarts , she was stunned by Luna Lovegood when she summoned Lord Voldemort 's Death Eaters .
She was then magically tied up in Ravenclaw Tower by Professor McGonagall .

After the battle, she managed to escape custody with her brother, Corban Yaxley , and Walden Macnair and briefly attempted to free Dolores Umbridge and use a Time-Turner to bring back Voldemort's regime, but was recaptured and sent to Azkaban along with the others for their crimes.
Biography
Early life
Alecto Carrow was born sometime before 1981 into the pure-blood Carrow family somewhere in the British Isles .
She likely acquired her wand at either Ollivander's Wand Shop in Diagon Alley or Wands by Gregorovitch at the Carkitt Market .
Alecto attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in her youth along with her brother, and was a member of Slytherin house.
First Wizarding War
A wanted poster of Alecto Carrow
Alecto and her brother, Amycus , supported Lord Voldemort and became Death Eaters during the First Wizarding War .
After Voldemort's downfall in 1981 , they did not search for their master, believing that Voldemort was gone forever, and thus avoided imprisonment in Azkaban .
Despite this, Alecto and Amycus were among those who, after Voldemort 's return , resumed their Death Eater activities.
The two siblings were fairly active during the Second Wizarding War .
Second Wizarding War

Alecto and her brother were, most likely, among the Death Eaters that were summoned by Lord Voldemort to the churchyard at Little Hangleton on 24 June 1995 , as their absence wasn't noted by Voldemort himself.
However he did not speak to either of them, if they were there.
Alecto and her brother among other Death Eaters atop the Astronomy Tower
On the evening of 30 June 1997 , Alecto and her brother participated in the assault on Hogwarts Castle , orchestrated by Draco Malfoy , that resulted in the death of Albus Dumbledore .
When the Death Eaters arrived at the top of the Astronomy Tower , where Dumbledore was trapped, Alecto gave "wheezing giggles", as her brother mocked the Headmaster .
When Severus Snape arrived on the scene, he cast the Killing Curse that ended the Headmaster's life.
On Snape's orders, she and her brother swiftly left the Tower, panting excitedly.
In the corridors below, Alecto and Amycus retreated after Snape with their arms over their heads, under attack from blasts by Minerva McGonagall .
As the brother and sister descended the Marble Staircase , Harry took a shortcut and arrived on the grounds before them.
As the two Death Eaters closed in after him, one of them cast a spell that sent Harry to the ground.
Harry hit one of them, who stumbled and fell, tripping up the other, with another Impediment Jinx .
Alecto and her brother recovered shortly after and were ordered along by Snape to leave Harry.
The two siblings then ran to the gates along with Thorfinn Rowle , and Disapparated beyond the school boundaries.
Alecto being present at the Death Eater meeting held in Malfoy Manor
That summer the Carrows attended a Death Eater meeting at Malfoy Manor .
This meeting concerned plans to capture or kill Harry Potter and take over the Ministry of Magic .
During this meeting it was revealed that the Death Eaters had successfully infiltrated the Ministry and that they were aware of the date in which Harry would be removed from Privet Drive.
This meeting took place during the height of the Second Wizarding War.
Headmaster Severus Snape with Deputy Heads Alecto (left) and Amycus Carrow (right)
On 1 August 1997 , the Death Eaters managed to stage a coup within the Ministry of Magic , thus gaining influence over all of wizarding Britain .
One month later, as of 1 September , Alecto was appointed as Muggle Studies teacher as well as Deputy Headmistress under the new Headmaster Severus Snape.
Muggle Studies was made a compulsory core class.
The curriculum was changed to include the Ministry's anti- Muggle propaganda exclusively (instead of teaching aspects of Muggle culture and science).
As one of the Deputy Heads, Alecto was in charge of all disciplinary action (along with her brother).
All Hogwarts staff were obliged to report any rule-breaking student to her or her brother (although the staff did not turn students in if they could avoid it).
Alecto's disciplinary measures included torture by way of the Cruciatus Curse , as well as binding students with chains, and corporal punishment in the form of beatings.
Dumbledore's Army , led by Neville Longbottom , spearheaded the resistance against the Carrows.
Alecto made a slash on Neville's face after he asked her how much Muggle blood she and her brother had.

The group, which was banned after the reenactment of Educational Decree Number Twenty-Four , would sneak into the corridors at night and write on the walls with messages like " Dumbledore's Army, Still Recruiting ".
Michael Corner was caught releasing a first-year that Alecto and/or Amycus had chained up, and he was thus brutally tortured.
When Alecto and Amycus understood they had no hold over Neville, they planned to kill him or send him to Azkaban .

As they chased him, Neville vanished into the Room of Requirement , and the rest of Dumbledore's Army soon followed in his footsteps, moving into the room as both Alecto and Amycus tried to hunt them all down.
By the evening of 1 May 1998 , news of Harry Potter , Ronald Weasley and Hermione Granger 's break-in of Gringotts Wizarding Bank reached the student body.
Terry Boot was beaten up by Alecto and Amycus for yelling about it in the Great Hall over dinner.

That same day, as Lord Voldemort became aware that Harry Potter, Ronald Weasley and Hermione Granger were hunting down and destroying his Horcruxes , he told Alecto and Amycus that Harry might try to get into Ravenclaw Tower .
At her urgent request Professor Flitwick , Head of Ravenclaw House , let Alecto into the common room, where she stood guard.
Alecto was keeping watch when Harry arrived with Luna Lovegood .
She immediately touched her Dark Mark , letting Voldemort and all the Death Eaters know that they had got him.
Alecto was immediately nonverbally Stunned by Luna, and Amycus demanded that Minerva McGonagall let him into the Tower.
Once inside, he saw his unconscious sister but no sign of Harry, as both Harry and Luna were hidden beneath Harry's Cloak of Invisibility .

Aware that they were going to feel Voldemort's wrath if they did not hand him Harry, Amycus planned to pass it off on the students, and when Professor McGonagall objected, calling Amycus and Alecto cowards in the process, he spat in her face.
This caused Harry to furiously use the Cruciatus Curse on him, which knocked him out.

Minerva McGonagall used the Imperius Curse on Amycus to have him carry his sister and then conjured a silver net over the two, which tied itself around them and hoisted them up into the air, where they were left dangling beneath the ceiling.
Neither Alecto nor her brother fought in the Battle of Hogwarts , as both of them were kept tied-up at Ravenclaw Tower .

However, the siblings managed to escape after the death of their master, avoiding immediate arrest, with the reformed Ministry of Magic under Kingsley Shacklebolt listing Alecto as one of the many remaining Death Eaters on the run.

Sometime after the Battle of Hogwarts , during the trial of Dolores Umbridge , Alecto infiltrated the British Ministry of Magic alongside Amycus and fellow escaped Death Eaters Corban Yaxley and Walden Macnair to help Umbridge escape.
However, Harry Potter , Ron Weasley , Hermione Granger , and Umbridge's former house-elf , Higgledy , arrived at the scene and started fighting Alecto and her fellow Death Eaters.
During the conflict, Umbridge reached the Time Room and attempted to use a Time Turner to travel back in time and restore Lord Voldemort's reign.
However, the plan went awry when Umbridge foolishly tried to repair a broken Time-Turner, destroying it in a massive explosion and ruining the Death Eater plot.
One of the four Death Eater infiltrators was sucked into the explosion and was potentially killed, although it is unclear if this individual was Alecto.

With their plans foiled, the three remaining Death Eaters, which may have included Alecto, were captured by Hermione and Higgledy while Umbridge was taken by Harry and Ron to her hearing, where she was sentenced to Azkaban .
If Alecto was one of the three captured Death Eaters, she was also sentenced to Azkaban shortly afterwards.
Physical description
Alecto Carrow at Hogwarts Castle
Alecto Carrow was a stocky little woman like the Weasley twins , with a wheezy giggle, much like her brother.
Sloping-shouldered, she had stubby fingers and, as a Death Eater , she was branded with the Dark Mark on her forearm.
Personality and traits
Alecto was an extreme sadist who enjoyed torturing students or just people in general.
Indeed, Neville even claimed that Alecto " made Umbridge look tame ".
Alecto had strong pure-blood supremacist beliefs (specifically the belief in blood purity ), as she taught that " blood traitors ", " Mudbloods " and Muggles were lesser than wizardkind .
She was not highly intelligent, however, as she needed Filius Flitwick to let her into Ravenclaw Tower .
However, she was seemingly slightly brighter than her brother Amycus.

Like Bellatrix Lestrange, she admired Lord Voldemort and detested Muggle-borns and Muggles alike; though unlike Bellatrix, Alecto was not loyal enough to Voldemort to seek him out after his first downfall, nor to brave Azkaban in his name.

Despite this lack of bravery for the Dark Lord, according to Nymphadora Tonks , Alecto appeared to be prepared to fight to the death during the Battle of the Astronomy Tower , resulting in aggressiveness that overwhelmed the Order of the Phoenix .
Similar to many of her comrades, Alecto seemed to respect Severus Snape , falling back at the sight of his arrival.
Magical abilities and skills
Alecto Carrow was a Death Eater , which meant she was adept in the Dark Arts.

She along with her brother Amycus, gained an infamous reputation within the wizarding world, particularly during their stint as joint Deputy Heads at Hogwarts, as they severely punished students for any rule-breaking within the school.

Alecto
Carrow

title: Cassandra Vole
paragraphs: Cassandra Vole was a half-blood witch who attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , where she was Sorted into Slytherin , in the 21st century .
Biography
Hogwarts years
On 1 September 2008 , Cassandra sat in a compartment with Colby and Fischer Frey on the Hogwarts Express .
When a fellow first year asked if they could sit with her, she immediately refused to let them and told them to find somewhere else.
Cassandra was Sorted into Slytherin house when she started attending Hogwarts at the age of eleven.
She was soon bullying her fellow students, including Ivy Warrington and Daniel Page .
After their first Charms lesson, the student saw Cassandra in the corridor using the Levitation Charm on a feather.
They told her it was impressive.
Cassandra told them she was naturally talented and when the student wished they could get better at it, she told them it was just a swish and flick.
When Colby and Fischer arrived, she invited the student to attend the Duelling Club with her if they weren't afraid.
Before they started duelling, Cassandra hoped they wouldn't make a scene when they lost.
At first, they duelled Colby but when they won, Cassandra challenged them to duel against her and Fischer instead.
They pointed out two against one was unfair, but Kevin explained it was a Duo Duel and Robyn offered to pair up with them.
When the student and Robyn won, Cassandra was surprised and thought they were less hopeless than they looked.
She asked for their name but they told her they already met in the corridor.
Cassandra told them beating the Freys wasn't a feat and they should retry duelling her when they were better at spells.
She overheard Daniel speaking to a friend one day about how he thought hiding magic from Muggles was wrong.
Cassandra began teasing Daniel, asking if he wanted to be in the paper or be a criminal.
Cassandra thought Muggles to be "silly" and frightened of their own shadows.
Daniel objected, saying she would be afraid of magic if she didn't have it.
Cassandra worked out that he had a Muggle in the Page family , and he told her to shut up.
Daniel's friend didn't think Cassandra was worth it, and Ivy Warrington asked if she didn't like non-magic people.
Cassandra, however, instantly told her she was not a supremacist, and that she had an uncle who was a Muggle and she thought he was hilarious.
Cassandra left, but Ivy ran after her and asked Cassandra to apologise to Daniel.
Cassandra advised her to choose her friends carefully and that Daniel was not a good choice.
Then Ivy started duelling her.
Ivy was knocked down by Cassandra, and used Evanesco in an attempt to obliterate Cassandra's wand, on her but missed, vanishing a suit of armour instead.
Professor Longbottom intervened and gave detention to Ivy and her friends.
Later that evening, Cassandra, Colby and Fischer Frey snuck out to the Library .
Daniel, Ivy and their friend found out and went to check out why.
They watched her until one of the twins noticed.
Cassandra then told Daniel's friends she had found out about Daniel's family who had been sent to prison.
Daniel and his friends then began duelling Cassandra and the Frey twins.
Cassandra lost the duel, and told Daniel it wasn't over and that he couldn't be trusted.
She noted that Daniel, Ivy and the student were friends but did not know each other well.
Cassandra put a curse on the book in the library so that when Daniel and his friends came looking for a book about the Page family, they were attacked by pixies.
After they fought off the pixies, she appeared "just for a bit of fun", and showed them The Quibbler .
She agreed when Ivy's friend said that The Quibbler was a stupid magazine, and laughed that they probably wouldn't believe a word of what was written here about Ivy.
Later, Cassandra followed them into the Book and Quill's tower .
She revealed that she had helped them to make sure Ivy got what she deserved, and said that Ivy was dangerous and should be expelled.
Daniel used a spell, but Cassandra successfully avoided it and used a Knockback Jinx on Daniel.
She started duelling with the student, but was defeated by Ivy's Full Body-Bind Curse , who entered the room later.
During her third year , in the 2010-2011 school year , a plant-based Healer named Astrid Cole was sent to Hogwarts to find an antidote for the Mysterious Malady .
Despite both being interested in the subject of Herbology , Cassandra disliked Cole, finding her suspicious.
Later that year, Cassandra was likely affected by the malady, causing her to fall into an unwakeable sleep.
Subsequently, a student visited her at the Hospital Wing and found her "special" rose in her hands.
Physical description
Cassandra was sometimes said to resemble her great-grandmother Delila in her past years.
She had dark green eyes, pale skin with red undertones, and long yellow-blonde hair that mostly rests on her left shoulder, except for a few stray strands.
She usually wore a green bow on the left side of her head and green triangle-shaped earrings with gold accents.
Green was her signature colour, and she was never seen without it in her outfit.
She normally wore white gloves.
She wore a standard school uniform, but outside of class she wore a black bolero, a white blouse with a green ribbon tie and a green high-waisted skirt.

She was considered a pretty girl by her classmates, as were Robyn Thistlethwaite and Ivy Warrington , but was also described as a "nightmare" and shunned because of the attitude she displayed towards those who spoke to her.
Personality and traits
Cassandra had a mean-spirited and conceited personality, and enjoyed belitting those she perceived as below her with her classmates, such as Ivy Warrington and Daniel Page .
She was entitled and always thought she was right.
She considered herself more attractive, more talented, and more popular than any other witch in the school.
She thought that anyone who disagreed this belief was obviously a fool, such as Ivy Warrington and her friends, and thought someone needed to teach them a lesson or two.
She was passionate about fashion and frequently criticised other students for their style choices.
Cassandra also believed that not all witches and wizards were created equal, and she wanted them to know their place.
She disliked the sport of Quidditch and enjoyed Herbology .
Despite her posh and arrogant bearing, she was not entirely heartless, and was delighted when Colby Frey gifted her a scarf he personally made for her on Christmas.

When Colby Frey's scarf was mocked by his brother Fischer, Colby fled away in mortification, and Cassandra chased after Colby to console him, stating that even if it was not as expensive or high-quality as Fischer's gift, the sentiment mattered to her much more than Fischer's gift.
Cassandra claimed she had no anti-Muggle sentiment , even revealing she had a Muggle uncle she found "hilarious", but caused her to think Muggles were "silly".
She also thought that learning about Muggles was of no use at all.
Magical abilities and skills
Possessions
Colby's gift scarf and Fischer's wand case
Ivy's gift bow
Lyncus, Cassandra's pet Kneazle
Relationships
Family
She disliked family dinners.
She also made secret the fact that her family were very nice people and hid the fact that her parents were Hufflepuffs.
Ivy Warrington
Cassandra shared a deeply antagonistic and competitive mutual enmity and rivalry with Ivy.
Their relationship was fraught with tension from the very beginning, marked by outbursts of anger and malice.
Cassandra firmly believed that not all people were born equal and considered her own existence as proof of this notion.
She oppressed others "simply to make them understand their position" and felt particularly compelled to teach Ivy 'a few lessons', often revealing her malicious intent.

Ivy, on the other hand, despised Cassandra as a bully who thrived on others' misfortune, often acting on impulses of anger in response to Cassandra's actions and frequently needing to be restrained by her friends.
During a first-year Charms class, Cassandra secretly sabotaged Ivy's practical performance with a counter-spell and mocked her afterwards.
When her interference was discovered, she brazenly continued to insult Ivy.
In response, Ivy thought to herself that she'd rather "bind Cassandra's mouth than the chest" and used a binding spell on her, losing house points as a result.

On another occasion, when Cassandra ruined a painting by Lottie Turner, Ivy angrily tailed Cassandra all the way to the library, so blinded by rage that she failed to realise her own behaviour until it was pointed out.
The first step in their worst clash began when Ivy stumbled upon an argument between her friend Daniel and Cassandra.
Ivy criticised Cassandra for describing Muggles as foolish people who even feared their own shadows.
However, Cassandra justified her stance, threatened to send Daniel to Azkaban, and made a cutting remark about Ivy's disappearance on the first day at school.
Ivy chased Cassandra through several staircases and corridors, demanding an apology for Daniel.
Cassandra instead advised Ivy to choose her friends more carefully, which escalated into a duel.
In the heat of the moment, Ivy attempted to disarm Cassandra but somehow ended up using a Vanishing Spell .
Ivy was shocked by her own actions, while Cassandra was visibly terrified.
Afterwards, on her friends' advice, Ivy tried to mend her relationship with Cassandra.
However, Cassandra responded that she had plenty of friends and wasn't particularly interested in someone like Ivy as a friend.
She mocked Ivy for being "lost", much like on her first day at school, and ridiculed her for her strange behaviour.
Despite these incidents, Cassandra occasionally had to encounter Ivy's strange affinities.
One Christmas, when Alice , a clerk from Fickle Fabrics , visited Hogwarts, Cassandra was presented with a Slytherin-style green hat by Ivy.
However, the gift was poorly received.
Cassandra was unhappy with the hat's fine colouring and the fact that it was ready-made.
On another Christmas, Cassandra was gifted a ribbon for her hair by Ivy.
This gift was a success, secretly pleasing Cassandra.
Later, after the Siege of Hogwarts , Ivy was not particularly surprised to hear that Cassandra had thanked her friends, unlike Daniel Page, who expressed scepticism.
Ivy even defended Cassandra to Daniel and seemed prepared to accept her as a new friend if given the chance.
In their fourth year, noticeable tension began to permeate Cassandra and Ivy's relationship when Winifred quickly and easily befriended Cassandra, drifting away from Ivy.
Ivy grew uneasy about the bond between Cassandra and her sister, and this unease surfaced as sharp words of reproach toward Cassandra when Winifred rejected her.
However, after the sisters reconciled and Winifred expressed a desire for Ivy to get along with her closest friend, their relationship began to take a slightly positive turn.
During their final challenge, Ivy offered Cassandra encouragement, to which Cassandra silently responded with a smile.

Cassandra mentioned her helpful side as she gasped when she heard that Ivy was being stranded to help a competitor, and that it would take some time to get used to that nature of hers, even if they were to become friends.
At the end-of-term feast, Ivy joined Cassandra's company alongside her sister.
Later, during a Hogsmeade trip just before the Christmas holidays, Cassandra unexpectedly ended up spending time with Ivy.
Although their relationship remained strained, it was held together by their connection through Winifred.

title: Mysterious Malady
paragraphs: The Mysterious Malady was an illness that made witches and wizards fall into an unwakeable sleep during the 2010s .
Astrid Cole eventually discovered that the Bewildering Blooms owner Yubert Thorne was responsible for the malady using his Bloom For You flowers.
History
Yubert Thorne was a supporter of Voldemort and his Death Eaters , and was bitter about their defeat at the Battle of Hogwarts .
He decided to get revenge by poisoning the witches and wizards responsible.
He created the Bloom For You plant, which would only grow for the person they were bred for, using their hair.
Once in their possession, the plant would cause them to fall into a deep sleep.
Obtaining the hair of witches and wizards who fought against Lord Voldemort during the Battle of Hogwarts , he began to grow and give the plants to them.
The Mysterious Malady was first reported by the Daily Prophet in the 2010-2011 school year .
According to Kevin Farrell , no cure had been found and even the Healers at St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries were "stumped".
Known victims who were infected by the malady were Seamus Finnigan , Luna Lovegood , Ginevra Weasley , Kingsley Shacklebolt , and Molly Weasley .
Eventually, the British Ministry of Magic sent plant-based Healer and Herbologist Astrid Cole to Hogwarts to work alongside other professors to find an antidote for the Mysterious Malady.

During her time at Hogwarts, Astrid suspected that the Bewildering Blooms owner Yubert Thorne had something to do with the malady, as he arrived moments before Professor Neville Longbottom was affected by the malady and suddenly fell into an unwakeable sleep.
She later revealed her suspicion of Yubert to a student and asked them to help her in "playing detective", to which the student agreed.
Professor Minerva McGonagall was also targeted by the malady.
Yubert's first attempt to poison her was unintentionally prevented by Cassandra Vole , who was supposed to deliver a plant to her but decided to steal it for herself.
Cassandra was instead affected by the malady and fell into a deep sleep.
On the second attempt, Yubert successfully poisoned Professor McGonagall after inviting her out for a drink at the Three Broomsticks Inn .
Yubert also planned to poison several more people after McGonagall, with the student finding evidence in his shop.

Their hairs were stored in jars with their names on them, including those of Harry Potter , Hermione Granger , another member of the Weasley family , Professor Filius Flitwick , and Professor Horace Slughorn .
Eventually, all the evidence proved Yubert Thorne to be the villain behind the malady, trying to take revenge for the Death Eaters' defeat.
Thorne was sent to Azkaban and the victims were revived with an antidote brewed by the student and Astrid Cole.
Notes and references

title: Kevin Farrell
paragraphs: Kevin "Kev" Farrell was a wizard who started attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 2008 and was sorted into Gryffindor .
Biography
Early life
During Christmas seasons, Kevin would often calculate with his father which end of Christmas crackers to pull to get the rewards, and listen to his father tell dry jokes.
Hogwarts years
Kevin began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 2008 .
On 1 September , he travelled to the school via the Hogwarts Express , and was sorted into Gryffindor along with Robyn Thistlethwaite .
After their first Charms lesson, he talked to a fellow student , Robyn, and Lottie Turner in a corridor.
He asked if they knew where the Hogwarts Library was after he forgot and got lost.
They didn't know because they hadn't been there yet.
He was worried it had moved but Robyn told him only the staircases move, which he was pleased to hear.
He later watched the student and Robyn duel Cassandra Vole and Fischer Frey in the Duelling Club , where he told the student what a Duo Duel was.
Kevin was forced to attend Dance Club by Robyn where she kept stepping on him while they were dancing.
The student talked to them and Kevin whinged about Robyn but she claimed he was having a great time.
He told her he was until she had stepped on him but she told him he didn't feel a thing.
He told her that he didn't at first so she shouted that he should find someone else to dance with next time.
After receiving an owl from Lottie to gather in the library to help find Ivy, Kevin snuck out after curfew.
He was eventually joined by the student, Daniel and Robyn.
Kevin was unsure if it was safe to walk around the castle and when Daniel told him it wouldn't be, Robyn disagreed to encourage Kevin to stay and help.
Even though Daniel left, Kevin agreed to help when the student told him they needed a clever person like him in their group.
They first entered the Potions Classroom where Robyn released Acromantulas by accident.
After they dispatched of the spiders, they left to search another part of the castle.
While they were talking, the portrait of William de Cognac asked them to put out their light so he could sleep.
Kevin asked if he happened to notice Ivy walking past.
He told them he hadn't and threatened to tell Filch they were there.
They were then spotted by Peeves who took great delight in finding the missing first-years before realising there was only supposed to be one.
They told Peeves they weren't lost but they were also looking for Ivy.
He decided to test their mettle.
After they defeated Peeves, the student and Robyn discovered Kevin had disappeared.
The next day, Kevin had breakfast with Robyn, Ivy, Daniel and their friend.
He received a copy of the Daily Prophet in the post and remarked he could now keep up with current affairs.
Fischer and Colby stole the paper and mocked Kevin for being the "cultered sort".
Kevin demanded that they give it back but they didn't think he knew how to even use a wand.
Kevin's friend threatened to duel Fischer and Colby, who left after remarking that they'd now made enemies.
Kevin was grateful for his friend's help.
Robyn asked Kevin to read some of the current events, and he told them over four hundred Muggles were Oblivated after witnessing statues springing to life and dancing the jig in Trafalgar Square .
Kevin reckoned NOTME was responsible.
In 2009 , he listened to another one of his father's jokes, which was about how the England national cricket team won a match on Christmas Day 1972 so that they could eat turkeys for dinner.
Kevin found the joke silly, but his father laughed hard.
Personality and traits
Kevin was an intelligent boy who liked reading books and didn't enjoy breaking the rules.

title: Viggo Victor
paragraphs: Viggo Victor was a pure-blood wizard who attended Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry during the early 21st century .
He was known for being talented at duelling .
Biography
He was a student of Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , where he was sorted into Horned Serpent House.

At some point in the 2011-2012 school year , Viggo visited Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry where he represented his school in the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup , along with Zack Johnson and Violet Williams , as the team captain.
During this event, he competed against at least six students from Mahoutokoro : Yumi Ito , Kenji Kobayashi , Tarōbō Amachi , and two other Mahoutokoro members .
Upon their arrival at the Great Hall , while Violet was making friends with Ivy Warrington , Daniel Page , and another student , he and Zach brought her away unfriendlily.
The three students caught up with Viggo, Zach and Violet, and when one of the three accidentally bumped into Viggo, he dared them to fight .
Days afterwards, while practising spells for the intercontinental competition, he was disrupted by one of Rubeus Hagrid 's missing Diricawls .

He called the student, whom he dared earlier and had been recapturing all the lost Diricawls for Hagrid, over in a boisterous manner and rudely requested that the bird be removed from his practice area.
The student then searched the surrounding bushes and found the Diricawl .
In the first challenge, he incorrectly answered the final question, causing the team's scoring tower, the Tower of Magical Knowledge , to collapse.
Viggo, enraged by the loss, stormed over to Kenji Kobayashi and claimed it was only luck that led Kenji to win first place.
Robyn Thistlethwaite , a Hogwarts student, watched the scene from afar and mockingly commented that someone couldn't accept losing.
Later at the American-style picnic, where he oversaw the menu, he laced Kenji's drink with something that aggravated his blood malediction , turning him into a hazardous fox -like beast .
Fortunately, Headmistress McGonagall and Headmaster Senju arrived at the scene, gave Kenji a potion , and brought him to the Hospital Wing .
Sometime later, the writer Rita Skeeter showed up (with her Quick-Quotes Quill ) to interview each competitor for the Daily Prophet .
During the interview, Viggo claimed he would be the reason for the team's victory, as leadership was in his blood.
The Quick-Quotes Quill, immediately after Viggo's speech, inaccurately recorded that he was bragging about his blood , which made him furious.
Rita, however, merely reacted to his anger by forbidding him from peeking and told him he would read it in the paper the next morning.
Afterwards, Viggo forced Violet to use her Metamorphmagus ability to impersonate Lottie Turner and Cassandra Vole in order to spy on the other teams.
However, Violet was caught and confessed to Viggo's scheme.
Before the second match, duelling , a Hogwarts student named Daniel Page informed the Hogwarts team the information from their "new spy".
One of the Ilvermorny's weaknesses, according to Daniel's spy's information, was Viggo's weird tendency to twirl before casting a Banishing Charm .

During the challenge, Viggo targeted one of his spells at Kevin Farrell , a competitor from the Hogwarts team who wasn't included in this particular challenge, causing him to be attacked and rendered unconscious.
Robyn Thistlethwaite , noticing Kevin's condition, attempted to "flatten" Viggo but was stopped by Kenji, as her act of revenge could lead to the Hogwarts team being disqualified.
Cassandra, however, cast a seemingly severe spell at Viggo, who, impressed by it, offered her a place on his team.
Cassandra refused and said that she'd prefer to be on the winning team.
As the challenge continued and the one-on-one match arrived, Violet decided to forfeit to the Hogwarts team, and Ivy did the same, causing Viggo to become furious.
In the final task, held in the Forbidden Forest , a Hidebehind was included as part of the challenge, disguising itself as Viggo for a time.
Later, when Violet became trapped in the Acromantulas' web , Viggo abandoned her without care, leaving her immobile and crying out for help from this mortal peril.
Luckily, students from the Hogwarts team passed by, heard her pleas, and rescued her.
As the teams raced to the chest in the forest, with victory going to whoever claimed it first, the three remaining Hogwarts members fought fiercely against Gawrloc , the chest's guardian.
Daniel heroically sacrificed himself to save Cassandra, leaving him unconscious.
When the remaining two let their guard down, Viggo Apparated into the scene, where Gawrloc had already been defeated, and knocked Cassandra out, leaving just one Hogwarts student standing.
While Viggo boasted about deserving to win and complained about Hogwarts' weather and food, the student struck him in the face, knocking him out and securing the win for Hogwarts.
After the competition ended, Hogwarts was declared the winner, and Viggo was furious.

Due to his actions that broke the competition's rules, Karen Crowley , the Headmistress of Ilvermorny, was extremely displeased, and, according to Violet, he would be "in big trouble" when they returned to school in America.
Physical description
Viggo had a tall and muscular figure, a broad, big face, and a large, flat nose.
His hair was red in colour, and he had a large quiff pointing upwards, resembling the tail of a phoenix .
Personality and traits
Viggo was ambitious to win, confident in himself, and arrogant.
Notes and references

title: Intercontinental Wizard's Cup
paragraphs: The Intercontinental Wizard's Cup was a competition held during the 2011-2012 school year between three of the most famous wizarding schools : Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , Mahoutokoro , and Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
The competitors would be chosen by the Intercontinental Trophy , which would later be awarded to the winner.
Overview

Students who wished to participate in the competition needed to submit their names to form a team of seven and then travel to one of the participating schools based on their school year: second and third-years would go to Ilvermorny Castle , fourth and fifth-years would compete at Hogwarts, and sixth and seventh-years would go to Mahoutokoro palace .
First challenge
The first challenge, the Game of Wits, was chosen by the Mahoutokoro team.
It consisted of at least eleven test questions about wizarding history .
Each school team would receive a number of bricks, which would come together one by one to form a tower, the Tower of Magical Knowledge , when a question was correctly answered.
The tower would collapse if a question was answered incorrectly, requiring the competitors to rebuild it from scratch.
Three students were allowed to compete in this challenge per team.
For Hogwarts, the team members were Kevin Farrell , Cassandra Vole , and another student .

The school team that won the first place in the first challenge was Mahoutokoro, the second place was won by Hogwarts (five points behind Mahoutokoro), and the last place was Ilvermorny ( Viggo Victor answered the question wrong, causing the tower to collapse).
Second challenge
The second challenge was chosen by the Ilvermorny team: duelling .
The challenge took place in the Duelling Dungeon and featured two types of duels, which were team and individual.
Each team for the particular challenge had been decided.
Additionally, outside of the team events, each person would need to face at least one individual match.
During this challenge, one of Viggo's spells targeted and attacked Kevin Farrell.
Robyn Thistlethwaite was furious but was stopped by Kenji Kobayashi before she could go to "flatten" Viggo.
Third challenge
The third and final task was chosen by Hogwarts and held in the depths of the Forbidden Forest .
The competitors had to navigate various obstacles, most of which were magical beasts , including some from the Americas and Asia to ensure Hogwarts had no advantage over the other teams.
These creatures included the Demiguise , Nundu , Thunderbird , Acromantula , Hidebehind , and Erumpent .
The goal was to retrieve a treasure hidden in a chest deep within the forest, with it being reported that seven of a new type of broom were inside, guarded by the half-giant witch, Gawrloc .
In this task, Kevin from the Hogwarts team was replaced by Daniel Page due to an injury sustained by Viggo in the previous challenge.
Hogwarts emerged victorious in this task, and henceforth, the Hogwarts team won the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup.

title: Gawrloc
paragraphs: Gawrloc was a female half-giant who served as the final obstacle in the third challenge of the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup .
Biography
At some point in her life, Gawrloc killed a dragon with her bare hands and used its bones , scales , and teeth to make a battle axe .
During the final challenge of the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup in 2012 , the teams had to find a treasure hidden in the depths of the Forbidden Forest .
The only goal was to be the first to open the chest, claiming victory for their school.
To serve as guardian of the chest, Hogwarts sought the help of Gawrloc.
During the challenge, Gawrloc defended the treasure chest, using her natural endurance, spell resistance , superhuman strength, and large battle axe.
She fended off Kenji Kobayashi from the Mahoutokoro team, and Zack Johnson from Ilvermorny , knocking them both out.
The Hogwarts students encountering Gawrloc
Eventually, the surviving members of Team Hogwarts - Cassandra Vole , Daniel Page , and a Muggle-born student - arrived at the chest.
However, when they tried to open it, Gawrloc surprised them.
The students battled the half-giant but couldn't even slow her down.
Remembering what Rubeus Hagrid had told them about a giant's eyes, they decided to cast the Conjunctivitis Curse on Gawrloc.
Cassandra distracted Gawrloc by provoking her, allowing the student to cast the curse , successfully blinding the giant temporarily.
In her desperation, Gawrloc swung her axe towards Cassandra, but Daniel pushed her out of the way, getting hit and knocked out instead.
Cassandra and the student realised they needed to use the forest to defeat Gawrloc.
After another attempt, they managed to trap her with the surrounding Devil's Snare .
Gawrloc admitted defeat, and the pair made their way to the chest.
While bound by the Devil's Snare, Gawrloc witnessed a confrontation between the students and Viggo Victor , who stood in front of the chest but was defeated before actually opening it.
Ivy Warrington then came and saw Gawrloc already defeated, and expressed regret at not being able to fight a giant.
Gawrloc in the Great Hall after the tournament
Gawrloc was present at the tournament's celebration in the Great Hall , where the Intercontinental Trophy was presented to the winning team.

After the award ceremony, Headmistress McGonagall thanked her for her help and enthusiasm during the challenge, asked if her eyes were doing better, and recommended that the Hogwarts matron, Poppy Pomfrey , take a look at her.
Physical description
Being a half-giant , Gawrloc was immensely tall.
She had long brown hair and green eyes, a prominent nose with a wart on it and massive teeth coming out of her mouth.
Notes and references

title: Half-giant
paragraphs: Half-giants were beings with some, but not a total, amount of giant heritage or blood, as well as part human blood.
For instance, someone with this title might have had a giant mother and a wizard father or vice versa.
Characteristics
All known half-giants had magical blood and were capable of producing magic , traits they received from their witch or wizard ancestors.
From their giant family they usually retained a large height and build, they were usually considered extremely tall by human standards and short by giant standards.
They also retained the natural resistance to most types of magical attacks from their giant blood.

It is unknown as to whether a half-giant would still have magic if the human parent was a Muggle ; it is possible they could receive magic from the giant parent as giants are technically magical creatures.
However, the very act of a Muggle even meeting a giant, let alone having offspring with one, would be a breach of Clause 73 of the International Statute of Wizarding Secrecy .

Such a union after the events of the First Wizarding War became even less likely; Muggle mountaineers who approach the colony of the last giants would likely meet their demise at the hands of these fearsome beings.
Half-giants could not use any potion that was only designed for human physiology, such as Polyjuice Potion .
Appearance

The large physical build of half-giants lent itself easily to great physical strength and stamina that could rival many, if not most magical creatures, with endurance dependent on how active an individual's lifestyle was.
They were also gifted with human intelligence, enabling them to learn the use of magic at a wizarding school and the right to own a wand .

Despite their immense stature, half-giants appeared otherwise indistinguishable from humans, as their proportions relative to their size were not said to be abnormal, meaning that they simply appeared as oversized humans.
History
Rubeus Hagrid, a half-giant, was born on 6 December 1928 to Mr Hagrid (a wizard ) and Fridwulfa (a giantess ) and grew up in the West Country of England .
He grewup near the Forest of Dean , where he acquired his distinctive accent.
When Hagrid was about three, his mother returned to her Giant colony , leaving his father to raise him alone.
As a half-giant, he overtook his father in size by the age of six, and amused the " tiny " wizard by picking him up and setting him on top of a dresser when Hagrid was annoyed with him.
Later, when talking to Harry Potter, Ron Weasley, and Hermione Granger about the death of his mother, Hagrid admitted that she was not a great mother at all.
Hagrid grew to a height of eleven and a half feet tall, immense by human standards but very small by giant standards.
Olympe Maxime , a half-giant, was born to one magical parent and one giant (unknown whether the giant was her mother or father) making her a half-giantess.
She kept this heritage hidden, out of fear of the prejudice that would strike her were it to be revealed.
She was likely educated at Beauxbatons in France , as she would later become the establishment's Headmistress .
DUMBLEDORE'S GIANT MISTAKE was an article published in the Daily Prophet in early January 1995 .

It was written by Rita Skeeter and revealed to the public that Rubeus Hagrid was a half-giant on the side of his mother, Fridwulfa , and also contained a number of nasty insinuations regarding Hagrid's suitability to teach at Hogwarts .
As was the usual standard with material published by Rita Skeeter, the article contained a certain amount of fact, but mixed it with exaggerations, insinuations, and at least one outright falsehood.

Upon the publication of the article, Hagrid received a large amount of hate mail , which caused him to lock himself in his hut and refuse to teach classes, requiring a substitute to teach them instead.
Not long after reading this article, Harry, Ron and Hermione paid a visit to Hagrid in an attempt to draw him out, but he simply refused to answer his door.
Oppression
Many half-giants had been discriminated against, as with werewolves , centaurs , and other half-humans.
This prejudice was notoriously demonstrated by Death Eaters , some pure-bloods , and simply rude individuals like Dolores Umbridge .

One example of this prejudice was then- Minister for Magic Cornelius Fudge accusing Olympe Maxime of murdering Bartemius Crouch Senior during his conversation with Albus Dumbledore because of the circumstantial evidence of Crouch's disappearance taking place near the Beauxbatons Carriage , despite having no conclusive evidence to back up this claim and instead basing this suspicion around the violent nature that giants commonly have.
Pure giants also looked down on half-giants due to their inferior sizes, as it was a giant's pride to give birth to large children.
Half-giants were rare, as Hagrid never thought he would meet another one before Madame Maxime.
This suggests that the bonding between humans and giants was indeed rare, seeing animosity for giants as it was.
Maxime desperately kept her heritage hidden to protect herself from prejudice.

title: Magizoologist
paragraphs: Newt Scamander , a famous magizoologist
A Magizoologist was a wizard or witch who studied magical creatures professionally (a field known as magizoology ); though they might also be referred to as wizarding naturalists.

In certain cases, a Magizoologist's obligations might not be limited to merely observing and taking care of magical creatures, as they might even be immersed in sanctioned breeding, and even actively tracking and rescuing them from less-principled parties.

A wizard or witch might not need to have graduated from a wizarding school to become a Magizoologist, as Newt Scamander was expelled from Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , and still managed to become a highly renowned Magizoologist in his adult life.
Rubeus Hagrid also did not graduate from Hogwarts, but later became the Care of Magical Creatures Professor.
History
Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
The Scamander family had many members that have worked as magizoologists.
One of the most famous magizoologists was Newt Scamander .
He was the author of Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them .
Early in life, Scamander developed an interest in magical creatures that was influenced by his mother 's breeding of Hippogriffs .
Newt's grandson Rolf and his wife Luna were considered wizarding naturalists.
Care of Magical Creatures was a class taught at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for students who wished to learn about magical beasts.
Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them was a required textbook and the Professor of the subject could be counted as a Magizoologist, since they were educating others about creatures.
When Field Studies , which involved studying creatures in their natural habitat, was added as a class to Hogwarts in the 2010s , both its Professors were renowned Magizoologists.
A dragonologist was a Magizoologist who specialised in the study and handling of dragons .
Known Magizoologists

title: Mending Charm
paragraphs: The Mending Charm , also known as the Repairing Charm ( Reparo ), was a charm that could be used to seamlessly repair a broken or ripped object and worked on most materials.
This incredibly useful and practical charm was invented by Orabella Nuttley , in or before 1754 .
History
The charm was invented by Orabella Nuttley , an employee of the Improper Use of Magic Office in the British Ministry of Magic , in or before 1754 .
She used her charm to repair the Colosseum after it had been accidentally destroyed.
Thereafter, it became famous; this instance was recorded in Book of Spells , by Miranda Goshawk .

There were various textbooks containing instructions for this spell, including The Standard Book of Spells, Grade 1 (a first-year Charms textbook at Hogwarts ), although there was still a spellbook designated entirely to the teaching of this charm .
During the 1985-1986 school year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , this spell was taught to second-year students in Transfiguration by Professor Minerva McGonagall .
Effects
The Mending charm's effects
The Mending Charm was effective at repairing most materials.
However, damage caused by certain rare, powerful curses such as Fiendfyre were impossible to undo.
The charm was suitable for use only on inanimate objects.
Use on living beings was entirely proscribed.
Serious scarring could result if it were cast on a person or animal in an attempt to heal wounds.
This charm mending a broken plate
While a properly cast Mending Charm was generally enough to fix an object, it seemed less experienced casters might not have succeeded in returning liquids to broken containers.
There were some limits on what the spell could do concerning magical objects - it couldn't repair broken magic.
For example, while the charm might fix the physical shell of a broken wand, the magic inside would remain damaged beyond repair, causing the wand in question to fall apart again upon attempted use.
The sole exception to this rule was the Elder Wand , which was used to successfully repaired Harry's wand , due to the strength and magnitude of the Elder Wand's power.
Additionally, this charm did not seem to work on objects of powerful and complex magic , such as broken Vanishing Cabinets .
Draco Malfoy proved this by having spent almost an entire school year trying to repair the damaged cabinet through a more specific spell , due to the complexity of the magical passage.
This charm specifically didn't work well on clothing, and was only able to repair small rips and tears.
If a piece of clothing was torn to shreds or otherwise heavily damaged, then the Mending Charm wouldn't be able to do much.
Known uses
Successful
Unsuccessful
Known practitioners
Variations
Two similar spells existed: Oculus Reparo , which was used to repair glasses , and Papyrus Reparo , which could be used to restore torn pieces of paper.
Their history and relationship to the original Mending Charm - apart from the etymology and effects - are unknown.
It is also possible that these incantations were just the Mending Charm with the appropriate spell modifier added.
Etymology
Reparo is a play on reparo (latin for fix, mend, or put back).
Notes and references

title: Reviving Spell
paragraphs: The Reviving Spell ( Rennervate ) was a spell whose effect depended on the intent of the caster, and were either categorised as a charm that could be used to awaken a living target from a state of unconsciousness, and consequently served as the counter-charm to the Stunning Spell , or as a curse that would reanimate a dead target, typically by Dark wizards , turning the corpse in question into a grisly puppet known as an Inferius .
Effect
It could be used to counteract a single Stunning Spell , although it was ineffective against multiple Stunners hitting an individual.
It was also ineffective against Dark Magic , such as the Drink of Despair , when only used once.

When the spell was used on deceased bodies with the intent to reanimate them , however, they wouldn't come back to life, but rather their physical form could be controlled by the wizard in a form of necromancy .
Known uses
Known practitioners
Etymology
The original incantation was Enervate , which means "to weaken".
Due to this misconception, J. K. Rowling officially renamed it to " Rennervate ", which means "to energise".
Notes and references

title: Rosmerta
paragraphs: Madam Rosmerta (fl.
1970s-2010s) was a British witch who was the landlady of the Three Broomsticks Inn pub in the village of Hogsmeade .
Rosmerta was put under the Imperius Curse , cast by Draco Malfoy in 1997 .
After being placed under the curse , she helped Malfoy against her will to smuggle cursed items into Hogwarts Castle .
It is likely she later redeemed herself by fighting in the Battle of Hogwarts .
Biography
Early life
Rosmerta was born into a family of unknown wizarding descent no later than 1955 and attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry during her formative years.
Bartender at the Three Broomsticks

By the 1973-1974 school year, Rosmerta had graduated from Hogwarts and worked as the barmaid at the Three Broomsticks in Hogsmeade , during which time the establishment would be visited by the Marauders whilst they were all still at school, and continued to do so throughout the First Wizarding War .

During the conflict, the young Rosmerta, despite living in constant fear of the prospect that the worst of wizardkind would emerge victorious, nevertheless played a small role in passing on useful information she overheard at the inn, though she mostly just kept her head down.
Like most of the magical community, she also suffered personal bereavements during the first period of Voldemort's power, as she knew some of the people who went mysteriously missing,

She also suffered adverse effects from the war herself, as she was one of the numerous witches and wizards who fell victim to what, unbeknownst to herself, were the Frequensting - curse of the Death Eater Antoine Grimalkin , a which inflicted an intensifying, rhythmic stinging pain in its victim along with the echoed looping piece of music from a cursed gramophone , which continued to torment them and even after the sound.

Rosmerta was able to deduce it was connected to the Dark Lord and his followers when, on 1 November 1981 , she and the rest of his victims, woke up to the news of the Voldemort's defeat and James and Lily Potter 's deaths, and the realisation that the mysterious ailment no longer plagued them.
She was later one of the many people who believed the rumours that Sirius Black had turned his friends over to Lord Voldemort , and later that he had duelled and killed Peter Pettigrew .
Madam Rosmerta meeting Jacob's sibling for the first time
She continued to tend bar during the 1980s .
During the 1986-1987 school year , Rosmerta was introduced to Jacob's sibling by Rubeus Hagrid in the Three Broomsticks during the student's first outing to Hogsmeade .

They requested for information regarding their brother and his search for the Cursed Vaults from Rosmerta, in which they learnt from her recount that Jacob had Transfigured a secret notebook of his into a Black Quill, the whereabouts of which were unknown then.
Jacob's sibling beseeched Rosmerta to find it for them, promising to do anything for her in return, an offer she promptly accepted.

While Rosmerta was preoccupied in searching for the Black Quill in the pub's back room, Jacob's sibling proceeded to help her out by serving her customers their orders, an activity they found moderatly easy, with the exception of them having nearly dropped a mug of Butterbeer that was Tranfigured into a mongoose by the timely intervention of a helpful wizard.

Acknowledging that her search for the desired quill would take longer, Rosmerta requested that Jacob's sibling help her concoct an extra-sweet brew of Butterbeer by fetching its various ingredients from the Hogwarts Castle for her.
By the time they had managed to fulfil her request and returned to the Three Broomsticks, Rosmerta had managed to successfully retrieve the Black Quill, which she then gave to Jacob's sibling.
Later during the year, she retrieved some vintage Butterbeer 1707 for Bilton Bilmes upon Jacob's sibling 's request from the back rooms of the inn, while they managed the customers for her.
Rosmerta was interrogated by Patricia Rakepick regarding the possible whereabouts of Jacob 's notebook and map.

She claimed to know nothing and threatened to inform some of her best customers from the Department of Magical Law Enforcement regarding Rakepick's behaviour, which made the Curse-Breaker back down quickly.
Rosmerta than sarcastically gave her farewell and told her not to return to her establishment again.
Towards the end of this school year, Rosmerta was present at a party held at the inn by various Hogwarts staff and students, which the Weird Sisters also performed at.
During this school year, Rosmerta gave Jacob's sibling and Nymphadora Tonks the permission to use her fireplace in the inn to access the British Ministry of Magic via the Floo Network .
Much later, she served Jacob's sibling and their father Peregrine when the two came to the Three Broomsticks for a personal dinner.
However, she ended up dropping the two mugs of Butterbeer Peregrine ordered when he told her to stop listening in on their private conversation.
Rosmerta, Cornelius Fudge, and Minerva McGonagall meeting outside her pub

In the 1993-1994 school year , Madam Rosmerta was angered when Dementors were in Hogsmeade to catch Sirius Black because their presence was scaring away many of her customers, not least when they searched her pub twice.
She hosted an informal meeting between Minerva McGonagall , Cornelius Fudge , Filius Flitwick , and Rubeus Hagrid discussing Sirius Black and his friends.
They discussed how Sirius Black had been named Harry Potter's godfather before the Potters' demise.
Second Wizarding War
Rosmerta talking with Fudge and McGonagall
In 1997, it emerged that Rosmerta had become an unwilling agent of the Death Eaters .
In order to fulfil his mission to assassinate Albus Dumbledore, Draco Malfoy had managed to place Rosmerta under the Imperius Curse .

He used her to pass on a cursed Opal Necklace to Hogwarts student Katie Bell with the Imperius Curse, but Katie accidentally touched the necklace and was subjected to the very harmful curse intended for the Headmaster, nearly killing her.

Rosmerta also poisoned mead that was intended to be given to Dumbledore through Horace Slughorn in the guise as a Christmas present, but it was unintentionally drunk by Ron Weasley , who was saved by Harry Potter; Harry had shoved a Bezoar down Ron's throat to save his life.
Malfoy communicated with Rosmerta through fake galleons , copying the idea from 'the Mudblood Granger ' and Dumbledore's Army .
Argus Filch did not suspect anything provided by Rosmerta, hence allowing the poisoned mead to sneak past security.

After Harry and Dumbledore had been to the cave to retrieve a locket , they believed to be one of Voldemort 's Horcruxes , they Apparated to Hogsmeade , where Madam Rosmerta alerted them to the presence of the Dark Mark above the school and gave them brooms on which they could travel rapidly back to Hogwarts, where Draco's plan could be brought to completion.
Harry Potter eventually cleared her name, as he feared that that an investigation into Albus Dumbledore's death might link to her.
It is unknown if Rosmerta was part of the reinforcements from Hogsmeade during the Battle of Hogwarts or if she participated in the war.
This battle resulted in the end of the Second Wizarding War .
Rosmerta in the 2010s
Madam Rosmerta had trouble with her Christmas tree decorations vanishing yearly.
In December 2010 , a student helped her track the stolen baubles to a group of Nifflers , and she let them keep a few.
On another day, she noticed the student looking down and found out they had argued with Robyn Thistlethwaite .
Rosmerta encouraged them to keep trying, saying true friends come around with time.
In December , Rosmerta caught Renka Rabblehauser putting up anti- werewolf posters in the Three Broomsticks and called them "filth".
Renka insisted werewolves were dangerous, and Rosmerta accused her of wanting Ministry officials everywhere - which Renka didn't deny.
Aberforth Dumbledore backed Rosmerta, causing Renka to storm off.
Later, she welcomed a student to the pub and recommended Butterbeer or pumpkin fizz .
After the student and Daniel Page dealt with a sudden spider outbreak, she thanked them with free drinks, blaming it on Rubeus Hagrid 's pets.
When the student met her again outside the pub, Rosmerta warned them about local politics, especially the werewolf debate.
Though the student disagreed with the fear, she advised them to be careful what they said.
After a break-in to the pub, Rosmerta used Mending Charms to repair the damage.
When questioned, she reminded the student Aberforth warned them not to get involved, but said she wouldn't tell if they didn't stop.
Rosmerta noticed Professor Minerva McGonagall meeting with Bewildering Blooms owner Yubert Thorne in her pub.

Astrid Cole asked Rosmerta if the two were still in the pub while pursuing Thorne alongside the student in an attempt to save Professor McGonagall from the Mysterious Malady , but Rosmerta told her that they had just left together.
During the Calamity , Rosmerta instructed a panel of Magizoologists on a basic Revive Charm , which they later worked with Poppy Pomfrey to refine.

Rosmerta also greeted a Calamity Investigator working for the Statute of Secrecy Task Force along with a slew of ecstatic pub owners when they arrived at the Three Broomsticks Inn , as their efforts to enhance wizarding inns had resulted in a sharp uptick in business.
Physical description
Madam Rosmerta as a middle-aged women
Rosmerta was an attractive woman with long wavy blonde hair and green eyes, described as " a curvy sort of woman with a pretty face ".
On one occasion, she was seen wearing glittery open-toed high-heels.
Several Hogwarts pupils, including Ron Weasley , have fancied her.
Magical abilities and skills
Possessions
Etymology
Rosmerta was the Romano-Celtic goddess of fertility and abundance, known as the "Great Provider".
In Latin, it means "good purveyor" or "great provider".
