title: Verucca Buckthorn-Snyde
paragraphs: Verucca Buckthorn-Snyde , known as the Director , was a Dark witch , who was a high-ranking member of a dangerous organisation known as ' R '.
She was also a Metamorphmagus who could change her appearance at will.
Biography
Early life
Verucca was born into the Snyde family .
She later married into the Buckthorn family, taking the double-barrelled surname Buckthorn-Snyde.

She became Merula Snyde 's legal guardian after her sister and brother-in-law were both sent to Azkaban for being Death Eaters after the First Wizarding War , however rather than living with her, she would let Merula live at the empty house of her parents, checking in semi-regularly.
She raised Merula to think that black cats were evil and brought bad luck.
Every Christmas she would cast the Snowflake-Making Spell , and taught the spell to Merula so she could participate in the tradition as well.
Merula fondly remembered this tradition, as it was the only spell her aunt taught her which couldn't be used to hurt someone.
At an unspecified point in time, Verucca joined the enigmatic "R", a powerful and clandestine society of witches and wizards that opposed the British Ministry of Magic .
She worked her way up through the ranks and assumed the alias of "the Director", named as such for her exultant rank in the cabal.
1988-1989 school year
Verucca approaching Jacob's sibling in Knockturn Alley

During the 1988-1989 school year , when Jacob's sibling and a friend visited Knockturn Alley , Verucca prevented them from entering Borgin and Burkes and asked for a sacrifice of their anatomy in order for them to enjoy safe passage in Knockturn Alley.
She duelled them and attracted more Dark Witches and Wizards.
However, Patricia Rakepick arrived in time and defeated them, including Verucca, whom she swiftly blasted to the floor with a spell .

In the 1989 summer holidays , Merula made an Unbreakable Vow with Verucca, to ensure she remained loyal to her one "true" family, or die , promising her niece that she would teach her to defeat Patricia Rakepick.
Merula was initially unaware Verucca was also a member of "R" and had to do everything her aunt told her to do.
1989-1990 school year
During the 1989-1990 school year , Verucca was magically impersonated by Mundungus Fletcher as a disguise in Knockturn Alley.
Jacob's sibling uncovered his disguise with the Revelio Charm to reveal him to Nymphadora Tonks and Ben Copper .

At an unspecified period in time during this year, Verucca revealed to her niece her true identity as a high-ranking player in R's game and seemingly used the Unbreakable Vow made between them to manipulate Merula into becoming a follower - though not yet a member - of R.

Later during this school year, Verucca attended a secret meeting of " R " outside Borgin and Burkes with Kazuhiro Shiratori to discuss R's next courses of actions, which Jacob's sibling infiltrated impersonating Patricia Rakepick using Polyjuice Potion .

Along with Shiratori, Verucca questioned the presence of 'Rakepick', who had informed R that her appearance so early after taking the life of a Hogwarts student might endanger the group, which Verucca brought up in her inquiry.

Verucca and Kazuhiro were apparently expecting other members of the Cabal, but the disguised Jacob's sibling pushed the discussion ahead and the three discuss how their mole in Hogwarts (Merula) was providing them with a great source of information, Verucca assuring her associates she and their spy were in constant contact.

When the real Rakepick Apparated onto the scene and exposed Jacob's sibling, Verucca helped her fight Jacob's sibling's team, deflecting a spell fired by Nymphadora Tonks (who had been standing by in the form of a dark witch), then walking to join Patricia in the wake of Jacob and Alastor Moody's arrival and Disapparating away after Rakepick assured R's foes their fight was not over, though Kazuhiro was captured.
Verucca having revealed her true appearance in Knockturn Alley

At some point near the end of the school year, Verucca was seen in the Hog's Head Inn and was what appeared at the time to be unknowingly eavesdropped by Jacob's sibling and Mundungus Fletcher while talking about meeting someone later.
In Knockturn Alley , she met Merula Snyde , who was ready to join R .
Then she transformed into her original look and took Merula with her.

Because of Merula's place as a student at Hogwarts who was assisting in seeking out the Cursed Vault, Verucca had initially given her two tasks: persuade Jacob's sibling to join the ranks of R and to secure Crown of Mneme located in the Sunken Vault .
The crown's powers were needed in R's plan to rid the Ministry of corruption by forcing officials they considered corrupt via mind control.
To achieve the latter, Verucca gave her niece a potion that, when drunk, rendered her immune to the effects of the Vault and when Merula stole the artefact, she presumably gave it to her aunt.
1990-1991 school year
She infiltrated the British Ministry of Magic during the 1990-1991 school year , disguising herself as several individuals, including Reginald Cattermole , Amos Diggory and Nymphadora Tonks .
She also cursed the enchanted windows to display a hurricane.

After Jacob's sibling updated Corey Hayden about the events, Corey suspected the Dark witch from Knockturn Alley to be the same individual who had infiltrated the Ministry due to the known transfiguration of her in the previous school year .
Zenith Xeep giving Verucca the stolen wand

Later, disguising herself as as Wilkie Twycross , Verucca revealed herself during a meeting with Zenith Xeep in Knockturn Alley and talked about Xeep's Luscious Locks Solution and the wand Zenith had stolen from Ollivanders , the former of which's name she found ridiculous while inquiring of its potency.

During the meeting, Verucca demonstrated the authority and power her rank gave her over Xeep, who showed immediate deference towards her, as well as subtly threatening Zenith, reminding the opera singer that she would be wise to remember how Verucca answered to incompetence.
When Zenith was about to give her the wand, Ben Copper , who had been secretly watching with Jacob's sibling , rashly interrupted them, and Verucca instantly used the Stunning Spell on him.
When Jacob's sibling also emerged, they and Verucca exchanged a brief look before she Disapparated , leaving Xeep to be defeated, then lose her memory via her own potion.

Later during the school year, when Jacob's sibling accused Merula Snyde of being a member of R by the Hogwarts Whomping Willow after a wandless duel, Merula explained she only attacked them as she feared they were Verucca in disguise.

Prior to this event, Verucca had let slip the presence of a R infiltrator within St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries whilst scolding her niece for her failure to as of yet convince Jacob's sibling to embrace R as she had been commanded to, telling Merula it now no longer mattered, as, in her words, " Burke's idea [was] no laughing matter ".
Verucca in St Mungo's

After Jacob's sibling defeated the R agent and Healer Eustace Burke in a St Mungo's ward in a duel , Verucca appeared on the scene via Apparition, knocked Jacob's sibling over with a spell , refused to divulge her identity to them when asked and Disapparated away, taking Burke with her.

Later at the shore of the Black Lake , Merula Snyde told Jacob's sibling more about Verucca, telling them she was commonly called the "Director" by other members of R and that she was powerful and fearsome.
Verucca in the Shrieking Shack

After Merula had kidnapped Corey Hayden and taken them to the Shrieking Shack , Jacob's sibling followed Merula there, where they encountered Verucca, who revealed her name to Jacob's sibling, and that she was Merula's aunt.

She informed that Rakepick, Kazuhiro Shiratori and Eustace Burke were merely pawns in the plan to bring them to R, and that she had arranged the meeting she had with Merula in Knockturn Alley the year prior so they would witness it, making sure to behave suspiciously around Mundungus Fletcher so they would seek her out.
She also told them it was finally time for them to know their purpose and why they were destined to lead R, and introduced them to Peregrine , the leader of R and their long lost father.

She was present with Merula while Peregrine was telling Corey and their child that their organisation was not evil, but that it supposedly sought good, giving only a smile when Peregrine noted that while the methods Verucca utilised were extreme, they were undoubtedly effective.
Verucca standing in Jacob's sibling's way in the Shrieking Shack
Verucca spent the year brewing Dai Ryusaki 's mind-enhancing potion for "R", with her forcing Merula to tell her the ingredients.

After Merula returned from collecting Jacob's sibling per Verucca's instructions, Verucca herself was present when Peregrine tested "R"'s mind control plan in the Shrieking Shack, involving Jacob wearing the Crown of Mneme enhanced with the potion to control their friend's mind, and tried to stop Jacob's sibling from interfering, moving in front of them as they started forwards to warn them with a smile that she would be observing their every movement during the testing.

Listening wordlessly as Peregrine addressed the wizards and witches present, Verucca, included, welcoming them to what he called the "dawn of a new era for wizardkind", after which Verucca boasted at her accomplishment in recreating Dai Ryusaki's potion to enhance the mind, which she noted to not be without it' difficulties.

When Peregrine revealed that R had learnt of the potion's full recipe from Merula, Verucca encouraged Jacob's sibling not to judge her niece to harshly, declaring that it was not as if she had a choice in the matter, and soon after, she reminded them of how she had met with Zenith Xeep previously to obtain the wand Peregrine had displayed to them.

Diverting her gaze from Merula and her friend to stand by Peregrine as the two members of R watched as Jacob initiated the ritual, which Verucca beheld with delight, vowing that now that R's plans were coming into blossom, the Ministry of Magic would regret crossing them.

The plan was unsuccessful as wearing the cursed Crown pained Jacob, and Jacob's sibling knocked the Crown away before Jacob took them away with Apparition, which Verucca and Peregrine went to retrieve.
Verucca meeting with Jacob's sibling in Knockturn Alley
Later, Merula told Jacob's sibling in the Boathouse that Verucca wanted to privately meet with them in Knockturn Alley , much to their surprise shock.

Although very reluctant at first, they met with Verucca, where she told them that she thought Peregrine, her leader was behaving erratically, not like the Peregrine she once knew, and he risked derailing the entire organisation's plans.
They informed her that he was wearing Dai Ryusaki's amulet , which she acknowledged as a potent cursed artefact.
She then told them they had a shared common goal of helping their father, and that she had to work with her to steal the amulet off him to return him to normal.

Although they agreed (with hesitancy) to her deal, they later informed Alastor Moody in the Ministry of her offer, and he agreed he would intercept Verucca while doing so, as she was a wanted criminal.

Merula later told the student Verucca was a difficult woman to please with no time for small talk, while giving them advise on how to best deal with her, while still maintaining the Unbreakable Vow with her.
Verucca meeting with Jacob and his sibling in the Hog's Head Inn
Verucca met with Jacob and their sibling in the Hog's Head Inn , where she disguised herself as a witch with red hair to avoid detection in public, along with her distrust of Jacob's family .
While discussing their plan, she told them that they would act as bait, and then she would make Peregrine hand over the amulet with the Imperius Curse .

However when they both refused using an Unforgivable Curse on their dad, Jacob's sibling proposed Verucca meet with Peregrine, with the two of them striking when Verucca signalled Jacob's arrival via Apparition.
Verucca told them if the plan fell through, she would take matters into her own hands.
Verucca and Peregrine in Knockturn Alley
Verucca met with Peregrine in Knockturn Alley as planned.
Peregrine blamed Verucca for the failure of their experiment with the Crown of Mneme , with Jacob then arriving on the scene to confront his dad.

Jacob's sibling tried sneaking on their dad with the Invisibility Cloak but failed, with Verucca then taking matters into her own hands, with Verucca casting a powerful purple spell at Peregrine, but Jacob intercepted it and was knocked out.
Verucca then Disapparated from the scene as soon as Moody and his Aurors arrived.
Merula later told Jacob's sibling that Verucca suspected that the two would double-cross her with Aurors.
The spell Verucca had cast was a powerful variation of the Conjunctivitis Curse that completely blinded Jacob, with Peregrine swearing vegeance against her for having cursed his son.
Verucca and Merula at the Viaduct
After the Circle of Khanna defeated most of 'R' at the Viaduct during their attack against Hogwarts , Verucca appeared on the scene with Merula by her side.

Upon the Viaduct, Verucca confronted Peregrine, informing him that she was intending to take over as the group's leader, and demanding for to hand over the amulet, swiftly disarming Peregrine with a smile.

Verucca then duelled again with Jacob's sibling and lost, being disarmed of her wand and falling to the floor before Merula, who she demanded defend her, insulting in the process her relation's intelligence as she reminded her of her vow.
Merula abandoned her aunt, but did not break her Unbreakable Vow, as her friends at Hogwarts served as a true family, leading Verucca to denounce her as an ungrateful brat.
Verucca controlling Fiendfyre at the Viaduct

Verucca then wandlessly summoned her wand to conjure Fiendfyre , vowing furiously to enact vengeance on all who stood before her and climbing to her feet as she controlled the flames to attack Peregrine.

This caused Peregrine to fall from the Viaduct without his wand, forcing Jacob's sibling and Merula to flee while she watched, only to be confronted and held at wand-point by a member of the Auror Office.
Verucca was subsequently arrested by Aurors on the scene led by Moody, and was taken into custody at Azkaban , along with all other 'R' members.
Physical description
Verucca, in her most commonly assumed form, was a witch with short white hair with amber streaks and light skin, with brown eyes.
She wore a long dark purple dress with a pin of the Evil Eye and a small black hat.
Personality and traits
Verucca was a cunning dark witch who was not to be crossed.
Her niece Merula was frightened of disobeying her orders, given the Unbreakable Vow she established with her.
She was a strong-willed leader who was willing to take control of difficult situtations should others fail.

She considered herself more than capable of leading her organisation, and was more than willing to betray her leader Peregrine when she considered him unfit for his role, proving that R itself was the only entity she was genuinely loyal to.
She also had a vicious, violent temper, summoning Fiendfyre in an attempt to kill Peregrine when everyone had turned against her.

title: Slug-vomiting Charm
paragraphs: The Slug-vomiting Charm ( Slugulus Eructo ) was a curse , that forced the victim to vomit slugs .
They may also have taken on a sallow complexion as a side-effect.
It was described as a green jet of light.
Treacle fudge can cure the effects in a few seconds, although it will eventually wear off on its own.
History
Ron vomiting slugs

During the 1988-1989 school year of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , Jacob's sibling ventured out to Knockturn Alley with a companion, during which they encountered a dark witch who maliciously used this curse on Jacob's sibling's companion.
Towards the start of the 1992-1993 school year , Ron Weasley attempted to curse Draco Malfoy with this spell after Draco referred to Hermione Granger as a " filthy little Mudblood ".
However, because his wand was broken, the spell backfired, causing Ron to curse himself instead.
Ron was then taken inside to Rubeus Hagrid 's Hut where he threw up slugs every so often into the basin given to him by Hagrid.

title: Gellert Grindelwald's wand
paragraphs: The wand of Gellert Grindelwald was of an unknown length , wood , and core material.
He likely obtained it prior to starting his education at the Durmstrang Institute , and used it throughout his school career, and beyond.
Grindelwald's wand remained in its master's possession in the months following his expulsion from Durmstrang.
However, Grindelwald eventually set it aside upon attaining mastery of the Elder Wand .
History
Creation and early usage
Grindelwald holding his wand
While at Durmstrang, Grindelwald gained a reputation as a brilliant student, with an unfortunate fascination with the Dark Arts .
Eventually Grindelwald's experiments in Dark Magic escalated to the point where he came close to killing a number of his fellow students.
After this incident Grindelwald was expelled from Durmstrang, but not before he carved the Sign of the Deathly Hallows onto one of the castle's walls.
Later usage
After his expulsion, Grindelwald set out on an expedition to find the Deathly Hallows , which he had long been obsessed with.
His journey took him to Godric's Hollow , where he sought to investigate the grave of Ignotus Peverell .
While in Godric's Hollow, Grindelwald struck up a romance with an eighteen year old Albus Dumbledore .
Together the two boys dreamed of a world in which wizards would rule over Muggles , and sought to find and use the Deathly Hallows to help them achieve this goal.
At some point during this time the two young lovers forged a blood pact to ensure they could never move against one another.

After two months of scheming Dumbledore and Grindelwald were all but ready to put their plans into action, and were preparing to depart on their quest for the Hallows, with Albus's younger sister Ariana to accompany them.
Unfortunately Ariana was in no fit state to travel, and it was Dumbledore's other sibling Aberforth who informed them so, refusing point blank to allow them to take Ariana abroad with them.
Grindelwald became enraged and inflicted the Cruciatus Curse on Aberforth, instigating a three way duel , in which Ariana was killed.
Fearing retribution for his part in the incident, Grindelwald fled the country, on what was now to be a solo quest.
Final usage
Working alone from this point on, Grindelwald pursued rumours of the Elder Wand , one of the three Hallows, which was said to reside with the noted wandmaker Mykew Gregorovitch .
Grindelwald located Gregorovitch's place of business, and broke into his workshop stealing the Elder Wand from its rightful master.
Gregorovitch burst into the room, intent on apprehending the thief.
Grindelwald then drew his wand for what may have been the final time.
He incapacitated the wandmaker with a Stunning Spell , and made his escape, the world's most powerful wand now in his possession.
Search for Grindelwald's wand
Grindelwald's wand by the 1991-1992 school year
Grindelwald's wand eventually ended up in the possession of Borgin and Burkes by the 1991-1992 school year , although Borgin and Caractacus Burke didn't obtain its provenance.
A magical artefacts collector bought the wand from the store and sought to verify it as Grindelwald's.

At the same time, a Metamorphmagus Dark wizard used the Cruciatus Curse on a number of individuals in an attempt to track down Grindelwald's wand to "reclaim Grindelwald's glory", catching the attention of the British Auror Office .
Kingsley Shacklebolt and Nymphadora Tonks were assigned to stake out Knockturn Alley in the hopes of capturing the Dark wizard.

With the Auror Office being short-handed, particularly due to the Dark wizard sending two Aurors to St Mungo's , Alastor Moody brought in the Rare, Obscure, and Confounding Case Division agent Jacob's sibling to help.
After Jacob's sibling met with Kingsley and Tonks, the three staked out Borgin and Burkes, as they had received intel that the Dark wizard was inside.

Noticing Mundungus Fletcher leaving Borgin and Burkes, Jacob's sibling convinced him to tell them that the Dark wizard had been inside the shop using the Cruciatus Curse on Borgin and demanding the location of the wand, although Borgin told him that the wand had already been sold to a collector.
Mundungus claimed that the Dark wizard had already left the shop, but stated that he had simply disappeared with no sign of Apparition or Floo powder .

After Kingsley had interviewed Borgin regarding the situation, he, Tonks, and Jacob's sibling met up at the Department of Magical Law Enforcement , where they discussed the collector who had bought the wand.
Kingsley stated that Borgin had claimed that the collector was legitimate and sought to obtain the provenance of the wand.
Knowing that Borgin and Burkes hadn't bothered to obtain the wand's provenance, the three realised that the collector would likely seek out Garrick Ollivander to verify the wand as Grindelwald's.
Jacob's sibling stated that, if they could get to the collector in time, they could involve the collector and Ollivander to set a trap for the Dark wizard.
Kingsley and Tonks agreed, deciding to head to the collector's home due to the higher likelihood that the Dark wizard would be there.

Jacob's sibling offered to visit Ollivanders to explain the situation to Ollivander before joining them at the collector's house, with Kingsley and Tonks agreeing after Kingsley was assured of what Jacob's sibling would do if confronted by the Dark wizard there.
However, before Jacob's sibling got to Ollivanders, the Dark wizard had already incapacitated Ollivander and used his Metamorphmagus abilities to assume his appearance.
Unaware of this, Jacob's sibling arrived at Ollivanders and questioned "Ollivander" regarding the wand on Auror business. "
Ollivander" seemed to have forgotten ever meeting Jacob's sibling and quickly attempted to hurry them out of the shop, claiming that he was closing up and doing inventory.

Jacob's sibling insisted on continuing the questioning, finding that "Ollivander" claimed that he didn't remember every wand he had ever sold and seemed to be extolling Gregorovitch's wands over his own.

Jacob's sibling quickly realised that "Ollivander" was actually an impostor and demanded they reveal themselves, with the Dark wizard revealing himself and his Metamorphmagus abilities, explaining his ability to disappear.
Jacob's sibling immediately cast either the Impediment Jinx or the Confundus Charm on the Dark wizard, incapacitating him, and secured the wand before alerting Kingsley and Tonks.

Jacob's sibling met up with Kingsley in the Department of Magical Law Enforcement, with Kingsley stating that the Dark wizard was awaiting trial and a likely Azkaban sentence and that the wand had been sent to a secure vault.

Kingsley also informed them that Ollivander was shaken but alive, having snuck through a back door when Jacob's sibling showed up and distracted the Dark wizard, and was having his statement taken by Tonks.

Kingsley offered Jacob's sibling some advice on working as an Auror before giving them a badge depicting Grindelwald's wand on behalf of Moody to remind them of their great accomplishments and all those that were still to come.

title: Metamorphmagus
paragraphs: A Metamorphmagus.
A Metamorphmagus (pl.
Metamorphmagi ) was a witch or wizard with the rare magical ability to change their physical appearance.
While most of the wizarding population required Polyjuice Potion , Fluxweed Syrup , or a Human Transfiguration spell , a Metamorphmagus could alter their form through sheer will alone.
Difference from Animagi
While both had the ability to transform at will, Animagi could only transform into one particular type of animal, which was predetermined by their inner traits.

By contrast, Metamorphmagi could take a wide variety of forms, changing gender and age, potentially looking like anyone at all, or even just changing a part of their appearance, such as the colour of their hair or shape of their noses.
Also, anyone could learn to become an Animagus.
It was a long and difficult process that had to be done in a specific way, but anyone could learn it all the same as long as they had the skill and patience for it.
A Metamorphmagus on the other hand was born, not made; it was not a magical skill that could be learned.
There also seemed to be a degree of heritability, as both Nymphadora Tonks and her son, Teddy Lupin , were Metamorphmagi, although both of Tonks's parents, Andromeda and Ted , were not.
It is unknown if Metamorphmagi had to register with the Ministry of Magic like Animagi had to, as Metamorphmagi did not choose to become what they were, while Animagi did.
Although, while Animagi possessed distinct markings on their animal forms which carried over from their true forms, Metamorphmagi did not.
Therefore, it would be far more difficult to keep track of them for any signs of ability abuse.
Metamorphic usage
Nymphadora Tonks changing her facial features at will and with ease.
Metamorphmagi could use their abilities to make themselves look exactly like another person.
During her school years at Hogwarts School, Tonks often got detentions for turning into teachers.
This also included ghosts .

While all witches and wizards had the potential to learn such magic (albeit at a highly advanced level ), Metamorphmagi did not need their wands or any potions to utilise their transformation abilities as other witches and wizards did.
Like many other types of magic, a Metamorphmagus's abilities were affected by their emotional state.
The person's appearance at any moment would often reflect the emotion the person is feeling at the time.
Strong emotions, such as shock or sadness, could affect their abilities to the point of having trouble using them at all.
For example, Nymphadora Tonks had difficulty using her abilities following Sirius Black 's death , and when she was depressed over her feelings for Remus Lupin .
Metamorphic abilities could be very helpful when it came to disguises.
For example, Nymphadora Tonks was able to put her abilities to use in performing espionage for the Order of the Phoenix .
She also got full marks in Concealment and Disguise of her Auror training , implying that this ability could be used for official examinations and competitions.
It is unknown whether Metamorphmagi received any training in developing their innate skill, or if they learnt through trial and error.
Given their rarity, it was unlikely that much training was available.
Nymphadora Tonks showed that she only needed to concentrate a little to change her appearance, so it may simply be a matter of the Metamorphmagus wanting to change.
Furthermore, the ability might present very early in life, as Teddy Lupin's hair changed colour when he was a newborn infant, as did his mother's.
Albus Dumbledore wrote an article in a 1926 issue of Transfiguration Today examining whether it was possible for Metamorphmagi to use their transformational abilities to disappear without a trace.
Known Metamorphmagi
Etymology
In Greek, "meta" means "change", "morph" means "shape", and "magus" (in Latin) means " magic or wizard ".
Hence, a wizard that can change shape, and the term "Metamorphosis" is the term to describe an animal changing into another animal such as how a caterpillar changes into a butterfly .

Jacob's sibling quickly realised that "Ollivander" was actually an impostor and demanded they reveal themselves, with this Dark wizard revealing himself and his Metamorphmagus abilities, explaining his ability to disappear.
Jacob's sibling immediately cast either the Impediment Jinx or the Confundus Charm on this Dark wizard, incapacitating him, and secured the wand before alerting Kingsley and Tonks.

Jacob's sibling met up with Kingsley in the Department of Magical Law Enforcement, with Kingsley stating that this Dark wizard was awaiting trial and a likely Azkaban sentence and that the wand had been sent to a secure vault.

Kingsley also informed them that Ollivander was shaken but alive, having snuck through a back door when Jacob's sibling showed up and distracted this Dark wizard, and was having his statement taken by Tonks.

Kingsley offered Jacob's sibling some advice on working as an Auror before giving them a badge depicting Grindelwald's wand on behalf of Moody to remind them of their great accomplishments and all those that were still to come.
Magical abilities and skills

title: Crushing Cabinet
paragraphs: A Crushing Cabinet , also known as a maiden or iron maiden , was a torture device consisting of a solid cabinet with spike-covered interior.
The crushing walls were activated by closing the door shut.
History
The Iron Maiden of Doom
Dinah Hecat owned a Crushing Cabinet, which she kept in her classroom while serving as the Professor Defence Against the Dark Arts at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the 1890s .
There was another iron maiden in the Charms Classroom .
During the 1980s , a cursed Crushing Cabinet known as the Iron Maiden of Doom was stolen from Classroom 3C, which magically compelled individuals to get locked inside it.
Under advice from The Hogwarts Diary , Jacob's sibling managed to recover the Iron Maiden and rescued the individual that was trapped inside.
A Crushing Cabinet could be found inside the Interrogation Room in Azkaban .

Borgin and Burkes owned a Crushing Cabinet, at least during the summer of 1992 , when Harry Potter hid in it to hide from Draco Malfoy after accidentally travelling to Knockturn Alley via the Floo Network .
Notes and references

title: 3 August
paragraphs: 3 August is the 215th day of the year (216th in leap years).
There are 150 days remaining until the end of the year.
Events

title: Hogwarts-Borgin and Burkes Vanishing Cabinet pair
paragraphs: A pair of Vanishing Cabinets formed a passage between Hogwarts Castle -- the location of Hogwarts School -- and Borgin and Burkes, a dark magic antique shop in Knockturn Alley .
The cabinets allowed objects placed in one cabinet to appear in the other.
The passage was successfully used to transport several Death Eaters from Borgin and Burkes into Hogwarts School, hence commencing the Battle of the Astronomy Tower .
Description
The two objects were large black cabinets, though the one in Hogwarts was both black and gold in colour.
The cabinets were said to be highly valuable.
History

It is unknown when the Vanishing Cabinet at Hogwarts first came to the school or who brought it in, but it was already stored in the Room of Requirement by the 1890-1891 school year , when Phineas Nigellus Black ( Slytherin and member of the pure-blood supremacist House of Black ) was Headmaster .
It is also unknown how or when the other Vanishing Cabinet came to Borgin and Burkes .
At some point, it was taken out of the Room of Requirement for unknown reasons.
It was obviously not known for the danger it represented, as neither any the subsequent headmasters nor any of the subsequent caretakers removed it from the premises.
Though they knew it was a Vanishing Cabinet, no one seemed to know it was linked to a second cabinet at Borgin and Burkes in the Dark Magic shopping district Knockturn Alley .
1992-1993 school year
When Harry accidentally arrived to Borgin and Burkes via Floo Powder , he hid inside the Cabinet without fully closing the door, to avoid Borgin , Lucius , and Draco Malfoy .
Draco nearly opened the door but was beckoned to leave with his father before that could be accomplished.
Peeves damaged the Cabinet at Hogwarts in 1992 when he was persuaded by Nearly Headless Nick to drop it in a classroom right above Filch 's office to get Harry out of trouble with Filch.
1995-1996 school year
In 1996 , Fred and George Weasley shoved Graham Montague headfirst into the Cabinet on the first floor of Hogwarts when he tried to take points away from them.
Montague eventually escaped (by Apparating ) and was found in a toilet's u-bend by Draco Malfoy, who summoned Professor Snape for help.
Montague nearly died in his escape attempt, and revealed the previously unknown powers of the Cabinets to Draco.
1996-1997 school year
Draco Malfoy using the Vanishing Cabinet
Draco used what he learned about the Cabinet's powers to his advantage.
When Lord Voldemort commanded Draco to assassinate Albus Dumbledore , Draco decided to use the Cabinets to allow Death Eaters into the castle to assist him.

The Hogwarts Vanishing Cabinet was later moved to the Room of Requirement , where Draco would spend the entire school year in repairing, after coaxing Borgin with death threats for instructions and assistance; he also ordered Borgin not to sell the counterpart Cabinet in store, and just keep it safe.

Repairing it seemed to be very difficult and taxing on Draco's behalf, as he became increasingly neglectful in his schoolwork, duties, and activities, with him even losing confidence in success from time to time in that he attempted other crude methods of assassination that failed.
Working off of Borgin's instructions instead of allowing the proprietor see the damage first hand also hampered the progress, as Borgin mentioned earlier.

However, he eventually succeeds in 1997 , and allowed a group of Death Eaters - Alecto and Amycus Carrow , Corban Yaxley , Thorfinn Rowle , Gibbon , and Fenrir Greyback - to enter Hogwarts from the Borgin & Burkes Vanishing Cabinet, in order to accomplish his mission.

The fact that the cabinets were able to grant the Death Eaters entrance into the castle despite the otherwise impenetrable defences horrified the wizarding world at large, as this meant that there was no longer anywhere safe from Voldemort.
1997-1998 school year
During this school year, it is unlikely that the Death Eaters used the pair of cabinets to enter the school because it was already under their control.

During the Battle of Hogwarts in 1998 , when Vincent Crabbe released Fiendfyre in the Room of Requirement, it was likely the Vanishing Cabinet was destroyed, along with many other artefacts hidden there.

However, since Lottie Turner and her friend were able to retrieve some furniture that had been placed there since the 1820s about ten years after Crabbe set the room on fire, the Cabinet itself may have been unharmed or restored.
Notes and references

title: Vanishing Cabinet
paragraphs: A pair of Vanishing Cabinets would act as a passage between two places.
If an object had been placed in one, it would appear in the other.

The cabinets seemed to ward off all known defensive spells , as they were successfully used to transport several Death Eaters from Borgin and Burkes into Hogwarts School , and Graham Montague was able to Apparate into Hogwarts despite the protection spells of the school normally preventing such an action.
Vanishing Cabinets were highly popular during the First Wizarding War ; in the event of a Death Eater attack, one could simply disappear to the other cabinet until the danger had passed.
History
Siméon Lignum ran a store in the Place Cachée which sold Vanishing Cabinets and also offered repair services.
The First and Second Wizarding wars
During the First Wizarding War , numerous witches and wizards used Vanishing Cabinets to anonymously disappear if the Death Eaters visited.
Arthur Weasley mentioned this during Christmas 1996 while talking to members of the Order of the Phoenix .
The Vanishing Cabinet inside Borgin and Burkes
In 1992 , when Harry accidentally arrived to Borgin and Burkes via Floo Powder , he hid inside the Cabinet without fully closing the door, to avoid Borgin , Lucius , and Draco Malfoy .
Draco nearly opened the Cabinet door but was beckoned to leave with his father before he could open the door.
Two months later, Peeves damaged the Cabinet at Hogwarts in when he was persuaded by Nearly Headless Nick to drop it in a classroom right above Filch 's office to get Harry out of trouble with Filch.
In 1996 , Fred and George Weasley shoved Graham Montague headfirst into the broken cabinet on the first floor of Hogwarts when he tried to take points away from them.
Montague eventually escaped (by Apparating ), and was found in a toilet's u-bend by Draco Malfoy, who summoned Professor Snape for help, although it nearly cost Montague his life.
Montague revealed the previously unknown powers of the Cabinets to Draco.
Second Wizarding War
Draco Malfoy observing the Vanishing Cabinet in the Room of Requirement

The Hogwarts Vanishing Cabinet was later moved to the Room of Requirement and in 1997 , Draco Malfoy successfully repaired it to allow a group of Death Eaters, including Fenrir Greyback , to enter Hogwarts from the Borgin and Burkes Vanishing Cabinet, to accomplish his plot to assassinate Albus Dumbledore .
During the Battle of Hogwarts , when Vincent Crabbe released Fiendfyre in the Room of Requirement, the Vanishing Cabinet was likely destroyed, along with many other artefacts hidden there.
21st century
During the Calamity which affected the wizarding world in the 2010s , Vanishing Cabinets were among the various magical items which appeared as Foundables in the world.

The cabinets were guarded by Pixies , in which volunteer wizards and witches of the Statute of Secrecy Task Force had to overpower using the Slowing Charm , allowing the cabinets to return to their rightful place.
While searching for Long Shouren , a Hogwarts student found a Vanishing Cabinet in the Shrieking Shack in Hogsmeade .
After investigating the shack, the student entered the cabinet and was transported to its pair in Borgin and Burkes .
Both the student and Shouren used the cabinet to travel between the shop and the shack several times.
Repair

If one cabinet was broken, a transferred object was trapped in a kind of limbo; repairing it seemed to be a very difficult task, as Draco Malfoy spent an entire school year with instructions from Borgin to accomplish.
The incantation used for the repair process was Harmonia Nectere Passus , which would require tremendous and repeated efforts, as Draco demonstrated throughout a year.
And it was more than simply saying the incantation, proven by the apparent yearly effort required.

The repairing process was, admittedly, hampered because Draco was working on Borgin's instructions; Borgin claimed that he might have had an easier time if Draco could have brought the damaged cabinet to let Borgin see it firsthand.
Notes and references

title: Borgin & Burkes Auction
paragraphs: The Borgin & Burkes Auction was an underground auction to sell magical creatures that were captured by poachers.
The auction was infiltrated by Long Shouren who wanted to rescue the creatures, and by Auror Ewan Ward who wanted to put an end to future unsanctioned sales.
History
Products

title: Wrackspurt
paragraphs: A Wrackspurt was an invisible magical creature which floated into a person's ears, making their brain become unfocused and confused.
Description
Supposedly, Wrackspurts could be seen with aid of Spectrespecs .
Those suffering from Wrackspurt infections could possibly dispel them by thinking positive thoughts.
History
In the 1989-1990 school year , Badeea Ali claimed the Hog's Head Inn was infested with Wrackspurts.
This, however, was actually a distraction so Jacob's sibling could put on their Invisibility Cloak without Aberforth Dumbledore noticing.
In 1998 , The Quibbler reported that some Wrackspurts broke out of the Ministry Elfin' Safety Enquiry .
Xenophilius Lovegood 's attempt to recreate Rowena Ravenclaw's Diadem included Wrackspurt siphons "to remove all sources of distraction from the thinker's immediate area".
Once in Diagon Alley , Luna Scamander suggested to a muddled student that there might be Wrackspurts flying around their head.
In the 21st century , Wrackspurts had to be collected by the Statute of Secrecy Task Force in order to address the Calamity .
Notes and references

title: Regina Rowle
paragraphs: Regina Rowle was a British witch who worked at the British Ministry of Magic in the 2010s , in the capacity of Junior Unspeakable .
Biography

Regina Rowle was hired as a Junior Unspeakable by Gareth Greengrass , who hired her to replace a former Unspeakable who had decided to leave the Department of Mysteries to write novels, with her being hired around the same time as Grim Fawley .
On one night, Rowle encountered Grim sleeping in the Love Room after hours.

Believing that he was attempting to move on from the loss of his wife, Penelope , she wrote him a note the next day informing him that she would keep his secret but warning him that she might not be the one who would find him next time.
At some point in her career, she entered the Love Chamber in the Department of Mysteries .
The log documenting the time of her entry and exit was brought to light during the investigation over the Calamity , as it also showed Grim Fawley was frequently in the room at odd times.
In the late 2010s or early 2020s , Rowle befriended a Calamity Investigator working for the Statute of Secrecy Task Force .
She later sent them a package containing instructional materials intended for new Unspeakables.
Although much of the material was redacted, it did provide the investigator a few valuable lessons.

Later, the same Calamity Investigator overheard Rowle loudly claiming that Grim Fawley's relentless nature led to his downfall, with her claim leading the investigator to think deeply about the relationship between determination and the Foundables Spell .

Rowle later "found" several portraits of Lord Voldemort in a back room at Borgin and Burkes and asked the same Calamity Investigator to transport them to safety, forcing them to undergo a thoroughly uncomfortable conversation with one of the portraits.

She also warned the same Calamity Investigator that the Calamity was likely to react sharply to wizards who spent time investigating its nature, although the investigator decided to brave the risks and continue their Calamity studies.
Personality and traits

Regina Rowle was noted by Constance Pickering as being one of the Ministry's "greatest gossips," indicating that, despite her Unspeakable position, she was a very gregarious, friendly individual who enjoyed spreading gossip about her coworkers.
Notes and references
