title: Inanimatus Conjurus Spell
paragraphs: The Inanimatus Conjurus Spell ( Inanimatus Conjurus ) was a transfiguration spell used to alter the design of a room.
History
In 1991 , Badeea Ali used this spell to change the design of Jacob's sibling 's new flat.

Professor Minerva McGonagall assigned her fifth-year students a long and very difficult essay on this spell as their homework on 6 September , 1995 as a break from their work on the Vanishing Spell , which they continued later on in the year, presumably as a means of introducing Conjuring Spells .
Etymology
From the English inanimate (+ the Latin suffix -us ), meaning non-living and to conjure (+ the Latin suffix -us ), meaning to bring up .
Notes and references

title: Gryffindor vs Slytherin Quidditch match (1995)
paragraphs: The Quidditch match was played between Gryffindor and Slytherin on 6 November 1995 .

The game introduced the new Gryffindor Keeper Ron Weasley and was won by Gryffindor, meaning that Gryffindor had continued to defeat Slytherin in every game since Harry Potter joined the team in 1991 .

However, the match was immediately followed by a severe altercation in which Potter and fellow Gryffindor player George Weasley physically assaulted Draco Malfoy after he insulted their families, resulting in the two Gryffindor players (plus George's twin Fred ) being banned for life from playing Quidditch by High Inquisitor Dolores Umbridge .
Players
Gryffindor
Slytherin
History
Background
The game was the first to be played since April - May 1994 .
In that time, Oliver Wood graduated meaning Gryffindor needed a new Keeper and captain.
Angelina Johnson replaced him and became the new captain while Ron Weasley became the new Keeper.
Ron was very nervous about playing.
The Slytherin team were making fun of him and jeered at him which made him throw the Quaffle at Katie Bell 's face and break her nose.
Gryffindor were particularly hoping to win the Quidditch Cup again that year and Angelina wanted the team to practise everyday.
However, Snape kept booking the pitch for Slytherin to train while the Slytherin team kept trying to injure the Gryffindor team.
Ron kept playing well in training and then freaking out when he made one blunder and kept letting the Slytherins upset him.
The Slytherins knew that they were upsetting Ron and continue to find new ways of achieving that.
They created badges reading " Weasley is our King " having decided Ron would make that many blunders while playing that he would actually help them win.
Harry and Hermione tried everything to keep Ron from noticing them.
Luna Lovegood wore her famous lion hat to the game to show her support for the Gryffindor Quidditch team.
Throughout the game, the players could hear her hat roar when she tapped the hat with her wand .
The match
Harry and Draco zoomed around the pitch looking for the Snitch .
Harry avoided one of the Bludgers while Angelina ducked Warrington and then was hit with the other Bludger.
Montague had the Quaffle until George Weasley hit him with one of the Bludgers which made him drop the ball.
Katie found it and threw it to Alicia Spinnet who avoided one of the Bludgers and threw it to Angelina who nearly won a goal.
The team then noticed that Slytherin were singing about Ron not being able to "save a thing" and that's why Weasley was their King.
They upset the team and Ron who tried to save the next goal and instead let the goal in, meaning Slytherin kept singing and were winning by 10 points.
Harry was very annoyed and was shouted at by Angelina when he stayed still watching the game instead of playing.
Harry kept looking around for the Snitch while noticing at even the Slytherin team were singing about Ron.
Slytherin then won another goal and then another two leaving Slytherin winning at 40 to nothing.
Harry knew that he needed to find the Snitch right away until Gryffindor managed to win their first goal of the game.
Harry then found the Snitch and dived for it.
Draco noticed and followed him.
It changed direction and the game was in Draco's favour.
Harry and Draco were neck and neck when Harry managed to win the game by retrieving the Snitch.
Gryffindor celebrated and Harry hoped that meant everyone would not worry about Ron.
Harry was then hit by the Bludger thrown at him in revenge and fell.
Draco then kept annoying the team by saying Harry had "saved Weasley's neck" and then made fun of Ron's family which angered them.
George tried to punch Draco and Harry held him back until Draco even made fun of Lily Potter and Harry joined George in fighting Draco.
He punched him while everyone tried to stop them.
Madam Hooch then broke them up with the Impediment Jinx .
Harry, Fred, George received lifelong bans from Quidditch by Dolores Umbridge , leaving Angelina to find a new Seeker and two new Beaters for their next game.
Their bans only lasted until Umbridge was fired from her job at the end of the school term, however.
Notes and references

title: Ivy Warrington
paragraphs: Ivy Warrington (b. 1997 ) was a half-blood witch , who began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 2008 .
Biography
Early life
Ivy was born to a Muggle father and a witch mother .
She had a grandmother who was a witch.
She also had an older twin sister named Winifred Warrington , who was also a witch.
Ivy first showed signs of magic when she was four or five years old.
The family possibly lived in or near Ottery St Catchpole .
Ivy used to ride a broomstick but stopped because she had no friends to play with.
When Ivy and her sister were young, her grandmother made oliebollen to celebrate the New Year.
It contained Ivy's favourite gooseberries and Winifred's favourite apples.
Ivy watching her sister accidentally vanish
She and her sister were accepted into Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , however, Winifred was not allowed to attend because their father feared her unpredictable magic could hurt someone.

Ivy promised to speak to the professors so they could speak with her father to make him change his mind, but Winifred was resentful and stubborn about not being allowed to attend, and accused Ivy of not caring about her.
Ivy tried to reason with her, but Winifred attempted to use Evanesco on Ivy's school trunk so she could not go to Hogwarts as well, which backfired and caused Winifred to vanish .
Their grandmother tried to help her forget what happened by using a Memory Charm .
However, it caused her to wholly forget about Winifred.
Ivy had an ability to vanish, and would do so even when she didn't intend to.
It was unknown when she manifested this ability.
At some point, she bought a wand at Ollivanders .
Shortly before starting Hogwarts, she took her wand back there to ask Garrick Ollivander to check it over.
She explained that the spells she used do were no longer working properly.
He asked her to demonstrate it but she knocked over a stack of The Monster Book of Monsters .
Another child buying their wand in the shop and they helped her deal with the books.
Ivy's spells started working properly with their help and afterwards, she introduced herself and thanked them for their help.
When she learned they were also starting Hogwarts that year, she told them she would see them at school.
Hogwarts years (2008-)
At the age of eleven, Ivy began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
While she was on the Hogwarts Express , she noticed the student she met in Ollivanders struggling to find a seat.
Ivy invited them to sit with her and told them she was very excited about going to Hogwarts.
They told her they were nervous but Ivy responded that they shouldn't be because the castle was amazing and she couldn't wait to start exploring.
During the Sorting Ceremony , Ivy went missing.
She was sorted at a later time into the same house as the student, Daniel Page and Lottie Turner .
Ivy got lost when she was wandering around the castle in search of something she couldn't remember.
She was sure she was being followed and eventually the door to the Room of Requirement appeared.
She entered it and waited for help.
The student and Daniel eventually found her sitting on a trunk.
She was delighted to be found and told them the story of how she ended up getting lost.
Daniel told her they had to leave before they were caught out after curfew.
They told her to bring her trunk but she didn't think it was hers so they left it.
One day during the Christmas holidays of her second year, Ivy and her friend found Daniel in the Potions classroom .
He spent all day mixing a potion.
Ivy asked why, he told her that he was making a confidence boosting brew to give to his older sister Esme , who had been working a lot since their parents were imprisoned.
Daniel had spent the past month working on the potion and had devised his own recipe, which included a Pepperup Potion , a Wit-Sharpening Potion and a few other ingredients.
Ivy pointed out that his support would be what would make Esme happier than anything else.
However, Daniel claimed that this potion must have been what she needed most.
Dancing Daniel
Later, Ivy and her friend found Daniel sitting in the corner of the ballroom stage.
Daniel reported that the gift had been sent back, and then told his sister that his dedication in itself had amplified her confidence.
When Ivy expressed her delight that her guesses had been right, Daniel murmured that Ivy had been right, as usual.
He asked Ivy to pick out a present for Esme on his behalf for her birthday, to which she readily agreed.
Daniel was unwilling to waste a confidence boosting brew that only had a short shelf life.
He took the potion himself, leaving his two friends in a state of shock.
He began to disclose his immense confidence in his potion brewing skill and other abilities, and said that he had been working on something in secret.
Daniel then went on stage and began to dance alone as the students around him looked on.
In the Great Hall , decorated for Christmas , Ivy was sitting at a table, looking deflated.
When a friend pointed this out, she revealed that she was recalling memories of Christmas with her older sister, Winifred .
Then Daniel appeared and invited them to a 'real snowball fight'.
Ivy promised to go later and left the Great Hall.
Daniel asked his friend about Ivy's condition, and when he found out why, he let out a few words as if he had thought of something and left the Great Hall.
Ivy and Daniel sending the present
Daniel found Ivy in the Astronomy Tower .
He showed her the present he had prepared, but she refused, saying she was not in the mood to open it.
He said the present was for Winifred.
Ivy regarded this as an unfunny joke.
Daniel suggested the idea of giving this present to Winifred with the Vanishing Spell .
Although a strange idea, he thought that this might help Ivy feel more connected to her sister.
With the help of headmistress McGonagall, Daniel had collected 'memories' from Ivy's friends of when they met her.
He explained this enabled Winifred to know Ivy's friends as well as Ivy did.
His words left her in tears.
After the present vanished, Daniel said that he was sure it was impossible for them to know if Winifred got it, clamming up and stopped speaking in the middle of a sentence.
Ivy followed his words by saying, "It didn't matter, I'm going to find her......someday."
Physical description
Ivy was younger looking than her age, with white skin, long, straight silver hair that covered the right half of her face, and purple eyes.
She always wore a shimmering blue locket around her neck.
She was very similar to her twin sister Winifred, but the difference was that unlike her sister, who had the same blue eyes as their mother, she had the same purple eyes as their grandmother.
She typically wore a uniform robe and long brown boots, with a book-shaped bag over her shoulder.
Outside of class, she was dressed more casually in a plum-coloured checked dress, white cardigan, and white stockings.
She was considered a pretty girl by her classmates, as were Robyn Thistlethwaite and Cassandra Vole , but was also described as 'a bit weird'.
Personality and traits
Ivy was an energetic, confident witch with excellent wand skills and a desire to prove herself.
Before attending Hogwarts, she had already been taught magic by her maternal grandmother and was familiar with many advanced spells and charms.
She was smart and fiercely loyal to her friends, and not afraid of confrontation to defend them.
She was particularly close to Daniel Page and the other student , who found her lost in the Room of Requirement.
She often helped Daniel or wound him up.
She took a negative stance against the disregard and disdain of non-magical peoples, but was not supportive of the notorious group known as NOTME and did not trust them at all.
Despite the generally positive outlook, she often had the feeling that something was missing.
Her memory was sometimes hazy.
Although she did not know why she does, she also knew that Daniel's mother had been put in Azkaban.
She sometimes became unstable, which surfaced when she tracked down Cassandra Vole , who had insulted her friend Daniel Page .
She unintentionally released the Vanishing spell in an attempt to disarm Cassandra.

She did not know at the time how or why she had used the spell, but later discovered that it had been influenced by a rough and hasty Memory Charm her grandmother had cast on her before she started at Hogwarts.
When talking about her future, Ivy told some vague dreams to be an Auror, run a candy shop or breed Crups .
She was known for her sweet tooth, including candy, coconut pudding and sugar quills, and would eat several treacle tarts prepared in the ballroom.

She liked other foods too, and when Hogwarts celebrated the New Year with food, she mentioned a number of foods as her favourites, but Robyn Thistlethwaite pointed out that everything was Ivy's favourite.
She was impressed by the excellence of Chinese cuisine and even started to think that she would like to visit the East one day.
Magical abilities and skills
Possessions
Relationships
Family
She seemed to adore her twin sister Winifred.
After their father decided not to send Winifred to Hogwarts, Ivy told her sister about her plan to persuade her father with Hogwarts's professors.
However, in the end, her sister was unable to contain her resentment and disappeared before Ivy's eyes through a spell she unleashed herself.
Ivy was dismayed.
Her Boggart appeared as herself, even after her memories about her sister were erased.
She appeared to have a relatively good relationship with her grandmother.
For her, a taste of home was the apple and gooseberry oliebollen her grandmother would make at Christmas.
However, she often suspected that her grandmother was hiding something.
The truth was that her grandmother had erased the existence of her sister Winifred from her memory, and that this was to protect her mind.

However, in reality, Winifred had not disappeared and had been sleeping in her bed at St Mungo's for three years, leaving Ivy with strong suspicions as to why her grandmother had not checked the hospital.
Not much is known about her parents.
Her father was a Muggle and did not carry his surname to his daughters.
Her mother lived with Ivy's family when she was very young, but was no longer at home before she entered Hogwarts.
Cassandra Vole
Ivy shared a deeply antagonistic and competitive mutual enmity and rivalry with Cassandra.
Their relationship was fraught with tension from the very beginning, marked by malice and sudden outbursts of anger.
Ivy despised Cassandra as a bully who thrived on others' misfortune, often acting on impulses of anger in response to Cassandra's actions and frequently needing to be restrained by her friends.
Cassandra, on the other hand, firmly believed that not all people were born equal and considered her own existence as proof of this notion.
She oppressed others "simply to make them understand their position" and felt particularly compelled to teach Ivy 'a few lessons', often revealing her malicious intent.
During a first-year Charms class, Cassandra secretly sabotaged Ivy's practical performance with a counter-spell and mocked her afterwards.
When her interference was discovered, she brazenly continued to insult Ivy.
In response, Ivy thought to herself that she'd rather "bind Cassandra's mouth than the chest" and used a binding spell on her, losing house points as a result.
Later, she jokingly suggested to her friends that they name a club formed to recover the lost house points "Cassandra Stinks".

On another occasion, when Cassandra ruined a painting by Lottie Turner, Ivy angrily tailed Cassandra all the way to the library, so blinded by rage that she failed to realise her own behaviour until it was pointed out.
The first step in their worst clash began when Ivy stumbled upon an argument between her friend Daniel and Cassandra.
Ivy criticised Cassandra for describing Muggles as foolish people who even feared their own shadows.
However, Cassandra justified her stance, threatened to send Daniel to Azkaban, and made a cutting remark about Ivy's disappearance on the first day at school.
Ivy chased Cassandra through several staircases and corridors, demanding an apology for Daniel.
Cassandra instead advised Ivy to choose her friends more carefully, which escalated into a duel.
In the heat of the moment, Ivy attempted to disarm Cassandra but somehow ended up using a Vanishing Spell.
Ivy was shocked by her own actions, while Cassandra was visibly terrified.
Afterwards, on her friends' advice, Ivy tried to mend her relationship with Cassandra.
However, Cassandra coldly responded that she had plenty of friends and wasn't particularly interested in someone like Ivy as a friend.
She mocked Ivy for being "lost", much like on her first day at school, and ridiculed her for her strange behaviour.
Despite these incidents, Ivy occasionally displayed a strange desire to connect with Cassandra.
One Christmas, when Alice , a clerk from Fickle Fabrics , visited Hogwarts, Ivy tried to give Cassandra a Slytherin-style green pointed hat .
However, the gift was poorly received, and Ivy felt so mortified by her design choice that she briefly thought she deserved to be sent to Azkaban.
Encouraged by her friends, she recovered and decided to create a hat herself, this time focusing not on Cassandra's house but on her close friends, which helped her recover.
Later, after the Siege of Hogwarts , Ivy was not particularly surprised to hear that Cassandra had thanked her friend , unlike Daniel Page, who expressed scepticism.
Ivy even defended Cassandra to Daniel and seemed prepared to accept her as a new friend if given the chance.
In their fourth year, noticeable tension began to permeate Ivy and Cassandra's relationship when Winifred quickly and easily befriended Cassandra, drifting away from her younger sister.
Ivy grew uneasy about the bond between Cassandra and her sister, and this unease surfaced as sharp words of reproach toward Cassandra when Winifred rejected her.
However, after the sisters reconciled and Winifred expressed a desire for Ivy to get along with her closest friend, their relationship began to take a slightly positive turn.
During their final challenge, Ivy offered Cassandra encouragement, to which Cassandra silently responded with a smile.
At the end-of-term feast, Ivy joined Cassandra's company alongside her sister.
Later, during a Hogsmeade trip with her sister just before the Christmas holidays, Ivy unexpectedly ended up spending time with Cassandra.
Although their relationship remained strained and distorted, it was held together by their connection through Winifred.

title: Winifred Warrington
paragraphs: Winifred "Winnie" Warrington was a half-blood witch , the daughter of a Muggle father and a witch mother .
Her grandmother and her younger twin sister, Ivy Warrington , were also witches.
Biography
Vanished
Winifred in the process of accidentally vanishing

During her childhood, both Winifred and her sister Ivy were accepted into Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , but their Muggle father decided to keep Winifred back, as sometimes when she was angry, her magic became unpredictable, and he was afraid she might hurt somebody.
Winifred was very unhappy and resentful about not attending as she wanted to go to the school, and was especially glad she could be there with her sister.
As Ivy was preparing to leave, she told Winifred she promised to speak to the professors at Hogwarts so they could speak to their father to make him change his mind.
Winifred resentfully got angrier and angrier and attempted to cast Evanesco on her case, but the spell backfired on her and she vanished instead.
Afterwards, their grandmother put a Memory Charm on Ivy so she would forget what happened to her, but it caused her to completely forget Winifred.
At the end of the 2010-2011 school year , Ivy saw Winifred lying in a bed at St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries .
A witch there said she had been talking to Winifred for three years while she was unconscious.
When Ivy touched Winifred, she woke up and said "you" were in trouble and "he" was watching.
Ivy thought she meant her, but Winifred pointed at her friend .
New school year
Before the start of the 2011-2012 school year , Winifred studied the lessons she missed during the three years she was missing and was able to understand all of them with the help of her twin sister.
On 1 September 2011 , while everyone was buzzing about the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup that would soon take place, Ivy was excited to finally have Winifred by her side.
Before the Sorting Ceremony , Winifred discussed with Ivy's friend , whom she had met at the hospital, the warning she gave when she woke up.
Ivy's friend concluded that it might have been just a dream , to which Winifred replied, "probably".
Later, Winifred was Sorted into Slytherin and chose to sit beside Cassandra Vole , Ivy's school rival.
When Cassandra asked why she chose to sit beside her sister's rival despite being told about her, Winifred answered, "I'm nothing like my sister".
Later, in the Care of Magical Creatures class, Winifred tried to deal with a Blast-Ended Skrewt , and denied Ivy when the latter offered to help.
When she could not handle the Skrewt, Cassandra showed up and protected Winifred.
Ivy saw the entire scene and felt neglected, for it was supposed to be her who protected Winifred, not Cassandra.
Daniel Page suggested that Winifred had been missing for so long that she most likely became different, causing Ivy to run away.
The next day, Winifred and Cassandra went to Professor Flitwick to sign up for the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup (Winifred was not chosen), and met Ivy and her friend there.
Ivy tried to talk to Winifred, but was rejected by her, and belittled by Cassandra, who also claimed that Winifred wanted nothing to do with and was afraid of Ivy.
On the Saturday after the first challenge of the competition, Winifred joined the barbecue picnic that was held near Hagrid's Hut .
During the picnic, Viggo Victor laced Kenji Kobayashi 's drink with something that aggravated his blood malediction , turning him into a hazardous fox -like beast .
After Kenji was brought to the Hospital Wing , Winifred whispered to herself that she could see darkness in him.
Ivy, having overheard her twin sister, approached to ask what she meant.
Winifred then told Ivy to step away, saying she could also see the darkness in her.
Ivy, realising Winifred had somehow perceived her "dark vision", wondered how she had seen it.
Determined to understand better, Ivy decided she would need to ask Cassandra for help, as Cassandra was the only fellow student whom Winifred trusted and confided in.
Physical description
Winifred had pale skin and long, straight silver hair that draped over the right side of her face.
While she closely resembled her identical twin sister, Ivy, their eye colour set them apart; Winifred had their mother 's blue eyes, whereas Ivy had the same purple eyes as their grandmother .
Given that Ivy was considered attractive by their classmates, it is likely Winifred was held in the same regard.
Outside of class, she preferred a casual style, typically wearing a blue checkered dress, a white cardigan, white stockings, and a blue scarf.
Magical abilities and skills
At a young age, her magic was said to be sometimes unpredictable in nature when she became angry, and thus a potential risk to others.

title: Daniel Page
paragraphs: Daniel Page (b. 1996) was a British or Irish half-blood wizard who began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 2008 .
Biography
Early life
A Muggle newspaper reporting the arrest of Daniel's family
Daniel was born and raised somewhere in the British Isles between 24 October and 22 November 1996 .
He was the third child and youngest son of a Muggle father, Gorman , and a witch named Kaleena , and was raised alongside his older brother Reggie and sister Esme .
While the only one of the three kids to possess magical ability, Daniel nevertheless attended a Muggle primary school prior to receiving his letter of acceptance from Hogwarts.
Prior to Hogwarts, Kaleena taught Daniel much about the wizarding world , including about the Book of Admittance .
Kaleena used to sing the Mooncalf lullaby to him while putting him to bed and took him to Hogsmeade once.
When he was very young, Kaleena took Daniel to meet Victor Gridley , but spent most of the meeting hiding behind his mother.
The Page family seemingly lived in London for most of Daniel's life.
As a child, Daniel found taking the London Underground to be scary and once visited the botanical gardens with his mother.
At one point, Daniel came into contact with a Pensieve and used it to view an unknown individual's memory .
Once, when Esme was angered by her father giving her a teddy bear for Christmas when she was already seventeen, she took Daniel to go ice skating, which made them extremely happy.
Daniel Page visiting his mother in prison
While apparently loving, Daniel's childhood were still marred by controversy from an early age, marked by the illicit activities of their father and, in due time, also Reggie, who was a Squib .
Daniel even became familiar with Knockturn Alley because his family visited the place.
At some point, they were eventually cornered by the Muggle police and arrested.
Daniel's mother was also apprehended when she apparently used magic to help, and was sentenced to Azkaban due to violation of the International Statute of Wizarding Secrecy .
The family's arrest was covered by a Muggle newspaper, dubbing them "The Bloody Pages".
Afterwards, Daniel, who was now left in the care of his older sister, found school to be anything but fun as he was forced to endure malicious rumours and judgement from his peers.

He was occasionally allowed to visit his mother in prison and her arrest apparently left him with a deep feeling of resentment towards the Ministry for how they had sentenced his mother, despite there never being any evidence to cement their claim of Kaleena's allegiance to NOTME.
Daniel never flew on a broomstick until he went to Hogwarts , because he lived in London.
Hogwarts years (2008-)
On 1 September 2008 , Daniel sat on his own on the Hogwarts Express .
When a fellow first year student asked if they could sit next to him, he told them they didn't want to sit there and that nobody would sit next to him.
Daniel Page being sorted
Daniel finally arrived at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry when he was eleven.
He did so with a sigh of relief, as few witches and wizards read Muggle newspapers and hence, nobody knew him, taking off a lot of the pressure he had been under after all that happened.

On 1 September 2008 , he travelled to the school via the Hogwarts Express and attended the Sorting Ceremony , being sorted into the same house as Lottie Turner , Ivy Warrington and an unidentified student .
One day, Daniel ran into the student in the Grand Staircase running away from Argus Filch .
He told them Filch was also after him for supposedly stealing potion ingredients in the Potions Storeroom which he denied responsibility for.
The nearby portrait of William de Cognac called it delightful drama and advised them to stay cool so that the problems will be solved.
When the student asked for suggestions, he told them about a great duel he heard about.
After the story, Daniel told the student that he thought Quidditch sounded good but he preferred studying Potions .
They showed an interested in flying to which he told them to talk to Robyn Thistlethwaite , who was recruiting "flying buddies" in the Great Hall .
One evening, he was invited to attend a search party meeting in the Hogwarts Library to help find Ivy.
Daniel was reading books which Robyn thought was mad, but he told her if studying at school was mad, then he supposed he was.
He didn't want to help search for her during the night in case they were caught and stayed behind when they left.
However, he later changed his mind because he was worried his friends would lose house points .
He found them in the Grand Staircase where he helped to search the Potions classroom .
Robyn disappeared after they fended off copies of The Monster Book of Monsters .
The student and Daniel carried on searching for Ivy.
At one point, they walked past the Troll Tapestry he thought was unique.
He wanted the student to give up the search for the night but on their way back, they accidentally found the Room of Requirement .
When they entered it, they found a confused Ivy who had no idea how she ended up there.

After hearing her story that the only thing she remembered was she was searching for "something" and suspected someone was following her, he told her they could investigate later but should get back to the common room before they get caught after curfew.
One day during the Christmas holidays of his second year, Daniel spent his time in the Potions classroom mixing a potion.

When Ivy Warrington and another friend came looking for him and asked why, he told them that he was making a confidence boosting brew to give to his older sister Esme , who had been working a lot since their parents were imprisoned.
Daniel had spent the past month working on the potion and had devised his own recipe, which included a Pepperup Potion , a Wit-Sharpening Potion and a few other ingredients.
Ivy pointed out that his support would be what would make Esme happier than anything else.
However, Daniel claimed that this potion must have been what she needed most.
Dancing Daniel
Later, Ivy and her friend found Daniel sitting in the corner of the ballroom stage.
Daniel reported that the gift had been sent back, and then told his sister that his dedication in itself had amplified her confidence.
When Ivy expressed her delight that her guesses had been right, Daniel murmured that Ivy had been right, as usual.
He asked Ivy to pick out a present for Esme on his behalf for her birthday, to which she readily agreed.
Daniel was unwilling to waste a confidence boosting brew that only had a short shelf life.
He took the potion himself, leaving his two friends in a state of shock.
He began to disclose his immense confidence in his potion brewing skill and other abilities, and said that he had been working on something in secret.
Daniel then went on stage and began to dance alone as the students around him looked on.
In the Great Hall , decorated for Christmas , Ivy was sitting at a table, looking deflated.
When a friend pointed this out, she revealed that she was recalling memories of Christmas with her older sister, Winifred .
Then Daniel appeared and invited them to a 'real snowball fight'.
Ivy promised to go later and left the Great Hall.
Daniel asked his friend about Ivy's condition, and when he found out why, he let out a few words as if he had thought of something and left the Great Hall.
Ivy and Daniel sending the present
Daniel found Ivy in the Astronomy Tower .
He showed her the present he had prepared, but she refused, saying she was not in the mood to open it.
He said the present was for Winifred.
Ivy regarded this as an unfunny joke.
Daniel suggested the idea of giving this present to Winifred with the Vanishing Spell .
Although a strange idea, he thought that this might help Ivy feel more connected to her sister.
With the help of headmistress McGonagall, Daniel had collected "memories" from Ivy's friends of when they met her.
He explained this enabled Winifred to know Ivy's friends as well as Ivy did.
His words left her in tears.
After the present vanished, Daniel said that he was sure it was impossible for them to know if Winifred got it, clamming up and stopping speaking in the middle of his sentence.
Ivy followed his words by saying, "It didn't matter, I'm going to find her......someday."
As a present to Daniel and all their friends, Lottie gave them blank canvases.
While the others were dumbfounded, Daniel bluntly pointed out they were blank, prompting Lottie to explain that she wished to paint with everyone.
Daniel stated that none of them could paint, but Lottie said that didn't matter as long they enjoyed it and the company of their loved ones, just like how she did with her father .
Touched by Lottie's words, the group thanked Lottie and began thinking what to paint, though Daniel told her not to expect a masterpiece.
Daniel returned home for the Christmas holidays and spent it with his sister, Esme and her boyfriend, Griffith .
She decided to spend New Year's Eve with Griffith, but invited Daniel to celebrate with them.
He didn't want to feel like a third wheel and decided to get an early train back to Hogwarts.
He told his friend about it and they invited him to spend the day with them in Hogsmeade .
He eventually agreed but wasn't impressed when they also invited Colby and Fischer Frey .
They spent the day in the village, visiting the Three Broomsticks and Zonko's before watching a firework display.
He admitted the day was better than he had thought it would be, the twins both told the student and Daniel that they had to go back to being "enemies" the next day.
Physical description
Daniel has light skin, shaggy auburn hair that covers the left half his face, and brown eyes.
He typically wore a uniform robe, brown pants, and brown shoes.
Outside of class, he was dressed more casually in a light purple, high-colour jumper, dark purple trousers, a brown jacket, and wooden pendant around his neck.
Personality and traits
Upon arriving at school, Daniel came off as a solitary, studious young wizard that often preferred focusing on his academics over interacting with other people.
He strove to be the best in all magical subjects and was determined to prove himself.
He preferred mixing potions to making new friends.
Daniel disliked noisy areas and preferred quiet places, like the Potions Classroom , where he spent most his time when not with his friends, and the Forbidden Forest .
When he befriended, among others , Robyn Thistlethwaite and Ivy Warrington , he became significantly more open and sociable.
Daniel was a very blunt person, unafraid of saying exactly what was on his mind, and had a dry, sarcastic wit.
He would talk back against adults and even his friends weren't spared from his candid remarks, which could sometimes be insensitive or rude.
Daniel could be a little awkward at socialising, and didn't like attending social events.
By his own admission, he was not good at picking gifts and cared little for fashion.
He also disliked attention, particularly stemming from his family's misfortune.
He did not like to do things like dancing or singing in public, but Daniel admitted to finding enjoyment out of activities he typically avoided with proper encouragement.
Daniel ironically had some artistic inclinations, as he was very good at dancing, had a pleasant singing voice, and knew how to play guitar.
Despite acting distant at times, Daniel was a very caring, thoughtful, and warm person who was always willing to help his friends.
However, he could be shy and reserved with expressing his warmer side, only showing such feelings to those closest to him and typically needed some coaxing for him to admit it.
He disliked intolerance and appreciated the loyal friends he made and would never betray those he cared about.
Daniel's kind heart was shown through his actions, from showing concern or healing injured creatures to providing his friends with potions to improve their health.
Daniel was supportive, generous, and protective towards his friends and those he cared about.
He cheered them on, made potions they requested, and aided them whenever he could.
Even when confused and hallucinating, Daniel couldn't bring himself to hurt his friends.
Daniel sometimes did favours and tasks for residents of Hogsmeade , often receiving free treats in gratitude for his efforts.
Daniel typically avoided getting into trouble, but he was actually rather audacious in breaking the school rules.
In his efforts to brew all types of potions, he constantly sneaked into the Forbidden Forest to gather herbs and potion ingredients .
He would brew potions without permission, such as the Polyjuice Potion , and would accidentally deplete the school's ingredients, like the rare Exploding Fluid .
However, he would never cheat in school or help others cheat, even if they were his friends.
Daniel also practised potions over the holidays, for which his Muggle-born friend noted he was skirting around the Decree for the Reasonable Restriction of Underage Sorcery .
Likely due to his family's criminal ties, Daniel was rather nonchalant in visiting places of poor reputation, such as the Hog's Head Inn and Knockturn Alley , or talking to a shady back-alley wizard.
As long as it was for a good reason and it was nothing too extreme, Daniel was willing to disobey the rules when he felt it necessary, especially for someone he cared about.
He was sensitive and had a bit of temper, which sometimes led to him recklessly taking action, but he always fought to the end.
He was also prone to acting emotionally, especially when angry or upset, and would isolate himself from others whenever something bad happened to him.
As he was not very honest with his emotions, Daniel would insist he was fine, when he really was not.
Despite this, he had a more realistic and mature mindset than his peers that made him more equipped at navigating morally complex, high-tension circumstances.
Daniel was quite self-reliant, daring and brave, displaying grit, perseverance and mental fortitude in the face of hardships.

Despite a very tumultuous third year at Hogwarts, Daniel courageously dealt with all the emotional stress of being blackmailed, suffering an identity crisis, and being forced to endure terrible gossip from his peers.
If it was for someone he cared about or to help others, Daniel demonstrated being more than willing to jump into danger and put himself at risk to protect those around him.
While polite and civil towards new people, Daniel was slow to trust and was usually sceptical about the various happenings around him.
He possessed a curious mind and was very intuitive with a penchant for investigating strange incidents and people.

Intelligent and magically gifted, Daniel was also a critical thinker and was clever, with keen observation skills and extraordinary insight, which aided him and his friends in the many troubles they involved themselves in.

He also kept well-informed on the goings-on in the wizarding community, to the point that he was very familiar with topics such as its' uneasy relationship with centaurs or the notorious group known as NOTME .
Daniel's wits and cautious attitude prompted him to be more attuned to suspicious, seemingly convenient events, as he often voiced his beliefs if something or someone felt off.
While not paranoid, Daniel's distrusting nature made him appear fairly cynical, something which Ivy and others sometimes chided him for assuming the worst about things.
Despite his jaded attitude, Daniel had a strong sense of justice and desire for search for the truth.
Be it investigation, schoolwork, or personal matters, Daniel handled everything in a very pragmatic, objective, and goal-oriented fashion.
While he knew his friends would never lie to him, Daniel would question them to better understand the truth.
He would always ask relevant questions or remind his friends to do so.
Once he set his mind on something, Daniel was very determined to see it through to the end and was willing to do so with or without help.
Despite his temper, Daniel could keep a level head in highly stressful situations, reacting quickly to events and adapt accordingly.
When he was caught flat-footed being sent into Victor Gridley 's dungeon by Gridley and his Dementors , Daniel got the idea to bring Gridley down by aiming at his desk with a Summoning Charm .
Furthermore, he cleverly managed to outplay people much older than him by making a copy of Gridley's Skeleton Key and keeping bits of information to himself.
While Daniel and his friends usually deferred to each other, Daniel's assertiveness, pragmatism, and quick-wit resulted him taking leadership within the group.
He led the charge in solving Ivy's foggy memory, in confronting the fishy Jakub Gorski , and coming up with plans for the final challenge of the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup .
Daniel always carried some potions on his person at all times, which was useful in certain emergencies, showing both resourcefulness and preparedness in his application of them.
His bravery, intelligence, and practicality made Daniel a reliable and trusted ally in tense, chaotic situations.
Following his mother's imprisonment after her violation of the International Statute of Wizarding Secrecy , he grew to view it as a "stupid law".

He expressed the belief that, while they should not necessarily go around flaunting their abilities to the masses, he nevertheless believed that keeping magic from the Muggle world entirely was a selfish thing to do.
He was apparently blind to the extent to which permitting magic around non-wizards could be exploited for nefarious purposes.
As such, he was known to dislike the British Ministry of Magic .

The source of this belief and resentment was apparently his mother being imprisoned under the accusation of being associated with NOTME despite there being no concrete evidence of this other than Kaleena performing magic in front of Muggles to save Daniel's father and brother.
Daniel clearly disliked that, despite his mother having no wish to hurt the Muggles arresting her family, she was still accused of being a criminal and sentenced to Azkaban.
While Daniel recognised the Ministry's authority and was willing to seek out help or information from them, he was usually very wary about any Ministry involvement.
He openly pointed out the Ministry's focus on positive publicity over truth and protecting someone's innocence or listening to other people's opinions.
Due to his previous negative experiences with them, Daniel was also critical of the news outlets, such the well-known "rubbish" Quibbler and sensationalistic Daily Prophet .

Despite coming off as strong and independent, Daniel deeply struggled with reconciling his complicated feelings of love for his family, the reality of their criminal deeds, and how it reflected his own self-perception.
His greatest fear was that his mother wasn't as good a person as he thought, and he was afraid that there were worse things about his family that he didn't know about.
After his family secret being outed to the entire school, Daniel eventually conquered that fear by accepting his own sense of self and learning to not care about what other people thought of him.
However, Daniel still possessed a deep fear of judgement for being a "Bloody Page" and Esme being put in danger because of it.
Aside from a few exceptions, Daniel didn't like speaking about his family to anyone, even after the whole school learned about them, and tended to be terse when he alluded to them.
Daniel aspired to be a strong, powerful wizard in the hopes of bringing his family back together one day.
When talking about his future plans, Daniel expressed a desire to own an apothecary after graduating and put his potions skills to use.
While Daniel strove to stand out academically, there some subjects he was more lax with, albeit unintentionally.
He was unable to finish his Astronomy class homework on time more than once and Transfiguration class seemed to be challenging for him.

He admitted to not really enjoying Care of Magical Creatures because of the dangerous beasts, nor Divination due to his tendency to fall asleep because he found the room to be cosy and the subject to be nonsense.

Despite Daniel sometimes joking about skipping class, even jesting about drinking a Draught of Living Death to avoid a disturbing Defence Against the Dark Arts class, he always attended his classes and applied himself to pass his courses.
Daniel even used the Wideye Potion to help himself stay awake in class.
Humorously, Daniel was willing to risk getting a minor injury rather than face punishment for not finishing his homework.
While Ivy scolded him for such thinking and called him "mad", Daniel wittily retorted that he was a "mad genius".
Much like Ivy, Daniel enjoyed sweets and various foods, though he was seen to have particular likes and dislikes.
Daniel's favourite foods included shepherd's pie and Butterbeer .
He was very fond of Pepper Imps and Ice Mice from Honeydukes .
He disliked Cucumber , and, oddly enough, seemed willing to eat Owl Treats .

Family
Daniel deeply cared about his family and wanted nothing more than to bring them together again.

While his relationship with his father and his older brother Reggie is largely unknown, Daniel had lingering attachments to the family as a whole, much to his sister Esme's dismay, who wanted Daniel to disown them.

While accepting of his father and brother's criminal activities, Daniel actively defended his mother's actions, knowing she never intended to hurt anyone or violate the International Statute of Wizarding Secrecy .
He saw her Azkaban sentence as unjust, especially since Kaleena had been accused and found guilty of being a member of the Nocturnal Order of Tricks and Magical Exhibitions without proper evidence.
Daniel was very close to his mother and learned much of the wizarding world from her as the only child with magical abilities.
When Daniel was a child, Kaleena used to sing the Mooncalf lullaby to him while putting him to bed, and Daniel joined her on various outings, such as to the botanical gardens , and Hogsmeade .
Daniel worried about his mother's time in Azkaban, and even tried to read the book Impenetrable Azkaban: The Hidden Prison to Escape in the World to learn more about the place.
The arrest of Kaleena apparently inspired his resentful attitude towards the Ministry of Magic and laws related to the secrecy of wizardkind.
Kaleena seemed evasive in speaking to Daniel about certain aspects about her past, as she refused to tell him about the coin she received from Victor Gridley and simply asked him to keep it safe.
Following the rest of his family's imprisonment, Daniel was placed under the legal guardianship of Esme.
They shared a very close relationship, viewing and valuing each other as their "everything".
Likewise, they were both very protective of each other, but this caused some disagreements between the two.
As the older sibling, Esme worried about Daniel getting into trouble and endangering himself, but Daniel stubbornly insisted that he could look after himself and that he needed to protect his sister.
According to Daniel, Esme became more protective of him after the incident with Gridley and barely let him out of her sight.
This greatly annoyed Daniel and he was forced to sneak out at night just to have time for himself.
As much as he loved his family, Daniel admitted that he found them to be "messy" and holidays were tough for him, hence why he enjoyed spending time at Hogwarts as an escape.

He also resented how his family's actions caused other people to judge him and putting him and Esme in socially difficult positions, especially fearing the magicless Esme would be endanger because of it.
Tiburon Merriweather's great-grandchild
The Muggle-born student was one of Daniel's best friends and a close confidant.

Before their first year began, Daniel encountered the student at Diagon Alley and the Hogwarts Express , but Daniel was very reserved and kept them at arm's length, warning them not to get too close to him.
Daniel and the student ended being sorted into the same House and were on cordial terms.
After spending time with each other while searching for a missing Ivy, Daniel and the student grew to be very close and became best friends with each other.
Daniel and the student shared a great deal of trust and respect for one another, understanding each other very well.
The student thought highly of Daniel's talent for potions and frequently went to him for help on the subject or recommended him to other people, like Abigail Grey , if they needed help.
Daniel generously lent his aid to brew the Hair-Dyeing Potion , the two-tone version, and the Beautification Potion for Alma because his friend asked him to help her stand out.
Although Daniel was slightly miffed about being dragged into supplying about half the school the Hair-Dyeing Potion due to its popularity, which the student apologised for.
During a mass prank period at Hogwarts, Daniel invented a Counter-Prank Concoction and gave it to the student, who had recently got pranked and needed a cure.
He often gave the student potions he made, which would be used by the student to help others in need or themselves.
Daniel was comfortable around the student, having a high opinion of their social intelligence, and he would confide in them first before anyone else.
As the student was even-tempered and mindful, the student would help Daniel navigate social situations as he was awkward, and would aid him in avoiding people in the Dance Club .
He enjoyed sharing classes with them, having signed up for Divination class because the student did.
As they were both curious, Daniel and his friend had a knack for stumbling into trouble and took it upon themselves to solve problems around Hogwarts and Hogsmeade .
They did it so much that Daniel considered himself, the student, and Ivy as a "team", and they typically assisted each other in solving any mysterious happenings.

Daniel and the student were often on a similar mental wavelength whenever they theorised the possible answers to the mysteries around them, engaging in an honest conversation of thoughts and information with each other.
Anytime something piqued their shared interest, they researched it together and even discovered new things along the way.
When it was just the two of them, Daniel and the student's adventures regularly included them disobeying the school rules and fighting something or someone.
Their escapades allowed them to strengthen their bond and develop good synergy at handling tasks and fighting side-by-side, as well as keeping any rashness in check.

While often exasperated by Daniel's potion-making antics, the student accompanied Daniel in his endeavours, if only to protect him since they knew Daniel would do what he wanted either way, and to make sure he didn't do anything reckless.
As a Muggle-born, the student valued Daniel's greater knowledge of the wizarding world, pragmatism, and his quick-wit.
Even when Daniel didn't fully involve himself in whatever task the student was doing, the student would still go to him for practical advice and analysis.

Whenever the student got stuck on a problem or bemoaned negative scrutiny for their actions, Daniel would be supportive and would reassure that he believed the student, as they were not the type to lie, and that things would blow over in time.
Daniel often worried about the student frequently landing themselves into bizarre trouble, though Daniel's own curiosity tended to lead to him doing the same.
Even when Daniel disagreed with getting involved in new problems, he would come along to help, knowing the student would do what they wanted.

In particularly dangerous situations, Daniel would stubbornly insist on coming with the student, who would be hesitant in putting him danger yet was deeply touched by Daniel's steadfast care and loyalty.
As such, Daniel was usually the most aware of the student's misadventures within their friend group due to the deep bond he and the student shared.
In their third year, their friendship became a bit strained as Daniel was going through an identity crisis and was being influenced by Elliot Evers .
While the student wasn't as vocal as Ivy, they didn't like Elliot, but tolerated him since he was Daniel's friend.
On top of Daniel being blackmailed, the student did their best to support Daniel in whatever way they could as he sorted out his problems.
The student broke the tension between Daniel and Ivy when they argued, comforted him when he was sad, and protected Daniel from danger.

Although it worried and sadden them, the student generally tried to respect Daniel's wishes, even if it meant Daniel pushed them away to do things alone, but would rebel against Daniel's requests in order to help him.
In their fourth year, the student was the first person Daniel told about his work with Elliot's reformed NOTME.
Recognising that Daniel been through a lot, the student chose not to pry and expressed relief that Daniel cut ties with Elliot.
After Daniel's family secret spread through Hogwarts, he began isolating himself because of the awful rumours about his family.
The student confronted him about it and Daniel confessed his fears that there might be some truth in the rumours.
The student assured him that they would always stand by his side no matter what.
In his depressed state, Daniel warned the student not make promises that they would regret, but the student was resolute that they wouldn't and remained a true friend to him.
Ivy Warrington
Ivy was one of Daniel's closest friends and a fellow Housemate , being one of the few people Daniel could fully trust and confide in.
During their first year, Daniel initially kept his distance from everyone and wasn't very close to anyone, though he and Ivy were familiar with each other as peers.
Daniel was uninterested in joining the unsanctioned search for Ivy when she went missing, but ended up joining in and being one of the two students to find her.
Since then, Daniel, Ivy and their Muggle-born friend became best friends with each other.
As they were in the same year and house, Daniel and Ivy spent a lot of their time together, from helping each other practising spells, doing group assignments, and having all sort of adventures.
Daniel's cynical pragmatism balanced out with Ivy's upbeat optimism, allowing their personalities to compliment and ground each other.
Ivy liked to tease Daniel and get him flustered, but it was always good-natured and they both held great respect for each other's abilities.
Daniel cared very much for Ivy and was protective of her, a feeling that Ivy returned as just as fiercely.
They did their best to be supportive when dealing with their respective family drama and comforted each other when they were down.
During their first year, Daniel and Ivy stood up for each other against their bully, Cassandra Vole , who attempted to hurt their friendship by alluding to their family affairs.
Daniel confided in Ivy and their friend about his family being criminals, and they didn't judge him for it.
When Ivy had a hard time dealing with her foggy memory about her twin sister Winifred , Daniel was determined to find out the truth for Ivy's sake, even when Ivy tried to push her friends away.
Daniel gave her space when needed, assuaged her fears, and repeatedly assured Ivy that she was a good person.
When Ivy felt sad about Winifred during the holidays, Daniel sought to comfort her by preparing a present of memories of Ivy for Winifred.
While they didn't know if the gift would reach Winifred, Ivy was touched by Daniel's sweet gesture.
However, as they were both stubborn and opinionated, Daniel and Ivy bickered at times, especially since they were not shy at expressing their displeasure with each other.
Their friendship became somewhat strained in their third year, as Daniel was being influenced by the devious Elliot Evers .
Ivy was very vocal about her distaste for Elliot and his sly actions, but Daniel defended him at every turn, much to her chagrin.
Despite their arguing and tension, Ivy did her best to defend Daniel and consoled him when he was working through his emotional issues.
Just like Daniel did with her, Ivy assured him that he was a good person and that she would always be there for him.

Since Daniel was being blackmailed by the villainous Victor Gridley to do a task, Daniel didn't want to involve his friends in such a dangerous situation, but Ivy and their Muggle-born friend insisted on being there for him.
By the end of year, Daniel set some boundaries with Ivy, telling her he could not be his "old self", as she could not expect him not to change, but he would always be her friend.
He also told her that she needed to respect his choices, even if she didn't agree with them, and he appreciated that Ivy would keep him from making any mistakes.
Robyn Thistlethwaite , Kevin Farrell , and Lottie Turner
Daniel was good friends with Robyn, Kevin, and Lottie since their first year, and they spent a lot of time together, going on adventures and doing school activities.
During their third year, Kevin and the girls learned about how most of Daniel's family was in jail.
Despite the exaggerated rumours and negative attention it brought, the trio did not believe it or cared, being more worried about Daniel's emotional well-being, and remained close to Daniel.
Daniel's studious, dry demeanour tended to clash against Robyn's impulsive, out-going attitude, causing the two to tease and sarcastically quip at each other.
Robyn sometimes engaged in playful games with Daniel in order to best him or play pranks on him, though Daniel typically noticed when she was in a more advantageous position or if something was off.
Daniel got along well with the more subdued, bookish Kevin and sweet, gentle Lottie.
Daniel liked to playfully rib Kevin for his clumsiness, but was always supportive and had a good rapport with him.
Daniel displayed a protective side towards Kevin and Lottie since both were rather timid.
Daniel enjoyed listening to Lottie's stories of her world travels and he was implied to view Lottie to be like family.
Cassandra Vole
Daniel shared a very antagonistic and competitive mutual rivalry with Cassandra, who bullied Daniel and his friends since their first year.

Daniel hated Cassandra's mean, haughty attitude and her belittlement of others, especially since Cassandra took every opportunity to insult and provoke Daniel and his friends, which usually led to a fight.

During the first year, Daniel and Cassandra argued about hiding magic from Muggles , when Cassandra mocked Daniel wanting to be a criminal, made insinuations about his family, and threatened to get him sent to Azkaban .

As the subject was a sore point due his family's circumstances, Daniel was angry at Cassandra and their enmity continued to escalate as Cassandra and the Frey twins kept meddling in his and his friends' affairs and friendship.
After learning about Daniel's family, Cassandra relished in gossiping about it with other students and called him criminal.
She cruelly taunted Daniel about it and believed in the exaggerated rumours going around school about him.
Cassandra was not above trying to sabotage Daniel and his friends during class, placing a Venomous Tentacula in their trough.
Daniel suspected it was Cassandra, but couldn't prove it and the entire class was unfairly punished for it.
At one point, Cassandra got Daniel into trouble by lying to Professor Neville Longbottom that he stole Wormwood from the Hogwarts greenhouses .
In their fourth year, Daniel pointedly told Cassandra he found her to be "cold-hearted" and was irritated at being forced to "put up with" her for the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup .
Due to all the grief she had given him and his friends, Daniel understandably found the prospect of being friends with Cassandra to be uncomfortable.
After the Siege of Hogwarts , Daniel expressed doubt after he heard that Cassandra had thanked his friend , in contrast to Ivy, who was more open to being friendlier with her.
Despite their mutual animosity, Daniel was capable of putting it aside and worked with her when the situation called for it.
Daniel gallantly protected Cassandra from being hit by Gawrloc during the Wizard's Cup.

After Cassandra sincerely thanked Daniel, he graciously accepted it, but noted how "weird" it was for the two of them to be amicable with each other and stated that they would likely be enemies again next year.
Fischer and Colby Frey
Daniel didn't hate the Frey twins the way Ivy hated Cassandra, but their relationship was marked by mutual antagonism and rivalry.
The Frey twins often bullied Daniel and his friends, with most encounters with the Freys started with the twins messing with Daniel and co. and throwing insults before devolving into a fight.
They hate Daniel and appeared to have a particular fixation on him and part of the reason seemed to be due to them envying Daniel for his academic performance.
They partook in trying to sabotage Daniel's homework.
During their second year, they tricked and lied to Argus Filch to get him to confiscate Daniel's potions equipment, just to get back at him for being better at Defence Against the Dark Arts class.

Their bullying of Daniel got to the point that it even exasperated Cassandra, who told them to lay off Daniel as she thought the twins were starting to "look desperate" in their attempts to one-up the boy.
Daniel was very aware of the Freys' periodic efforts to cheat, lie, pull pranks, and generally make his life difficult around Hogwarts.
He would both knowingly and unknowingly investigate their mischief, thwart their schemes, and made sure they didn't cause trouble.

During the beginning of the Hogwarts Chizpurfle infestation , Daniel initially suspected the Freys of having something to do with the mass broomstick malfunction and was prepared for a fight if he and his friends had to confront them, exemplifying Daniel's contentious relationship with the Freys and their antics.
Daniel also had little patience for their money-making schemes, knowing the ridiculous high prices they put on their wares.
After learning about Daniel's family, the Freys cruelly taunted Daniel about it and expressed amusement in the exaggerated rumours going around school about his family.
Despite their near-constant friction, Daniel was capable of getting along with the Freys, with his Muggle-born friend as intermediary, on special occasions.
Other friends
During his first year, Daniel and his friends found the portrait Gossamer in their common room and freed him from from his confinement.
Learning of Gossamer's mischievous behaviour, Daniel wanted to lock him up again before the chaos he reaped got everyone into trouble.
However, realising Gossamer just wanted companions, Daniel and his friends warmed to the portrait and promised to be his friends.
Daniel appreciated Gossamer's ability to spy and would request his help with tracking people or getting his knowledge of hidden areas in the castle.
Through their mutual friend , Daniel befriended Abigail Grey and was among the few at Hogwarts to know about her werewolf affliction.
They enjoyed spending time and having adventures together.
As she wasn't good at potions, Abigail sometimes relied on Daniel's skills with potions, such as when her Wizard's Chess set got infected with Chizpurfles and she needed to cleanse it.
When meeting Wénshī Scrivenshaft , Daniel was initially guarded and wary of the upperclassman.
After being suspected for stealing a goblin-forged sword , Daniel and his friends learned that Wénshī was responsible and about his financial crisis with Scrivenshaft's Quill Shop .
Daniel joined the effort to help Wénshī with his situation and assisted him in handling the sinister Midas Gullveig .
After defeating Midas, Wénshī was grateful for all his friends and started to write about them and their adventure in a book.

At one point, Wénshī gifted Daniel with one of his personally crafted quills, which Daniel was grateful for and planned to brew a potion for Wénshī as a thank-you present, but the quill turned out to be defective (due to a prank from the Freys) and was returned.
During the Intercontinental Wizard's Cup , Daniel became friends with Violet Williams of Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and Kenji Kobayashi of Mahoutokoro .
At the end of the tournament celebration, Daniel spent time enjoying the party and dancing with his foreign friends.
Horace Slughorn
Daniel enjoyed a good teacher-student relationship with his Potions professor.
As the top brewer of his class, Daniel excelled in Slughorn's class and impressed his professor with his skills.
Slughorn even spoke glowingly about Daniel to Severus Snape 's portrait , who agreed that Daniel was talented.
Slughorn also told Daniel where the best spots to pick herbs were in the Forbidden Forest .
After Daniel's family background was revealed to the entire school, Slughorn didn't judge Daniel for it.

When Daniel was caught trying to steal his potions supplies back from Argus Filch , Slughorn recognised that Daniel was being treated unfairly, since Daniel explained that he had been falsely accused of swapping Filch's pumpkin juice for a Babbling Beverage .

Slughorn took over handling Daniel's punishment, lecturing him over his irresponsible actions, but expressed understanding to Daniel's woes about his negative reputation and assured Daniel that he thought he was brilliant student.
Slughorn promised to get Daniel's stuff back from Filch and gave him a week's detention for breaking into Filch's office.
Slughorn made his student promise to never use his talents for foolish purposes again, which Daniel took to heart and vowed not to let him down.
Other Hogwarts staff
Overall, Daniel generally had a good relationship with most of his teachers and the Hogwarts staff.
Daniel wasn't afraid to be cheeky sometimes with some of his professors.
Daniel respected Headmistress Minerva McGonagall , who treated all students under her sternly yet fairly.

When Daniel started a fight with Cassandra and the Frey twins, McGonagall broke it up and defended Daniel when Cassandra derided him for his family's criminal history, stating one should not be judged for their upbringing.
The Headmistress then gave Daniel detention for his own bad behaviour.
Daniel and his friends even made a birthday cake for McGonagall to show their appreciation.
Daniel thought highly of his Herbology professor, Neville Longbottom , who was kind and fair to all his students.

Daniel knew of the Battle of Hogwarts and Professor Longbottom's role in it, calling him a hero, and disliked how Linderina Crane and Victor Gridley believed he could be associated with the Nocturnal Order of Tricks and Magical Exhibitions .
Daniel tried to protect the professor from being framed as a NOTME member, but complicated forces prevented him from doing so and Daniel had to rescue him and Esme from Gridley.
Longbottom was very understanding about Daniel's role in the mess since he was being blackmailed.
Daniel was curious about Longbottom's time as a student and even looked into Longbottom's former bullies after the professor relayed his own experience with bullying.
Rubeus Hagrid was a good teacher and friend to Daniel and his peers, as they often came by to help him outside of class assignments and occasionally sought his knowledge on certain topics.
Hagrid thought well of Daniel and knew of his excellent potion-making skills.

Whenever Hagrid needed a potion for his magical creatures, Daniel was happy to lend his help to heal them or keep them under control, and was even willing to help look after Fang if Hagrid wasn't around.
Due to their close, easy-going friendship, Daniel was more casual with Hagrid than his other professors, even playfully teasing him sometimes.

Hagrid also trusted Daniel enough to introduce him to his half-brother, Grawp , though Daniel was shocked and wary to see the young giant and snarked that Hagrid's ideas were going to be the death of him someday.
However, Daniel was usually exasperated by Hagrid's menagerie of dangerous pets and was baffled by the types of creatures he used for his Care of Magical Creatures class.
While he cared for Hagrid, Daniel admitted he didn't enjoy Care of Magical Creatures class due to dealing with all the dangerous beasts.
Daniel would also get annoyed by how some of Hagrid's pets would wander off and cause trouble for him.
Like most students, Daniel disliked Argus Filch for his unpleasant personality and how he seemed to "have it out" for Daniel since his enrolment in Hogwarts.
While Daniel was not afraid of rebelling against Filch, he would avoid being around the caretaker and receiving detention from him whenever possible.
Daniel and his peers' habit of trouble-making made Filch eager to shackle them and throw them in the dungeons, which they were spared due to timely intervention from the other Hogwarts staff.
When he was able to, Filch would give Daniel and his friends extra tasks to do in detention.
Daniel found Professor Sybill Trelawney to be odd and clumsy, and her constant omens of doom to be nonsense.
This contributed to Daniel's low opinion about Divination and found the class to be confusing.
Due to his general scepticism towards Divination, Daniel was noted to frequently grumbles about the class, and initially only signed up for the class because he wanted to be with his friends.
Elliot Evers
Daniel possessed a complex relationship with Elliot, which started to form even before they officially met.
After his mother was falsely accused of being part of NOTME, Daniel began to passively support NOTME's goal of sharing magic with Muggles .
In his third year, Daniel's entanglement with Elliot started after being dragged into NOTME's conflict with Victor Gridley , who was an old associate of his mother.
Elliot stole a Skeleton Key and Daniel was blackmailed into recovering it for Gridley.
When Gridley staged an attack in Hogsmeade , Daniel first encountered Elliot wearing his NOTME disguise and duelled him with his friends.
Since then, Elliot kept an watchful eye on Daniel and his friends, developing a shine to the younger boy.
They officially met after Elliot rescued Daniel and his friends from some Acromantulas in the Forbidden Forest .
Daniel was initially suspicious of Elliot and thought he was spying on them.
At Esme's request, Elliot took Daniel under his wing and Daniel ended up warming to Elliot as a mentor.
While Elliot taught him some advanced magic, gave him advice and protected him from bullies, his influence on Daniel eventually turned out to be negative.
As Daniel's friends noted, Daniel was changing in concerning ways and a lot of Elliot's words came off as dubious.
Elliot even confronted Daniel's closest friends and claimed that they didn't understand Daniel nor see how "special" Daniel was.
Elliot went as far as to duel them to prevent them from reaching Daniel when he was using a Boggart to deal with his emotional turmoil.

Despite his friends' warnings, Daniel defended Elliot's actions at every turn, but his opinion of his senior turned sour after Daniel figured out Elliot was part of NOTME and the reason why Gridley was threatening the Page siblings.
During a private talk, Elliot admitted to purposely leaving clues for Daniel to learn his secret and that he saw him as a kindred spirit.
As Esme was in danger at the time, Daniel requested Elliot's help, who took advantage of the situation and agreed if Daniel agreed to join his "new order".
Due to Elliot wanting to wait until Gridley made a move, a frustrated Daniel stole the Skeleton Key behind his back and gave his identity to Gridley as payback.
While angered by this, Elliot was also impressed by Daniel's clever play in tricking the British Ministry of Magic , stopping Gridley, and gaining leverage over him.
In the end, Daniel joined Elliot and NOTME, on the condition he treat Daniel as an equal, did not lie to him, and made sure his mother was safe for the rest of her sentence in Azkaban .

During his fourth year, Daniel worked diligently to brew potions for Elliot's reformed NOTME, but he eventually received news of his mother's prison sentence being abruptly extended due to "new evidence".
Seeing it as a betrayal of their deal, Daniel severed ties with Elliot, but Elliot continued to manipulate Daniel by breaking Kaleena out of Azkaban to win back his trust.
Victor Gridley
Gridley was an old criminal associate of his mother and a personal enemy for Daniel, who held the man in great contempt.
Daniel met Gridley once as a child, but was too young to remember.
Before Daniel's third year began, Gridley sent his underlings to spy on Daniel and Esme, as he was contemplating on how to use Daniel to retrieve his Skeleton Key from NOTME .

Daniel sensed what was going on and attempted to get to the bottom of it, only to botch Victor's trap to draw out NOTME, which angered him into dropping all pretences and directly summoning Daniel to him.
Having been stalked and attacked by his minions, Daniel disliked Gridley immediately and was furious that Gridley kept calling his mother a criminal, as well as insinuating Daniel was one too.
Daniel was not afraid of Gridley and stood up to him, but was coerced into his demands because he threatened to unleash a Dementor on Esme.
While all their exchanges were riddled with hostility, Gridley took amusement in Daniel's aggression and would praise him whenever he showed his sharp mind.
Gridley encouraged Daniel to give into his darker side, trying to corrupt the young boy, and compared him to Kaleena.
Daniel resisted Gridley's attempts to influence him and made his own plan to subvert Gridley, which he eventually succeeded in with the help of his friends.
