title: Hogwarts Apothecary Dept.
paragraphs: The department's logo
The Hogwarts Apothecary Dept. (
with 'dept.'
being short for 'department') was a department of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry presumably responsible for producing potions and ingredients.
Notes and references

title: Dartmoor
paragraphs: Dartmoor is an area of 368 square miles of moorland in south Devon , England , comprised mostly of uncultivated hill land.
History

In 1379 , Dartmoor was the site of a duelling contest in which wizards and witches from across Europe came to partake: according to contemporary reports, the contest (which was held at night, so as to avoid attracting the attention of Muggles ) featured duelling of a level of skill that was almost unprecedented.

Elizabeth Smudgling won this contest with a single Disarming Charm (a charm that, in the opinion of Miranda Goshawk , was of Smudgling's own making ) and was subsequently awarded the title of " Supreme Dueller ".
Newt Scamander and Jacob Kowalski looking for a Portkey in Dartmoor
In September 1927 , Newt Scamander and Jacob Kowalski headed to Dartmoor, where they used a Portkey to get to Paris .
Harry Potter , Hermione Granger , Weasleys ( Arthur , Fred , George , Ron and Ginny ) and Cedric and Amos Diggory travelled via Portkey to Dartmoor
In August 1994 , the 422nd Quidditch World Cup was held in a " nice deserted moor " in Dartmoor.
For that purpose, a gigantic stadium was built, with seats for one hundred thousand wizards .
Wizards camped at Mr Roberts's campsite .
In the night of 26 August , hours after the Cup final, a site was a place of Death Eater riot .

On 2 September 1997 , Harry Potter with Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger , on the run from British Ministry of Magic , Apparated to the forest in Dartmoor, where three years earlier they hid after Death Eaters stormed the campground.
They set up protections and spent a night camped out in the woods.
Next morning, before disapparating from the place, Harry found the oldest, most gnarled and resilient-looking tree he could find.
Under the tree, he buried the Alastor Moody's eye , found earlier in the Dolores Umbridge 's office in the Ministry headquarters , and marked the grave with a small cross.
Notes and references

title: Astronomy
paragraphs: The Astronomy Tower , where Astronomy was studied by students and staff at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
Astronomy was the magical and scientific study of celestial objects such as stars, planets , comets, and galaxies , as well as the phenomena that occur outside the Earth 's atmosphere.
Wizards and witches who dedicated themselves to understanding the properties and uses of these objects were called astronomers .
Nature
The stars magically projected inside the Great Hall
Wizardkind's knowledge of astronomy was significantly more advanced than their Muggle counterparts.
There were even some constellations known only to Wizards, such as the Merperson and the Thestral .
However unlike with most magical disciplines, advancements in astronomy made by wizards could eventually be discovered by Muggles who simply lacked the more advanced instruments of wizardkind.
It hasn't been directly stated how astronomy as a whole was relevant to the magical arts.
Knowledge of astronomy was useful for predicting celestial events, which played an important part in potions especially.

Hesper Starkey gained fame for discovering the role that the phases of the moon played in potion-making, and certain potions required an accurate knowledge of the lunar cycle in order to brew properly.
Additionally, Aurora Sinistra offered an insightful argument connecting astronomy to success in combat to a member of the Statute of Secrecy Task Force training to become a professor .
It helped open their mind, and increased the amount of damage they could deal in battle.
According to Professor Shah , there was much that could be gleaned from the stars.
She believed that people were like blank star charts , empty canvasses waiting to be inscribed by all that the universe had to offer.
Professor Shah found it increasingly rare to find a student who sought after things celestial (of their own accord).
Although, some students, like Amit Thakkar , were fascinated by the concept of infinity and limitless potential, as there was always something new being discovered in space.
The great devoted stargazer's of the past erected stone slabs known as Astronomy Tables throughout the Highlands , from which they gazed toward the heavens millennia ago.
They were ideal for studying constellations near and far, and they could be used to find hidden constellations.
For centuries, wizardkind made use of them, but they have since become mere monuments to the intrepid intellectual pursuits of a bygone epoch.
Some say the locations of the tables were originally marked by centaurs for ritual star gazing.
By the 1990s , common devices within the wizarding world included Orrerys which showed an accurate map of the solar system , and even globes which showed an accurate moving map of the galaxy .

Astrology , a branch of divination performed by observing the behaviour of heavenly bodies, was a separate field frowned upon by astronomers, who did not like it when the two were confused for each other.
Professor Satyavati Shah in particular believed that astrology was "mere lunacy".
Alchemy , in both the magical and Muggle worlds, adopted some of the terms and symbols of various other disciplines, including astronomy, in order to avoid persecution.
Limitations
Gazing up at the night sky and documenting one's findings was notably more difficult if one did not have the proper equipment, telescopes , star charts , and the like.
Dangers
While there was nothing particularly dangerous about astronomy, some people were heard complaining about the freezing cold at night, which was arguably dangerous in its own way.
Known astronomers
Wizardkind
Other astronomers
Centaurs were well known for their knowledge in astronomy, however they mostly used it to aid their divination.
Some people believed that the astronomy slabs that were dotted around the Highlands were built by centaurs, though others believed they were built by wizards.
Teaching
The top of the Astronomy Tower , where lessons took place
There was a Astronomy class at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , devoted to the study of the night skies.
As such, it was the only class at Hogwarts held at night, instead of during the day.
It was a core class and mandatory throughout the first five years of a students education.
It was optional to N.E.W.T. -level students in their sixth and seventh-years to those who achieved a high enough grade on their Ordinary Wizarding Level exam.
Objects studied
Texts on Astronomy
Magical
Non-magical
Instruments
Notes and references

title: Galaxy
paragraphs: A galaxy is a massive, gravitationally bound system that consists of stars and stellar remains.
The Milky Way galaxy is home to the planet Earth, and perfect moving models of the galaxy in a large glass ball were on sale in Diagon Alley .
Notes and references

title: Orrery
paragraphs: An Orrery was a model of the sun , planets, and moons of the solar system , used for studying astronomy .
History
The Astronomy class observing the orrery

During sixth-year Astronomy lessons during the 1989-1990 school year and seventh-year lessons in the 1990-1991 school year at Hogwarts , Professor Aurora Sinistra would have her students observe an orrery in the Astronomy Tower , in order to make predictions about the next eclipse .
Sybill Trelawney used one of all nine planets (including Pluto ) while teaching astrology during Divination in 1995 .
This orrery was magical , as astronomical objects inside the glass hovered in thin air .
Related items
Dumbledore's office with orrery-like globes to the bottom left and middle right
Notes and references

title: Astronomer
paragraphs: An astronomer is a scientist who works in the field of astronomy , the scientific study of celestial bodies outside Earth (including planets , stars, and galaxies ), as well as related natural phenomena.
As the field of Astronomy was studied by both magical and Non-magical people, known astronomers inlcude people from both groups.
Known astronomers
Notes and references

title: Merperson (constellation)
paragraphs: A tapestry depicting the constellation (left)
This constellation was a constellation only known to wizardkind .
They associated it with the merpeople , a species that dwelled underwater.
A tapestry could be found in Hogwarts Castle in the 19th century depicting this constellation, along with a Thestral-shaped one .
Notes and references

title: Thestral (constellation)
paragraphs: A tapestry depicting the constellation
This constellation was a constellation only known to wizardkind .
They associated it with the Thestral , a magical creature.
Several tapestries could be found in Hogwarts Castle in the 19th century depicting this constellation, along with a merperson-shaped one .
Notes and references

title: Hesper Starkey
paragraphs: Hesper Starkey ( 1881 - 1973 ) was a witch who studied how the moon 's phases affected potion fabrication.
History
In 1993-1994 , a portrait of her guarded a secret room at Hogwarts , to which the password (obtainable only from Fred and George Weasley ) was Lunartickle .
Magical abilities and skills
Notes and references

title: Aurora Sinistra
paragraphs: Professor Aurora Sinistra was a witch who taught in the Astronomy department at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
Professor Sinistra was teaching by September 1985 , and her take on teaching the subject included studying the night sky with telescopes .
The professor was present at many important events throughout Harry Potter 's time at Hogwarts.

In the 1992-1993 school year , the professor was present at the discovery of a petrified student, Justin Finch-Fletchley , and helped transport him with Filius Flitwick , the Charms Master , to Madam Pomfrey in the Hospital Wing .
In 1994 , Sinistra attended the Yule Ball with " Alastor Moody ", and danced a nervous two-step, careful to avoid his wooden leg.
Sinistra prepared fifth-year students for their Ordinary Wizarding Levels by demanding large amounts of homework.
She was probably good friends with Wilhelmina Grubbly-Plank , who she was found chatting with numerous times throughout the year.
It is unknown if Sinistra participated in the Battle of Hogwarts alongside the students and fellow staff.
If she did, then she witnessed the final defeat of Lord Voldemort at the hands of Harry Potter.
After the Second Wizarding War , she continued to teach at Hogwarts.
Biography
Early life
Little is known about Professor Sinistra's early life.
She presumably excelled at Astronomy during her student years, being either homeschooled by her parents/guardians or educated at a wizarding school .
Career at Hogwarts
Sinistra, Albus Dumbledore , and Minerva McGonagall singing the Hogwarts school song in 1991
Before September 1985, Sinistra applied for a teaching position at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and was accepted, becoming a Hogwarts Professor .
She taught many of her lessons at midnight at the top of the Astronomy Tower , the highest point of the castle.
Her students each required a telescope for her lessons, and she taught all about the different stars and constellations, as well as moons and planets.

She regularly attended the Start-of-Term Feast , where she appeared to enjoy socialising with other teachers, such as Pomona Sprout , the Herbology professor, and Wilhelmina Grubbly-Plank , the Care of Magical Creatures professor and later substitute for Professor Rubeus Hagrid .
She was known to give large amounts of homework to students in their fifth year and to those who continued Astronomy for the sixth and seventh .
In the 1985-1986 school year !
Professor Sinistra was teaching in Astronomy Tower when she became trapped in cursed ice along with the children in her class.
She was later broken out of the ice by her fellow teachers.
At the start of the 1989-1990 school year , Professor Sinistra attended the Start-of-Term Feast , where she informed students that she taught at midnight.
She began teaching sixth-year students at some point during the school year.
Professor Sinistra listening to Professor Dumbledore give his annual speech
Aurora sat at Professor Dumbledore's left hand side while Harry Potter and his classmates were being Sorted .
She was rather emotionless and clapped unenthusiastically.
She later attended the Gryffindor vs Slytherin Quidditch match , sitting near the Headmaster again.
When Angelina Johnson was fouled, she stood up with the rest of the teachers and gasped.
However, when Harry Potter appeared to lose control of his broomstick , she did not openly show signs of emotion.
Later that year, the professor's fellow colleague, Quirinus Quirrell , was revealed to be a servant of Lord Voldemort after the Philosopher's Stone which was hidden inside the school.
Apparently, Sinistra was not chosen to protect the Philosopher's Stone Chambers .
She also attended the Leaving Feast , in the same seat she was in earlier in the year, and watched as Gryffindor won the House Cup .
Sinistra sitting with Professors Dumbledore and McGonagall at the staff table
During the 1992-1993 school year , Professor Sinistra continued her career as Astronomy teacher.
This year, however, the Chamber of Secrets was opened once again, having killed a Ravenclaw student named Myrtle in 1943 .
Sinistra was present when Muggle-born student Justin Finch-Fletchley was discovered, petrified after an attempted attack on him by the Basilisk .
Together, she and Professor Filius Flitwick , the Charms Master , removed Justin's body and took him to the Hospital Wing where he was to be treated by Madam Poppy Pomfrey .
The Chamber was closed at the end of the year and the Basilisk slain.
Professor Sinistra attended the Yule Ball where she danced with Alastor Moody
During the 1994-1995 school year , the Triwizard Tournament took place at Hogwarts Castle .
For the Welcoming Feast , Professor Sinistra sat in between Severus Snape and Pomona Sprout , and was seen talking to the latter.
She attended the Yule Ball with Bartemius Crouch Jnr , who was posing as Alastor Moody .
Sinistra danced a nervous two-step with him, careful to avoid his wooden leg, and seemed rather uncomfortable.
Second Wizarding War
Professor Sinistra sitting at the staff table during meal time in the Great Hall
The following academic year, she gave large amounts of homework to her fifth-years as preparation for their Ordinary Wizarding Levels .

One of these known pieces of homework was a project on Jupiter 's moons ; during one lesson, she specifically stated that the moon Europa is covered in ice , but Harry Potter either misheard her or miswrote it as mice .
Throughout the year she was seen talking to Wilhelmina Grubbly-Plank , the stand-in professor for Rubeus Hagrid , the Care of Magical Creatures teacher.

That year, Hogwarts was the reluctant host of Ministry of Magic bureaucrat Dolores Umbridge , who had been appointed to the position of Defence Against the Dark Arts teacher but was in reality there to undermine Dumbledore and ensure Ministry control of the school.

At the Start-of-Term Feast , Professor Umbridge interrupted Headmaster Dumbledore's usual announcement and proceeded to make an incredibly dull speech about the Ministry and Hogwarts, at one point making a little bow to the other teachers.
Professor Sinistra, like her colleagues, understood the real meaning of the speech (the Ministry was interfering at Hogwarts) and neither returned the bow nor applauded when the speech was over.

Umbridge was later appointed High Inquisitor by order of Minister Cornelius Fudge , which gave her the power to inspect and dismiss teachers who ostensibly were not up to scratch (in reality it was a means of eliminating teachers who were either too close to Dumbledore or who taught things she felt were inappropriate).
Professor Sinistra presumably endured this intrusive inspection of her classes, but evidently proved a competent teacher as she was neither sacked or placed on probation.
She was also presumably among the teachers who requested Umbridge's help in getting rid of rogue fireworks in their classrooms and those who cheered her eventual departure at the end of the year.
The funeral of Albus Dumbledore, that Sinistra might have attended
At the end of the 1996-1997 school year Hogwarts was invaded by Death Eaters and the students and staff where threatened.
It is unknown if Sinistra participated in the Battle of the Astronomy Tower alongside students and fellow Professors.
During the battle Dumbledore was killed by Severus Snape and his funeral was held within the grounds of the school.
It is also unknown whether or not Sinistra attended the funeral, although it seems likely as Dumbledore was her employer.
Harry Potter's final defeat of Lord Voldemort and the end of the Second Wizarding War
This year Hogwarts had fallen under Voldemort's influence.
Voldemort made Death Eaters , Amycus Carrow and Alecto Carrow teachers at Hogwarts.
On 2 May 1998 , Voldemort and his army of Death Eaters and Dark creatures attacked Hogwarts, in order to capture Harry Potter.
It is probable that she, along with the rest of the faculty, fought in the Battle of Hogwarts .
If Sinistra did in fact stay to fight, then she witnessed Voldemort's final defeat and death at the hands of Harry Potter and therefore the end of the Second Wizarding War .
The Calamity
Professor Sinistra survived the Second Wizarding War and continued to teach Astronomy at Hogwarts into the time of the Calamity in the late 2010s and early 2020s .

She took a liking to a member of the Statute of Secrecy Task Force training to become a professor and helped open their mind through an insightful argument connecting astronomy to success in combat, increasing the amount of damage they could deal in battle.
She later offered some tips to the same professor regarding maximising the effects of the professor's Protection Charm .
Physical description
She often wore olive robes and a pointed hat spangled with astrological signs.
Personality and traits
Sinistra was a serious and strict woman.
She was proven to have been a highly competent teacher, as her lessons inspected by Dolores Umbridge were deemed satisfactory enough that she was not subject to disciplinary action by her.
Her competency as a teacher was also proven by how she taught her subject for at least ten years at Hogwarts, showing her to have been highly experienced and skilled in her field.
She feared the Dark Lord Voldemort and her Boggart assumed his form.
Sinistra was also friendly with fellow staff members, as she was seen dancing with Barty Crouch Jnr (disguised as Alastor Moody) at the Yule Ball.
She was also seen talking with Professor Grubbly-Plank .
Magical abilities and skills
Etymology
Professor Sinistra's surname originates from the Latin " sinister ", meaning " left " or " with a direction to the left ".
The most probable explanation for this is that most planets of the solar system rotate anti-clockwise.
Sinistra is also the name of a star of the constellation of Ophiuchus.
The contemporary meaning of the word " sinister " is "evil" or "menacing" and can be a synonym of "dark" (like in "dark events" for example).
Here, the name "Sinistra" probably refers to the fact that Astronomy is mostly practised at night, when the sky is dark.
The first name "Aurora" indicates a relationship with the dawn, however it is probably derived from "Aurora", a phenomena which occurs when solar winds interact with the earth's magnetic field.
Notes and references

title: Satyavati Shah
paragraphs: Professor Satyavati Shah was a witch who worked as the professor of Astronomy at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the late 19th century .
Professor Shah had a Squib sister named Suchrita who studied Astronomy at Cambridge University .
They had a close relationship, taking at least one trip together to Jantar Mantar in late 1890.
Biography
Early life
After being raised largely in the Muggle world , Satyavati Shah took an interest in the sciences , which she carried with her into her schooling at Hogwarts.
She also had a sister named Suchrita .
In her youth, she began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry where she was Sorted into Ravenclaw house .
Teaching career
Professor Shah teaching Astronomy
After graduating, she eventually took up a position as professor of Astronomy and devoted herself to her subject in a way that most would find monastic and extreme.
Like her scientific subject, she could come off to her pupils as a bit cold and demanding.
She was easily carried away when talking about the heavens and viewed many of the other Hogwarts disciplines (like Divination ) as wishy-washy.
Personal life
Professor Shah's sister Suchrita, with whom she kept a correspondence through letters, had a similar interest in Astronomy.
In 1890, Satyavati and Suchrita were planning to take a trip later in the year to the site of Jantar Mantar, New Delhi, a place that consisted of 13 architectural astronomy instruments.
Suchrita mentioned in one letter to Satyavati and expressed joy in getting to go on such an adventure with her sister.

In the same letter, Suchrita also disclosed to Satyavati regarding Satyavati and Suchrita's theory that her Cambridge contacts had been wrong in their understanding of meteor showers , and told her that Muggle astronomers had developed a way to calculate the position of dust at Earth's orbit in order to link meteors to comets.
Magical abilities and skills
Etymology
Satyavati may come from the queen of the same name.
Satyavati was the queen of the Kuru, wife of king Shantanu of Hastinapura and great-grandmother of the Pandava and Kaurava princes, principal characters of the Hindu epic Mahabharata.
Shah is a common surname in various countries and regions, including India.
In the Gujarat and Rajasthan regions, the name could come from the Gujarati word "sah" meaning "merchant" or Prakrit "sahu", with the actual spelling being popularised by the Persian word for "king".
Notes and references

title: Star chart
paragraphs: A star chart was a written document used to represent the positions and movements of the stars, like an ordinary map.
Astronomers used these for research or study.
An O.W.L. -level wizard or witch would have been able to fill in a blank star chart after some hours of skygazing in Astronomy .
History
Students completing star charts in Astronomy
Badeea Ali owned a star chart in the 1980s .
During the 1989-1990 school year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , sixth-year Astronomy students were tasked with the making of star charts in class.
This was continued in the seventh year .

During the 1994-1995 school year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , Professor Sybill Trelawney had fourth-year Divination students complete star charts in class, as part of their studies in Astrology .
In the 1995-1996 school year , fifth-year O.W.L. students at Hogwarts had to "fill in a blank star chart" based on a few hours of observing the night sky as part of their O.W.L. exam.
Notes and references

title: Amit Thakkar
paragraphs: Amit Thakkar (b. 1874/1875 ) was a wizard and Ravenclaw student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the late 19th century .
Biography
Childhood
Amit was born in either 1874 or 1875 , and at some point in his childhood came to know Gobbledegook .
He wanted to become a magical historian and was exceptionally intrigued by Astronomy .
Hogwarts years
In September 1886 , he began his education at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , where he was Sorted into Ravenclaw House .

In the 1890-1891 school year , during his fifth year , in the first Astronomy class of the school year, he was introduced to a new student of the same year by Professor Shah to help them with their first Astronomy class.
He lent them his old telescope , and later, as a favour, they helped him explore the region around Hogwarts Castle for Astronomy Tables , an ancient invention for stargazing.
Later in the year, the new friend began investigating Ranrok , the goblin rebel who had sparked a mass rebellion during that time, and his plans.
They needed information, and as Lodgok - a good, non-rebel goblin - had told them, notes on the plans were in The Mine's Eye , but they were written in Gobbledegook.
Amit, an expert in reading the language, was asked to come along to decipher them in the mine.
Personality and traits
Amit aspired to be a magical historian, having made extensive plans for his first memoir.
He was exceptionally bright and well-read.
He adored stargazing and always seemed to have the most recent, top-of-the-line telescope on hand to use whenever needed.

He would selflessly help out his friends when called upon to do so, although he sometimes found himself in over his head and reflecting that he might have been better off had he stayed at home and written about the exploits of more daring peers than he was by going out to experience them first hand.
Magical abilities and skills
Possessions
Etymology
"Amit" is a name of either Indian or Hebrew descent.
In Hindi it means "infinite" or "boundless" and in Hebrew means "friend", "colleague" or "member of the organisation". "
Thakkar" is a Hindu Indian surname popular in the state of Gujarat .
Notes and references

title: Astronomy Table
paragraphs: Astronomy Tables were magical stone altars located throughout the Highlands on and around the Hogwarts grounds .
They were erected millennia ago by the great devoted stargazer's of the past.
The Astronomy Tables were used for the study of the cosmos .
They were ideal for studying constellations near and far, and they could be used to find hidden constellations.
Some say the locations of the tables were originally marked by centaurs for ritual star gazing.
For centuries, wizardkind made use of them, but they have since become mere monuments to the intrepid intellectual pursuits of a bygone epoch.
In the 1890's , they were sought out by Amit Thakkar , who later revealed them to a new student .
Locations

There were fifteen of them, hidden in nine locations in the Scottish Highlands : at the base of the tall spiral tower located in the middle of the North Ford Bog region, in the Forbidden Forest , in the Hogsmeade Valley , in the South Hogwarts Region (two tables), the Hogwarts Valley near Keenbridge (two tables), at Feldcroft (two tables), on the corner of the cliff above Marunweem Lake , on a hill overlooking the ruins in Clagmar Coast , and by the cliff's edge south of Cragcroftshire .
Constellations
These constellations could be seen from the Astronomy Tables:
Notes and references

title: Highlands
paragraphs: The Highlands is a historic region of Scotland , to the north-west of the Highland Boundary Fault , which crosses mainland Scotland in a near-straight line.
The area is generally sparsely populated, with many mountain ranges, and includes the highest mountain in the British Isles , Ben Nevis.
Known locations

The highlands covered at least several square miles, with known regions including North Ford Bog , the Forbidden Forest , Hogsmeade Valley , North Hogwarts Region , South Hogwarts Region , Hogwarts Valley , Feldcroft , South Sea Bog , Poidsear Coast , Marunweem Lake , Manor Cape , Cragcroftshire , and Clagmar Coast .
Hogwarts Castle , located "not far" from Dufftown , stood in the Scottish Highlands, as was located the only all- wizarding village of Hogsmeade .
Minerva McGonagall , Headmistress of Hogwarts School , was raised in the Scottish Highlands, in Caithness .
The Highlands are also the site of many lakes and other bodies of water , such as Loch Lomond , Loch Ness , and the Great Lake .
Herbologist Hadrian Whittle wrote a book on the magical flora of the lochs in the Highlands, titled Magical Water Plants of the Highland Lochs .
The Vale of McGowan is also the site of a spring.
Notes and references

title: Solar system
paragraphs: A model of the inner solar system in the Astronomy Tower
The solar system consists of the sun and the celestial bodies bound in orbit around it by the force of gravity.

This includes the eight planets Mercury , Venus , Earth , Mars , Jupiter , Saturn , Uranus , and Neptune , the dwarf planet Pluto , their moons, and various other objects, such as asteroids and comets.

In 1995 , Professor Sybill Trelawney showed her fourth-year Divination class a magical model of the solar system, complete with a "fiery sun" surrounded by the nine planets and their moons, all suspended under a glass dome.
Notes and references

title: Telescope
paragraphs: A telescope was a device used for seeing faraway objects.
A lunascope was a type of telescope invented by Perpetua Fancourt which showed phases of the moon , countering the difficulty of using moon charts .
History
They were essential in Astronomy , and thus all Hogwarts students up to their fifth year (and their sixth and seventh should they have chosen Astronomy as an elective) were required to own one.
Hogwarts itself possessed a unique telescope which could be used to obtain much more precise data than regular telescopes.
A Celestia Contemplor was a top-range telescope that was released in 1890 ; Ravenclaw student Amit Thakkar owned one.
Wiseacre's Wizarding Equipment sold brass telescopes for five Galleons .
Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes sold a joke version of this product: the boxing telescope .
Professor Quirinus Quirrell kept a telescope in his office in the 1991-1992 school year at Hogwarts.
Notes and references

title: Atlas of Celestial Anomalies
paragraphs: Atlas of Celestial Anomalies was a book written by M. P. N. Carneirus , which was published by 1927 .
The cover design included the words Omega Centauri , spiral galaxy , Omega Nebula , and spiral arm .
History
Gellert Grindelwald , the infamous Dark wizard , owned a copy of Atlas of Celestial Anomalies .
He kept it stored at Nurmengard Castle in 1927 .
During the 1988-1989 school year , Irma Pince recommended this book to a student who was looking for books on love .
Notes and references

title: M. P. N. Carneirus
paragraphs: M. P. N. Carneirus was the name of an individual who authored the book Atlas of Celestial Anomalies .
In the 1890s , he maintained an epistolary correspondence with Satyavati Shah , the professor of Astronomy at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
Notes and references

title: Gateway to the Far Stars
paragraphs: Gateway to the Far Stars was an Astronomy book owned by Amit Thakkar during the 1890-1891 school year .
Notes and references

title: A Brief History of Time
paragraphs: A Brief History of Time: From the Big Bang to Black Holes is a book written by Muggle physicist Stephen Hawking .
It was first published in 1988 .
Overview
It concerns a range of subjects in cosmology including the Big Bang and black holes , as well as the works of Galileo and Newton and modern astrophysics.
The book was given positive reviews by such publications as The New York Times and the Chicago Tribune .
The introduction was written by Carl Sagan .
History
In August 1993 , a patron at the Leaky Cauldron read this book.
Notes and references

title: Stephen Hawking
paragraphs: Stephen William Hawking ( 8 January 1942 - 14 March 2018 ) was an English Muggle theoretical physicist internationally considered the best since Albert Einstein .
Biography

When Harry Potter arrived at the Leaky Cauldron after fleeing the Dursley house after letting his Aunt fly away in 1993 , there was a wizard sitting at a table reading A Brief History of Time , a best-selling popular science book written by Hawking.
At the time of this book's publication, Hawking had been living with Lou Gehrig's disease for over twenty years, requiring him to use a wheelchair .
Etymology
The name "Stephen" comes from the Greek name Στεφανος (Stephanos) meaning "crown".
Notes and references

title: Astrolabe
paragraphs: An astrolabe is an ancient navigation tool that was essentially a handheld version of the universe and mainly used for studying the stars, but also had, according to Grace Pinch-Smedley , "a thousand" other uses.
History
The Pinch-Smedley family had an astrolabe .
Grace Pinch-Smedley 's grandfather and grandmother sailed into the Great Lake with the astrolabe to stargaze but never returned.

Her father was so distraught that he forbade the family from entering the lake, and so when Grace wanted to retrieve the astrolabe from the lake to bring her father some peace, she asked the new fifth-year student during the 1890-1891 school year to do it for her.
A portrait hung in the Headmaster's office depicted a Headmaster with an astrolabe.
Notes and references

title: Globe of the Moon
paragraphs: A Globe of the Moon was a spherical scale model of the moon , the Earth's natural satellite.
It was used in Astronomy , to study lunar movements and activity.
One could purchase a globe of the moon in Diagon Alley , at Wiseacre's Wizarding Equipment , for a cost of thirteen Galleons .
Notes and references

title: Lunascope
paragraphs: A lunascope was an astronomical instrument invented by Perpetua Fancourt , which showed the phases of the moon .
It was created to counter the difficulty of using moon charts .
History
In December 1926 , Newt Scamander offered up one of his lunascopes to negotiate for information from the goblin gangster Gnarlak , regarding his missing beasts that were freely roaming New York .
However, Gnarlak was uninterested, as he retorted that he himself owned five of them.
During the 1980s , there was a lunascope in the Artefact Room at Hogwarts .

Before the start of his third year at Hogwarts, Harry Potter spent some time at the Leaky Cauldron exploring the shops in Diagon Alley and eating under brightly-coloured umbrellas outside cafés, where diners were showing each other their purchases.
One diner boasted that he had bought a lunascope, which, it was claimed, removed the need to mess around with moon charts .
Albus Dumbledore kept one in his office .
Harry Potter chucked it into the fireplace in 1996 , lashing out in anger over the death of his godfather, Sirius Black .

title: Moon chart
paragraphs: A moon chart was a written astronomical instrument.
It was used to represent the position, movement and phases of the moon , not unlike a star chart .
Astronomers usually used these for research or study.
It was quite difficult to interpret one, so one who had difficulty with these charts should have used a lunascope instead.
They were sold for 5 Galleons at Wiseacre's Wizarding Equipment in Diagon Alley .
Notes and references

title: Sextant
paragraphs: A sextant was an instrument used to measure the angular distance between two visible objects; it was primarily used in the study of astronomy .
History
During the 1989-1990 school year and 1990-1991 school year , sextants were often used in Astronomy classes at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .

title: Suchrita
paragraphs: Suchrita was a Squib who lived in the late 19th century .
Biography
She was born into a wizarding family, being the first Squib in generations.
Her sister was Satyavati Shah .
Astronomy was one of the few subjects she and her sister were able to study, while attending Muggle school.
She attended Cambridge University , but was forced to act and dress like a gentleman.
She made some advancements in the field of meteor showers and had corrected several of her peers.

title: Hogwarts Legacy
paragraphs: Hogwarts Legacy is an open-world action role-playing game set in the late 19th century within the wizarding world .

Developed by Avalanche Software and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment under the Portkey Games label, the game was released on 10 February 2023 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. It was originally scheduled to be released on 4 April 2023 on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, but the release date was changed to 5 May 2023 .
It was released on the Nintendo Switch on 14 November 2023 .
It was released on the Nintendo Switch 2 on 5 June 2025 , as a launch title for the console.

Despite the boycott the game received due to a recent controversy , 22 million copies of Hogwarts Legacy had been sold by the end of 2023 and had hit 34 million by March 2025 and 40 million in late December , making it the second best-selling video game in the 2020s and 19th in all video game history.
It also is one of the top three most-played single-player games on PS5, the other two being Assassin's Creed Valhalla and God of War Ragnarök .
Plot
Players create a character capable of seeing and harnessing ancient magic who begins attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry as a fifth-year student in the 1890s .
During the gameplay reveal trailer in March 2022, a newspaper can be seen dated 1 September 1890.
Players experience the life of the student as they "live the unwritten" and embark on a dangerous journey to uncover a hidden truth of the wizarding world.

Besides the protagonist, there are companion students such as Natsai Onai , a brave and justice-seeking Gryffindor, Poppy Sweeting , a kind and beast-loving Hufflepuff, and Sebastian Sallow , a charismatic and optimistic Slytherin.
Villains include Ranrok (a goblin staging a rebellion against wizardkind ) and Victor Rookwood (a Dark wizard operating in and around Hogsmeade ).
Development
The game was originally leaked on Reddit in October 2018 alongside a now-deleted unofficial trailer that showed extensive character creation, spell-casting, magical creatures, and exploration.
No official comment was given by either Warner Bros. nor J. K. Rowling , although many reputable sources inside WB Avalanche, including high ranking employees, teased or claimed to know of the game.
The game was announced via a video game showcase stream by Sony on 16 September 2020 .
It was set to be available to players in 2021 , but the date was later delayed twice, first to 2022 , then to 10 February 2023 to continue developing the game for a better experience for players.
On 17 March 2022, PlayStation revealed a State of Play presentation that featured 20 minutes of gameplay and behind the scenes content.
Community manager Chandler Wood revealed that the game will not have any microtransactions.
On 18 May 2022, Avalanche released an ASMR video showing some additional footage of the Hogwarts grounds, Hogsmeade, and an unidentified area which included a store called the Magic Neep.
While it did not include any additional story information, it did confirm several locations including Zonkos, Dervish and Banges, and Steeply and Sons tea shop.
On 24 May 2022, PlayStation revealed that PS5 will have exclusives relating to the Dual Sense controllers.
The game had started development with actors portraying characters in the games.
Actors were cast and were scheduled to start when the COVID-19 pandemic occurred.
As a result, actors were forced to stay at home.
The cast were forced to use the company Beyond Capture in Vancouver and employ Canadian actors.
They used actors who were able to perform multiple actors; Direction and communication via Zoom.

On 12 August 2022, the official release date was revealed to be 10 February 2023 for PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S and Xbox Series X. The Switch version would be ported later on.
A new exclusive trailer was unveiled at Gamescon on 23 August 2022 , with a pre-order date on 25 August .
A Digital Deluxe version was revealed in the same trailer, with a collector's edition revealed on 24 August.
On 13 December 2022, Avalanche delayed the game for Xbox One and PlayStation 4 until 4 April 2023.
On 6 March , the game on Xbox One and Playstation 4 was delayed from 4 April to 5 May .
Gameplay
Gameplay includes detailed character creation, spell-casting, exploration, stealth, and elements of both the action and role-playing genres.
As it is common for non-free console and PC games, no system of microtransactions is used, unlike the similar mobile game Harry Potter: Hogwarts Mystery .
The player is able to develop their own duelling style by combining different spells.

They are also able to make specific allies; it is possible to become a Dark wizard or witch instead of following a hero path, though the ending will still be the same as the protagonist is lauded as a hero for saving Hogwarts.
The game is set in the Scottish Highlands , including Hogwarts and a vast territory around it.
Broom flight can be used to reach farther locations, which includes wizard villages such as Hogsmeade.
The developers have also confirmed a fast-travel system known as " Floo Flames ".
The scenery and other environments are highly detailed and intricate, weather events affect the environment, and the four climatic seasons are reflected in the landscape.
A Wizard's Field Guide is provided to the player which keeps track of their level.
It also includes their map, quests, owl post , settings, challenges, collections, talents (which unlocks through the main story), inventory and gear.

title: Vine
paragraphs: Vine (genus Vitis ) in the narrowest sense is grapevine ( Vitis ), but more generally it can refer to any plant with a growth habit of trailing or scandent, that is to say climbing, stems or runners.
The word also can refer to such stems or runners themselves, for instance when used in wicker work.
It corresponded to one of the thirteen months of the Celtic calendar, from 2 September to 29 September , known as Muin.
History

The druids considered anything with a woody stem as a tree; this, combined with the fact that vine was thought to have produced wands of a special nature, means that whilst vines were not actually trees, they continued to be used in the production of wands to this day.
Wandlore

Vine wands were among the less common types, and their owners were nearly always those witches or wizards who sought a greater purpose, who had a vision beyond the ordinary and who frequently astounded those who thought they knew them best.

Vine wands seemed strongly attracted by personalities with hidden depths, and Garrick Ollivander himself had found them more sensitive than any other when it came to instantly detecting a prospective match.
Reliable sources claimed that these wands could emit magical effects upon the mere entrance into their room of a suitable owner, and this had been noted to have occurred twice within Ollivanders .
Cosme Acajor also sold wands made of vine.
Known vine wand owners
Etymology
Vine is derived from Latin vīnea "grapevine", "vineyard", from vīnum "wine".

title: Thirteen
paragraphs: Thirteen was a number that was considered by members of both the magical and non-magical communities to be unlucky and to be the cause of suffering and misfortune.

title: Celts
paragraphs: The Celts were a group of culturally and linguistically-affiliated peoples who lived in Europe .
They primarily lived in Great Britain , Ireland , and north-west France .
In Celtic times, there was a class of priests and scholars known as druids .
Evidently, Druids were skilled in wandmaking .
They produced wands made of vine , as they considered anything with a woody stem to be a tree.
Some might've considered this tradition unorthodox, but it was one still followed by wandmakers like Garrick Ollivander in the 20th century .
The famous Celtic hero Tristan tried to slay the giant Morholt and ended up getting stabbed with his poison sword.
Thestrals had a special affinity for wizards and witches descended from the horse -loving Celtic peoples.
Various apparel items commonly found in the Highlands during the 1890s , including scarves, capes and outfits, were designed with Celtic motifs.
Celtic attire was noted to have a mystical aura , as if its designs were imbued with magic .
The Celtic calendar had thirteen months, and each month corresponded to a different type of tree:

paragraphs: 29 September is the 272nd day of the year (273rd in leap years).
There are 93 days remaining.

title: Druid
paragraphs: Cliodna , a druidess
A druid was, in Celtic times, a member of the learned and priestly class (bards, magistrates, scholars, scientists, teachers, sacrificers, Seers , priests, etc.).

Druids were, apparently, skilled in wandmaking and, considering anything with a woody stem a tree, produced wands made of vine , a tradition that was still followed by Garrick Ollivander in the 20th century .
According to Xenophilius Lovegood , druids were actually ancient aliens , and that sharing stories was an ancient art passed down by them.

title: Cosme Acajor
paragraphs: Cosme Acajor (fl.
1929 ) was a French witch and wandmaker , and the proprietress of Baguettes Magiques de Cosme Acajor in Place Cachée , Paris .
She attended Beauxbatons Academy of Magic in her youth, but left before graduating, and opened a wand shop.
She was known for her belief that the wizard chose the wand, as opposed to the other way around.
Biography
Acajor obtained her wand from another wandmaker, and the wand chose her.
During her youth, she attended Beauxbatons Academy of Magic , but performed poorly as she had not properly bonded with her wand.
Over the years, she made adjustments to her wand to the envy of fellow students.
Before leaving, she would host fashion shows at Beauxbatons using Abraxans .
After being told this was a violation, she left the school.
After leaving school, set up her wand shop to sell her services to others.
Unlike Garrick Ollivander , another wandmaker on Britain , who believed that the wand chose the wizard, Acajor strongly believed that the wizard influenced the wand.
She would ask customers to pick a wand that they believed they wanted, and thought that their particular decision showed more about the wand's bond than anything else.
Notes and references

title: Revealer
paragraphs: A Revealer was a magical device used to render invisible writing visible.
It had the appearance of an ordinary Muggle eraser, although it had a bright red colour.
History
During the 1988-1989 school year , Jae Kim offered a Revealer to Jacob's sibling after they met serving detention in the Hogwarts kitchens .
Hermione Granger bought a Revealer in Diagon Alley sometime in or prior to the summer of 1992 .
On 1 February 1993 , upon her first inspection of Tom Riddle 's old school diary , she used her Revealer, along with the Revealing Charm to detect any hidden writings.
Notes and references

title: Invisibility
paragraphs: A wizard turning himself invisible
Invisibility was the power of being invisible, the state in which a physical object remained magically unseen by others.
Examples of invisibility
Wizardkind
Harry Potter turning himself invisible with his Cloak of Invisibility
A highly useful skill, invisibility could be harnessed by wizardkind , most notably by using an Invisibility Cloak , the Invisibility Potion or the Invisibility Spell .
A Disillusionment Charm or Bedazzling Hex could also be cast to achieve virtual invisibility.
The protective enchantment Cave inimicum would produce an invisible boundary over the caster, concealing them from view.
The Invisible Book of Invisibility
Wizards had also developed the Invisibility Charm , a spell used to render a target area invisible.
They also developed the Invisibility Booster , a device which could turn an enchanted car, its passengers, and everything else inside invisible.
Invisible Ink was a type of magical ink that transfigured writing to become invisible.
Disappearing Ink would presumably write invisible text onto paper.
Headless Hats were prank devices invented by Fred and George Weasley to make the wearer's head become invisible, in order to startle people.
There was also a section of books in the Hogwarts Library called the Invisibility Section .
The books within this section discussed invisibility and were, appropriately, invisible.

Some books, such as The Invisible Book of Invisibility , were invisible, raising the question how they were even read, as Flourish and Blotts could never so much as find two-hundred copies of these books.
Creatures
The Demiguise , a peaceful creature that could turn itself invisible at will
Several magical creatures possessed various degrees of invisibility.

Most notable include the Demiguise , an orangutan-like ape, who could turn invisible at will, and the Thestral , who appeared invisible to anybody that hasn't witnessed and accepted the reality of death .
Poltergeists such as Peeves may have chosen to be invisible or not, an ability they may share with other non-beings.
The Tebo and Hidebehind were also magical beasts who all had the ability to become invisible.
The Wrackspurt was an invisible creature which could float into a person's ears, and make their brain go fuzzy, but could be seen with Spectrespecs .
Conditional invisibility

Certain creatures and items could become invisible to certain people while remaining fully visible to others at the same time; while compared to true invisibility, this ability seemed more akin to manipulation of the targets' minds.
The most well-known example of this debatable form of invisibility were Thestrals , a type of skeletal winged horse known for being "invisible" to those who had not witnessed and comprehended death .
Another example was bimetal alchemical thread , a patented wizard-made magical fibre, invisible to practitioners of the Dark Arts .
Dementors were invisible to Muggles and Squibs , but visible to wizardkind .

title: Revealing Charm
paragraphs: The Revealing Charm ( Aparecium ) was a charm that revealed secret messages written in Invisible Ink , or any other hidden markings written using other means such as Concealing charms .
History
On 1 February 1993 , Hermione Granger used this spell on Tom Riddle's Diary to see if anything could be read.
Nothing appeared after she used the spell because that was not the enchantment placed on the book.
This spell was also listed in the Book of Spells (chapter 2) by Miranda Goshawk .

The Revealing Charm may have been the implied spell Snape used when he tapped the Marauder's Map with his wand and ordered the parchment to "r eveal your secrets " before being insulted by the Marauders.
During the 2008-2009 school year , a student used this spell to reveal the chains that were trapping Gossamer in his portrait.
Known practitioners
Etymology
The Latin word appareo which means "to become visible or to appear".

title: Freezing Spell
paragraphs: The Freezing Spell ( Glacius ), also known as the Glacius Charm , was a charm that froze a target with icy-cold air created from the tip of the wand .
This, in turn, could freeze water , extinguish fires and freeze opponents.
There existed a spellbook for this charm.
History
During the 1890-1891 school year at Hogwarts , Madam Kogawa taught this charm to the new fifth-year student .
The door to the Vault of Ice , one of the Cursed Vaults at Hogwarts Castle , was enchanted with this spell.
In the 1985-1986 school year , when Rowan Khanna nearly entered it, they were attacked by the spell and knocked unconscious, and had to recover in the Hospital Wing afterwards.
Also during the same year, Jacob's sibling , Ben Copper , Penny Haywood , and Merula Snyde used this spell to repair the damage done to the Winter Wonderland party .

During the 1986-1987 school year , Todd Cribb attempted to use this spell on Jacob's sibling, Rubeus Hagrid , Barnaby Lee , Ben Copper, Penny Haywood, and Nymphadora Tonks so they couldn't prevent him from harvesting the blood of two Fire Dwelling Salamanders they had befriended.

However, Cribb's wand had previously been broken after he had accidentally stepped on it while searching for it in the Forest at the Magical Creatures Reserve after having been disarmed by Jacob's sibling and had only been crudely repaired with Spellotape .
Because of this, his attempt to cast this spell backfired, causing Cribb to be encased in thick ice instead.
During the 1989-1990 school year , Jacob's sibling and Barnaby Lee decided to use this spell to safely freeze a set of Ashwinder eggs that they had found in the Slytherin common room .

After brushing up on their casting of this spell with Professor Filius Flitwick , which involved Jacob's sibling casting the spell on Barnaby for practice, Jacob's sibling was able to cast the spell on the Ashwinder eggs, safely freezing them before they could start a fire.
During the 1993-1994 school year at Hogwarts, Professor Remus Lupin taught this spell to his third-year Defence Against the Dark Arts class.
Later on that year, Professor Filius Flitwick also taught this charm to students and included it in the third year exams for charms class .
When Harry tried to turn vinegar to wine incorrectly in a sixth-year Charms class in 1997 , he turned it into ice instead, possibly casting this spell by accident.
Effect
This charm had the unfortunate side-effect of making the breath of anyone nearby turn into thick white mist due to the extreme frigidity caused by the spell 's casting.
An object could be enchanted with this spell to attack a person when touched.
An example was one of the Cursed Vaults at Hogwarts Castle.
Known practitioners
Etymology
The incantation is Latin for "ice".
Notes and references

title: Reparospellbook
paragraphs: The Reparo spellbook was a book that gave instruction and information on the Mending Charm .
History

For unknown reasons, it was kept in the dungeons of Hogwarts Castle , but Hermione Granger recovered it during the 1993-1994 school year and used it to repair several broken objects in the bowels of the castle.
She took the spellbook with her.

title: Aqua Eructospellbook
paragraphs: The Aqua Eructo spellbook was a spellbook containing information on, and instructions of how to perform the charm Aqua Eructo .
History
It was owned by Bartemius Crouch Junior (disguised as Alastor Moody ), who kept it in a room of the Defence Against the Dark Arts Classroom in Hogwarts Castle for unknown reasons.

Harry Potter , Ronald Weasley and Hermione Granger later came across it during the 1994-1995 school year and used it to learn the spell , which proved valuable against the Salamander which Professor "Moody" (Crouch) had kept in the room.
Notes and references

title: Aqua Eructo
paragraphs: Aqua Eructo was the incantation of a charm that could be used to create a spout of water from the tip of the wand .
The intensity of the water flow could be anything from a thin fountain to an immense and powerful jet.
Effects
Hermione Granger casting this spell

This water could be used for a variety of purposes, such as extinguishing fires (including dragon fire), extinguishing the flames within Fumos Bat Flamers , cooling off fiery beasts like Fire Dwelling Salamanders and Blast-Ended Skrewts , although it was most often used to extinguish flames, as above noted.
This spell worked particularly well with the similarly water -based Ebublio Jinx when both used in tandem when dealing with certain fiery beasts .
History
The trio using Aqua Eructo to extinguish fire

While impersonating Alastor Moody throughout the 1994-1995 school year , Bartemius Crouch Jnr provided extra lessons for his fourth-years on this charm , among other spells in his Defence Against the Dark Arts classes.
Information on this spell could be found in a certain spellbook , a copy of which was used by Barty Crouch Jnr in his DADA lessons to help teach his students the spell.
Known practitioners
Etymology
" Aqua " is Latin for " water ", and " eructo " is Latin for " erupt "; therefore, the incantation , roughly translated, means " water erupts ".
This is suitable given the effect of the spell, which is for large, powerful jets of water to erupt from the wand .
Notes and references

title: Herbivicus spellbook
paragraphs: The Herbivicus spellbook was a book containing information on, and instructions of how to perform the Herbivicus Charm .
History
It was owned by Professor Pomona Sprout , who kept it in a garden of the Hogwarts greenhouses at Hogwarts Castle .

Harry Potter , Ronald Weasley and Hermione Granger later came across it during the 1994-1995 school year and used it to learn the spell, which proved valuable against the ungrown plants which could be found all over the Hogwarts grounds.

title: Hogwarts greenhouses
paragraphs: The Hogwarts greenhouses or Herbology greenhouses were where Herbology classes were taught at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
During the 1996-1997 school year , the greenhouses were also used by the Potions Club .
Description
They were located on the north side of the castle, after the vegetable patch .
The greenhouses had statues of long, serpentine dragon statues running along the peaked roofs.
They were home to many exotic and magical plants including some that were extremely rare, difficult to cultivate and maintain, or dangerous, such as Mandrakes , Venomous Tentacula or Snargaluffs .
History
During the 1890-1891 school year there was one large multi-tiered greenhouse with multiple rooms in place of the many separate greenhouses that would be seen later.
In the centre of the greenhouse was a large tree which had a system of roots that stretched as deep as the dungeons.
There were many plants available for students to pick and study, such as Venomous Tentacula and Dirigible Plums , as well as several non-magical plants like cacti and bamboo .
At one point, the greenhouses might have been gardens.
The greenhouses were surrounded by battlements .
Although these battlements were very large in the 19th century , they had been reduced by the 20th century .

The inside of Greenhouse Three
Used by second to seventh-year Herbology classes, this greenhouse contained Mandrakes along with various other species of plants.
It was later used by Horace Slughorn in the 1996-1997 school year to surreptitiously collect Venomous Tentacula leaves for usage in Potion-making .

title: Magick Moste Evile
paragraphs: Magick Moste Evile was a Dark Arts reference book, written in the early Middle Ages by Godelot .
This book had the characteristic of letting out a ghostly wail when slammed shut.
History
A copy of Magick Moste Evile
A copy of the book was kept in the Restricted Section of the library of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
Hermione Granger checked it out in early 1997 in an attempt to gain information on Horcruxes , only to be thoroughly annoyed by its lack of information.
That particular copy let out "a ghostly wail" when Hermione slammed it shut in irritation.

During the Calamity in the late 2010s or early 2020s , a Calamity Investigator working for the Statute of Secrecy Task Force realised that the Calamity was stealing copies of this book at an alarming rate.
In an attempt to understand why, the investigator read the book from cover to cover.
The experience chilled their blood, but did give them a better understanding of the Dark Arts .
In 2020 , Hermione Granger had a copy of this along with many other dangerous or banned books on her bookshelves in her office as British Minister for Magic .
Contents

Godelot wrote down this collection of dangerous spells with the help of his wand (according to Godelot in his notebook) which he claims is made of Elder ( Deathly Hallows believers consider this to be the Elder Wand ).
This body of work greatly advanced the study of Dark Magic.

Horcruxes , however, receive only a brief mention in the book, which does not detail what they really are, their nature considered so vile that even a book on the Dark Arts was unwilling to speak of them.
Notes and references

title: Godelot
paragraphs: Godelot was a medieval Dark wizard who once owned the Elder Wand .
Biography

Described as an " unpleasant character ", Godelot considered the Elder Wand to be an instructor, and used his knowledge of the wand's powers to write Magick Moste Evile , a book that contained information on Dark Magic .
Despite his affinity towards Dark Magic, he refused to discuss Horcruxes , deeming them and the ritual involved too dark even for him.
Godelot perished in his own cellar, after he was locked in by his son, Hereward , who did this to gain ownership of the Elder Wand .
Notes and references

title: Minister for Magic's office
paragraphs: The Minister for Magic's office was the section of the British Ministry of Magic where the Minister for Magic conducted business.
It was located on Level 1, Minister for Magic and Support Staff .
History
Cornelius Fudge
On 12 August 1995 , Lucius Malfoy had a meeting with Minister Cornelius Fudge in his office.
He waited for Fudge just outside the Department of Mysteries , as Fudge was, at the time, in the nearby Courtroom Ten presiding over the disciplinary hearing of Harry Potter .
Harry Potter privately wondered why Malfoy did not simply wait outside the Minister's office for him.
Though Arthur Weasley told Harry he figured Malfoy was trying to sneak into the trial, it is most likely he believed Malfoy was scouting the Department of Mysteries for Voldemort .
In January of 1996 , Fudge gave an interview to the Daily Prophet in his office regarding the recent mass breakout from Azkaban .
In this interview, he discussed his belief that the breakout was masterminded by Sirius Black .
Said interview was later published as part of the article MASS BREAKOUT FROM AZKABAN .
Hermione Granger
In 2020 , Hermione Granger had bewitched her collective library in the Minister for Magic office to suck an individual into it when picking up a book.
The individual had to defuse the riddle to allow the library to open the book which hid an illegal Time-Turner .
Notes and references

title: Elder
paragraphs: Elder (genus Sambucus ), also known as elderberry , is a genus of between 5 and 30 species of shrubs or small trees in the moschatel family, Adoxaceae .
It corresponded to one of the thirteen months of the Celtic calendar, from 25 November to 23 December , known as Ruis.
Wandlore
The rarest wand wood of all, and reputed to be deeply unlucky, elder wands were considerably trickier to master than any other.
They contained powerful magic , but scorned to remain with any owner who was not the superior of their company; it took a remarkable wizard to keep an elder wand for any length of time.

The old superstition, " wand of elder, never prosper", had its basis in this fear of the wand, but in fact, the superstition was baseless, and those foolish wandmakers who refused to work with elder did so more because they doubted they would be able to sell their products than from fear of working with this wood.

The truth was that only a highly unusual person would find their perfect match in elder, and on the rare occasion when such a pairing occurred, it might be taken as certain that the witch or wizard in question was marked out for a special destiny.
It was also noted that the owners of elder wands almost always felt a powerful affinity with those chosen by rowan .
The most famous wand made of this wood, and perhaps the most infamous wand ever created, was the Elder Wand , one of the three Deathly Hallows that was reputed to be the most powerful wand ever made.
The Elder Wand's long and bloody history was a large part of this wood's dark reputation.
Known elder wand owners
Other uses
Elderberries were edible fruits.
In the 19th century , a delirious Apollonia Black consumed poisonous belladonna berries for elderberries and died from them, although her house-elf Scrope did warn her prior.
Notes and references

paragraphs: This book was large and bound in black and silver.

title: Sonnets of a Sorcerer
paragraphs: Sonnets of a Sorcerer was a wizarding poetry book.
History
A copy of Sonnets of a Sorcerer
By 1932 , Eulalie Hicks owned a copy of it.
Sometime between 1 September 1986 and 31 August 1989 , Talbott Winger was reading a copy of the book in the Hogwarts Library and thought it was quite good.

Sometime before 1993 , Arthur Weasley , while working for the Misuse of Muggle Artefacts Office , confiscated a cursed copy that would force anyone who read it to speak in limericks for the rest of their lives.
In 1993 , Ron Weasley mentioned this to Harry Potter when discussing the ways that a book could be dangerous.
Another copy was found on Hermione Granger 's bookshelves at the British Ministry of Magic in 2020 .

title: Eulalie Hicks
paragraphs: Professor Eulalie "Lally" Hicks was an American witch and a Charms professor at Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the early 20th century and fought in the Global Wizarding War in the 1930s .
Biography
Early life
Eulalie Hicks was born into the Hicks family sometime between the 1890s and 1900 , and grew up in the neighbourhood of Harlem , Manhattan , New York .

Despite the fact that she grew up living in the No-Maj world , she displayed signs of magic from an early age and was taught about the traditional magic that existed in their family by her grandmother .
Ilvermorny years
In her youth, she attended Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry where she was sorted into Thunderbird house.
She gained a wand made of rosewood with an African mermaid hair core .
During her school life, she became best friends with Porpentina Goldstein , and knew her younger sister Queenie as well, growing up together.
When they graduated from Ilvermorny, Lally and Tina stayed close friends.
At some point during her schooling, Eulalie came across the written work of Professor Albus Dumbledore in the school library , and proceeded to write the author to share her thoughts on it.
Dumbledore, who recognised Eulalie as wise beyond her years, wrote back, a decision that heralded many years of correspondence between the two, during which he became something of a mentor to her.
Teaching career
Sometime after her graduation, Eulalie at some point was hired as the Ilvermorny Charms professor .
Evidently a respected member of the teaching staff, she was also named the school's Keeper of the Keys by the headteacher of the day.
Eulalie at some point released a book on charms titled Advanced Charm Casting .
Lally became acquainted with Newton Scamander at some point, and became a fan of his book Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them .
She first met him in 1932 and told him that she had made his book mandatory reading for her all fifth-years at Ilvermorny.
He too appreciated her work.
Alliance with Dumbledore and movement against Grindelwald
Nicholas Flamel talks to Eulalie Hicks
On September 1927 , Eulalie became aware that Nicolas Flamel was reaching out via phoenix-embossed books to her and he told her that Gellert Grindelwald was holding a dangerous rally in Paris .
Eulalie, unable to do anything herself at the time, urged him to do what he could and assured him that they all believed in him.
Eulalie Hicks "dresses" Jacob with a spell
In 1932 , Hicks agreed to take a more active part in the anti-Grindelwald movement by joining an army to assist Dumbledore in thwarting Grindelwald's rise to dominance over the wizarding world .

Shortly before this team was due to meet up at The Great Wizarding Express headed for Berlin , she was sent to recruit the Jacob Kowalski , who had grown disillusioned with wizardkind after losing Queenie Goldstein .

To accomplish this, Hicks travelled to his bakery in New York and, with the help of her cousin Stanley and his friends, staged an altercation where she pretended to be harassed by them so Jacob would come to her rescue in order to remind him of his bravery, worth and value to their cause.
During the incident, when the men "threatened" Jacob Kowalski when he confronted them, she paralysed Frank Doyle from behind, which revealed the whole scene as a ruse.
She then entered Jacob's bakery, and after some reluctance from him, she managed to convince him to come with her.

Having transported Jacob and herself away with the help of a Portkey made from one of her own books, Hicks brought her new companion to a place where the pair of them could join the rest of the group on the train via the Floo Network .
Once there, she met Newt Scamander for the first time.
She also met Theseus Scamander , Yusuf Kama and Bunty Broadacre .
Eulalie and Jacob disappearing from the Candidates' Dinner
Together, they travelled to Berlin to visit the German Ministry of Magic .

There, they witnessed the acquittal of Grindelwald by Anton Vogel , much to their shock, and attended the Candidates' Dinner , where they stopped an assassination attempt on Vicência Santos , with Hicks also having to save Jacob after he confronted Grindelwald at the dinner and made himself look like the assassin.
Dumbledore's first army gathering in the Great Hall

After the group members completed their missions, they all met at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , where Lally spoke to some students in the Great Hall about the importance of studying Charms.
She was informed of the Eyrie in Bhutan by Dumbledore and travelled there via a portkey in the Room of Requirement , to attend the walk of the Qilin .

She was handed a duplicated copy of Newt's suitcase before travelling to deceive Grindelwald's followers there, as the real suitcase contained a living Qilin that was paramount to stopping Grindelwald.
Lally and Theseus in a duel in Bhutan
When in Bhutan for the ceremony, Lally and Theseus Scamander fought Grindelwald's followers in the streets when they sought to take their suitcases, defeating many, but they were soon outnumbered.
However, upon Helmut opening the fake suitcases, him and Grindelwald's men were attacked by various enchanted objects within, allowing Lally and Theseus to escape.
Lally witnessed Grindelwald's defeat in the election, his electoral fraud being exposed and his subsequent escape.
Eulalie attending Queenie's and Jacob's wedding in New York
Sometime later, Professor Hicks attended Jacob's and Queenie's wedding in Kowalski's Quality Baked Goods.
This was a small wedding, as marriage between magical and non-magical people was still illegal in the United States.
She attended with her fellow comrades and her friend, Tina Goldstein, who she asked to tell her about the new luminaries at MACUSA .
Personality and traits
Eulalie holding a friendly conversation with Jacob Kowalski
Eulalie was shown to be an intelligent, learned, and witty witch.
She was also kind and supportive, given how she encouraged Jacob Kowalski to believe in himself.
She also had a strong sense of morality and bravery, given how she opposed Gellert Grindelwald and his followers and worked diligently and firmly to assist Albus Dumbledore in stopping him.
She was also sensible, given how she recommended Jacob show restraint during their mission, and also resourceful, effortlessly using magic to save herself in dangerous situations.
She was also shown to advocate education, being a professor, given how she encouraged Hogwarts students to study Charms.

title: Magical Theory
paragraphs: The magical theoretician Adalbert Waffling studying magic
Magical Theory was the wizarding study of the nature of magic , and of the fundamental laws and mechanisms by which magic operated.
Overview
A copy of Magical Theory by Adalbert Waffling , a required textbook at Hogwarts
Magical Theory was a field of study and research into the underlying principles that governed the practice of magic , as well as the consequences of meddling with them.

Those who specialised in the field were known as " Magical Theoreticians ", who wrote treatises sought to create, develop and study of the theoretical frameworks used to form testable explanations for how it worked.

This also included the study of energy transfer during spellcasting , which was important to understand how spells worked, which in turn formed the foundation of creating new ones through tinkering and further study.

Beyond the mechanics of spellcasting, however, it also formed the foundation for most other branches of magic, like Charms , Herbology , Transfiguration , and Potions , by providing them the framework through which they could be properly understood and safely expanded.

Magical Theory was part of the curriculum of at least some of the most well-established and prestigious wizarding schools in the world, including Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and Durmstrang Institute .
Hogwarts offered a class on the subject.
History
Magical Theory was an established part of wizarding academia since before the late 19th century .
Eleazar Fig studied it and had become the professor of the Magical Theory class at Hogwarts by the 1890s .
Despite being generally knowledgeable, he was unfamiliar with ancient magic .

In the 20th century , Adalbert Waffling rose to prominence with his own thoughts on the subject, whose writings, such as the book Magical Theory , were known to have covered everything that a witch or wizard " will ever need to know about what makes spells work " and illuminated the fact that while certain spells were a matter of the caster's will, others were a question of intent.
One of Waffling's most celebrated findings was formulating the Fundamental Laws of Magic , and it was a popular claim that every modern wizard and witch had learned from his writings.
Saul Croaker , an Unspeakable from the British Ministry of Magic 's Department of Mysteries , drew a conclusion regarding the limits of time travel.

At an unknown point in time, the Magical Theoretician Millford Quisling authored a treatise on spellcasting which, while widely regarded as discredited in his own time, was nevertheless found to be accurate after all in the early 21st century .

This was also a time when the subject of energy transfer during spellcasting continued to occupy scholarly witches and wizards, such as Gareth Greengrass , who conducted a study in which he documented more than seven hundred cases of spells having been cast in anger that appeared to be more powerful than the casters themselves expected.
A Calamity Investigator working for the Statute of Secrecy Task Force attempted to research magical theory regarding the elements: earth , wind , fire , and water .

Although this research resulted in little information of real consequence, doing so did enable them to feel more confident when facing a Confoundable composed of one of the four elements, reducing the chance that Confoundables would elude them.

title: Adalbert Waffling
paragraphs: Adalbert Waffling (d. 1981 ) was a wizard who was a magical theoretician, credited to have written "all about magic".
Waffling is somewhat seen as the "father of magical theory", as it is a popular claim that every modern witch or wizard has learned from his writings.

Waffling was the one who formulated the Fundamental Laws of Magic and wrote Magical Theory , a most popular textbook still being used today by the young witches and wizards at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
Biography
Early life
Adalbert Waffling was born in or before the 19th-century.

By the 1890s , he was already a notable theoretician whose ideas on energy transfer in spellcasting illuminated the fact that while certain spells were a matter of the caster's will, others were a question of intent.
Later life
Waffling studying magic
By the 1890s , Waffling was already one of most notable wizards of the date, so it is more than likely he published some of his writings before this point.
Around this time Albus Dumbledore , the " most brilliant student ever seen [at Hogwarts] ", was in regular correspondence with Waffling in order to exchange ideas about magic.
Minerva McGonagall later shared these letters with members of the Statute of Secrecy Task Force who pursued a Professorship profession to help improve their skills in addressing the Calamity .
Waffling died in 1981 .
Legacy
Adalbert on a Chocolate Frog Card
Waffling was commemorated on a Chocolate Frog Card .

During the Calamity in the late 2010s or early 2020s , a Calamity Investigator working for the Statute of Secrecy Task Force attended a retrospective on the life of Adalbert Waffling, paying attention to his ideas on energy transfer in spellcasting .
Waffling claimed that certain spells seemed to be a matter of the caster's will while others focused on the caster's intent.
The investigator used Waffling's ideas to increase the duration of their Inn Charm .
Etymology
Adal is Old High German for " noble " or " aristocratic "; berta , " bright ". "
Waffling" means speaking or writing at length in a vague or trivial manner without a clear point or aim.
Notes and references

title: Gryffindor Notice Board
paragraphs: The Gryffindor Notice Board was in the Gryffindor common room .
It was where Gryffindor students posted notices and advertisements.
Description
Things pinned on the notice board included asking about lost items, serving as a lost-and-found, or students could use it to see if people wanted to trade Chocolate Frog Cards .
At the beginning of the season, the house 's Quidditch captain might post a notice for when try-outs were being held, and then on upcoming games and practises.

Also students could posts items they wished to sell or trade, teachers could post club information, events or other general information relating to Flying lessons , Hogsmeade visits , Careers Advice , and Apparition lessons .
Occasionally, although rarely, the Head of House might post warnings.
In the 1995-1996 school year , High Inquisitor Dolores Umbridge posted many Educational Decrees on the board .
Every day the latest copy of the Daily Prophet and The Quibbler would be pinned to the board if any student wished to read them.
