title: Lee Family Toast
paragraphs: The Lee Family Toast was a once in a generation gathering of the Lee family , where the entire extended Lee family got together to celebrate.
The tradition went back generations.
Role of the Toast Giver
The youngest Lee family member of a suitable age was designated the 'Toast Giver', and had to give a speech in front of the whole family.
The speech comprised of several verses which honoured each family member, which altogether told the story of the Lee family.
In addition, the Toast Giver had to compose new verses for each new family member.
To aid them in their duties, they could invite a guest along.
Every verse that previous Toast Givers had composed was recorded in a Book of Toast Giver verses that the Toast Giver would memorise and perfectly recite.
Toast Giver curse
The Toast Giver and their guest had to recite the speech perfectly, as failure to recite the speech properly would trigger a curse and cause the Lee family to have three generations of bad luck.
Cecil Lee's great-grandfather once missed a single syllable when reciting the speech and the curse was triggered.
However, Barnaby's grandmother revealed that there was no such curse placed on the Lee Family Toast, remarking that it sounded like the kind of thing that Barnaby's father would make up to scare him.
Despite this, she also commented that some curses didn't need to be cast to take effect.
Role of the Toast Giver's guest
If the Toast Giver failed to remember one of the verses, the Toast Giver's guest could complete it for them, provided they had memorised the verse themselves.
Additionally, at the end of the Toast the Toast Giver's guest had to recite a verse about the Toast Giver themselves.
History
Barnaby Lee's father's Toast
In the generation before Barnaby Lee , his father gave the Toast.
According to his own mother , he performed the Toast flawlessly, however his sister Leah thought it wasn't very good.
1986-1987 school year
During this year, Barnaby Lee was appointed the Toast Giver, but was nervous about the role.
As the Toast Giver was allowed to bring a guest to help with Toast-Giving duties, they invited Jacob's sibling along to help them.
Barnaby and Jacob's sibling managed to convince Leah Lee to come as she wasn't originally planning on attending.
Jacob's sibling helped Barnaby with memorising the verses and composing new ones on the way down.
They ended up meeting Barnaby Lee's grandmother in the Leaky Cauldron instead of the Lee family house since Vulcan had accidentally set fire to the parlour.

Before the Toast, Barnaby Lee's grandmother sent Jacob's sibling and Barnaby to collect various things they needed for the Toast such as crystal glassware and Butterbeer 1900 , as well as to get new formal outfits.

After collecting the things needed, Jacob's sibling and Barnaby helped break up some arguments amongst the family members, but as the landlady of the Leaky Cauldron wouldn't let Barnaby's grandmother rent out the entire pub for the day, she stormed off.
Jacob's sibling went after her and managed to convince her to continue holding the Toast, but with a crowd watching.
Barnaby managed to recite the verses perfectly, and his grandmother was highly impressed.
Notes and references

title: Barnaby Lee's grandmother
paragraphs: The grandmother of Barnaby Lee (whom he called his "grandmum") was a British Dark witch living in London .
Biography
Barnaby's grandmother had three children, Leah , Cecil , and another son .
She also owned a collection of Dark artefacts.
Since she never bought him toys as a child, Barnaby used to play with her artefacts when he visited her house instead, although his grandmother didn't want him to touch them.
Barnaby's grandmother owned a Crup , although her grandson suspected she only did to scare Muggles .
She also owned an Occamy eggshell , which she forbade Barnaby from holding.
She also regularly told her grandson not to step in mysterious messes, particularly puddles, and never let her grandson learn much about Muggles.
Barnaby's grandmother also had her grandson catch Bundimuns in the shed of her house and taught him how to safely extract Bundimun Secretion to use in Doxycide .

On one night before Barnaby started attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , Cecil took her, along with Barnaby and his parents , on a camping trip, where he made a roaring campfire and served them some of his famous cocoa, complete with his pet Fire Dwelling Salamander Vulcan performing a cocoa-warming trick.
Barnaby later recalled that everyone loved seeing the trick, even his parents, claiming that the moment was one of the only happy memories he had of them.
Barnaby's grandmother later took Barnaby in following his parents' arrest and Azkaban sentencing in the aftermath of Voldemort 's demise on 31 October 1981 .
According to Barnaby, she was devastated at the news of their capture and the downfall of the Death Eaters since she agreed with the their goals and ideologies .
While she remained as cold to him as she had been previously, she still ensured that he always had food and a place to call home.
During the 1986-1987 school year , she chose Barnaby to be the Toast Giver for the Lee Family Toast , a role which had previously belonged to her son .
Although she had wanted to host the Toast in the Lee family house , Vulcan had burnt the salon down, so she decided to try to host it in the Leaky Cauldron instead.
She instructed Cecil to give Barnaby and Jacob's sibling tickets for the Hogwarts Express , but chastised the pair for tardiness when they arrived.
Whilst she continued to try to privately rent out the Leaky Cauldron, she sent Jacob's sibling and Barnaby to get crystal glassware, Butterbeer 1900 , and formal attire .
When the pair didn't arrive back in time, she sent her children, Cecil and Leah, to find them.
After they returned, she was still not able to privately rent the Leaky Cauldron, so she stormed off in a huff, declaring the Toast cancelled.
Jacob's sibling managed to find her and, after asking her why the tradition meant so much to her, managed to convince her to continue it with some slight alterations.

She was highly impressed with Barnaby's recital and congratulated him and Jacob's sibling afterwards, letting them keep their formal clothing as gifts, though she then stated she hoped to never see Jacob's sibling again.

After Barnaby graduated from Hogwarts, he and his pet Knarl , Knarl , continued living in his grandmother's house in London , as he was unable to afford his own flat due to not yet having started his new job as a Houndmaster for the Department for the Regulation and Control of Magical Creatures .
However, Barnaby was displeased to be living with his grandmother, being unnerved by her propensity to lurk in dark corners and displeased by her tendency to negatively comment on his life choices.
He also frequently became lost while trying to find one of the ten bathrooms in her massive house and his grandmother forbade him from displaying his statue of a Mooncalf in her living room.

While explaining this situation to Jacob's sibling at the Three Broomsticks , Jacob's sibling reassured Barnaby that his work would enable him to have to spend less time at his grandmother's house before he and Knarl could finally move out.
Barnaby's grandmother claimed that Barnaby would never acquire his Apparition licence , believing that he wasn't serious enough to obtain one.

When Barnaby was preparing for the Apparition exam after taking a twelve-week remedial course with Jacob's sibling and Nymphadora Tonks under the instruction of Wilkie Twycross , he expressed a fear that he would prove his grandmother right by failing the exam.
However, after being reassured by Jacob's sibling and Tonks, Barnaby was successfully able to pass the exam and acquire his licence, defying his grandmother's prediction.
Barnaby's grandmother later became sick with a cold, leading to her becoming even more grumpy than usual, according to Barnaby, who was forced to clean her giant house all by himself.
Barnaby also later brought one of the Department for the Regulation and Control of Magical Creatures's albino bloodhounds to his grandmother's house, with the dog ruining her carpet.
Despite Barnaby claiming that his grandmother seemed to be getting over her cold, she eventually died in 1992 .
Cecil informed Barnaby of her death while he was talking with Jacob's sibling in the Ministry All-Purpose Room , deeply saddening him.

Jacob's sibling organised a get-together of their friends in the Hog's Head Inn to help comfort Barnaby regarding his feelings of loss at her death, with the group consoling him until Barnaby had to leave to help Cecil at his grandmother's house.

The suddenness of her death also inspired Jacob's sibling to tell Jacob to come clean regarding his feelings for Olivia Green , as they now realised there was always a possibility he might not get the chance to do so.

Following her death, a portrait of Barnaby's grandmother was hung in the living room of her house, with the portrait continuing to complain about the changes being made to her house as a result of Penny Haywood , Liz Tuttle , Alanza Alves , Andre Egwu , and Tulip Karasu moving in.
Physical description
Barnaby's grandmother was described by her grandson as looking "a bit like a Dementor ", as she was also somewhat frail and skeletal.
Personality
Leah Lee described her mother as 'the most judgemental witch in Great Britain ', and Barnaby described her as 'stubborn as Knarl '.
She was also highly elitist, referring to people she viewed as below her as 'common people'.
She was very proud of her family and its traditions, and lamented the declining state of the Lee family in the 20th century .
She was also quite cruel, picking favourites between her children and wasn't afraid to voice negative opinions of those family members she didn't like.
Magical abilities and skills
Notes and references

title: Barnaby Lee's father's Kneazle
paragraphs: This pet Kneazle was owned by Barnaby Lee 's father , a Death Eater .
Biography
At some point before or on 31 October 1981 , this Kneazle was drowned by Lord Voldemort , Mr Lee's master.
Notes and references

title: Brain
paragraphs: The brain is an organ present in all but the simplest of creatures which exerts control over all other organs in the body.

Arthur Weasley considered it reasonable not to trust anything if one could not see where it kept its brain, advice he passed on to his children and repeated to Ginevra Weasley after learned the amount of trust she had devoted to Tom Riddle's diary .
Damage to the brain
Partial damage
There exists a number of means to damage the brain; damage by a direct object passing into it is almost always fatal.
The brain could also suffer damage from non-physical sources that affect its stability.
Traumatic experiences, such as the ones endured by Sirius Black and Dobby , could negatively affect the brain, but not irreparably.
Other things that could damage one's thinking were exposure to the Mirror of Erised (such as Harry Potter ) and the Emerald Potion created by Lord Voldemort (such as Kreacher and Albus Dumbledore ).
There was a spell that transformed a person's brain into a frog .
It most likely had a corresponding counter-spell .
Absolute damage
The brain could be damaged permanently by prolonged exposure to the Unforgivable Curses .
When under the Imperius Curse , Bartemius Crouch Senior became delirious for the rest of his life, and when he himself placed his son under the curse , he experienced similar symptoms.
When under the Cruciatus Curse for a long time, Alice and Frank Longbottom became permanently insane and spent the rest of their lives in St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries .
When struck by the Killing Curse , the victim's brain would shut down instantly.
Study of the brain
A tank of brains, found in the Brain Room
In a certain room of the Department of Mysteries , there existed a large tank containing a number of brains or brain-like objects, which contained a green potion to preserve the brains in.
These brains exuded thoughts as thin tendrils along their "bodies", and appeared to have a certain amount of sentience on their own.
They were used by Unspeakables to study human thought.

During the Battle of the Department of Mysteries , Ronald Weasley , under influence of a Death Eater 's spell that made him disoriented (possibly the Confundus Charm ), used a Summoning Charm on one of these brains.
The brain immediately attacked when it touched Ron, wrapping its tentacle-like thoughts around his body and attempting to suffocate him.
Though he was eventually able to get free and was treated to by Poppy Pomfrey , he suffered a great deal of damage and had scars from the event that would presumably last the rest of his life.
Notes and references

title: Cecil Lee
paragraphs: Cecil Lee was a wizard in the employment of the Ministry of Magic , where he worked in the Werewolf Capture Unit , part of the Beast Division of the Department for the Regulation and Control of Magical Creatures , in the 1980s .
He was the uncle of Barnaby Lee .
Biography
Early life and schooling
Cecil Lee was born into the wizarding Lee family , and had at least one brother .
He had a single nephew, Barnaby Lee .

During his formative years, he attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , where he did not seem to be a particularly gifted student: he remembered little of Charms class apart from where his seat was.
According to himself, however, he "[did] well" in his N.E.W.T.s .

Cecil didn't share the pure-blood supremacist views of his brother and his brother's wife , supporting his nephew despite his parents asserting that he didn't have it in him to be a Death Eater like they were.
Cecil also acquired and trained a Fire Dwelling Salamander he named Vulcan .

Over several years of building trust between them, Cecil trained Vulcan to reheat drinks, particularly hot cocoa, on command upon seeing Cecil standing up and asking his guests if they were "up for a nice cosy cocoa."
As part of the trick, Vulcan would approach the drink and curl up around it, re-heating the contents with his body heat.
Career in the Werewolf Capture Unit
Sometime after school, he joined the Ministry of Magic 's Werewolf Capture Unit .

During his career, he hunted werewolves with extreme prejudice, and reportedly fought and captured several werewolves: he claimed to have had several run-ins with Fenrir Greyback , who gained notoriety as the most savage werewolf of them all - though, by his own admission, he never managed to catch him.

According to his nephew Barnaby , work was Cecil Lee's "greatest passion" (closely followed by topiary and the sculpting of his prized rose bushes); for that reason, he reportedly spent a period of more than two years without taking a single day off.

When the Department of Magical Maintenance was angling for a pay raise and had the Ministry's enchanted windows display nothing but hurricanes for two months, the Werewolf Capture Unit sent Cecil to talk to them.
Lee was an admirer of Gilderoy Lockhart , who he was convinced was the most gifted wizard in the world.

He believed Lockhart's (later proven false) account of his victory over the Wagga Wagga Werewolf using the complex Homorphus Charm ; Lee would himself supposedly use this charm to "stop werewolves in their tracks" during the course of his duties.

Lee also at one point attended a special symposium with the celebrity author, in which he learned and took it as fact that clear skies are the perfect weather for hunting werewolves because bright sunlight makes them weaker (which is patently false).

Throughout his career, Lee frequently mistook packs of dogs for werewolves and attempted to arrest them, resulting in them attacking him and sending him to St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries for recovery.

On one night before Barnaby started attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , Cecil took Barnaby, his parents, and his grandmother on a camping trip where he made a roaring campfire and served them some of his famous cocoa, complete with Vulcan performing his cocoa-warming trick.
Barnaby later recalled that everyone loved seeing the trick, even his parents, claiming that the moment was one of the only happy memories he had of them.
Greyback's attack on Hogwarts

After a pack of werewolves led by Fenrir Greyback attacked Hogwarts on Hallowe'en during the 1980s , then Headmaster Albus Dumbledore sent an owl to the Ministry of Magic soliciting their assistance, who in response, sent Cecil to investigate.
With the help of Jacob's sibling , he went to look for clues about the attack.
They started by interviewing Chiara Lobosca and staff members Rolanda Hooch , Argus Filch , and Filius Flitwick .

The following full moon, when Greyback arrived for a second attack, Cecil Lee and Jacob's sibling successfully captured Greyback using an Incarcerous Spell , only for him to escape again not long after.
Nevertheless, Lee thanked the student for their help, and presented them with honorary membership of the Werewolf Capture Unit , complete with their own uniform.
Lee Family Toast
Cecil, Leah , Barnaby, and Jacob's sibling using the Book of Toast Giver verses as a Portkey

When Barnaby was selected as the host of that generation's Lee Family Toast , Cecil was supposed to bring the tickets for the Hogwarts Express to take them to London , however he got distracted by rumours of a werewolf sighting in the Forbidden Forest and went off in search of it.
It actually turned out to be a yeti , and he had to be rescued by Jacob's sibling and Barnaby before giving them the tickets.
Later, his mother sent him and his older sister to search for Jacob's sibling and Barnaby, who hadn't returned from getting the supplies.
The pair found them in Hogsmeade , unable to get home, so Cecil enchanted the Book of Toast Giver verses into a Portkey so all four of them could get home.
He then argued about the Portkey with his sister, and both of them had to be calmed down by Jacob's sibling.
He and Leah later participated in the Lee Family Toast, which he considered better than his younger brother's .
Career's day at Hogwarts

Cecil was rushed in to replace a Gringotts Wizarding Bank Curse-Breaker in giving a lecture on curse-breaking , as the other Curse-Breaker had fallen afoul of a nasty curse and been left hospitalised.
He had been provided with a cursed sock and Curse-Breaking instructions , however, he made the mistake of putting the sock on, causing him to be hoisted up into the air by the Dangling Jinx .
Jacob's sibling and Merula helped Cecil by casting the counter-spell Liberacorpus , which returned him to normal.
Trip to New Orleans

At some point after Greyback's attack on Hogwarts, Cecil was sent to New Orleans by the Ministry of Magic to study rougarous , preventing Barnaby from inviting him to Jacob's sibling 's planned family appreciation feast.
Visit to St Mungo's
After mistaking another pack of dogs for werewolves and attempting to arrest them, Cecil suffered a series of bites and was sent to St Mungo's to recover.
While there, he sent Vulcan and an Enchanted heated rock to Barnaby at Hogwarts so that he could look after the salamander until he could return home.
Physical description
Cecil Lee had chocolate brown hair and emerald green eyes.
He was tall and lean, and had a thick brown moustache.
Animals, such as Mrs Norris , reacted in an hostile manner to him, which he attributed to his "very masculine scent".
Personality and traits

A rather bumptious, opinionated man, Cecil Lee was an immensely inflexible and intolerant individual who apparently subscribed strongly to the common view on werewolves in the magical community, as he frequently voiced the opinion that all werewolves should be eradicated because "there's nothing [good] left of a person once they're bitten."

Even when faced with a werewolf-offspring in the form of a pup from the Forbidden Forest wolf pack , he refused to believe that it had werewolf blood in its veins, insisting that if it did, it would have gone for their throats.

It would appear that his stance softened somewhat, however, when he saw a werewolf come to the defence of a student that was about to be attacked by Fenrir Greyback , after which he brought the unconscious body of Chiara Lobosca to the office of Albus Dumbledore rather than taking her back to the Ministry.

While unafraid to admit that he feared Fenrir Greyback for his savage villainy, he was nevertheless a man who was decisive in both thought and deed, and ultimately unflappable when it mattered and confronted him and his pack, and even placed himself in front of Jacob's sibling to protect them from the attackers.

Cecil Lee was not very intelligent, which appears to be a family trait: he once proudly remarked that his nephew Barnaby Lee (himself noted not to be the brightest student), was the sharpest person in the family "by a wide margin".

He had a somewhat bumbling disposition (as demonstrated, for example, by the time he was investigating Greyback 's attack on Hogwarts and he decided to interview Madam Hooch for the sole reason her surname rhymed with "pooch" which reminded him of werewolves) and was not very good with words, mixing up terms like "matriculate" and "meticulous", " euphonium " and "euphemism", or "symphony" and "symposium".
When speaking about the usefulness of books, he remarked "they make excellent projectiles, and decent pillows."
He was among the many to buy many of Gilderoy Lockhart 's tall tales, believing in many of his dubious work that he in fact stole credit from more accomplished wizards.
Another trait he shared with his nephew Barnaby was a large appetite, having apparently raided the Hogwarts kitchens when he was supposed to be hunting werewolves.
Magical abilities and skills
Cecil Lee did not appear to be a very capable wizard , even though by his own account he did very well in his N.E.W.T.s and described himself as "highly trained".
Possessions
Notes and references

title: Barnaby Lee's mother
paragraphs: Barnaby Lee's mother was a Dark witch who was one of Lord Voldemort 's Death Eaters during the First Wizarding War .
She was sentenced to Azkaban following the war for her crimes as a Death Eater, along with her husband .
Biography
She attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in her youth, where she was sorted into Slytherin .

On one night before Barnaby started attending Hogwarts, Cecil Lee took Barnaby, his mother, his father and his grandmother on a camping trip where he made a roaring campfire and served them some of his famous cocoa, complete with his pet Fire Dwelling Salamander Vulcan performing the cocoa-warming trick.
Barnaby later recalled that everyone loved seeing the trick, even his parents, claiming that the moment was one of the only happy memories he had of them.
Notes and references

title: Vulcan
paragraphs: Vulcan was a Fire Dwelling Salamander belonging to Cecil Lee .
Biography
Cecil Lee acquired Vulcan during his nephew, Barnaby Lee 's, childhood, with the boy finding the creature fascinating.
Cecil trained Vulcan over several years of building trust to reheat drinks, particularly hot cocoa , upon hearing Cecil ask his party guests if they were "up for a nice cosy cocoa."
As part of the trick, Vulcan would approach the drink and curl around it, re-heating the contents with his body heat.

On one night before Barnaby started attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , Cecil took Barnaby, his parents , and his grandmother on a camping trip where he made a roaring campfire and served them some of his famous cocoa, complete with Vulcan performing the cocoa-warming trick.
Barnaby later recalled that everyone loved seeing the trick, even his parents, claiming that the moment was one of the only happy memories he had of them.

During the 1986-1987 school year , Cecil was attacked by a pack of dogs after mistakenly trying to arrest them, believing them to be werewolves , and was hospitalised in St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries while he recovered.
While in St Mungo's, Cecil sent Vulcan to Barnaby at Hogwarts so he could look after him.

Desiring to do his uncle proud by looking after Vulcan properly, Barnaby met with Rubeus Hagrid at Hagrid's Hut in order to try to learn as much as he could about Fire Dwelling Salamanders, asking Jacob's sibling to meet with them as well.

After informing Jacob's sibling of the situation and introducing them to Vulcan, Barnaby and Jacob's sibling discussed salamanders with Hagrid, learning that they would die if kept away from heat and fire for too long.
Barnaby explained that he had also borrowed a magically-heated rock enchanted to stay hot at all times for Vulcan to use to keep warm no matter where Barnaby went.

Barnaby revealed that he had called Jacob's sibling to the meeting to ask them about his idea to help make Vulcan's time at Hogwarts extra special by holding a campfire party to celebrate Fire Dwelling Salamanders, suggesting that Jacob's sibling could bring the Fire Dwelling Salamander they had bonded with in order to keep Vulcan company.

After Jacob's sibling agreed to the plan, Hagrid asserted that it would be good for the salamanders to interact with other members of their kind and stated that he would make sure the fire was safe and contained.

Hagrid revealed that he had already selected a spot by the Great Lake for the campfire that evening while Barnaby and Jacob's sibling agreed to meet in the Courtyard to discuss ideas for the campfire.
Jacob's sibling collected their salamander and brought it to the Courtyard to meet with Barnaby and Vulcan, where the two salamanders quickly bonded while resting on the heated rock.
Barnaby claimed that he had had several ideas for the campfire, including setting off fireworks, but had been warned by Hagrid that some of those ideas would be too elaborate and unpredictable.
After discussing simpler ideas for the campfire, Barnaby revealed his idea to have Vulcan use his cocoa-heating trick to heat hot cocoa at the party.

Upon learning how much this idea meant to Barnaby, Jacob's sibling agreed that they should perform the trick at the party, although Barnaby wasn't sure if he could repeat the trick, claiming that, although Cecil had showed it to him once, he had never gotten Vulcan to do it himself.

After some encouragement from Jacob's sibling, Barnaby agreed to meet them in the Great Hall to see if they could get Vulcan to do the trick, asking that they bring their salamander as well for moral support.
When Jacob's sibling and their salamander arrived in the Great Hall, Barnaby explained how the coca-warming trick worked.

Barnaby claimed that, although the trick sounded simple, Fire Dwelling Salamanders weren't known for performing tricks and that it had taken years to train Vulcan to perform the trick in the first place.

After further encouragement regarding his affinity with magical creatures by Jacob's sibling, Barnaby attempted to demonstrate the trick by having Vulcan reheat a teapot, although Vulcan failed to replicate it.

Jacob's sibling theorised that Barnaby might not be speaking the correct command words, although Barnaby explained that Cecil never used to command Vulcan directly, instead simply standing up and asking everyone if they were "up for a nice cosy cocoa."

At that moment, Vulcan immediately ran over to the teapot and curled around it, rapidly heating it up and warming its contents, with Barnaby elated that he had found the right words to get Vulcan to do the trick.

Now confident that he could get Vulcan to perform the cocoa-heating trick at the campfire, Barnaby and Jacob's sibling excitedly wondered if they could get Jacob's sibling's salamander to learn the trick as well.
Barnaby explained that Cecil was only able to train Vulcan to perform the trick after building extensive trust between him and Vulcan.

Barnaby stated that he would continue practising the trick with Vulcan while Jacob's sibling met with Hagrid in the Forest of the Magical Creatures Reserve to gather firewood, bringing their salamander along as well.
When Jacob's sibling and Hagrid returned from collecting firewood, Barnaby met with them at Hagrid's Hut and revealed to them that Vulcan had suddenly started showing signs of sickness.
Hagrid calmed everyone down, stating that they didn't even know what was wrong with Vulcan yet.
The trio observed Vulcan closely in an attempt to determine his symptoms, discovering that some of Vulcan's scales were turning dull and flakey, with some even falling off.

Hagrid identified that Vulcan was suffering from scale rot , for which the dull, flaking scales were a telltale sign, to which the frantic Barnaby questioned if there was a way to treat the disease and save Vulcan.

Jacob's sibling suggested that they could rub Vulcan's scales with Chilli powder , to which Hagrid agreed, claiming that a little Chilli powder and rest would return Vulcan to normal, much to Barnaby's relief.

Jacob's sibling questioned whether they should cancel the campfire, with Hagrid reassuring them that Vulcan would most likely be better by then, although it would be best to avoid stressing him out too much to be safe.
Barnaby sadly stated that he couldn't possibly expect Vulcan to perform the cocoa-warming trick while he was recovering, asserting that Jacob's sibling's salamander would have to perform it instead.
Jacob's sibling agreed, but asserted that they would have to train their salamander properly first, to which Barnaby agreed to meet them in the Great Hall.
After a lengthy training session, the pair were successfully able to train Jacob's sibling's salamander to perform the cocoa-heating trick.

Having prepared everything they needed for the campfire, Barnaby asserted that the bond between Jacob's sibling and their salamander was just as strong as that between Cecil and Vulcan, with Jacob's sibling agreeing that that would greatly help them when performing the cocoa-warming trick.

The pair waited until nightfall, where they met up with Hagrid, Ben Copper , Penny Haywood , and Nymphadora Tonks , along with Vulcan and Jacob's sibling's salamander, on the shore of the Great Lake for the campfire party.
Barnaby explained that Vulcan had fully recovered and was ready to spend his evening by the campfire.
However, before Jacob's sibling could start the campfire, Todd Cribb appeared, claiming that he wanted revenge against Jacob's sibling in addition to the blood of both salamanders.

Todd asserted that Jacob's sibling had caught them off guard when he had encountered them previously in the reserve's forest and that he had gotten lost in the forest after locating his disarmed wand, claiming that he was tired, hungry, and eager for revenge.
When Todd produced his wand, Jacob's sibling noticed it was damaged, leading Todd to explain that he had accidentally stepped on it while searching for it in the forest.
Jacob's sibling tried to dissuade Todd from using a broken wand, but Todd asserted that his wand was as good as new after repairing it with Spellotape and attempted to use the Freezing Spell on them.
However, the spell quickly backfired and encased Todd's body in a block of ice.
After deciding wether to leave Todd frozen, make him leave, or allow him to join their bonfire, Jacob's sibling lit the campfire with the Fire-Making Spell , officially beginning the campfire party.
Jacob's sibling used the command words to tell their salamander to heat up the cocoa Barnaby had previously prepared, to which their salamander responded by performing the trick perfectly.

The group enjoyed the campfire, with Barnaby asserting that Vulcan hadn't had this much fun since the family camping trip when he was a child and that Jacob's sibling's salamander was doing a great job of keeping the cocoa hot.
Barnaby thanked Jacob's sibling for helping him relieve a childhood memory and share it with his new friends as the group continued to drink hot cocoa by the campfire into the night.

Also during the 1986-1987 school year , Vulcan accidentally burnt the salon in the Lee family house down, forcing Barnaby Lee's grandmother to have to try and rent out the Leaky Cauldron instead to host the Lee Family Toast .
Vulcan went along to the Toast and may have gotten a verse written about him in the Book of Toast Giver verses .
Notes and references

title: Dark Lord
paragraphs: Lord Voldemort, who addressed himself as "Dark Lord"
Dark Lord was a title to address Voldemort during both of his failed attempts to conquer wizarding Britain.
Tom Riddle was a Dark wizard who adopted the name Lord Voldemort before the First Wizarding War .
The title of Dark Lord was used mainly by Death Eaters , something which Severus Snape was called out for by Harry Potter .
Calling Voldemort "the Dark Lord" was seen as a mark of utmost respect among the Death Eaters, while calling him by his real name was akin to blasphemy to rabid followers like Bellatrix Lestrange .
Notes and references

title: Ginevra Weasley's Valentine to Harry Potter
paragraphs: This message was spoken by Ginevra Weasley to a dwarf during a Valentine's Day celebration in order to let him give the message to Harry Potter .
Harry however was not fond of this and tried to run away from the dwarf, until he tripped and fell in a hallway and the dwarf began to sing, which led all students in the hall laugh.
Draco Malfoy seemed to know the poem was from Ginny, and made a scathing remark aloud against her, which led Ginny to embarrassedly run away.
Notes and references

title: Curse on Marvolo Gaunt's Ring
paragraphs: A powerful curse ( incantation unknown ) was placed upon Marvolo Gaunt's Ring by Lord Voldemort , around the time that he turned it into a Horcrux , as a defence against anyone who might try to destroy it.
The curse was designed to quickly kill anyone who dared to wear the ring.
Effects
This curse would rapidly cause the death of anyone who came into contact with it, although in certain cases the spread of the curse could be slowed down by magical means .
In the case of Dumbledore, this curse caused serious injury to his hand, causing it to look as if it had died, and would prove fatal in roughly one year.
It was also the type of curse that would strengthen over time.

Regardless of the methods of delaying the spread, there was no known way of removing or completely stopping this curse, though Snape claimed that he may have been able to do more to stop the curse had Dumbledore come to him more quickly.
It is unknown if Dumbledore would have escaped the curse if he had simply removed his hand from his body.
Although removing the curse from an infected individual was seemingly impossible, it could be removed from the host object if said artefact was damaged to a certain degree.
When Dumbledore used the basilisk venom -infused Sword of Gryffindor to attack the cursed ring, it destroyed the Horcrux and disabled the curse on it.
Harry Potter was able to hold the Stone without any sign of the curse affecting him thereafter.
History
Marvolo Gaunt's Ring, which carried the curse
Placing the Curse
After he had acquired his maternal grandfather's prized heirloom ring from his deranged uncle , Tom Riddle wore it openly during his time at Hogwarts after killing his father and grandparents.
Once he learned about the effects and possibility of creating multiple Horcruxes, Riddle no longer desired to wear the ring, and instead turned it into a Horcrux with his father 's murder.
He then placed the curse on the ring as one of the many precautions before he hid it in its place of origin.

The lack of hesitancy of placing the curse onto the Resurrection Stone was a sign of Voldemort's lack of knowledge or care for its powers and status as one of the three Deathly Hallows ; even if he had known, the Stone's powers were useless to him as he had no loved ones to bring back.
Activation
Dumbledore touching the ring

In the summer of 1996 , when Dumbledore found the ring under the rotting floorboards of the Gaunt Shack , he saw it immediately as the Hallow that he had desired for so many years, the Resurrection Stone .

Wanting to use it to revive his family and apologise for his selfishness in the past, Dumbledore lost his common sense, forgot that it was a Horcrux which may have been cursed, and adorned it on his right hand.
Almost immediately, the curse triggered, and nearly killed Dumbledore.
However, Dumbledore managed to use his own prodigious skill to contain the curse from spreading any further, which prevented him from dying immediately.

He returned to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry quickly and went to see Snape , whose masterful knowledge in the Dark Arts helped him to halt the curse's spread temporarily through a thick golden potion and several incantations.
Dumbledore's hand moments after being inflicted with the curse

Unfortunately, Snape claimed that though the curse was contained in his right hand, it would eventually break free of the restraints and spread once again, eventually killing him; he was also angry that Dumbledore fell to the temptation of mounting the ring on his finger, as a wizard of his calibre would have surely detected the curse placed upon it.
Snape also claimed that had Dumbledore managed to return sooner, he might have done more to save him.
Upon learning that he had no more than a year to live, and in an attempt at preventing a humiliating and agonising death, he requested Snape to kill him when the time came.

When Dumbledore used the Sword of Gryffindor to crack the ring, the curse seemingly disappeared, as he was able to wear the ring to pick up Harry Potter from the Dursleys with no further ill effects (however, the existing curse on Dumbledore never dissipated).
Also, when Harry received the Resurrection Stone that was taken out of the ring, the curse did not spread on contact.
Notes and references

title: Thick golden potion
paragraphs: A Thick Golden Potion was used by Professor Severus Snape in the summer of 1996 to treat the effects that the curse on the Ring Horcrux had on Albus Dumbledore , while chanting incantations and pointing his wand at the injured right hand.

The potion and the spells together managed to hold the injury within his hand temporarily, but Snape was unable to prevent the curse from spreading, which would have been fatal for Dumbledore in around a year if he had not asked Snape to kill him at the Battle of the Astronomy Tower .
Notes and references

title: Basilisk venom
paragraphs: Basilisk venom was an extremely poisonous and corrosive substance generated by the said species .
Overview
Basilisk venom was extremely powerful, and could kill a person within a little more than a minute at best, making the person drowsy and blurry-visioned before they died .
This powerful venom was one of the few substances known to be capable of destroying Horcruxes , causing them fatal damage that could not be repaired.
It only had one known antidote : phoenix tears , which happened to be very rare, increasing the venom's deadliness.
The venom's potency was apparently extremely long-lasting, as Hermione Granger was able to use the venom from the fang of a Basilisk that was dead for nearly five years.
Basilisk venom was one of the few poisons that was not curable by bezoars .
The Gigantic serpent that guarded a hill in the enchanted garden where the Wizarding Schools Potions Championship took place had the venomous fangs of a Basilisk .
It was possibly a part-Basilisk hybrid.
History
In 1993 , Harry Potter impaled the Basilisk through the roof of her mouth with the Sword of Gryffindor and ended up with a fang splintered into his arm.
Tom Riddle described the venom as being able to kill Harry in a little more than a minute, though Fawkes 's tears healed Harry's arm and cleansed the poison.
After being healed, Harry took the fang and stabbed Riddle's diary three times, destroying that Horcrux beyond magical repair.
Because Harry had impaled the Basilisk with the sword, it was imbued with Basilisk venom and was therefore able to destroy Horcruxes and poison opponents that it cut through as well.
Albus Dumbledore used the Sword of Gryffindor, which had been imbued with the Basilisk's venom three years earlier, to destroy Marvolo Gaunt 's Ring in 1996 .
Later in 1998 , Ron Weasley use the sword to destroy Salazar Slytherin 's Locket .
In 1998 , during the Battle of Hogwarts , Ron and Hermione went down to the Chamber of Secrets and destroyed Helga Hufflepuff's Cup with a Basilisk fang.
In the same battle, Neville Longbottom used the Sword of Gryffindor to kill Nagini , Lord Voldemort 's pet snake and last Horcrux.
Notes and references

title: Fidelius Charm
paragraphs: The Fidelius Charm ( incantation unknown ) was a very powerful spell used to hide things or places, or to conceal secrets.
It was an extremely difficult, multifaceted, and potent charm that could be used to conceal a secret inside an individual's soul .
The witch or wizard who housed the secret was known as the Secret Keeper .
A dwelling whose location had been protected by this spell was then invisible , intangible, unplottable , and soundproof.
This was an extremely old spell, one of the most ancient of all.
History
First Wizarding War
Voldemort arrives after the Potter cottage 's Fidelius Charm is broken
The Fidelius Charm was used to protect James , Lily , and Harry Potter from Lord Voldemort at their home in Godric's Hollow , the location of which was the secret entrusted.
They designated their Secret-Keeper as Sirius Black , but then switched to Peter Pettigrew at the last minute before the spell was cast as they thought it would be less obvious.

Lily and James had refused Albus Dumbledore 's offer to be secret keeper due to them preferring their friends, which proved a deadly mistake - Pettigrew betrayed them to Lord Voldemort , who found and murdered the Potters, with only Harry Potter surviving the attack.
Harry's survival would henceforth dub him the "Boy Who Lived".
Second Wizarding War
The trio stayed at Shell Cottage , as it was protected by the Fidelius Charm
The Fidelius Charm was once more employed to cloak the base of the Order of the Phoenix at 12 Grimmauld Place.
However, in 1997 when Albus Dumbledore (primary Keeper) was killed, the members of the Order of the Phoenix automatically became Secret-Keepers for the HQ.
This included Severus Snape , whose allegiance was doubtful at the time.
As such, the Order was forced to change their headquarters to The Burrow .
This charm was used on Muriel's house ( Arthur Weasley as Keeper) and Shell Cottage ( Bill Weasley as Keeper) during the Second Wizarding War .
Nature
Becoming Secret Keeper
When the charm was initially cast, one could choose more than one person to be Secret Keeper, though it is unknown if there was a limit as to how many people could carry the same secret in this way.
Once the Secret Keeper died, all the people who had learnt the secret from them would become the new Secret Keepers.
If the Keeper had chosen not to reveal the secret to anyone (so that they are the only Keepers), then the secret rested with them forever.
It is unknown what criteria had to be met before someone could qualify as a Secret Keeper.

However, it appeared that, to be eligible, one had to be capable of divulging the secret if they wished to, as this would explain why wizards did not simply bestow the secret onto creatures who could not speak a human language, or creatures such as house-elves , who could simply be ordered by their masters to not divulge the secret (as such an order would override their free will).
It was also possible that the spell had to be cast by the Secret Keeper him/herself, so only a wizard can be it.
Revealing the secret
Once the secret had been implanted, the only method for another to learn it was for the primary Secret Keeper to divulge it to that person directly ; it could not be discovered any other way.
Additionally, the disclosure had to be completely voluntary, as methods of magical coercion such as Veritaserum , Legilimency , the Cruciatus Curse , or the Imperius Curse had no effect on the charm.

The people to whom the Secret Keeper had already divulged the information (secondary Keepers) would not be able to pass it along even if they wanted to, and the information in question could not be learned even by stumbling across it, even if one were staring the secret in the face.

For example, if someone were to hide a location in this way, even if a person were to stumble into the specific area they would not be able to recognise it for what it was (i.e. as the area they were looking for), and they would not therefore learn the location accidentally.
Harry Potter uses Grimmauld Place as a base while being a secondary secret keeper
The method for the primary Keeper to voluntarily tell another person the secret could be verbal or written.
It was also possible that primary Keepers could reveal information to another by showing it to them.

This theory was postulated because whilst 12 Grimmauld Place was under this charm and being used as a base of operations for Harry, Hermione and Ron only after Dumbledore's death, the Death Eaters evidently became aware of 12 Grimmauld Place's approximate location knowing that Harry Potter had inherited the property from Sirius Black .

Despite watching the gap between numbers 11 and 13 when on the lookout for Harry, the house remained invisible to them until Yaxley grabbed onto Hermione Granger 's arm while she, Harry, and Ron Weasley Disapparated away from the Ministry of Magic to 12 Grimmauld Place, where they had been hiding.

It is explained that because Hermione (along with everyone else who knew the house's location) had been rendered Secret-Keeper by Dumbledore's death, she inadvertently took Yaxley past the protections of the Fidelius Charm.
The trio subsequently abandoned the house as a hideout.

Once the secondary Keeper had received the information in either of these ways, the information would still appear hidden to them until they started thinking about it, at which point the secret would reveal itself to them alone.
For example, Alastor Moody gave Harry Potter a parchment with Albus Dumbledore instructing where the Order of the Phoenix 's headquarters was.
He then merely had to think about the said location whilst in the correct area and it would appear out of thin air, allowing him entry.
Known uses
Etymology
"Fidelis" is Latin, meaning trustworthy and faithful. "
Fidelius" is the neuter comparative form of this word, meaning more trustworthy and more faithful. "
Fidelius" can also translate to authors.
Mentions in the book
Notes and references

title: Unplottability
paragraphs: Unplottability referred to the deliberate magical concealment of several places around the world.
Unplottable locations were either magically hidden from plain sight or simply removed from maps.
One of the main reasons for Unplottability was for individual safety and the protection of certain secrets, particularly schools of magic .
A Masking Spell could be used to achieve unplottability.
Known unplottable locations
Azkaban Prison, an unplottable location
Notes and references

title: Secret Keeper
paragraphs: Peter Pettigrew , The Potters' Secret Keeper
The Secret Keeper was the witch or wizard designated to hide a secret by means of the Fidelius Charm .
The secret was embedded in their very soul .

Once a Secret Keeper was selected, the person who told them the secret would find themselves unable to pass the information on again, as the Secret Keeper was the only one capable of revealing the secret, whether orally or written.
The Secret Keeper could tell as many people as they liked, but they must do so voluntarily.
The secret couldn't be blackmailed, bewitched, or tortured out of them.
History
First Wizarding War
The Fidelius Charm breaks and Voldemort murders James and Lily Potter
Originally meant to be the Secret Keeper for James and Lily Potter , Sirius Black thought Voldemort was on to him (he thought that Remus Lupin was a spy).
He therefore passed on the role of Secret Keeper to Peter Pettigrew .
Albus Dumbledore originally offered to be the Potters' Secret Keeper, but the couple refused on trust of their friends.

Pettigrew was then the new Secret Keeper for James and Lily Potter after they went into hiding during the First Wizarding War with their infant son Harry , keeping their whereabouts in Godric's Hollow a secret.
However, Pettigrew was secretly a traitor to the Order of the Phoenix .
He informed Lord Voldemort of the Potters' location, resulting in the murders of James and Lily and Voldemort's first defeat when the Killing Curse rebounded from Harry.

Sirius Black was later believed to have murdered Pettigrew and twelve bystanding Muggles in front of more than fifty eyewitnesses, when really Pettigrew had killed them himself and went into his Animagus form to flee the scene, leaving behind his severed index finger.
Caught at the scene of the crime, Black was thus blamed for the betrayal of the Potters (not knowing that Pettigrew had really been the betrayer) and imprisoned in Azkaban for it without a trial.
Secret-keeper Peter Pettigrew exposed after 12 years of hiding

He escaped twelve years later using what was believed to be a trick Voldemort taught him that made Black and his insanity unaffected by the Dementors ' depressing aura, when really Black had maintained his sanity due to the knowledge of his innocence since incarceration (a non-happy thought that the Dementors could not take) and went into his Animagus form to slip through his cell door while the Dementors were bringing in his food, swimming across the North Sea after seeing a picture of Pettigrew still in his animal disguise of "Scabbers", the pet rat of Harry's best friend at Hogwarts Ron Weasley , on a copy of the Daily Prophet given to him by then-Minister for Magic Cornelius Fudge .
Second Wizarding War

Albus Dumbledore was the Secret Keeper for 12 Grimmauld Place, the Headquarters of the Order of the Phoenix , until he died in 1997 , thus making all the members of the Order, along with the trio the succeeding Secret Keepers.
This forced the Order to abandon it, as they erroneously believed Severus Snape to be a traitor and he knew the location.

Later, the trio returned to the house (accepting the risk of a visit from Snape) until they infiltrated the Ministry of Magic , where afterward Yaxley grabbed Hermione as the trio Apparated to 12 Grimmauld Place to escape.
They then considered the location permanently compromised.

In 1997 and 1998 , the Order of the Phoenix used many safe houses, including Aunt Muriel's House and Shell Cottage , all of which were under the Fidelius Charm and maintained by various Secret Keepers.
Dangers

Being a Secret Keeper was a very dangerous position to be in; although it was impossible to bewitch or torture the information out of the Secret Keeper, many had in the past been subjected to the Imperius and Cruciatus Curses in others' attempts to find the secret.
It was such a serious and binding enchantment that few would undertake it lightly.
If the Secret Keeper in question turned out to be someone untrustworthy, this could lead to the detrimental consequence of the secret being exposed.
If a Secret Keeper died, all the people already aware of the secret information became Secret Keepers.
This would, unfortunately, dilute the effect greatly as more people could pass the information at will.
Known Secret Keepers

title: Muriel's house
paragraphs: Muriel's house was located somewhere in England , "not that far" from Ottery St Catchpole in Devon , and was the residence of Muriel , aunt of Molly Weasley .
History
Second Wizarding War
Although Muriel was not a member of the Order of the Phoenix , her niece's family was, and she allowed their home to be used as one of the Order's safehouses.
In late July of 1997 , it was one of the locations Order members retreated to after the Battle of the Seven Potters .
Ronald Weasley and Nymphadora Tonks fled there after evading Bellatrix Lestrange 's attacks, but managing to injure Rodolphus Lestrange .
They ended up missing their Portkey to The Burrow , and Muriel "fussed" over them.
In early 1998 , when the Death Eater regime found out Ronald Weasley was with Harry Potter and Hermione Granger , the Weasley family moved to Muriel's and placed a Fidelius Charm around the house.
Unable to run their shop Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes in Diagon Alley , Fred and George Weasley started operating an Owl-Order business out of Muriel's back room, much to her chagrin.
Mr Ollivander later moved to Muriel's too.
Notes and references

title: Lestrange family
paragraphs: Lestrange was the surname of an ancient pure-blood wizarding family, originally from France but also with branches in Great Britain , and one of the Sacred Twenty-Eight .
They were related to the Rosier , Black , Malfoy , Tonks , and Lupin families.
Bellatrix Black married into the family only because it was expected of her to make a respectable pure-blood marriage.
The Lestranges were a very old and wealthy family with a vault at Gringotts Wizarding Bank full of treasure.

Like the House of Black, many Lestranges practised the Dark Arts and believed in the notion of pure-blood supremacy , they disdained Muggles , Muggle-borns , blood traitors , and in some cases, half-bloods .
Similar to the Gaunts , and the Blacks they were willing to intermarry with cousins to maintain their purity.
The Lestranges' family emblem was a raven , and their massive family vault was located in Paris , in the Père Lachaise Cemetery .
Their family tree depicted only the male descendants (females were depicted as flowers without names or faces), something which was noted to be unusual by Leta Lestrange .
The family were also well-known enough in France to have a dish, Quiches Lestrange , named after them.
The family motto is "Corvus oculum corvi non eruit" , which in English means "a crow will not pull out the eye of another crow", which represents how members of the family will not betray each other.
History

The family produced a Minister for Magic during the 1800s : Rodolphus Lestrange took a reactionary position, and attempted to shut down the Department of Mysteries , but was ignored by the Unspeakables and the rest of the Ministry .
He resigned after six years in office due to ill health, which was rumoured to be an inability to cope with the stress of the office.
Laurena Kama being abducted by Corvus Lestrange (IV)
Corvus Lestrange (IV) was the head of the family during the late 19th century and into the early 20th, being acquainted with the Kama family , a French-Senegalese pure-blood clan.
Desiring the already happily married Laurena Kama for himself in order to produce a pure-blooded male heir, Corvus used the Imperius Curse to force Laurena to leave her family and come to him.
Laurena died giving birth to his child, a girl they named Leta, but Corvus did not care for her at all as she could not continue his line or name.
Corvus Lestrange (IV), Leta Lestrange , and Irma Dugard in Lestrange Manor
Marrying a second time to Clarisse Tremblay , his cousin, this union produced the coveted son Corvus had desired, Corvus Lestrange (V) .
The Kamas became aware of their matriarch's death and swore revenge, with Laurena's husband forcing their son Yusuf to swear an Unbreakable Vow to kill the one person that Corvus loved.
To protect his precious son and heir, Corvus dispatched his son and daughter to America with a servant, Irma Dugard , whose half-elf magic was too weak to trace.
However the ship sank in a storm and Corvus V perished due to Leta having swapped him for a quieter baby in the neighbouring cabin.
In the 1920s , there was a dish at Patisserie Matagot in Paris named " Quiches Lestrange ", likely a homage to the influential French wizarding family.
During her time at Hogwarts around the 1910s , Leta Lestrange developed a close relationship with fellow student and magical beast enthusiast Newton Scamander .
After one of Leta's experiments went wrong and endangered the life of a student, Newt Scamander took the blame and was expelled in her place.
She would later cross paths with Newt again.
The Lestrange family, being named in the Pure-Blood Directory as one of the " Sacred Twenty-Eight " Pure-blood families, dated back centuries in the British wizarding community.
Three members of the Lestrange family on trial in front of the Council of Magical Law
During the First and Second Wizarding Wars , the Lestranges supported Lord Voldemort and at least a few members of the family were Death Eaters .

Voldemort named Bellatrix , Rodolphus , and Rabastan Lestrange among his most loyal followers, as they were the only Death Eaters who tried to find him after his defeat in 1981 and spent fourteen years in Azkaban because of their loyalty.
Bellatrix, in particular, described herself as " the Dark Lord's most loyal servant ".
Bellatrix also had a "secret" relationship with Lord Voldemort and gave birth to a child with him before the Battle of Hogwarts .
Bellatrix and Voldemort's daughter was later named Delphini .
As Bellatrix and Voldemort both died in the Battle of Hogwarts , Delphini grew up as an orphan.

Etymology
The name 'Lestrange' echoes the French phrase l'étrange , literally "the strange one", referring to Bellatrix's mental disturbance.
In Old French, estrange means "foreigner" .

The surname may allude to English journalist Roger L'Estrange , who was known for opposing religious toleration and for being involved in plots against the government of William and Mary, similar to the Lestranges' intolerance about blood purity and involvement in the Death Eaters organisation.
In addition, a few Lestranges have the forename Corvus, which is Latin for 'crow'.
A raven, which is related to the crow, appears on the Lestrange family emblem.
Notes and references

title: Rosier family
paragraphs: Rosier was the surname of an old pure-blood wizarding family, and one of the Sacred Twenty-Eight .
The family possibly originated in France .
They were related to the wizarding Lestrange , Perrot , Gage , Black , and Malfoy families and the Muggle Tonks family, and more distantly to the Lupin and Greengrass families.

Due to the participation of one Rosier in the Global Wizarding War as a Grindelwald acolyte , and later two Rosiers in the First Wizarding War as Death Eaters , it is likely that the Rosiers placed great importance on their pure-blood heritage.
History

By the 20th century , the family had close marriage ties with many British pure-blood families, and at least one member attending Hogwarts , suggesting the family had relocated from France to Great Britain.
Known family members
Etymology
Rosier is French for "rose tree" or "rose bush" and is a common surname in Francophone areas.
Notes and references

title: Tonks family
paragraphs: Tonks was the surname of a family that was originally made up of Muggles .
Ted Tonks , however, was a Muggle-born wizard and he married a pure-blood witch, Andromeda Black (for which Andromeda was disowned from her family), with whom he had one child, Nymphadora Tonks .
The Tonks family were related to the Lupin , Black , Malfoy , and Lestrange families.
They were distantly related to the Potter , Weasley , Peverell , Prewett , Crabbe , Riddle , Slytherin , Crouch , and Gaunt families.
They were also possibly related to the Longbottom and Abbott families.
The female line of the family continued through Edward Remus Lupin .
During the Second Wizarding War the family supported Albus Dumbledore and Harry Potter .
History
Not much is known about the early history of the Tonks family.
Sometime in the late 1960s or early 1970s Muggle-born Ted Tonks married Andromeda Black after they graduated from Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
Because of this marriage, Andromeda was disowned by her family.
In 1973 they had a daughter and their only child Nymphadora Tonks .
First Wizarding War
It can be assumed that during the First Wizarding War , the Tonks family supported the Order of the Phoenix .
However, they were not actual members, only allies.
They were also happy when Lord Voldemort was defeated at the hands of Harry Potter in 1981.
Between the wars
Tonks as a third-year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
In 1984, Nymphadora began her education at Hogwarts where she was Sorted into Hufflepuff House during the Sorting Ceremony .
During her time at school she was not all-together the best behaved.
Despite her behaviour, Tonks achieved good marks on her exams and qualified for Auror training when she left school in 1991.
This means that she presumably took Defence Against the Dark Arts , Transfiguration , Charms , Potions , and another subject in her sixth and seventh year.
She earned ' Outstanding ' or ' Exceeds Expectations ' on all of her N.E.W.T.s .
Being the daughter of the ostracised Andromeda Tonks, she was rejected by the pure-blood supremacists of the House of Black.
Nymphadora Tonks working as a Auror for the Ministry of Magic

Undergoing three years of Auror training under the tutelage of Alastor Moody , Tonks's natural metamorphic abilities allowed her to easily pass the Concealment and Disguise portion of the training without doing any work for it at all.
However, her clumsiness gave her trouble with the Stealth and Tracking portion of the course, which she almost failed.
Tonks qualified fully as an Auror in 1994.
It was most likely that her parents were proud when she was appointed as a full-fledged Auror.
Second Wizarding War
Remus and Tonks's dead bodies lying in the Great Hall during the one-hour armistice
The Tonks family supported the Order of the Phoenix during the Second Wizarding War , though only Nymphadora Tonks was an actual member.

Shortly after marrying Remus Lupin , she became pregnant and stayed at her parents' home with her mother, while her father was forced to go on the run to avoid the Muggle-Born Registration Commission .
Ted was murdered by Snatchers in March 1998 while on the run with other undesirables.
On 2 May 1998, Nymphadora and her husband were murdered separately by Death Eaters Bellatrix Lestrange and Antonin Dolohov , whilst fighting in the Battle of Hogwarts .
Their deaths left their infant son in his maternal grandmother's care.
After the war
After his parents' deaths, Teddy was raised by Andromeda.
He usually spent much of his time with the Potter and Weasley families.
These families were also distant relatives of his through on Andromeda's side of the family.
Since he was born in April 1998, Teddy began his education in the magical arts at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry on 1 September 2009 .
He was Sorted into Hufflepuff and was made Head Boy in his seventh year.

title: Lupin family
paragraphs: Lupin was the surname of a wizarding family with Muggle as well as magical heritage .
They were related to the Muggle Howell and Tonks families (the latter with some magical members), and thus distantly to the wizarding Black , Lestrange , Malfoy, and Potter families.
The Lupins supported the Order of the Phoenix during the First and Second Wizarding Wars .
Members included Remus and Nymphadora Lupin , their son Teddy Lupin , and Remus' parents, Lyall and Hope Lupin .
Recent family history
First Wizarding War
Lyall Lupin was a wizard who was a world-renowned authority on Non-Human Spirituous Apparitions .

During the prelude to the First Wizarding War , the Ministry of Magic called on his expertise of Dark creatures to help contain the threat, and he eventually joined the Department for the Regulation and Control of Magical Creatures .
Lyall married a Muggle woman, Hope Howell , and had one son, Remus , who was bitten by the werewolf Fenrir Greyback in retaliation for a negative comment about lycanthropes that Lyall made.
Remus was afflicted with lycanthropy during his childhood, as Fenrir Greyback's revenge against Lyall.
He attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and was Sorted into Gryffindor house.
During his school years, he was one of the Marauders, best friends with Sirius Black , James Potter , and Peter Pettigrew .
Remus during the First Wizarding War, as a member of the original Order
After Hogwarts, Remus joined the Order of the Phoenix and fought in the First Wizarding War .
However, Pettigrew betrayed James and Lily Potter to Lord Voldemort and Remus had lost all of his closest friends in various ways by the end of the First Wizarding War.
The loss of his friends was said to be the most tramatic experience of his life, though he and Sirius Black later rekindled their friendship.
Between the Wars
Remus teaching Harry Potter the highly advanced Patronus Charm
By the early 1990s, Lupin was living in poverty, in a tumbledown, semi-derelict cottage in Yorkshire.
Albus Dumbledore tracked Lupin down in the summer of 1993 and offered him a teaching post.
Remus taught at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry as Professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts during the 1993-1994 school year.
He was also a professor of Harry Potter , James's son, whom he taught how to conjure a corporeal Patronus , but resigned after Severus Snape revealed to the public that Remus was a werewolf.
Second Wizarding War
Remus and Tonks's dead bodies lying in the Great Hall during the one-hour armistice
He fought against Death Eaters once more in the Second Wizarding War , during which he lost his friend Sirius.
In 1997, Remus married fellow Order member Nymphadora Tonks and had a son, Edward Remus "Teddy" Lupin .
Remus fought at the Battle of Hogwarts , during which his wife was murdered by Bellatrix Lestrange .
Remus was also murdered by Death Eater, Antonin Dolohov , during the same battle in 1998.
Leaving Teddy to grow up parentless.
After the war
After his parents deaths, Teddy was raised by his maternal grandmother.
He usually spent much of his time with the Potter and Weasley families.
These families were also distant relatives of his through his maternal grandmother's side of the family.
Since he was born in April 1998, Teddy began his education in the magical arts at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry on 1 September , 2009 .
He was Sorted into Hufflepuff .
He was made Head Boy in his seventh year.

Family tree
Etymology
Lupin is derived from the Latin word lupus , meaning "wolf".
Lupin or lupine is also the name of a flower, and the latter is an English adjective meaning "wolflike".
This alludes to the lycanthropy in the family.

title: Half-blood
paragraphs: Half-blood Harry Potter was the son of a pure-blood wizard and a Muggle-born witch
Half-blood was the term commonly given to wizards and witches whose heritage consisted of both Muggle and wizarding ancestry.
By the 1990s , half-bloods were the most common type of wizard or witch , as the pure-blood wizarding population would have become extinct had they not inter-married with Muggles and Muggle-borns .
Overview

It should be noted that any wizard or witch who was neither pure-blood nor Muggle-born was considered half-blood, even if they had two magical parents; they need not have had exactly half-Muggle/half-wizard heritage.
Those with at least one Muggle or Muggle-born grandparent were considered half-blood.
Non-magical children born with at least one magical parent were considered Squibs by the wizarding community rather than Half-bloods or Muggles.
Examples include Martha Steward (II) , Dolores Umbridge's brother , and Gilderoy Lockhart's two sisters .
Because of their Muggle parentage, many end up assimilating into the Muggle population as they would have more trouble thriving within the magical community.
Magical children born to a Muggle-born and a Muggle are also considered half-bloods, such as Penny and Beatrice Haywood .
Treatment
Harry Potter and his children are half-bloods with known Muggle ancestry
Those who believed in the importance of blood purity considered half-bloods to be inferior because of their Muggle heritage, though superior to Muggle-borns .
It could be argued that half-bloods in the eyes of those who believed in blood purity bridged the gap between "respectable" and inferior.
As such, some families such as the Malfoys allowed them to marry into their pure-blood family and could do so without affecting their family's pure-blood status.
In spite of this, this never deterred "respect" from families such as the Blacks , Gaunt and the Lestranges against the Malfoys.
Other more fanatical families such as the Gaunts , Blacks , and Lestranges required all marriages to be those of pure-blood .

Members of these families were more likely to use "half-blood" in a derogatory manner, similar to the epithet " Mudblood "; Bellatrix Lestrange did so on multiple occasions, and the portrait of Walburga Black often equated half-bloods with Half-breeds .
Severus Snape , the "Half-Blood Prince"
Some bigoted half-bloods expressed prejudice towards those with Muggle heritage, despite having some themselves, and clung only to what wizarding heritage they had.
Notably Lord Voldemort persecuted Muggles and Muggle-borns, despite the fact that his mother ( Merope Gaunt ) was a pure-blood witch and his father ( Tom Riddle Snr ) was a Muggle.

He denied his Muggle heritage, instead emphasising his wizard ancestors; his legend-entitled nickname was " Heir of Slytherin " because his most notable wizard ancestor ( Salazar Slytherin ) was a famous pure-blood champion, which made himself more believable.

Severus Snape may have been another example; his self-entitled nickname was " Half-Blood Prince " because his mother ( Eileen Prince ) was a pure-blood witch and his father ( Tobias Snape ) was a Muggle.
However, Remus Lupin reported that he never used the nickname openly.
This, as well as Snape's membership in the Death Eaters , suggests he may have been ashamed of his Muggle heritage, at least in his early life.
In fact, these people, along with some other Death Eaters, pretend to be pure-bloods, hiding their Muggle heritage from anyone else.
Ironically (or perhaps because of), regarding the prophecy concerning his defeat , Voldemort chose to go after the half-blood Harry Potter instead of the pure-blood Neville Longbottom .
When the British Ministry of Magic fell under Voldemort's control in 1997 , Muggle-borns were openly persecuted and pure-bloods were favoured above all else.
Half-bloods were still accepted at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and in the British Ministry of Magic , but were not treated as well as the pure-blood members.
This was repealed once Lord Voldemort was officially defeated .

title: Inbreeding
paragraphs: Orion and Walburga Black (parents of Sirius and Regulus Black ) were second cousins, thus very closely related
Inbreeding is a practice in which someone marries and has children with someone who is in their own family.
Inbreeding was a common practice for elite pure-blood wizarding families wishing to uphold the tradition of marrying only wizards of respected ancestry.
It was noted that wizarding families became more diverse as time passed, as wizards began to marry half-bloods , Muggle-borns , and Muggles .
Nevertheless, more conventional, elitist families tended to marry within their family, particularly cousins.
Wizarding views
Due to the dangers of inbreeding, many wizarding families eschewed such practices, particularly the Muggle-admiring Weasleys .
By Hermione Granger 's claim, there were not enough pure-bloods to compose the entire Death Eater organisation.
Therefore, some of them were more likely half-bloods clinging onto their wizarding ancestries, pretending to be pure, furthering the rejection of inbreeding, even among the fanatics.
Lord Voldemort was one of the most notorious examples.

The Malfoy family had been inclined to blood-purity since ancient times, though even they would not be willing to intermarry with cousins, believing the practice would endanger them, instead making them more willing to marry half-bloods.

This differed them from the small minority families of the true fanatics such as the Gaunts , Blacks , and Lestranges , but were still considered a "respectable" pure-blood family among said families.
Side effects
Mental instability was observed in several wizarding families that practised inbreeding (the Gaunts, Lestranges and Blacks).
Inbreeding also had a negative effect on a person's physical appearance.
Marvolo Gaunt was short, and oddly proportioned, and his eyes, like those of his son and daughter, stared in opposite directions.
Furthermore, Morfin Gaunt had an odd rolling gait.
Merope Gaunt was likewise described as having a " plain, pale, rather heavy face ".
According to Mrs Cole , " she was no beauty ".
Because of the implications of inbreeding, the families claiming to be pure were declining in the 20th century .
Inbred families
House of Black
Second cousins Orion and Walburga Black with their two sons
The House of Black 's family motto was " Toujours pur " (English: always pure ).
Therefore, the family was strictly traditionalised to marry other families (failing this, extremely rich families).

The Black family took their motto seriously, and all family members who did not conform with the Black views of pure-blood supremacy or happened to be Squibs were disowned quickly and removed from the Black family tapestry.
In desperation to keep with the tradition, the Blacks, at one known point, resorted to extremes.
Orion and Walburga Black were second cousins (their grandfathers Sirius and Cygnus were brothers) who married and had two children together.
Due to the Black family tree tapestry being so large, it was possible that many related people married without knowing about their relationship.

For instance, Victoire Weasley and Teddy Lupin became romantically involved without anyone mentioning or realising that they were fourth cousins once removed through the Blacks, likewise Harry Potter and Ginny Weasley , as Harry had relation to Dorea Black and Ginny was related to Cedrella Black and Lucretia Black , making Harry and Ginny cousins, though it is unknown what level of cousins they are.
House of Gaunt
The Gaunt family's consequences of inbreeding for many generations
The House of Gaunt had a fanatical belief in blood-purity, stemming from their esteemed ancestors Salazar Slytherin and Cadmus Peverell .
To maintain their heritage's purity, they tended to marry their own cousins, which also allowed them to pass down Slytherin's Parseltongue ability.
This led many members of the family to deteriorate mentally and physiologically, and they squandered much of their family gold long before the 1920s .
As such, Marvolo Gaunt and his son suffered much mental instability , accompanied with violence, and disproportionate bodily appearances.
By the 20th century the family was living in poverty, in a small destitute shack .
Lestrange family
The Lestrange family tree

The bloodlines of Corvus Lestrange I and Cyrille Lestrange I also practised inbreeding, as his youngest grandson Corvus married his first cousin Eglantine Lestrange , and their son (another Corvus ) married his first cousin Clarisse Tremblay .
Separately, Fulcran Lestrange III was also married to his second cousin once removed, Quintilla Lestrange .
Known incestuous relationships
