title: Lestrange Mausoleum
paragraphs: The Lestrange Mausoleum was a large building located at the Père Lachaise Cemetery in Paris , France and housed Corvus Lestrange's (IV)'s tomb , Corvus Lestrange (I)'s grave and many other coffins of countless members of the ancient wizarding Lestrange family .
History
In 1927 , the notorious Dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald called for a rally underneath the mausoleum.
He gave an inspiring speech to a huge crowd of his followers regarding the future and his views on Muggles , but was interrupted by Aurors , which caused a furious and lethal battle to break out.
Notes and references

title: Père Lachaise Cemetery
paragraphs: Père Lachaise Cemetery was a cemetery and park located on the Northeast side of Paris in France , and was both the largest cemetery and park in the city.
The Lestrange Mausoleum was located there.
History
In 1927 , Gellert Grindelwald held a rally here deep in the Lestrange family Mausoleum .

The cemetery was nearly destroyed after Grindelwald set loose magical flames which were only contained by the combined efforts of Nicolas Flamel , Porpentina Goldstein , Yusuf Kama , and Theseus and Newton Scamander .
Notes and references

title: Quiches Lestrange
paragraphs: Quiches Lestrange was a food that was served during the 1920s at Patisserie Matagot .
Etymology
The dish is presumably named after the Lestrange family , as an influential French wizarding family, as there is no concept of a 'Quiche Lestrange' in the real world.
That said, the dish is also likely a pun on Quiche Lorraine .
Notes and references

title: Rodolphus Lestrange (I)
paragraphs: Minister Rodolphus Lestrange was a British wizard who served as the fifteenth Minister for Magic of the British Ministry of Magic , in office from 1835 to 1841 , being elected at least once.
Biography
He unsuccessfully attempted to close down the Department of Mysteries , and eventually resigned due to ill health, which was rumoured to be an inability to cope with the stress of the office.
Etymology
Rodolphus is the Latin form of the name 'Rudolf', which is derived from the Germanic name Hrodwulf , meaning "famous wolf".
Removing the l, Rodophus is Greek for 'Rosy-cheeked'.
Notes and references

title: Corvus Lestrange (IV)
paragraphs: Corvus Lestrange (pre 1879 - pre 1927 ) was a French wizard and a member of the pure-blood Lestrange family .
He was the son of Corvus Lestrange and Eglantine Lestrange .
He abducted Laurena Kama and had a daughter with her, Leta Lestrange .
When Laurena died, he married Clarisse Tremblay and had a son with her, Corvus .
Biography
Corvus was acquainted with the Kama family .
One night, Corvus Lestrange put Laurena Kama under the Imperius Curse to abduct her.
He had a daughter with her, Leta Lestrange .
Laurena died shortly after.
Shortly after, he married Clarisse Tremblay .
Their union produced a son, Corvus .
When Clarisse died, Corvus was the light in his eyes.
Yusuf Kama , son of Laurena Kama and Mustafa Kama , swore an Unbreakable Vow to kill young Corvus and end the Lestrange lineage as revenge for the abduction of his mother.
In an attempt to protect his son, Lestrange sent both him and his daughter Leta to America along with his servant Irma Dugard .
Sometime afterwards, he passed away, and a family tree he owned ended up at the French ministry.

Yusuf mistakenly believed Credence Barebone to be Corvus Lestrange (along with much of the rest of the wizarding world), as he was unaware that a young Leta had switched Corvus in his crib with Aurelius Dumbledore , and attempted to resolve his vow by killing Credence.
After his death, Corvus Lestrange's remains were interred at the Lestrange Mausoleum , at the Père Lachaise Cemetery , in Paris , his grand marble tomb dominating the many sarcophagi there.
Personality and traits
From what is known of his history, Corvus (IV) seemed to be a cold-hearted man who was not above using dark magic or forcing a woman into marriage.
Furthermore, he did not care about the consequences of his actions, showing to be rather ruthless, selfish and egotistical.
He did not love his daughter Leta or Clarisse Tremblay, but loved his son, possibly because Corvus V's birth meant the future survival of his family line.
Magical abilities and skills
Etymology
" Corvus " is Latin for " raven ", probably from the Greek κόραξ ( korax , " raven ").
Corvus is the genus of medium to large black birds including crows, ravens, jackdaws and the like.
This is thus an allusion to the Dark nature of the Lestrange family, as such birds (particularly ravens) have often been harbingers of doom in folklore.
Notes and references

title: Kama family
paragraphs: Kama was the surname of a very old French wizarding family that was of Senegalese descent and had pure-blood heritage.
Known family members
Etymology
The surname Kama is a Sanskrit name meaning "desire."
It is also a surname common among Serer people in Senegal.
Notes and references

title: Laurena Kama
paragraphs: Laurena Kama (fl.
1896 ) was a French pure-blood witch , wife to Mustafa Kama and the coerced wife of Corvus Lestrange .
She was the mother of both Yusuf Kama and Leta Lestrange .
Biography
Hailing from a pure-blood family and happily married to the Senegalese pure-blood Mustafa Kama , Laurena was put under the Imperius Curse by Corvus Lestrange and forced to bear a daughter with him.
Laurena died after giving birth to Leta Lestrange .
Notes and references

title: Lestrange Manor
paragraphs: Lestrange Manor was the home of the French branch of the Lestrange family , during, at the very least, the 1890s and early 1900s .
History
Both Leta Lestrange and Corvus Lestrange were born in the master bedroom of Lestrange Manor, delivered by the half-elf housekeeper Irma Dugard .
Notes and references

title: Clarisse Tremblay
paragraphs: Clarisse Lestrange (née Tremblay ) was a witch and a member of the pure-blood Tremblay family .
She was the daughter of Bernard Tremblay and Leonie Lestrange , and the sister of Falco .
She married Corvus Lestrange and had a son with him, Corvus .
Biography
Clarisse Tremblay was the second wife of Corvus Lestrange , her first cousin.
She married him after his first wife, Laurena, had died in childbirth.
In 1901 , at the age of at least twenty one, she gave birth to a son, named Corvus after his father.
At some point thereafter, her son was separated from his family.
Her later fate is unknown.
Etymology
Notes and references

title: Corvus Lestrange (V)
paragraphs: Corvus Lestrange was a French wizard and a member of the pure-blood Lestrange family .
He was the son of Corvus Lestrange and Clarisse Tremblay .
He died as an infant when the ship carrying him and his half-sister, Leta to America sank in the Atlantic Ocean.
Leta swapped Corvus with another child because she said she didn't want to hear him cry anymore.
Biography
Before his birth, his father had made an enemy out of Yusuf Kama , the son of Lestrange's first wife Laurena and older half-brother of Leta.
Yusuf had taken a vow to kill the person Lestrange loved most as revenge for Laurena's death, which was Corvus.
Corvus' father entrusted him and Leta to Irma Dugard , a half-elf servant, to take them to America.
Irma's weak magic would make them untraceable , but during the trip over the sea, the ship sank.
Leta had, unaware of the commotion before it was too late, switched her half-brother with another baby who was travelling with his aunt.

The aunt picked up Corvus from her cabin, not noticing the switch, and ended up in another boat than Leta, Irma and the nephew, which got turned over by a wave during a storm causing her to lose her grip on Corvus, so he would sink into the sea and drown.
Leta never told anyone of the switch resulting in that the other child was given up for adoption in his place.
Post-mortem
With Corvus' death Yusuf Kama's vow became void, but he was unaware of it until 1927.
Leta confronting a Boggart taking on the image of Corvus drowning
As a result of Corvus' death, Leta's fear is him drowning, reflected by the form a Boggart would take when she confronted one.

The guilt she felt over her role in his death would plague Leta for the rest of her life, leaving her with feelings of intense self-loathing that left her childhood an isolated and unhappy one, the one exception to that being her friendship with Newt Scamander .
Etymology
" Corvus " is Latin for "raven", probably from the Greek κόραξ ( korax , "raven").
Corvus is the family name of medium to large black birds including crows, ravens, jackdaws and the like.
This is thus an allusion to the Dark nature of the Lestrange family, as such birds (particularly ravens) have often been harbingers of doom in folklore.
Notes and references

title: Yusuf Kama
paragraphs: Yusuf Kama (born c. 1884 ) was a French pure-blood wizard of Senegalese ancestry, son of Laurena and Mustafa Kama , and half-brother of Leta Lestrange .
He claimed to be the last male in his pure-blood family line.
Biography
Early life (1884-1896)
Yusuf was born around 1884 , the son of Mustafa and Laurena Kama, a pair of pure-blooded wizards.
They all lived in the Kama Mansion .
Seeking vengeance (1896-1926)
12-year-old Yusuf with his mother Laurena and father Mustafa
Yusuf's parents were acquainted with Corvus Lestrange , who desired Laurena.
One night in 1896 , he used the Imperius Curse to lure Laurena out of her home and abduct her.
Yusuf tried to stop her from leaving, but Lestrange cursed him.
That was the last time Yusuf saw his mother.
Later he and his father learned that Laurena died giving birth to Lestrange's daughter Leta .
Mustafa became insane because of grief and with his dying breath, he made Yusuf take an Unbreakable Vow to seek revenge by killing the person who Lestrange loved most in the world.
Yusuf first thought that his intended victim was Leta, since she was Lestrange's only close relative at the time, but he learned that Lestrange didn't love his daughter.

However, Yusuf learned that Lestrange married Clarisse Tremblay soon after Laurena's death, and while Lestrange didn't love his wife either, he later had a son with her in 1901 , named after himself, whom he loved more than anything.
So Corvus became Yusuf's target for revenge.
Lestrange learned of Yusuf's vow of revenge and sent both his children with the servant Irma Dugard to America.
Because of Irma's weak magic, Yusuf couldn't trace her and Corvus seemed to have escaped him.
Global Wizarding War (1927-1945)
Yusuf watching Credence and Nagini's escape
In 1927 , Yusuf Kama was on a mission and tracked Credence Barebone to Paris.
Yusuf was determent to track Credence down and kill him because he believed him to be Corvus Lestrange , the son of Corvus Lestrange IV who had Imperiused Yusuf's mother into marriage.
He had heard rumours about Credence's identity and managed to locate Credence at the Circus Arcanus , where Nagini , the Maledictus , had a show.
During Nagini's performance, Kama carefully observed the behaviour of Skender , the circus owner provoking the woman.
When Nagini turned into a snake, she attacked Skender.
A moment later, as a result of Credence releasing animals from the cage, panic broke out in the circus and the crowd began to run away.
Credence and Nagini escaped from the circus, which prevented Yusuf from capturing the Obscurial.
Hearing the conversation between the Auror, Porpentina Goldstein and Skender, he quickly realised that the topic of the conversation was Barebone.
Therefore, when the woman finished talking, he invited her for tea .
Yusuf talking with Tina
During the meeting with Tina at Café Abringer , Yusuf told the woman that he was probably related to Credence.
That the witch would believe him, he offered her that he would show reliable evidence that would determine his story.
Kama lured Tina into his hideout in the sewers to the chamber full of notes on the wall and a drawn family tree of the Lestrange family.
He probably took the woman's wand and locked her there, so she wouldn't interfere with his mission.
Yusuf disarming Newt and locking him and Jacob with Tina
Yusuf returned to the café where he had previously drunk tea with Tina.
He went into the bathroom, and then instilled an eye in which there was a troublesome parasite.
After leaving the interior of the café, he was accosted by Newt Scamander and Muggle Jacob Kowalski , who asked him about their friend Tina.
Initially, Yusuf answered evasively, but after a short while he decided to show the men where Tina was.
He led them to the sewers, and as soon as they entered, he disarmed Newton and locked him and Jacob in the chamber with Tina.
Jacob holding unconscious Yusuf

Yusuf promptly left, but not before promising to his captives that he would return and set them free once he had concluded his business with Credence; a business wherein either the boy died, or Yusuf himself did should the latter fail in his endeavour.
A moment later, the African-French wizard began to sweat intensively from the parasite and had a seizure, leading to him fainting.
With the help of the Newt's Bowtruckle , Pickett , who could open the locks, all three of them got out of the previously closed room.
Hearing the prowling on the streets, the Zouwu , Newt, Tina and Jacob transported Kama and moved to the Alexander III Bridge .
Newt tamed the creature with a toy , while Tina and Jacob guarded the unconscious Yusuf at that time.
When the Zouwu got into the suitcase, the card Newt received from Albus Dumbledore in London showed him the direction in which they should go, so they took Yusuf and went in the designated direction.
Yusuf with Jacob at Flamel's house
Yusuf lay unconscious in the Flamel House for a short period.
During this time he was examined by Tina, who said that the man probably took an Unbreakable Vow .
When the witch wanted to question him, believing that he knew where Credence was, the parasite in Kama's eye began to move.
Newt pulled it out with tweezers, which caused Yusuf to awake for a moment.
He said then that "he must kill" and after a while he lost consciousness again.
Yusuf trying to kill Credence
As soon as the wizard awoke, he jumped to his feet and fled from Flamel's apartment, heading towards the Lestrange Mausoleum on Pere Lachaise cemetery .
Soon after, Jacob, Credence and Nagini arrived, with Yusuf holding the Muggle at wandpoint.
After a while, Newt, Tina and Leta Lestrange were also found in the tomb.
Yusuf announced to the audience that Credence was Leta's half-brother.
Kama told about his past: how Corvus Lestrange enchanted his mother Laurena, and then the woman gave birth to his daughter Leta.

Yusuf also admitted that he planned to kill Leta, fulfilling the promise made to his father Mustafa, but he changed his goal to Credence when he learned that Corvus begot another child he truly loved.
This child was Credence, who was initially named after his biological father, Corvus.
After telling the story, Kama said that he would complete his Unbreakable Vow, and then pulled out his wand , which he aimed at Barebone.
Seeing the intentions of the African-French wizard, Leta shouted that Corvus was dead and that she had unintentionally killed him.
The witch told the story of the adoption of Corvus, in which she participated: during a boat trip at sea there was a storm that forced passengers to evacuate to lifeboats.
Leta swapped the baby, wanting to free herself from her brother.
With an unknown child and Irma Dugard , half-elf maid, got on the boat and sailed away, watching other boats get sunk, including the one in which she had changed her brother.
The conversation was interrupted by opening of the door to the next chamber, in which Gellert Grindelwald's rally began.
Yusuf fighting with Grindelwald's flames
Yusuf went to a meeting of Gellert Grindelwald 's supporters, which took place in the mausoleum.
During the rally, Yusuf witnessed the wizard's speech and the vision of the World War II that Grindelwald had presented.
Shortly after an Auror squadron under the command of Theseus Scamander arrived and a pure-blood witch was killed in self-defence by one of them , Grindelwald sent his followers to spread the word.
He then began to fight by conjuring a circle of black fire to divide friend from foe.
Credence passed successfully, as did Queenie Goldstein , Tina's younger sister and Jacob's fiancée.

Yusuf also was a witness of his half-sister's death, because when Grindelwald attacked both Scamander brothers, Leta interfered and sacrificed herself to allow Yusuf and the others time to escape from the mausoleum.
Kama grabbed Nagini, forcing her to Disapparate outside the mausoleum.
Grindelwald fled the scene, but before he did, he unleashed deadly fire to destroy Paris.

Yusuf, the Scamander brothers, Tina, Jacob and Nagini were powerless, but luckily Nicolas Flamel converged upon the cemetery to instruct Kama and the other wizards to use the General Counter-Spell to prevent Grindelwald's flames from escaping.
Kama listened to the alchemist and stuck his wand into the ground and helped to stop the fire.
Yusuf, shocked by the events of the evening, was unable to say anything after for a while afterwards.
Yusuf and others at Hogwarts
Yusuf, along with the other survivors, travelled to Hogwarts, where he witnessed Newt Scamander's conversation with Albus Dumbledore.
He was probably aware of the purpose of the visit.
He watched Dumbledore's discussion with Newt from a distance of several metres, with Newt being invited by Albus for tea after a while.
Nagini was wearing his coat, so he presumably lent it to her for her comfort.
Dumbledore's first army on the train
In 1932 , Yusuf joined Dumbledore's first army , which also included Newt, Theseus, Jacob, Eulalie Hicks , and Bunty Broadacre .
Kama and the others travelled to Berlin by The Great Wizarding Express .
Yusuf was assigned to become a spy in Grindelwald's inner circle by Dumbledore as part of his plan to prevent Grindelwald ascending to Supreme Mugwump .
Somehow, he was able to find the location of Nurmengard Castle .
Grindelwald erasing Yusuf's memories
Once there, Yusuf informed Grindelwald that Dumbledore had commissioned him to spy on him and asked Gellert what to tell Albus.
Grindelwald ordered Queenie to use Legilimency on Kama.
Thanks to this, Grindelwald found out that Yusuf was furious with him for murdering Leta.
The Dark Wizard removed Yusuf's memory of his sister's death so that his pain would be forgotten.
However, Queenie Goldstein stated to Credence that she didn't always tell Grindelwald everything that she found out.

Since Queenie would have seen images of Yusuf Kama plotting with Dumbledore and his allies, like Theseus and Eulalie, she obviously omitted those parts from her response to Grindelwald's order, keeping true to her not-totally-loyal façade.
Yusuf joining the cheering crowd
Yusuf, together with Grindelwald and his acolytes, went to the Candidates' Dinner in the German Ministry of Magic .
As Jacob and Lally caused a confusion, Kama grabbed Queenie and left the building with the rest of the crowd, gently leading her away.
Yusuf overthrowing Grindelwald's supporters
Soon after, Yusuf travelled with Grindelwald's followers to Bhutan for the walk of the Qilin .
When Grindelwald's henchmen wanted to attack Theseus and Lally, Yusuf attacked Grindelwald's acolytes, thus confirming which side he was on.
Kama later witnessed Newt expose Grindelwald's lie.
Yusuf was also one of the people who wanted to capture the Dark Wizard before he escaped.
Personality and traits
Yusuf Kama was extremely ambitious, cunning, and resourceful.
This was shown in his determination to track down and kill Corvus Lestrange to fulfil the Unbreakable Vow which his father, Mustafa Kama , had forced him to make.

Indeed, Yusuf was so desperate to complete this mission, that he tricked and trapped Newt Scamander , Tina Goldstein , and Jacob Kowalski , and later even ruthlessly threatened to kill Jacob if the No-Maj was to get in his way.
Moreover, Yusuf was notably cunning enough to trick even the highly skilled Auror Tina.
Yusuf in his hideout
Despite Yusuf's occasional ruthlessness, however, he had a softer side and was capable of genuine love and had a decent degree of morals and empathy.
Yusuf deeply loved his mother Laurena Kama and his father and was devastated by the tragedy that separated them.
Although he was determined to kill Corvus, Yusuf seemed to pity the young man who he thought was Corvus V for his fated doom caused by his apparent father's actions.
He didn't want to kill anyone else and demanded them to move.
Moreover, despite his pride in being a pure-blood wizard, Yusuf was not a pure-blood supremacist .

While willing to trap Newt, Jacob, and Tina after completing his mission, Yusuf wanted to release them after he killed Corvus V. Yusuf also seemed to harbour no ill will towards his half-sister Leta Lestrange , and even seemed to love her in a way, even hesitating before stating that her father Corvus Lestrange (IV) had never loved her (apparently not wishing to hurt Leta's feelings).
Indeed, following Leta's death, Yusuf was filled with rage and grief, according to Queenie, his every breath being a reminder that Leta breathed no more.
Furthermore, he also never corrected those that referred to Leta simply as his sister, rather than his half-sibling.

After learning that his Vow was void (due to Corvus already being dead), Yusuf started to display a more moral and selfless side - not being tempted by Grindelwald's persuasive speech, risking his life to save Nagini from the black fire, and then helping Nicolas Flamel , as well as his former situational enemies, by conjuring purifying orange flames.

Inspired by the selfless sacrifice of his half-sister Leta, Yusuf officially joined the Global Wizarding War on the side opposing Grindelwald and journeyed to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry to meet with Albus Dumbledore .

title: Pure-Blood Directory
paragraphs: The Pure-Blood Directory was a directory created in the 1930s that was published anonymously in Great Britain listing twenty-eight families judged to be pure-blood by the anonymous author, who was widely believed to be a wizard by the name of Cantankerus Nott .
He dubbed these families the Sacred Twenty-Eight .
History
A number of families appearing on the list deplored their inclusion, with many, including the Weasleys , proudly noting that they had Muggle ancestors.
Others felt there was a certain prestige in being on this list, and adherents to the pure-blood supremacy doctrine made quite a big deal out of their inclusion on this list of "pedigree".

The directory seemed to have certain levels of bias and information inaccuracy, as the Potter family was excluded due to Henry Potter 's outspoken pro-Muggle ideals and possible Muggle origins of their name, and the Ollivander family was included despite Garrick Ollivander's mother , a Muggle-born , being married into the family at the time of the directory's publishing.

title: Scholastic
paragraphs: Scholastic's logo as it appears on the Harry Potter books
Scholastic is an American publishing house that publishes the Harry Potter books and its complementary novels in the United States .
It is the only company to have published J. K. Rowling 's novels in English besides Bloomsbury , the original publisher in the United Kingdom .
On 31 July , 2012 ( Harry Potter 's birthday), Scholastic launched a Harry Potter Reading Club .
On 2013 , Kazu Kibuishi (an American author and illustrator) was asked to design and create special edition cover art for the fifteenth anniversary of the Harry Potter books .
These special editions were available in advance online (the final book released on Harry Potter's birthday).
The books were officially released on 27 August , 2013.
Singularity of Scholastic Harry Potter books
The Scholastic edition of Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

The main difference between Scholastic and Bloomsbury editions of the books is the covers and the spelling (Scholastic uses American spelling for words such as symbolise, which is spelt as symbolize ).
Also, the title of the first novel differs between the two publishers.
Bloombsbury published the first novel as Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone , whereas in America the novel was published as Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone .
Early criticism was directed at Levine for changes that were made to the author's English prose.
There were around 80 word changes in Sorcerer's stone and some significant alteration in the placing of commas.
When questioned, in March 2012, he responded that 'I did not do anything to the text.
Every change was something that I discussed with Jo.
In fact, Jo came up with the alternative title of Sorcerer's Stone... It's one of the most common conversations that you have in a publishing company with a writer.
The conversation goes something like this: "I presented this to the sales and marketing department and they feel that the title doesn't do this... So let's consider alternatives".
Of course if the author says "no absolutely not - that's my title" then that's the title that goes on the book.
It's a simple matter.
But authors are professional people and sometimes just changing the title gives the sales and marketing department a degree of confidence that helps your book.'
Levine noted that he needed a title that said 'magic' more overtly to American readers.

He continued, 'I certainly did not mind Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone but I can see, if you forget now what happened after, ...why a book that is titled Philosopher's Stone might seem more arcane or something.
So the title that I had suggested to me and which I then turned to Jo was Harry Potter and the School of Magic.
Jo very thoughtfully said "No - that doesn't feel right to me... there are objects that I would like.
What if we called it the Sorcerer's Stone?"
And that completely does it."

Other, very minor, differences in wording occur throughout the Scholastic editions, preferring American nomenclature over British, such as the word "soccer" instead of "football" or "sweater" instead of "jumper."
Also, the text is a bit bigger and, unlike Bloomsbury , at the beginning of every chapter there is a small picture illustrated by Mary GrandPré .

In addition to standard typographical changes (including italics, capitals and small capitals) there are other typographical features exclusive to the American editions, such as facsimile of signatures, "handwritten" texts, quill writing, newspaper headlines, advertisement signs, etc.
Scholastic covers of the Harry Potter series also have a characteristic stylized logo of the franchise name, notable for the lightning-shaped P. It later became the logo of the film series .
Notes and references

title: Vault 713
paragraphs: Vault 713 was a high-security vault at Gringotts Wizarding Bank in London , England .
It was located deep underground and required a Gringotts goblin to pass its finger along the length of the door, in order for the door to melt away.
History
The entrance to the vault

The Philosopher's Stone was protected in this vault until Rubeus Hagrid removed it on 31 July 1991 on Albus Dumbledore 's orders to be placed under more effective protection at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
Quirinus Quirrell attempted to break into this vault after the Philosopher's Stone had been removed that same day by Harry Potter and Hagrid 's visit.
This was done under the direction of Lord Voldemort .
It is unknown who was the owner of the vault or what, if anything, the vault was used for after it guarded the Philosopher's Stone .
Security

According to the goblin Griphook , if anyone but a Gringotts goblin tried to open Vault 713, they'd be sucked through the door and trapped inside the vault until the vault was opened (which Gringotts goblins did once every ten years).
Based on this, Disapparition was more than likely impossible from within the vault.
Notes and references

title: Nimbus 2000
paragraphs: The Nimbus 2000 was a broomstick produced by the Nimbus Racing Broom Company as part of their successful line of racing brooms.
At the time of its release in 1991 , it was the fastest broomstick in production.
The Nimbus 2000 easily outperformed its competitors on the Quidditch pitch until it was replaced as the top broomstick by the Nimbus 2001 .
History
The broom was released in or before August 1991 and became the best broom on offer at the time.
It was very popular but expensive to purchase.
The broom handle was made of mahogany, and appeared sleek and shiny.
It had a long tail of neat twigs with the words "Nimbus Two Thousand" written in gold near the top of the handle.
It was also light and speedy.
It has protections against tampering that can only be subverted by powerful Dark Magic .
The Japanese National Quidditch team rode on Nimbus 2000s during the 1994 Quidditch World Cup .
Harry's broomstick
Harry Potter with the broomstick
Harry Potter received one from Minerva McGonagall when he joined the Gryffindor Quidditch team as the new Seeker .
He owned it for two years until the Gryffindor and Hufflepuff Quidditch match in November 1993 .
Harry fell off the broom when dementors appeared on the pitch, and it struck the Whomping Willow .
Later, when Harry asked about his broomstick, Ron uncovered the damaged remains in the Hospital Wing , the broom having been reduced to splinters.
Known owners
Etymology
"Nimbus" means "rainstorm" or "cloud" in Latin.
This is probably a reference to its flying.
Notes and references

title: Nimbus Racing Broom Company
paragraphs: The Nimbus Racing Broom Company was a broomstick company formed in 1967 by Devlin Whitehorn .
Its arrival galvanised the racing broom market, and its first product, the Nimbus 1000 , was a revolutionary design.
The Nimbus immediately became the broom of choice for professional Quidditch teams across Europe , and subsequent models kept the Nimbus at the top of the field until the Firebolt came along.
Products
Harry Potter with a Nimbus 2000 , and Draco Malfoy with a Nimbus 2001 (circa 1992-1993 school year )
Etymology
"Nimbus" is the Latin word for cloud.
Notes and references

title: Nimbus 2001
paragraphs: The Nimbus 2001 was a broom produced by the Nimbus Racing Broom Company as part of their successful line of racing brooms .
History
Conception of the Nimbus 2001
Released in August 1992 , it was faster than its predecessor, the Nimbus 2000 .
It officially became the fastest broom in existence, until the launch of the Firebolt in 1993 .
The broom itself was black and silver with revolving stirrups.
Despite the Firebolt being faster, the Nimbus 2001 was still used by the majority of Quidditch teams across the globe.

In January 1994 , after Harry Potter received a Firebolt as a Christmas gift, which was confiscated by Professor McGonagall on the grounds that it may have been sent by Sirius Black , Oliver Wood suggested Harry get a Nimbus 2001.
However, Harry flatly refused to buy 'anything Malfoy thinks is good'.
Known owners
Slytherin Quidditch team with their Nimbus 2001s gifted to them by Lucius Malfoy
The Slytherin Quidditch team was outfitted with a Nimbus 2001 each by Lucius Malfoy , with the suggestion being that the gift was in exchange for his son, Draco Malfoy being made Seeker .

It is unknown whether the students who joined the team in later years, such as C. Warrington , Vincent Crabbe , and Gregory Goyle , were given this model of broomstick when they joined the team or if they had to use the broomstick that they already had (if they had one).
If the new players were not given Nimbus 2001s when they joined the team and did not have brooms of their own, they probably had to use one of the old school brooms.
Notes and references

title: Japanese National Quidditch team
paragraphs: The Japanese National Quidditch Team was the team that represented Japan for international Quidditch tournaments.
Japan competed in the 422nd Quidditch World Cup in 1994 , and in the the 2014 Quidditch World Cup .

Every team member attributed their prowess to the gruelling training they were given at Mahoutokoro , where they practised over a sometimes turbulent sea in stormy conditions, forced to watch out for not only the Bludgers but also for planes from the Muggle airbase on a neighbouring island.
Uniform
They wore grass-green robes and white protective gears with red accents.
Emblem
Team emblem
The team's emblem was a white circle with a teal outer rim containing a red dragon with its claw upon a Quaffle .
Team special move
The Japanese team's special move, The Tsunami , involved a lot of spinning, seemingly inspired by Martial Arts .
First, Chaser Noriyuki Sato had the Quaffle flanked by the Japanese Beaters .
Sato then did a spinning trick to avoid the opposing players, then passed to Chaser Ryotaro Tanaka , who passed to Yoshihiro Suzuki .
Suzuki then punched one of the beaters and threw the Quaffle to Sato who kicked it through the middle hoop.
Then Tanaka, who was waiting behind the hoop, kicked it to the left hoop where Suzuki kicked it into the hoop.
Stadium
Japanese Stadium
The Japanese National Quidditch Stadium was built in the shadow of an immense Sengoku-era castle , and was surrounded by pink cherry blossom , the sakura trees, magically kept blooming year-round.
It had several huge pagoda -style towers above the regular stands with the colours of green, gold and red, in which spectators could get a spectacular arial view.
Instead of a normal Quidditch pitch , the matches were held over a massive koi pond , which was bisected by an elegantly carved wooden bridge.
The goals themselves were made in the style of the Japanese gates, the torii .
History
Japan qualified for the 1994 Quidditch World Cup but did not make it to the final.
The entire team rode Nimbus 2000s .
Japan qualified for the tournament beginning in April in Argentina .
The team rode Yajirushis .
On 21 May , they played against the Polish National Quidditch team and won 350 to 140.
The veteran Japanese Beaters Masaki Hongo and Shintaro Shingo put a lot of pressure on the young Polish team, and Seeker Noriko Sato beat Poland's Wladyslaw Wolfke to the Snitch in the 59th minute.
On 10 June , they beat joint favourites Nigeria 270 to 100.
Hongo and Shingo were again pivotal in the win, with Hongo smashing the tail off Nigerian Seeker Samuel Equiano 's broom with a powerful bludger hit.
On 6 July , they played against the Bulgarian National Quidditch team in the semi-finals, losing the game after 10 hours, when Bulgarian Seeker Viktor Krum caught the Snitch.
The final score was 610 to 460.
On 9 July , they then played against USA to determine third place, a game that they won with 330 to 120, thus achieving third place in the 2014 Quidditch World Cup .
In 2021, Gareth Greengrass revealed the team captain as a member of the Unforgivable .
Squads

title: Bloomsbury Publishing
paragraphs: Logo of Bloomsbury Publishing
Bloomsbury is the publisher of the Harry Potter series in British English , and was the first publisher out of twelve to accept J. K. Rowling 's books in 1997 .
They are also the publisher of the series in Australian and formerly Canadian English , along with Ancient Greek , Irish , Latin and Welsh .
The Australian books are distributed by Allen & Unwin and the Canadian ones by Raincoast Books until 2010 .
Over the last decade it has grown a lot bigger, and Bloomsbury won the Publisher of the Year in 1999 and again in 2000 , primarily because of the Harry Potter series.
Bloomsbury maintains an official website for the Harry Potter series.
Known personnel
The 15th Anniversary Edition of Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
The 21st Birthday Celebratory Edition, Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone: 21 Great Bloomsbury Reads for the 21st Century
Project-related individuals
Harry Potter in Bloomsbury
Bloomsbury's first Adult Edition Boxed Set (Books 1-4)
Harry Potter remains a popular title within Bloomsbury, in return, they've published several editions in various formats, catering readers from different demographic.
Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone , in particular, exclusively received covers to celebrate occasions such as its 15th and 21st birthdays.
The first adult edition published by Bloomsbury only consisted the first four titles, with covers below:
Bloomsbury has since then published two completed adult edition sets containing all seven books.
It also has published Pocket Potters: Little guides to the Harry Potter stories by J.K. Rowling on 26 August , 2025 , and in 2026 .

title: Harry Potter Book Day
paragraphs: Harry Potter Book Day logo

Harry Potter Book Day , previously known as Harry Potter Book Night and by the abbreviation HPBN , is an annual event initiated by Bloomsbury Publishing , first announced on 12 October 2014 with the fist event held on 5 February 2015 .
Three years later, Scholastic joined the global celebration.

Other publishers known to have promoted the event included: Adriano Salani Editore ( Italy ), Ediciones Salamandra now part of Penguin Random House Grupo Editorial ( Spain and Latin America, notably Colombia ), and Peru Éditions Gallimard ( France ), Егмонт ( Bulgaria ), and Gramedia Pustaka Utama ( Indonesia ).
In 2023, the event was rebranded as Harry Potter Book Day.
Overview
Former logo - Harry Potter Book Night
History
The 1st Harry Potter Book Night had 10,500 parties and celebrations in total
The 2nd annual HPBN had 12,600 parties and celebrations in total.
By the 4th annual HPBN, the event had been celebrated in 39 different countries with over 10,000 parties taking place around the world.
Nicholas Filbert participated in an event in Indonesia .

The 5th annual HPBN had over 476 events over the world, with the most northern event being a school party in Russia , the most southern event at the Khandallah Library , Wellington , New Zealand , and the event furthest away from any other located in an international school in China .
In London , Jim Kay and Chris Riddell participated their first ever joint event together at Waterstones .

The 7th annual HPBN was originally scheduled to be held on 4 February 2021 but was rescheduled; due to Covid-19 restrictions for large-scale gatherings across the world, any activities and ideas were planed by Bloomsbury to be easily adapted to any group size, and suitable for participating virtual online as many as possible.
In 2023, the event was rebranded as Harry Potter Book Day.

Bloomsbury Publishing stated that "we have rebranded the event to ensure that this annual celebration becomes even more inclusive for fans of all ages - whether you're an early bird or a night owl, you can celebrate at whatever time of the day, or night, suits you!"
The date was moved 12 October.
Notes and references

title: Unicorn blood
paragraphs: Unicorn blood was a thick, silvery magical substance that ran within a unicorn 's veins.
Description
A Medieval tapestry depicting wizards slaying a unicorn , and collecting its blood
The blood of a unicorn could be drunk in order to keep a person alive.
However, the act of slaying a unicorn and drinking its blood would cause the drinker to suffer a cursed life, though the specifics of what this actually entailed were not well known.
It was probably non-tradeable , since the sale of this substance was controlled by the British Ministry of Magic , making it strictly forbidden.
Mr Mulpepper's Apothecary in Diagon Alley had a sign outside its door asking patrons not to inquire about it.
Firenze and Harry Potter both believed that only those who had nothing to lose and everything to gain would dare drink unicorn blood.
Unicorn blood was an ingredient for a potion that created a rudimentary body for a disembodied soul .
History
During the 1890-1891 school year , an individual could be seen in Hogsmeade talking about whether it was worth drinking unicorn blood to continue one's life in a cursed state.
A pool of unicorn blood in the Forbidden Forest
During the 1991-1992 school year , Lord Voldemort used unicorn blood to sustain his life, until he could steal the Philosopher's Stone in order to regain his true body.
As he was possessing Quirinus Quirrell and inhabiting his body at the time, Quirrell drank the blood on Voldemort's behalf.
Quirrell drinking unicorn blood on Voldemort's behalf
On 26 May 1992 , when Harry Potter , Hermione Granger , Neville Longbottom , and Draco Malfoy were caught out of bounds, they were punished with detention in the Forbidden Forest .
At the edge of the forest, they joined Rubeus Hagrid , the Hogwarts gamekeeper, who told them that a unicorn had been injured and that they were to search for it.
Prior to splitting up the group, Hagrid pointed out the unicorn blood on the ground.

Harry and Draco eventually found a hooded figure (Voldemort) drinking blood from a slain unicorn; Draco ran away in terror, while Voldemort confronted Harry, only to be charged at by the centaur Firenze , causing him to flee.
Firenze then explained the properties of unicorn blood to Harry, including how drinking it would give someone a cursed life for slaying a creature so pure.
He then took back him to safety with Hagrid horseback.
Voldemort's temporary body potion used unicorn blood
In 1994 , Peter Pettigrew used unicorn blood along with Nagini 's venom to create a potion which would create a temporary body for Voldemort, until he could regain his true body .
It is unknown if producing such a potion and proceeding to use it (orally or otherwise) creates a similar curse upon the user's life.
In Voldemort's case, his re-usage of unicorn blood (having indirectly consumed some two years prior) may have had a cumulative effect on the curse's potency.
Voldemort's questionable degree of humanity, however, may have diluted, or even negated entirely, the efficacy of the curse .
Notes and references

title: Slytherin Dungeon tapestries
paragraphs: These tapestries were hung on the rough stone walls of Slytherin Dungeon .
They had been in place since the founding of the school and depicted the adventures of famous medieval Slytherins.
One such episode depicted on the tapestries was the slaying of a unicorn and the collection of its blood .
Notes and references

title: Mr Mulpepper's Apothecary
paragraphs: Mr Mulpepper's Apothecary was a shop in Diagon Alley which sold potion ingredients.
It was established in 1106 , and was located directly next door to its competitor Slug & Jiggers Apothecary .
One could buy a Potion Kit Bag here for a charge of 10 sickles and Cleaning Solutions & Restorative Draughts could also be purchased here.
Another shop was located in Knockturn Alley , although most wizards were unaware of its presence there outside of those of ill-repute.
History
In late 1991 , potion prices declined.
An article written in the Daily Prophet was titled "POTION PRICES SLIP, MAY BE HEADED FOR DUNGEONS" By 1992 Mr Mulpepper's Apothecary had greatly reduced prices.

During the Calamity in the late 2010s or early 2020s , Constance Pickering was referred to the Knockturn Alley branch of Mr Mulpepper's Apothecary when the Diagon Alley branch ran out of fairy wings , learning that the Knockturn Alley branch existed in the first place in the process.

She later told Minister for Magic Hermione Granger about this event during a Calamity surge focused on Knockturn Alley in October 2020 , with even Hermione being unaware of the existence of the Knockturn Alley branch until their conversation.
Known inventory
The sign for Mulpepper's
The shop did not sell unicorn blood , as the sale of it was forbidden.
A large sign was posted on the shop's door warning patrons not to ask about it.
Despite this, the British Ministry of Magic kept a close eye on the Knockturn Alley branch of the shop to ensure that unicorn blood truly wasn't being sold there.
Notes and references

title: 26 May
paragraphs: 26 May is the 146th day of the year (147th in leap years).
There are 219 days remaining until the end of the year.
Events
Draco Malfoy and Harry Potter serving their detention in the Forbidden Forest on this day in 1992

title: Detention in the Forbidden Forest (1992)
paragraphs: This detention session was held in the Forbidden Forest on 26 May 1992 .
History
Background

After finding both Harry Potter and Hermione Granger at the top of the Astronomy Tower , Argus Filch escorted them to Minerva McGonagall 's office for punishment, with Minerva deciding they would be serving detention, joined by Draco Malfoy and Neville Longbottom , who were also found out of bed.
Missives were delivered the following morning, notifying them to meet up Filch eleven o'clock that night at the Entrance Hall .
The detention
Firenze speaking to Harry Potter
Filch led the four serving detention to meet up with Rubeus Hagrid , who told them that a unicorn had been injured in the Forbidden Forest and that they were to search for it.

After some initial difficulty with Malfoy's behaviour, Harry, Malfoy, and Hagrid's hound, Fang found the slain unicorn; however, before they could report their discovery to Hagrid, a hooded figure swept down upon them, causing Malfoy and Fang to flee.
Harry was paralysed by fright and the pain in his scar and could not run away.
As Harry collapsed to the ground, he was saved by the centaur Firenze .
Firenze explained to Harry the magical properties of unicorn blood and how the hooded figure was Lord Voldemort .
Hagrid and the others soon appeared and they all returned to the castle.
Notes and references

title: Nagini's venom
paragraphs: The venom produced from the snake -form of the Maledictus , Nagini , was an extremely potent poison that prevented the wounds of the victim from healing.
This would lead to severe blood loss that must be compensated with a Blood-Replenishing Potion , or the blood loss severity would turn fatal .
There was an antidote to it, though this remedy was apparently difficult to find.
The venom was capable of melting stitches , rendering it an ineffective treatment against it.

Though the venom itself was harmful to living beings, it might have also been used as a potion ingredient that granted health benefits for the drinker, albeit the resultant state was so gruesome and miserable that it horrified all who bore witness to it.
History

In 1994 , Death Eater Peter Pettigrew milked the venom from Nagini's fangs and used it, along with unicorn blood , to concoct a dark potion , which allowed Lord Voldemort's shattered soul to regain a rudimentary, but physical form.

This form was very weak, and it greatly inhibited Voldemort's capabilities, but granted him the ability to hold his wand and enough energy to perform sufficient magic , until he could regain his true form .
Until then, Voldemort required the potion every few hours to keep his crippled body alive, and Pettigrew had to continuously milk Nagini for the venom to keep feeding his master.

It was for this reason that Voldemort refused to let Pettigrew escape under the lie to find another wizard for the true rebirth ceremony, as Voldemort himself could not milk Nagini for the venom and concoct the potion.
Arthur Weasley , injured by Nagini's venom

In 1995 , when Nagini was sent by Voldemort to infiltrate the Department of Mysteries , she met up with Arthur Weasley , who was sent by Albus Dumbledore to guard the prophecy , on behalf of the Order of the Phoenix .
Nagini, who sensed Arthur hiding under an Invisibility Cloak , bit him in his chest and injected him with her venom, causing a wound and at the same time preventing his wound from healing.

Arthur was sent to St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries , and was to take a Blood-Replenishing Potion every hour to counter the blood loss that would otherwise cost him his life, but was otherwise fine.
When Arthur was persuaded by trainee Healer Augustus Pye to try the Muggle remedy stitches to seal the wound, the venom melted the stitches, rendering them ineffective.
Eventually, Arthur managed to find an antidote to dispel the venom .
Nagini injecting the venom into Snape's neck, killing him
During the Battle of Hogwarts in 1998 , when Voldemort mistakenly assumed that Severus Snape was the master of the Elder Wand , he ordered Nagini to kill Severus.
The great serpent bit him in the neck, and injecting him with the venom, preventing it from healing (even by magical means), thus leading to Snape's demise.
Notes and references

title: Fang
paragraphs: Fang (b. circa 1984 ) was an over-sized boarhound dog , and one of the pets under Rubeus Hagrid 's ownership and care.
A large dog, he lived with Hagrid in his hut and often accompanied him to places such as the Forbidden Forest .
Fang was present for the majority of the Second Wizarding War , such as the Battle of the Astronomy Tower and the Battle of Hogwarts .
He survived the war and was still alive and well in the late 2000s and early 2010s .
Biography
Early life
Fang as a little puppy, fetching a stick
Fang was born in around 1984 , and became Rubeus Hagrid 's pet by September of the same year.
He was seen as a puppy on the school grounds fetching a stick and bolting down the hill back towards Hagrid's Hut .
In 1985 , Fang was trapped by the same Devil's Snare which Hagrid had rescued Jacob's sibling from the year before.

Hagrid asked them if they could help him with the Devil's Snare, being aware that using the Wand-Lighting Charm would only cause the dangerous plant to retreat further into the room in which it had been placed, placing Fang's life in danger.
Fang relaxing outside his master's hut
Hagrid told Jacob's sibling to help him by brewing a Fire-Breathing Potion .
Hagrid decided not to share what the potion was for, as he was embarrassed about his failure to keep a close enough eye on his pup, and merely recited the ingredients.
Jacob's sibling, Rowan Khanna , Ben Copper , and Penny Haywood eventually made the potion.
Hagrid then told Jacob's sibling why he needed the potion, and they saved Fang from the Devil's Snare by using the potion.
Hagrid then revealed he had not named the puppy yet, and they decided on the name Fang.
At some point during the 1985-1986 school year , Fang became afraid of cats , mostly due to Mrs Norris .
Jacob's sibling, Rowan, Penny, and Minerva McGonagall helped him overcome his fear and prepare for the pet gathering .
During the 1985-1986 school year , Fang was kidnapped by Todd and Corrine Cribb along with many other pets, as they wanted to get revenge on Hagrid for disrupting their poaching activities.
They didn't know specifically which pet was Hagrid's, but managed to capture Fang anyway (who was in the care of Merula Snyde at the time).
When Jacob's sibling and Merula discovered Todd and Corrine, Fang came rushing to their side and was eventually returned to Hagrid.
By September 1986 , Fang enjoyed kipping in the Library and hanging out in the Transfiguration Classroom because he saw a cat in there once, which was actually Minerva McGonagall in Animagus form.
At the beginning of the 1986-1987 school year , Fang went missing when he was scared by a fairy he found in the pumpkin patch by Hagrid's Hut.
Hagrid once again asked Jacob's sibling to help him.
Hagrid then searched the Forbidden Forest , telling them Fang once ran in there and couldn't find the way out.
Fang disguised as a wizard

During the 1990-1991 school year , Jacob's sibling and their friends disguised Fang as a wizard with a pointed wizard's hat and blue shirt to bring him into St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries to visit a bedridden Hagrid, who had been missing him while hospitalised there.
They lied to the hospital staff that Fang was a wizard who had been transfigured into a dog sent in for treatment so he could enter, as animals were not allowed inside the hospital.
Later that school year, Fang found Mrs Norris trapped in the roots of the Hogwarts Whomping Willow .
Fang in the Forbidden Forest with Harry Potter and Draco Malfoy

In 1992 , Fang accompanied first-year students Draco Malfoy and Harry Potter into the Forbidden Forest for a detention , only to run away in fear after encountering a hooded figure drinking blood from a dead unicorn .
After running away, he soon found Hagrid and Hermione Granger , who immediately knew that Draco and Harry were in danger.
In 1993 , Fang accompanied Ron Weasley and Harry to visit Aragog in the Forbidden Forest .
He, Harry, and Ron were nearly eaten by Aragog's children , but they were rescued by the wild Ford Anglia that was previously owned by Ron's father, Arthur Weasley .
Fang and Buckbeak inside Hagrid's hut
Fang was present when Buckbeak was being reviewed by the British Ministry of Magic .
He was seen sulking in his basket during one of the trio's many visits to Hagrid's hut during the 1993-1994 school year .

Fang also shared the hut with Buckbeak after Hagrid moved the hippogriff inside after Lucius Malfoy made his case to the Committee for the Disposal of Dangerous Creatures after Buckbeak attacked his son during a Care of Magical Creatures lesson that resulted in Draco's arm being injured.
In 1994 , Hagrid decided not to take Fang with him to see the dragons kept in the Forbidden Forest with Harry, as he thought he would not like them.

In 1995 , when the trio tried to enter Hagrid's hut and Hagrid initially did not answer due to being upset about Rita Skeeter 's article about him being a half-giant , Fang barked and scratched at the door when they knocked.
Albus Dumbledore , who was with Hagrid, let them in and Hagrid explained to them why he was feeling down.
Later that year, Fang went with Hagrid in order to look for Bartemius Crouch Senior in the Forbidden Forest after Viktor Krum had been found stunned .
Second Wizarding War
In 1996 , after Hagrid had returned to Hogwarts after his mission to the Giant colony , Fang was with him in the hut when the trio visited him to hear of his tale, and was very happy to see them.
Fang also tried to lick Dolores Umbridge 's face when she entered, but she snapped at him to get away and waved her handbag at him.

When Hagrid was attacked by Ministry of Magic Aurors led by Umbridge, Fang was hit by a Stunning Spell when he tried to defend Hagrid, resulting in the responsible party being hurled over ten feet away by an enraged Hagrid.
Hagrid took the stunned Fang with him when he escaped into the mountains.
After Voldemort 's return was made public and Umbridge was sacked, Hagrid and Fang returned to their hut at the edge of the Forbidden Forest.
Fang next to Harry Potter after the funeral of Aragog

Fang was present during the funeral of Aragog " sulking in his basket during the burial " and, afterwards, padded across the floor to Harry Potter and laid his head in his lap before proceeding to slobber all over his robes.
Fang was also inside Hagrid's hut when it was set ablaze by Death Eater Thorfinn Rowle during the Battle of the Astronomy Tower on 30 June 1997 .
He was rescued shortly after when Hagrid and Harry doused the fire with the Water-Making Spell .
It can be assumed that Fang was present at Dumbledore's funeral with Hagrid.
In 1998 , Fang went with Hagrid and Grawp to Hogwarts to help in the defence of the castle .
However, as soon as the fighting began, Fang was startled when a vase nearby was hit by a spell and exploded, and he ran away in fright, with Hagrid going after him immediately.
He survived the battle and continued to live with Hagrid in his hut afterwards.
21st century
During the 2009-2010 school year , Fang went wild after hearing the songs of uncontrolled Fwoopers in Hagrid's Hut .
When a student encountered him, he showed them some teeth before passing out.
Physical description
Fang was described as a giant boarhound with black fur.
He appeared to have heterochromia , with his left eye being light blue and his right pupil orange.
Personality and traits
Fang was a large hound who slobbered constantly.
On several occasions he completely soaked Harry Potter 's robes while laying his head on Harry's lap.
When someone entered Hagrid's hut, he would greet them with loud, booming barks and almost always licking their faces or ears.
He was very protective of Hagrid, but was a "bloody coward".
Fang was a very friendly, affectionate, and sociable dog, and was often very happy to see the trio whenever they came to see Hagrid and him.
He would also try to play with the other animals at Hogwarts, including Fawkes , much to Albus Dumbledore 's amusement.
Fang was very fond of taking baths, although he could only take them when he had the help of another person.
Whenever he went too long without having a bath, he would start to smell of a Bundimun infestation.
Notes and references

title: Boarhound
paragraphs: The boarhound , also known as the Great Dane , is a large breed of dog used historically for hunting wild boars .
Rubeus Hagrid 's pet, Fang , was a boarhound, described as "enormous" and "black".
Notes and references

title: Rubeus Hagrid's pets
paragraphs: Hagrid and Fang
Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry 's Keeper of Keys and Grounds and Care of Magical Creatures professor , Rubeus Hagrid , was commonly known for owning dangerous pets .
Whilst Hagrid had the skill and knowledge to handle these animals, he was kind and had a rather gullible temperament that often caused problems.
Known pets
Fang
Fang
Like Hagrid himself, Fang the boarhound was not nearly as fierce as he looked.
Fang had often been described as a "coward."
Fang accompanied Hermione Granger , Harry Potter , Neville Longbottom , and Draco Malfoy into the Forbidden Forest, along with Hagrid, during a detention in their first year .
Fang also accompanied Harry Potter and Ron Weasley in their second year , when they investigated Hagrid's words to "follow the spiders " to Aragog 's lair.
In 1996 , Fang was stunned by Aurors as he protected Hagrid from being attacked by Dolores Umbridge and her companions, including John Dawlish .

Fang was also trapped in Hagrid's burning cabin during the Death Eaters' assault on Hogwarts in 1997 , but he was unharmed and Hagrid with the help of Harry Potter extinguished the fire with the Water-Making Spell .
After Hagrid went on the run during from Death Eaters in 1998 , Fang went with him.

Before the Battle of Hogwarts started, he was pushed through a window into the castle with Hagrid by Grawp , then ran off when a nearby vase was blasted off its plinth, with Hagrid immediately going after him.
He presumably survived, as his name was not mentioned amongst the casualties, but his exact fate is unknown.
Fluffy
Fluffy
A giant three-headed dog.
Purchased from a "Greek chappie" in a pub, Hagrid lent Fluffy to Albus Dumbledore in 1991 to help protect the Philosopher's Stone .
Hagrid revealed that Fluffy could be calmed and put to sleep by music.
It was this slip of the lip that allowed Professor Quirrell , Harry, Hermione, and Ron to all get past Fluffy and into the hall where the Philosopher's Stone was hidden.
Norbert
Norbert(a)
A Norwegian Ridgeback dragon .
Hagrid won Norbert's egg from a hooded man at the Hog's Head during a card game.

As dragon breeding was outlawed by the Warlocks' Convention of 1709 , Hagrid could not legally keep Norbert, and had the dragon taken away by Charlie Weasley and his colleagues to the Romanian Dragon Sanctuary .
Norwegian Ridgebacks breathe fire .
Nesting mothers breathe on them to keep them warm, explaining why Hagrid kept the egg in a pot over the fireplace in his home, even in warm weather.
A pet dragon such as this one, once it hatches, should be fed brandy mixed with chicken's blood.
After Norbert was taken into Charles Weasley 's care, the dragon was mentioned only in passing.
In 1997, Charlie revealed to Hagrid that Norbert was actually a female, and had been renamed "Norberta".
Acromantulas
Aragog
An enormous talking Acromantula , Aragog's egg came into Hagrid's possession when Hagrid was a student at Hogwarts.
The spider hatched and was hidden at the school in a cupboard; he never saw any other part of the castle.
Hagrid was eventually forced to set Aragog free when his presence in the school became worrisome and Aragog was framed for causing Myrtle Warren 's death.
Even then, Hagrid was expelled and Aragog made a den deep in the Forbidden Forest.
Hagrid eventually provided Aragog with a mate, Mosag , and together they had many offspring.
Aragog met Harry and Ron in 1993, when Hagrid was briefly taken into custody at Azkaban for allegedly opening the Chamber of Secrets .
It was through Aragog's explanation of events that Harry and Ron learned Hagrid was innocent of those charges.
Aragog died in the spring of 1997 of old age.
The Acromantulas living in Aragog's den tried to prevent Hagrid from removing the body from the Forbidden Forest; Hagrid managed to escape, intent upon giving the Acromantula a proper burial.
Professor Horace Slughorn attended the funeral for the sole purpose of procuring some of Aragog's venom, which he felt he could sell for a hundred Galleons a pint.
It was because of these events leading up to Aragog's funeral that Harry, under the influence of Felix Felicis , managed to secure Slughorn's memory regarding Voldemort and Horcruxes .
Mosag was a female Acromantula that Hagrid brought to Aragog as a potential mate.
Aragog and Mosag founded a large Acromantula colony in the Forbidden Forest .
Hippogriffs
Buckbeak
A steel-grey-coloured Hippogriff .
Buckbeak was introduced in 1993 , in Hagrid's first Care of Magical Creatures teaching assignment as one of thirteen Hippogriffs.
It was during this class that Buckbeak injured Draco Malfoy .
Through the influence of Lucius Malfoy , Buckbeak was sentenced to death by the Ministry of Magic , to be carried out in the coming spring.
However, he was rescued by Harry and Hermione, through the use of the Time-Turner .
Buckbeak then joined Sirius Black , aiding his escape from custody at Hogwarts.
The two of them relocated to an unknown country.
When Sirius returned in 1994 , during the events surrounding the Triwizard Tournament , he brought Buckbeak with him.
Buckbeak stayed with Sirius in a cave in the mountains around Hogsmeade .
Buckbeak appeared again at 12 Grimmauld Place in the spring of 1995 .
At some point, Buckbeak was injured by Sirius' house-elf Kreacher ; when Harry attempted to contact Sirius through the Floo Network, Sirius was tending to Buckbeak's injuries.
After Sirius' death, Harry inherited Buckbeak's companionship, along with Sirius' material possessions.
Harry, in turn, returned Buckbeak (rechristened "Witherwings" to protect his identity; Buckbeak was supposed to be a fugitive of the law) to Hagrid's care.
During the Death Eaters' attack on Hogwarts in the early summer of 1997, Buckbeak protected Harry from Severus Snape .
During the Battle of Hogwarts , Buckbeak and a congregation of Thestrals attacked Voldemort 's giants , pecking at their eyes.
In 1993 , Hagrid showed thirteen other Hippogriffs to the third year students in his Care of Magical Creatures class.
Flobberworms
In the 1993-1994 school year , after Malfoy was injured, Hagrid used Flobberworms in teaching.
Blast-Ended Skrewt
The Blast-Ended Skrewt was a magical hybrid beast bred by Rubeus Hagrid in the autumn of 1994 , by cross-breeding Manticores and Fire Crabs .
Whether Hagrid used magic or somehow got the two different species to mate was unknown.
Thestrals
One of the Hogwarts Thestrals
Hagrid raised and trained a herd of Thestrals to pull the Hogwarts Carriages .
The herd started out with one male and five females, with Tenebrus as the first to be bred.
They were trained not to attack owls .
Hagrid introduced his fifth-year Care of Magical Creatures class to the herd, although only three students were able to see them.
Egg Creature
This creature was owned by Hagrid during 1994 ; he hid it under a tea towel when the Minister for Magic Cornelius Fudge came.
Flitterby Moths
Hagrid once owned a flock of Flitterby Moths which escaped his garden and flew into the Training Grounds .
Harry Potter was given the challenge by Rolanda Hooch to catch them.
Crup pups
Niffler
Mooncalves
By the 21st century , Hagrid owned a herd of Mooncalves , one of whom was called Borklump .
Occamy
By the 21st century , Hagrid owned an Occamy .

title: Fire-Breathing Potion
paragraphs: The Fire-Breathing Potion was a dangerous potion that could make a person breathe fire .
History
In the 1985-1986 school year , Rubeus Hagrid asked Jacob's sibling for help brewing this potion to free his puppy from a Devil's Snare .
When Jacob's sibling asked Severus Snape to teach them how to make it, the Potions Master reluctantly permitted them to observe as he brewed some for his potions stores.

While brewing it, he stated that the powdered horn of a Romanian Longhorn was an extremely valuable and versatile ingredient, and warned Jacob's sibling from using the fire-breathing potion recklessly, and preferably not at all, informing them that the fluid was, once finished, "highly volatile, and has been known to melt flesh to the bone."
However, as Hagrid had already informed Jacob's sibling beforehand, mint had naturally healing and cooling properties, allowing the drinker to consume it without melting their tongue.
Notes and references

title: Pet gathering
paragraphs: The pet gathering was held by Rubeus Hagrid during the 1985-1986 school year to gather pets owned by Hogwarts students and staff.
History
Before the gathering, a student and their friends helped Fang overcome his fear of cats , a fear likely caused by Mrs Norris .
Interacting with the student's cat and Professor McGonagall in her Animagus form allowed Fang to become more comfortable around cats.
This gave him the courage to stand up to Mrs Norris when they confronted each other.
Notes and references

title: Corrine Cribb
paragraphs: Corrine Cribb was a Dark witch with an interest in magical beasts .

Although she and her husband had been caught many times doing illegal acts, to the point where Jacob's sibling wondered why they weren't in Azkaban , Corrine and her husband, Todd Cribb , managed to avoid going to Azkaban for their many crimes, as Corrine had friends in the Ministry , who usually went easy on them.
Biography
Early life
She attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in her youth, where she met Todd Cribb .
The pair fell in love and together they discovered a hidden location within the Forbidden Forest , which they would sneak off from class to visit.
At some point, Corrine married Todd, and the pair engaged in criminal enterprises.
During their life of crime, Corrine managed to earn a reputation as a Dark witch , unlike Todd.
Chinese Fireball
Corrine threatening Rubeus Hagrid

At some point in the 1980s , she threatened Rubeus Hagrid that she would ask the owner of a female Chinese Fireball to sell the dragon to her, because she wanted to make a dragon-skin coat out of her.
Corrine swearing vegeance against Hagrid for having foiled her plans on the Training Grounds

Cribb's desire to purchase the dragon failed, thankfully, since Jacob's sibling and Penny Haywood managed to cure her inability to breathe fire with an altered Pepperup Potion , leaving Cribb very angry that she would no longer be able to buy the dragon from its owner.
She swore revenge against Hagrid, but Hagrid later told the two students that her "bark was worse than her bite", and that she would be burned if she tried to capture the dragon herself.
1985-1986 school year

During the 1985-1986 school year , Corrine and Todd Cribb tried to kidnap Fang from Rubeus Hagrid as revenge for Hagrid stopping their poaching activities, however they were unable determine which pets belonged to Hagrid, so kidnapped all pets in the vicinity .
Corrine and her husband did this under an Invisibility Cloak so they wouldn't be followed, but they were able to be followed by the trail of birdseed , tung oil , and Demiguise hair that they left.
Jacob's sibling and Merula Snyde confronted the pair and defeated them in a duel, after which they Disapparated to an unknown location.
Cribb being apprehended by Jacob's sibling and Holly Blackbird
At some point, MACUSA employee Holly Blackbird caught Cribb trying to sneak into a Hodag reserve in Wisconsin .
Cribb lured a Hodag that was being kept by Hagrid with Mooncalf Essence into the Forest Grove of the Forbidden Forest so she could take its horns as a prized potion ingredient.
Jacob's sibling apprehended her and duelled her, but Cribb Disapparated with the Hodag.

Jacob's sibling then informed Blackbird and Hagrid of her theft, and Blackbird and Jacob's sibling found her in the Magical Creatures Reserve with the Hodag, upon which Blackbird defeated and incapacitated her.
Physical description
She looked like a middle-aged woman in the late 1980s .
She wore all black.
She had dark coloured eyes and black hair with two strands of grey hair made into a bun.
Personality and traits

According to Rubeus Hagrid, Corrine Cribb was a cruel and callous witch with a disregard for both people and animals, as shown with her sadistic desire to have a dragon skinned alive simply to make a coat from its skin.
She also saw no problem with threatening other individuals.
However, Hagrid acknowledged that her "bark was worse than her bite", implying her threats were often empty.
Magical abilities and skills
