title: One Hundred Historical Sites from the Second Wizarding War
paragraphs: One Hundred Historical Sites from the Second Wizarding War was a travel guide published following the end of the Second Wizarding War , and detailed various locations significant to Lord Voldemort 's second rise to power .
The Burrow was mentioned in this book as an important place during the war.
History
Written at some point after 2 May 1998 , this travel guide would eventually hit number seventeen on the Daily Prophet 's bestseller list.
Notes and references

title: Kingsley Shacklebolt's house
paragraphs: Kingsley Shacklebolt's house was located somewhere in England and was the residence of Kingsley Shacklebolt , Auror and later Minister for Magic of wizarding Britain .
History
Second Wizarding War
As Kingsley was a member of the Order of the Phoenix , he allowed his home to be used as one of the Order's safehouses.
In late July of 1997 , it was one of the locations Order members retreated to after the Battle of the Seven Potters .
Notes and references

title: Tonks house
paragraphs: The Tonks house was the home of Edward and Andromeda Tonks .
Their daughter Nymphadora Tonks presumably grew up there, as well as resided there during her pregnancy from late 1997 to early 1998 .
It would later become the home to her orphaned son, Edward Lupin .
History
Prior to the Second Wizarding War

The Tonks house was either the home of Ted Tonks when he was younger, or was purchased by him after he married Andromeda, who came to live in the house sometime before late 1972 at the approximate age of 20
Second Wizarding War
Although neither Ted nor Andromeda were members of the Order of the Phoenix , their daughter was, and they allowed their home to be used as one of the Order's safehouses.
In late July of 1997 , it was one of the locations Order members fled to after the Battle of the Seven Potters .
Harry Potter and Rubeus Hagrid went to the Tonkses' home, where the former was patched up by Ted and the latter by Andromeda.
They then took a Portkey to The Burrow .
Soon afterwards, Lord Voldemort took over the Ministry of Magic , and Ted and Andromeda were both interrogated and tortured by Death Eaters for information.

Ted was soon forced to go on the run, as the prosecution of Muggle-borns began with the Ministry requiring that they register with the Muggle-Born Registration Commission , which imprisoned innocents in Azkaban for allegedly stealing magic from "real" wizards and witches.
Ted refused to register on principle and was soon a fugitive.
His wife stayed behind because their daughter , recently wed to Remus Lupin , became pregnant and, as a Pureblood, Andromeda wasn't in danger of being killed.
Ted was eventually killed by Snatchers , and his grandson was named in his memory.

When news arrived that the Order and Dumbledore's Army were making their final stand against the Death Eaters at Hogwarts on 2 May, 1998 , Nymphadora Tonks left her family home to go fight beside her husband, leaving her newborn son in Andromeda's care.
Teddy was rendered an orphan, as his mother and father were killed in battle by Bellatrix Lestrange and Antonin Dolohov , respectively.
Teddy was raised by his grandmother in the Tonks House but frequently visited his godfather, Harry Potter and family.
Notes and references

title: Adversary
paragraphs: An Adversary was a special type of particularly aggressive Foundable that manifested itself in the world during the Calamity .

Members of the Statute of Secrecy Task Force found dealing these types of Foundables very challenging, since they were magically stronger than normal Foundables, and they usually took the form of powerful wizards and creatures from the history of the wizarding world .
Notes and references

title: Pigwidgeon
paragraphs: Pigwidgeon (fl.
1994 - 1997 ), also known as Pig or Piggy , was Ron Weasley 's first pet owl .
He was a miniature scops owl .
Pig was responsible for the handling of Ron's mail starting in 1994.
He was a gift from Sirius Black after the loss of Ron's pet rat .
Biography

After Scabbers , Ron's old pet rat, disappeared (having been found out to be Peter Pettigrew ), Sirius Black , who felt partly responsible for Ron's loss of a pet, sent him Pigwidgeon (nicknamed "Pig").
Upon receiving the owl, Ron (to the surprise of Harry and Hermione ) actually let Crookshanks sniff him to check if he really was an owl.
Pigwidgeon was named by Ginny Weasley , because she thought the name was cute.
Though Ron tried to change it, the owl would not answer to another name.
Pigwidgeon was exceedingly hyper, loud, bothersome, very small, and had been known to be a show off for other people (this, however, annoyed other owls, forcing Ron to keep him in his room).
Ron Weasley 's new pet Pigwidgeon
Pigwidgeon was described by Harry as resembling a "fluffy snitch ".
He was usually excited for a job to deliver letters, even though most of the time they were usually heavy for him.
Harry borrowed Pigwidgeon during the Triwizard Tournament to communicate with Sirius who was in hiding at the time.
Fred and George Weasley also asked to borrow him in order to support their secretive business venture.
Pigwidgeon was occasionally known to hang around the stairways performing for students.
This prompted Ron to call him a "stupid little feathery git" for his attempts to show off rather than promptly bringing Ron the letters.
He also delivered food to Sirius when he was hiding in a cave in Hogsmeade , though not without the help of Hogwarts owls, as the food was quite heavy.

Pigwidgeon travelled with Ron to and from Hogwarts during his years in school, although he stayed at The Burrow when Ron skipped his final year at Hogwarts to accompany Harry and Hermione on the hunt for Horcruxes .
During the 2020s , Pigwidgeon appeared as a Foundable during the Calamity .
Volunteer members of the Statute of Secrecy Task Force were able to return him to his original time.
Etymology
Pigwidgeon means "small" or "petty" and also can be spelled pigwidgin or pigwiggin .
It combines "pig" with "widgeon", two species of duck found in North America and Europe, or "pigeon", another name for the rock dove.
English author and poet Michael Drayton (1563-1631) had a male fairy named Pigwiggen in his comical poem "Nimphidia".
Notes and references

title: Scops owl
paragraphs: The scops owl , also called scops-owl, is the second-smallest type of owl in the world, the smallest being the elf owl.
Scops owls might be sold at Eeylops Owl Emporium in Diagon Alley .
A scops owl was one possible corporeal form of the Patronus Charm .
History
In the 1989-1990 school year , Jacob's sibling spotted what they thought to be a scops owl in the Owlery while looking for a white owl with Talbott Winger .
This kind of owl was present in the Hogsmeade Post Office, making " LOCAL DELIVERIES ONLY ".
Ron Weasley owned a small scops owl, Pigwidgeon , since 1994 .
Notes and references

title: Scouring Charm
paragraphs: The Scouring Charm ( Scourgify ) was a cleaning charm used for washing things.
It could also be used to clean out smaller bundimun infestations.
This spell was listed in the third chapter of Book of Spells by Miranda Goshawk .
Many wizarding families used this spell, both for cleaning and punishing people who swore, as the spell caused human mouths to be filled with soap.
This spell was also one of the few methods of effectively cleaning the teeth of a Leucrotta , as they disliked having their teeth touched with a brush.
History
James Potter used this charm to bully Severus Snape on the Hogwarts grounds, causing soap to fill his mouth.
In the 1987-1988 school year , this charm was taught to the fourth-years in Charms class by Professor Filius Flitwick .
Jacob's sibling later used the Scouring Charm to clean up Bundimun Secretion in Rubeus Hagrid 's hut and used it the following year to help clean the teeth of a Leucrotta they had befriended.
Hermione Granger taught Neville Longbottom the Scouring Charm to clean frog guts out from under his fingernails in their fourth year .
The Scouring Charm was used by Nymphadora Tonks when attempting to clean Hedwig 's cage during their liberation of Harry Potter from 4 Privet Drive in 1995 .
The spell had only a minimal effect and Tonks admitted that she had never quite gotten the hang of "household-y" spells of this type.
It was later used by Ginevra Weasley on 1 September that year on the Hogwarts Express to clear Stinksap that had squirted from Neville's Mimbulus mimbletonia .

During the Calamity in the late 2010s or early 2020s , Gethsemane Prickle "visited" a Calamity Investigator working for the Statute of Secrecy Task Force and was so offended that their cauldron failed to meet Ministry cleanliness guidelines that she spent the next forty-two minutes forcing them to practise the Scouring Charm while relentlessly lecturing them.
To the investigator's chagrin, these cleaning methods reduced the brewing time for all of their potions.
Known practitioners
Etymology
Perhaps related to English scour , "clean".
-ify is a common English suffix meaning "to make ...".
Therefore scourgify likely means "to make clean".
Notes and references

title: Skurge Charm
paragraphs: The Skurge Charm ( Skurge ) was a charm that could be used to clean up the sticky green ectoplasm created by passing ghosts .
It could also be used to frighten spirits , such as the aforementioned ghosts , as well as poltergeists .
It was not be confused with the more versatile Scouring Charm .
History
The Skurge Charm was invented sometime after 1492 .
Before its invention, wizards and witches had to use shovels to get rid of ectoplasm .
This was a rather basic spell , as it was taught by Professor Filius Flitwick to second-year Charms students at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .
It was also included in The Standard Book of Spells, Grade 2 by Miranda Goshawk , as well as another spellbook that could be found in the Hogwarts Library .
Practitioners
Notes and references

title: Cleaning spell
paragraphs: A cleaning spell is a generic term for a charm used to make an object cleaner, such as the Scouring Charm , Wiping Spell or Skurge Scouring Charm .
Ronald Weasley did not know many, if any, cleaning spells.
History
In the 1885 , the wizard Albert Tillyman was forced to learn cleaning and darning spells after his wife Violet left him, resulting in their house becoming extremely dirty.

In the summer of 1996 whilst at The Burrow , Ron Weasley recommended that Harry Potter use the Levitation Charm to throw some old cauldrons filled with Love Potion residue that Fred and George had left in The Burrow 's garage in a nearby pond, rather than clean them out by hand as his mother requested.
Hermione pointed out that if Ron would merely learn some cleaning spells, he could have saved himself the hassle.
Notes and references

title: Leucrotta
paragraphs: Leucrottas were large, cloven hooved magical beasts that resembled moose in appearance.
Description
Leucrottas resembled large moose with very long, jagged antlers and an impossibly huge mouth in respect to their head and face.
Some believed that they were "half- hyena and half- lion ," while others believed they were "part-moose."
They were capable of stretching their jaws wide enough that a full-grown human could fit inside.
They were capable of mimicing and repeating sounds and voices around them.
They also strongly disliked their teeth being touched, which could pose a problem when trying to brush their teeth.
Their teeth could most easily be cleaned with the Scouring Charm .
Leucrottas were omnivorous, eating both small animals, such as Nifflers and pixies , and fruits and vegetables.
They were known to have a distinct preference for pumpkins .
History
In 1927 , Newton Scamander owned a Leucrotta which he kept in his basement in 9 Sherringford Square along with various other magical beasts.
One day, Bunty Broadacre was giving the Leucrotta dental care when Newt entered the basement.
In the 1980s and early 1990s , Jacob's sibling took care of a Leucrotta in the Magical Creatures Reserve .

At some point between 1984 and 1991 , Newt sent a a male Leucrotta to Professor Silvanus Kettleburn at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry from London , as he had trouble with cleaning the beast's teeth.
Kettleburn tasked Jacob's sibling with cleaning the Leucrotta's teeth.

Jacob's sibling failed to find anything in the Hogwarts Library that helped them with their problem, but they realised that the Scouring Charm would work, since the beast did not like his teeth being touched.
The Leucrotta's teeth were cleaned and he was allowed to remain at Hogwarts after Newt was made aware of the bond he had formed with Jacob's sibling.
After graduating from Hogwarts, Liz Tuttle spent time living with a pack of Leucrottas as part of a conservation assignment for her job as a Magizoologist .
Newt's Leucrotta from 9 Sherringford Square became a Foundable during the Calamity which affected the wizarding world in the late 2010s /early 2020s .
It had to be returned by members of the Statute of Secrecy Task Force to its original place in Newt's menagerie, being recorded in a Foundable registry called " Exploration ".
Notes and references

title: Bundimun Secretion
paragraphs: Bundimun Secretion or Bundimun Ooze was a magical substance, produced by the Bundimun , known to be an extremely acidic substance that could rot a building's structure.
It could also harm those who come into contact with it.
When diluted, the secretions of the Bundimun were known to be used in some magical cleaning products .
It was also an ingredient in Doxycide .
Notes and references

title: Mr Leucrotta
paragraphs: Mr Leucrotta was a male Leucrotta who lived in the 1980s .
Biography
During the 1988-1989 school year , Mr Leucrotta lived in London as one of the many magical beasts tamed by Newt Scamander .
However, despite Newt's skill, Mr Leucrotta refused to open his jaws to allow Newt or Bunty Broadacre to clean his teeth, rendering his food unpalatable.
Unsure of what was troubling the Leucrotta, Newt contacted his close friend, Professor Silvanus Kettleburn , who brought Mr Leucrotta to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .

However, finding himself still unable to convince the beast to allow him to clean his teeth and desiring to keep his current prosthetic limbs intact, Kettleburn attempted to contact Rubeus Hagrid for assistance, as the half-giant was big and strong enough to open the Leucrotta's mouth without losing a limb.
Although Hagrid agreed to help out, he had to travel to Hogsmeade for the day and would be unable to help clean Mr Leucrotta's teeth until he returned.
In the meantime, Kettleburn contacted one of his Care of Magical Creatures students, Jacob's sibling , and informed them of the situation.
Kettleburn asked Jacob's sibling to help him keep Mr Leucrotta busy until Hagrid returned, to which they agreed.
Kettleburn informed Jacob's sibling that Mr Leucrotta was currently in the Forest at the Magical Creatures Reserve and asserted that the beast was in good hands with Jacob's sibling.

However, while acknowledging their understanding of Leucrottas from befriending another one at the reserve, he warned them that their large mouths could be dangerous and that they had several other magical abilities that he had no time to explain properly.
Understanding the risks, Jacob's sibling accepted the challenge and travelled to the Forest to meet Mr Leucrotta.
Upon arriving at the Forest at the Magical Creatures Reserve, Jacob's sibling encountered Mr Leucrotta and Barnaby Lee , who had also come to visit the beast.
After speculating as to why Mr Leucrotta was acting so crankily, Jacob's sibling informed Barnaby of the situation.
Barnaby seemed saddened that Mr Leucrotta would have to suffer until Hagrid returned.

Jacob's sibling hoped that they could cheer the beast up sooner rather than later, to which Barnaby suggested that they should get to know the Leucrotta better in order to determine what was bothering it.
After attempting to approach Mr Leucrotta, the two found that the Leucrotta would allow them to approach and was friendly towards them, but still refused to open his mouth for them.
Barnaby commiserated with Mr Leucrotta, claiming that he didn't enjoy brushing either and understood why the beast was trying to avoid it.
Suddenly, Mr Leucrotta perfectly mimicked Barnaby's statement, surprising both him and Jacob's sibling.
Realising that the beast had the ability to perfectly mimic human voices, Jacob's sibling suggested that this might have been one of the beast's special magical abilities.
Mr Leucrotta finally opened his mouth in front of the pair, with Barnaby attempting to approach in order to lean inside.
However, the beast quickly snapped his jaws shut before Barnaby could get too close, although Barnaby was able to see that Mr Leucrotta's teeth looked quite dirty.
Barnaby suggested that Mr Leucrotta was attempting to tell them that his teeth needed to be cleaned, with Jacob's sibling further suggesting that the beast might have sensitive teeth.

Still unsure of why this might be the case, Jacob's sibling decided to research grooming animals further in the Hogwarts Library to find out more, with Barnaby deciding to stay in the Forest to watch over Mr Leucrotta.
Jacob's sibling sent an owl to Tulip Karasu asking her to meet them in the library and to gather books on grooming animals to help them with their research.

Jacob's sibling was surprised to see that Tulip had brought another student with her, with Tulip introducing them as her friend, Kelly , who had been with her when she received Jacob's sibling's owl and asked to tag along in hopes of riling up Madam Irma Pince .
The three attempted to find any information that might help them with their problem, although they were unsuccessful.
Kelly suggested filling Mr Leucrotta's mouth with funny-tasting soap as a prank to show it not to be afraid of a toothbrush, but Jacob's sibling rejected this idea.
However, Jacob's sibling then realised that the Scouring Charm could work, as long as they could perform it without climbing inside the beast's mouth.
Suddenly, Barnaby arrived in the library with Mr Leucrotta, explaining that the pair had become bored waiting and that the beast was still hungry.
Jacob's sibling was distressed, as Pince had forbidden creatures from the library and was already in a foul mood.
However, Kelly disagreed, claiming that Pince was "just a huffy, uptight witch with a bad attitude and an even worse hat."
Tulip attempted to quiet Kelly, fearing that Pince would hear them, but the librarian seemed to have missed their comment, relieving everyone.
However, Mr Leucrotta suddenly loudly mimicked Kelly's comment, catching the attention of Pince, who demanded that whoever had made the comment stay where they were so she could punish them.
Although everyone else managed to escape, Jacob's sibling was left behind and confronted by Pince, who blamed them for making the offensive remark.
Although Jacob's sibling claimed that Kelly had truly made the remark, Pince claimed that she had heard it twice and that the second time was quite clear.
Jacob's sibling stated that the repetition of the remark was due to a Leucrotta and its ability to replicate voices, but Pince did not believe them and gave them detention.
Jacob's sibling met up with Barnaby and Mr Leucrotta on the Training Grounds , where Barnaby apologised to Jacob's sibling for having gotten them into trouble.

Despite the new setback, Jacob's sibling and Barnaby still planed to try to use the Scouring Charm to clean Mr Leucrotta's teeth, with Barnaby suggesting that, afterwards, Jacob's sibling should bring the beast to meet Madam Pince, hoping to get them out of detention.

After convincing Mr Leucrotta that they would clean his teeth using the Scouring Charm rather than a toothbrush, the beast finally opened his mouth and allowed Jacob's sibling to use the charm, successfully cleaning his teeth.

However, when Jacob's sibling asked Mr Leucrotta to accompany them back to the library to help them apologise to Pince, the beast suddenly ran away, with Barnaby suggesting that he may have gotten the beast too excited for his first meal in a while.

Desiring not to disappoint Kettleburn by failing to watch over Mr Leucrotta after having already disappointed Madam Pince, Jacob's sibling and Barnaby decided to follow the beast to see where he had fled.

Jacob's sibling and Barnaby located Mr Leucrotta in the Forest Grove in the Forbidden Forest , finding the beast attempting to forage for food while being harassed by a flock of pixies , which Jacob's sibling feared the Leucrotta could eat if they weren't careful.

Barnaby realised that the beast seemed to get crankier the harder it tried to catch something to eat, with Jacob's sibling suggesting that they should distract Mr Leucrotta until the pixies lost interest before figuring out something else to feed him.
The pair successfully managed to distract Mr Leucrotta, with the pixie flock finally leaving the beast alone.
However, the two still needed to figure out a plan to feed the beast, with Jacob's sibling suggesting that they should find something less skittish.

Jacob's sibling and Barnaby decided that they should feed the beast with fruits and vegetables, as they would not run away and were delicious enough to sustain the creature, to which Mr Leucrotta consented.
In order to find some fruits and vegetables, Jacob's sibling decided to lead Mr Leucrotta to Hagrid's Garden .
Upon arriving at Hagrid's Garden, Jacob's sibling and Mr Leucrotta met up with Hagrid, who commended Jacob's sibling on being able to clean the beast's teeth without sustaining any injuries.
After explaining how they managed to clean Mr Leucrotta's teeth, Jacob's sibling asked Hagrid if they could feed the hungry beast with some of the pumpkins from his garden, to which Hagrid agreed.
After feeding Mr Leucrotta and finally filling his stomach.
Mr Leucrotta allowed Jacob's sibling to pet him, revealing the close bond they had formed.

With Mr Leucrotta now fed, Jacob's sibling informed Hagrid about their situation with Madam Pince and their idea to have her meet with the Leucrotta so that she could understand their innocence and cancel their detention.

Knowing that they would have to talk to her soon, Hagrid assured them that Pince would listen to reason and agreed to ask her to meet Jacob's sibling and Mr Leucrotta in the Care of Magical Creatures classroom to hear their case.
Once Madam Pince arrived at the Care of Magical Creatures classroom, Professor Kettleburn sent an owl to Jacob's sibling to inform them that she was ready to meet.
Jacob's sibling arrived to find Pince, Kettleburn, Barnaby, and Mr Leucrotta waiting for them.
Kettleburn commended Jacob's sibling for helping him out with Mr Leucrotta, while Jacob's sibling explained to Pince that she had heard the Leucrotta's voice repeating the offensive remark.

Pince asserted that bringing a creature into the library was still against the rules, but Barnaby claimed that the situation was his fault, as he was too eager to help the beast get his teeth cleaned.
While Pince initially believed that the pair were making up their story, Kettleburn assured her that he had indeed asked Jacob's sibling to watch over Mr Leucrotta.
Pince was still furious about the offensive remark, but Jacob's sibling and Kettleburn convinced her to give Jacob's sibling one final chance to explain themselves.

Jacob's sibling and Barnaby were successfully able to convince Pince that Jacob's sibling hadn't made the offensive remark and that, while they couldn't get Kelly to confess, there truly was a Leucrotta in the library.
Jacob's sibling apologised for breaking the rule against bringing creatures into the library and allowing Mr Leucrotta to repeat the rude remark, claiming that no one deserved to be treated badly.
Mr Leucrotta repeated this statement, finally revealing to Pince that the Leucrotta could indeed perfectly replicate voices.
Now satisfied, Pince claimed that she had jumped to conclusions and apologised to Jacob's sibling, cancelling their detention.

Pince asserted that she should have investigated further rather than just reacting based on her original impression, with Kettleburn agreeing that this was a good rule for all to follow and Mr Leucrotta repeating this statement.

Kettleburn revealed that, as it was clear that Mr Leucrotta had bonded with Jacob's sibling, Newt had decided to allow him to remain at Hogwarts, greatly pleasing Jacob's sibling, who assured Kettleburn that they would give him regular teeth cleanings and feed him plenty of pumpkins.

Pince suggested that Jacob's sibling should also help Mr Leucrotta try to keep better company in the future, with Jacob's sibling asserting that, despite the beast's big mouth, they would help him learn when to keep it shut.
Notes and references

title: Ectoplasm
paragraphs: Ectoplasm was a sticky, viscous green substance left behind by ghosts and other spirits that accumulates over time.
Description
Ectoplasm blocking a door
Ectoplasm was strong enough to act as a powerful adhesive (making a loud churning sound when doing so), but it also harmed humans should they come into contact with it, making it a hazard to them.
This could prove to be a great annoyance, as it was typically found blocking doorways.
Wizards subsequently generally treated ectoplasm as unwanted filth.
History
In the Middle Ages , ectoplasm was typically removed by shovelling it elsewhere.

Fortunately, some time after 1492 , ectoplasm could be cleaned using more convenient methods, such as Mrs Skower's All-Purpose Magical Mess Remover , or for the more magically inclined, the Skurge Charm .
Notes and references

title: Spanish
paragraphs: An advertisement for a series of Spanish instruction CDs from a 1995 issue of the Daily Express
Spanish is a Latin language which originated in the Castile region of Spain .
It is spoken natively by hundreds of millions of people throughout the world.
History
In the summer of 1995 , the Daily Express promoted an eight-disc set of instructional CDs , which promised to teach Spanish in one week with "no books" and "no writing."
The newspaper included a voucher in one issue that readers could use to pick up a free copy of Part Four of the set.
It also offered the complete series by post, which was valued at £70.

An advertisement for a magic translator's services that appeared in the classified section of an issue of the Quibbler listed several languages available for translation, including the "Latin languages," which presumably included Spanish.
Notes and references

title: Ginevra Weasley's wand
paragraphs: Ginny Weasley's wand was made of yew wood with an unknown length and core material.
History
Ginny conjuring a horse Patronus with her wand
Like most wizards and witches in Great Britain , Ginny likely purchased it at the age of eleven before beginning her education at Hogwarts in 1992 .
She was able to perform powerful magic with her wand , such as casting a masterful Bat-Bogey Hex , and a fully corporeal Patronus in the shape of a horse .

Ginny also wielded this wand in many battles of the Second Wizarding War such as: the Battle of the Department of Mysteries , the Battle of the Astronomy Tower , and the Battle of Hogwarts where she duelled Bellatrix Lestrange with Hermione and Luna .
Notes and references

title: George Weasley's wand
paragraphs: George Weasley 's wand was of an unknown length , wood and core material.
History
George Weasley was a powerful and gifted wizard along with his brother Fred , and was able to perform a wide variety of magic with his wand , from charms , Transfiguration and martial magic .
He was also capable of conjuring a fully corporeal Patronus in the form of a Magpie .

During the 1995-1996 school year , George became a loyal member of Dumbledore's Army , and would have learned how to cast various defensive and offensive spells under Harry Potter 's masterful Defence Against the Dark Arts teaching.
On 2 May 1998 , George used his wand to fight during the Battle of Hogwarts .
Together with Lee Jordan , George was able to duel and defeat Yaxley .
Notes and references

title: Ginevra Weasley's broomstick
paragraphs: Ginevra Weasley had an unknown broomstick which she used for Quidditch during her years at Hogwarts .
History
In 1996 , Ginny auditioned for Quidditch tryouts using this broom.
She managed to become a Chaser, and during Keeper tryouts, her shot nearly went in but was caught by her brother Ronald Weasley .
During the various matches in that year, she played on this broom and managed to help Gryffindor win matches.
Notes and references

title: Ginevra Weasley's bedroom
paragraphs: Ginny Weasley 's bedroom was the room in which Ginny used as her bedroom.
This was her bedroom while she lived at the Burrow during her childhood.
It was located on the first floor landing, above the kitchen and below Fred and George Weasley 's bedroom.
Description
The room was described as small, but had a good view of the orchard where the Weasleys played Quidditch .

The walls were painted pink and were decorated with a poster of Gwenog Jones , the Beater and Captain for the Holyhead Harpies (a team that Ginny herself later played for), as well as a poster of the Weird Sisters , a popular band in the Wizarding World .
History
Ginny in her bedroom
On the many occasions when Harry came to the Burrow to spend the holidays, his brief encounters with Ginny generally involved her becoming flustered and retreating to her bedroom.
On 31 July , 1997 , the morning of Harry's seventeenth birthday , Ginny took Harry into her bedroom for the first time, though they had spent very little time alone together since their break-up.
They briefly discussed Harry leaving Hogwarts and going on the run with Ron and Hermione, then shared a kiss , which was intentionally interrupted by Ginny's older brother Ron .
When Harry left the room, he suspected that Ginny was crying-- something she was rarely known to do.
Whenever Hermione Granger visited the Burrow (usually during the summer holidays), she slept in Ginny's bedroom.
Notes and references

title: Harry Potter's seventeenth birthday
paragraphs: A party was held at The Burrow in Devon , England for Harry Potter 's seventeenth birthday on 31 July 1997 .

The party took place days after the Order of the Phoenix removed Harry from his relative 's home , battling Death Eaters in the process and the day before the wedding of Bill Weasley and Fleur Delacour was held at the Burrow.
The party was interrupted by the arrival of Minister for Magic Rufus Scrimgeour , who wanted Harry to support the British Ministry of Magic during the Second Wizarding War .
History
Background
Harry Potter lived with his maternal relatives, the Dursley family , after his father and mother were murdered by Lord Voldemort on 31 October 1981 .

Because his aunt Petunia Dursley is the older sister of Harry's mother, whose loving sacrifice protected him from Voldemort's Killing Curse , Harry was protected by ancient magic while he lived with his aunt.
The seven Potters
This protection would expire when Harry became an adult in the wizarding world, on his seventeenth birthday of 31 July 1997 .
The Order of the Phoenix and the Death Eaters were both aware of this.
Thus, the Death Eaters manipulated the British Ministry of Magic to cut off Harry's means of transportation away from 4 Privet Drive , and the Order made a plan to remove Harry on 27 July .
The Order used Polyjuice Potion to disguise six members as Harry, so that seven teams of two would fly away from Little Whinging to divert anyone if they were attacked.
The group was attacked by at least thirty Death Eaters and Lord Voldemort himself joined the sky battle.
Harry was brought to safety at the Burrow , but Alastor Moody and Harry's owl Hedwig were killed in the process.
Birthday celebrations
Twelve Fail-Safe Ways to Charm Witches
When Harry awoke on the morning of his seventeenth birthday, he immediately used magic , summoning his glasses.
Ron Weasley gave him his present right away, not wanting his mother to see it.
It was a copy of Twelve Fail-Safe Ways to Charm Witches , a book that Ron had been given previously by his older brothers Fred and George .
Ron found it extremely useful for dealing with girls.
The boys then headed downstairs for breakfast, where Mrs Weasley and Monsieur and Apolline Delacour all wished Harry a happy birthday.
Harry also received a variety of presents, including a watch from Mrs Weasley that had once belonged to her late brother Fabian Prewett , which he hugged her in thanks for.
Hermione Granger then entered the kitchen with her gift for Harry, a new Sneakoscope .
Bill Weasley and Fleur Delacour gave him an enchanted razor , the Delacours gave him chocolates, and Fred and George gave him an enormous box of merchandise from their joke shop .
Ginny giving Harry his birthday present
After breakfast, Ginny Weasley approached Harry and asked to speak to him alone in her bedroom.
Although Ron did not like the idea, Hermione pulled him away, and Harry followed Ginny into her room.
There, Ginny said that she did not know what to get him for his birthday, and then kissed Harry as she had never kissed him before.
They were interrupted by Ron and Hermione; the former angrily reminded Harry that he had broken up with Ginny and that he should not be "messing her around".
Harry regretfully agreed that it would not happen again.

For Harry's celebratory dinner, Fred and George bewitched a number of purple lanterns with "17" on them to hang above the kitchen and Hermione conjured purple and gold streamers to be draped around the trees and bushes, and turned a crabapple tree to gold.
Charles Weasley , Rubeus Hagrid , Remus Lupin , and Nymphadora Tonks also joined everyone for dinner.
Mrs Weasley baked a cake in the form of a Golden Snitch , sized bigger like a beach-ball , and Hagrid gave Harry his gift of a pouch .
Before the dinner could get started, however, Arthur Weasley 's Patronus arrived to warn the guests that Minister for Magic Rufus Scrimgeour was accompanying him to the Burrow.
Remus and Tonks quickly left, since the two had recently married and the Ministry of Magic had anti-werewolf legislation in effect.
Arthur and Scrimgeour arrived shortly afterward, and the latter requested a private word with Harry, Ron, and Hermione.
Scrimgeour gives the first Snitch Harry caught, willed to him by Albus Dumbledore
Once in the sitting room, Scrimegour wanted to speak to each of them individually, but Harry refused.
Scrimgeour then explained to them that they had all been bequeathed items in Albus Dumbledore's will .
To Harry, Dumbledore had left the first Snitch he ever caught, as well as the Sword of Gryffindor .
To Ron he left a Deluminator and to Hermione a first edition of The Tales of Beedle the Bard .

The Ministry had held the will and its contents under the Decree for Justifiable Confiscation for 31 days, as they suspected that Dumbledore was attempting to communicate secret information to the trio.
Scrimgeour suspiciously questioned all three of them, but ultimately turned over all the objects but the Sword, which he argued did not belong to Dumbledore and was not his to give.

Scrimgeour also attempted to convince Harry to support the Ministry for the second time, and again, Harry turned him down, reminding him that he did not agree with the Ministry's methods, such as their cover-up of the recent break-out of Azkaban prisoners.
Scrimgeour left in a fury.
Afterwards, everybody ate dinner quickly, and Harry, Ron, and Hermione met once everyone had gone to bed to discuss what had happened.
It was not until much later that they realised the full significance of Dumbledore's will, and how it assisted them in their search for the Horcruxes and knowledge of the Deathly Hallows .
Attendees
Notes and references

title: Weasley jumper
paragraphs: A Weasley jumper was a home-made jumper made by Molly Weasley for family and friends and sent as Christmas gifts.
They usually varied in colour, but often had the recipient's first initial on the front.
Fred and George seemed to enjoy them, calling them "lovely and warm", but Ron disliked the fact that his jumper was always maroon.
History
Harry Potter 's Weasley jumper
Beginning in Christmas 1991 , Harry Potter received an annual Weasley jumper.
This would be among the first meaningful Christmas presents Harry had ever received.
His were usually much more extravagant, including one with the picture of a Hungarian Horntail .
In Christmas 1994 , Ron Weasley gave his jumper to Dobby the house elf, who was overjoyed by it.
In Christmas 1995 , Percy Weasley , who had broken contact with the family following Voldemort's return , returned his jumper to Molly unopened.
This left Molly very heartbroken.
In Christmas 1996 , it was noted that Molly did not make one of these for Fleur Delacour , apparently not wanting to waste on her.
At the time, Molly did not approve of Fleur's upcoming marriage to her son, William Weasley .
On 1 September 2017 , Hermione Granger , whilst on the Platform Nine and Three-Quarters asked her daughter, Rose Granger-Weasley whether she had her jumper or not.
Notes and references

title: Return of Lord Voldemort
paragraphs: The return of Lord Voldemort took place on 24 June 1995 in the graveyard of Little Hangleton .
While in the graveyard, Lord Voldemort was restored to physical form and full magical power.
He was restored after being incorporeal for nearly fourteen years.

The rebirth was the result of months of meticulous planning by Voldemort and his servants, Peter Pettigrew and Bartemius Crouch Junior , who manipulated the Triwizard Tournament being held at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry that year in order to deliver Harry Potter to Lord Voldemort.
Per his master's command, Pettigrew murdered Cedric Diggory , who was transported along with Harry, and used some of Harry's blood in the ritual to restore Voldemort.
Voldemort then called his Death Eaters to him and duelled the gravely hurt and weakened Harry, who again managed to escape with his life and warn Albus Dumbledore .

This event marked the beginning of the Second Wizarding War , although the Ministry of Magic did not admit this until a year later , due to their desire to maintain the peace they worked so hard to create.
History
Background information
During Lord Voldemort 's first rise to power, a prophecy was made about an infant with the power to defeat him who would be born to a couple who had thrice defied him.
The prophecy stated that the infant would be a boy and would be born at the end of July.
Voldemort marked Harry, son of Order of the Phoenix members James and Lily Potter , who had thrice defied Voldemort.
Voldemort murdering Lily Potter after she refused to stop shielding her infant son
The Potters went into hiding, yet Voldemort soon located them and arrived at their home in Godric's Hollow .
Although his murder of James was immediate and effortless, he offered Lily a chance to save herself because one of his Death Eaters , Severus Snape , had requested it of him.
Finally, Voldemort used the Killing Curse on her and then on Harry.
Because Lily had willingly and lovingly sacrificed herself for Harry by refusing to stop shielding him, the curse backfired.
This left the boy with a lightning-bolt scar on his forehead and Voldemort's body was destroyed.

The rebounding Killing Curse split Voldemort's already mangled soul once again; the piece of Voldemort's soul that broke off then attached itself to Harry's body, inadvertently turning him into a Horcrux.
The Lestranges and Barty Crouch Junior standing trial for their crimes
This marked the end of the First Wizarding War, after which many of Voldemort's followers were imprisoned in Azkaban or managed to convince the Ministry of Magic of their innocence.
Sirius Black was imprisoned for Pettigrew's crimes, as everyone believed him to be the Potters' Secret-Keeper.
Pettigrew went into hiding for years in his Animagus form of a rat, known as Scabbers, acting as a pet to Percy Weasley and later to his younger brother Ron .
Some Death Eaters, such as the Lestranges, declared that the Dark Lord would return, while others resisted arrest and were ultimately killed, such as Evan Rosier .
Voldemort made a prior attempt to regain his physical form and power in his attempt to use Quirinus Quirrell to obtain the Philosopher's Stone and to murder Harry Potter .
This plot failed, and by 1994, Voldemort had all but given up hope of ever returning.

However, that summer, Peter Pettigrew , the man who had treacherously provided the whereabouts of Harry's parents in the first place, returned to his service; his true identity and crimes were exposed after Sirius Black escaped from Azkaban , and, with the assistance of his old friend Remus Lupin , confronted Pettigrew and informed Harry of the truth behind his parents' deaths.
Peter and Voldemort making the plot
Pettigrew managed to escape and contact his former master.
Pettigrew brought Voldemort back into a temporary form with a potion , and began plotting to gather the required ingredients for a true revival.

Throughout the planning, Pettigrew repeatedly tried to persuade Voldemort to use another wizard's blood instead of Harry Potter 's to accelerate the process, but Voldemort refused for believing Harry's blood would make him stronger, while knowing full well that Pettigrew was trying to desert him out of regret of returning at all.
They also managed to free Bartemius Crouch Junior , one of Voldemort's fanatical Death Eaters , from his father 's control .
Voldemort ordered Crouch to infiltrate Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and to bring him Harry Potter, a task which Crouch completed with success.
The Goblet of Fire choosing Harry Potter as a fourth champion
Crouch managed this by abducting Alastor Moody , the new Defence Against the Dark Arts Professor at Hogwarts and using Polyjuice Potion to take his place.
In this position, he was able to manipulate the Triwizard Tournament so that the Goblet of Fire selected Harry as a fourth Champion.
Harry was bewildered by this and by how his scar was increasingly beginning to burn.

By the Third Task of the Tournament, Crouch had succeeded in turning the Triwizard Cup into a Portkey that would transport whoever touched it to Little Hangleton , where Voldemort and Pettigrew were waiting.
Harry and Cedric Diggory , the other Hogwarts champion, agreed that they were equally winners and thus touched the Cup at the same time.
Restoration of Lord Voldemort
Cedric murdered by Pettigrew on Voldemort's orders
Harry and Cedric were both transported to the graveyard of Little Hangleton .
Voldemort ordered Pettigrew to " kill the spare ", and Cedric was struck with the Killing Curse .
To his horror, Harry saw a flash of green light then heard the sound of a body hitting the graveyard's ground.
Cedric was dead instantly.
He was then restrained to Tom Riddle Snr's grave marker so that Pettigrew could cut his arm open and take some of his blood to use in a Dark potion to restore Voldemort to full power and strength.
While taking Harry's blood Pettigrew refused to make eye-contact, possibly feeling some reluctance regarding his actions.
This reluctance stemmed from Harry having saved his life the year prior.
Voldemort emerging from the cauldron
Pettigrew also took a bone from the grave of Tom Riddle Snr and his own hand as part of the potion.
Voldemort regained a corporeal body and therefore was returned to full power.
He ordered Pettigrew to stretch out his uninjured left arm, bearing the Dark Mark.
Voldemort touched it, and Death Eaters who were loyal or evaded capture came to him at once.
Voldemort surrounded by his supporters
Voldemort greeted and confronted several of the Death Eaters for not trying to find him during his absence, such as Lucius Malfoy , Crabbe Snr , Goyle Snr , Nott Snr , Avery , and Walden Macnair .
They all claimed to still be loyal to him, though he uncovered these hasty lies with ease.

He expressed fury and disappointment at their lack of faith, torturing Avery before proclaiming that he would only forgive them after thirteen years of servitude to match the thirteen years he had been absent.
Voldemort also swore vengeance on those who did not respond to his summons, such as Severus Snape and Igor Karkaroff .
He praised the Lestranges for their loyalty, announcing that they would be honoured beyond their dreams for their loyalty.
Voldemort torturing Harry with the Cruciatus Curse twice
He explained his situation after his first downfall.
At this point he also created a silver hand for Pettigrew in reward for helping him return to his body.
The Dark Lord then turned to Harry, remarking upon how the boy had survived his Killing Curse thirteen years ago and how, with his blood in his body, he could now touch him.
He used the Cruciatus Curse on Harry briefly and then demanded that he duel him.
He used the Imperius Curse on Harry, which Harry was able to resist, much to the astonishment of all those present.
The wands of Voldemort and Harry Potter connecting in Priori Incantatem
The duel started with Voldemort casting the Killing Curse, while Harry cast the Disarming Charm .
Because the cores of their wands shared the same source, Harry's wand and Voldemort's wand were brothers and thus the rare effect of Priori Incantatem was created when they conflicted.

A battle of wills began and Harry's wand (the dominant) forced Voldemort's wand (the submissive) to regurgitate its most recent past spells, and Voldemort's murder victims emerged in spirit form: Cedric, Frank Bryce, Bertha Jorkins, Lily Potter, and James Potter.
Cedric's echo asking Harry to take his body back to his parents
Frank's spirit expressed amazement that Voldemort was in fact a wizard and encouraged Harry to defeat him.
Cedric's spirit asked Harry to return his body to his parents, and the spirits of Harry's parents told him that they would all provide a distraction so that he could escape.
At a signal from James, Harry wrenched his wand upward, breaking the Priori Incantatem, and the manifested spirits swarmed Voldemort to block Harry from his sight, however briefly.
Harry quickly seized Cedric's body and the Triwizard Cup with the Summoning Charm , transporting back to Hogwarts.

During the duel, according to Albus Dumbledore , when Harry's wand forced Voldemort's to regurgitate its spells, it had absorbed a part of Voldemort's own dark powers, making Harry's wand even stronger and more powerfully effective, but only against Voldemort himself.
This would later save his life in the Battle of the Seven Potters .
Bartemius Crouch Junior being interrogated
Chaos erupted when Harry returned to Hogwarts with Cedric's body in tow.
Students were shocked, dismayed, and disbelieving all at once.
Amos Diggory was devastated by the loss of his son.
Crouch, disguised as Moody, managed to usher Harry away from the panicking crowd to interrogate him about Voldemort's return.
He wanted to kill Harry, but a furious Albus Dumbledore and several other members of the Hogwarts staff arrived to stop him.
Witnessing the celebrated wizard's fury, Harry finally understood why Dumbledore was so feared.
Alastor Moody as he was discovered down in the trunk
Under the influence of Severus Snape 's Veritaserum , Crouch confessed everything.
The real Alastor Moody was discovered in trunk, and had been there for quite some time.
Before he could testify before the Wizengamot , however, Minister for Magic Cornelius Fudge arrived with a Dementor , which performed the Dementor's Kiss on him.
The Daily Prophet accusing Harry of lying about Voldemort's return
The Ministry of Magic refused to believe Harry Potter 's account of Voldemort 's return, even when he was supported by Albus Dumbledore .
This denial and refusal to see the truth was due to Fudge not wanting the peace and tranquillity they worked so hard for to be destabilised by this announcement.
The Ministry publicly denied the Dark Lord's return and branded Harry and Dumbledore either liars or nutters in the press.
The Daily Prophet in particular was known to print copies with headlines such as, "The Boy Who Lies?"
and "Dumbledore: Daft or Dangerous?"
Voldemort and his Death Eaters took advantage of this campaign to discredit Dumbledore and Harry.
They used it to operate in secret and advance their plans.
At the same time Dumbledore called for a reconstitution of the Order of the Phoenix in order to combat Voldemort and his Death Eaters.
The issue of Voldemort's return would be highly divisive amongst the public.
In Harry's next year of school, many of his fellow students were sceptical of his claims, even some he considered friends, such as Seamus Finnigan .
Percy Weasley also had a severe falling out with the rest of his family over their loyalty to Dumbledore over the Ministry.
Umbridge inspecting classes and interfering at Hogwarts

The Ministry was so suspicious of Dumbledore that Dolores Umbridge was installed at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry as High Inquisitor during the 1995-1996 school year, a position she used to monitor and undermine Dumbledore and to spread Ministry propaganda.
Umbridge's dictatorial reign over the school sowed the seeds of rebellion.
Dumbledore's Army is formed, taught and lead by Harry Potter
Harry, Hermione Granger , and Ron Weasley founded Dumbledore's Army, a group in which students could learn practical Defence Against the Dark Arts and oppose Ministry control at Hogwarts.
Harry's side of the story eventually got to the public after Hermione arranged for Rita Skeeter to interview him and Luna Lovegood helped get it published in The Quibbler .
In the meantime, Voldemort was able to gain more followers and to stage a break-out of many of his Death Eaters from Azkaban .

The Ministry did not admit that Voldemort had returned until June of 1996 , after the Dark Lord was seen by the Minister for Magic himself in the Ministry following the Battle of the Department of Mysteries .
Voldemort's usage of Harry's blood for his revival was due to his belief that it would allow him to bypass the protection that Lily bestowed onto him.

This, however, was a mistake due to Voldemort's lack of understanding of the power of love , and while Voldemort was able to touch Harry without injuring himself, in truth, it strengthened the protection by anchoring Harry to the world of the living even after being struck by the Killing Curse again, thus ensuring Voldemort's defeat three years later.

title: Rose Granger-Weasley
paragraphs: Rose Granger-Weasley , also known as Rosie (b. 2005 / 2006 ), was an English half-blood witch and the daughter of Ronald Weasley and Hermione Granger .
She had a younger brother named Hugo , who was born around two to three years after her.
She began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 2017 - the same year as Albus Potter and Scorpius Malfoy - and she was sorted into Gryffindor house.
Biography
Early years (2005-2016)
During their youth, Rose and her cousin Albus were very close, and at the age of six they considered each other best friends.
In 2014 , Rose, at the age of eight, attended the finals of the 427th Quidditch World Cup with her family and relatives.
Like Albus and all the Weasleys, minus her mother, she was wearing green clothes to show her support of the Brazilians .
Hogwarts years (2017-?)

As Rose prepared to go off to her first year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry with her cousin Albus in 2017 , her father jokingly encouraged her to be Sorted into the same House as himself and her mother, Gryffindor .
Rose with her family at Platform 9¾ in 2017
Ron also jokingly told her to beat Draco Malfoy 's son, Scorpius , in every test, though Hermione expressed a more tolerant attitude towards a possible friendship with Scorpius.
Ron, though, warned Rose not to get too friendly with Scorpius, quipping that her grandfather, Arthur Weasley , would never forgive her for marrying a pure-blood .
Later, while on board the train, Albus and Rose wandered around the train looking for a compartment to sit in.
Rose reminded Albus that their parents met on the train, so finding the right compartment to sit in was very important as they too could meet their lifelong friends here.
Opening the door to one compartment, Albus and Rose found Scorpius Malfoy sitting alone with sweets and introduced themselves to him.
Following her father's advice, Rose left to look for another compartment, yet Albus decided to stay and accompany Scorpius, the two boys striking up a fast friendship.
After arriving at Hogwarts, Rose and her cousin attended the Sorting Ceremony with their fellow students.
As it was expected, the Sorting Hat placed Rose in Gryffindor but sorted Albus with Scorpius in Slytherin, to the surprise of many, including a distraught Rose.

Later during their common first flying lesson , Rose demonstrated a natural affinity for flying, with her broom obeying her at her first command, but Albus failed to make his broom move to the slightest and was subsequently nicknamed the "Slytherin Squib" by his peers.

Consequently, the popular Rose distanced herself from Albus as she disliked the fact her cousin was sorted into Slytherin, as well as being highly disapproving of Albus's friendship with Scorpius, due to his Death Eater family, only acting friendly towards her former best friend in front of their relatives.

During her second year, Rose was chosen as the new Chaser of Gryffindor Quidditch team , with Headmistress Minerva McGonagall happily announcing it to all the school and calling Rose "Gryffindor's superb new chaser".
According to Scorpius and like her mother before her, Rose was also a brilliant student.

During the following years, Scorpius, who had a crush on Rose, tried to woo her on numerous occasions and to overcome her distrust of him, but to no avail which led to often embarrassing himself (as well as Albus at times) in the process.
Rose with her family on platform 9¾ before starting her fourth year

At the beginning of her fourth year, in the Hogwarts Express , Rose tried to reach out to Albus and to improve their relation, who had become increasingly tense as Albus had a difficult time in Hogwarts in contrast with Rose and was also growing apart from his family.

To get his attention, she tried to engage in small talks, telling him that the Ministry now led by her mother recently confiscated a Time-Turner , a story which greatly interested Albus who left to share it with Scorpius.

However, as Albus reached the compartment he shared with Scorpius, Rose followed him, trying to talk to him, but Albus knew that Rose was in fact acting on her parents' behalf and abruptly told her to leave him alone.
Seeing Rose, Scorpius tried to flirt with her again, telling her that she smelled like "fresh grass and fresh bread" prompting Rose to leave.

Later, Albus and Scorpius travelled back to the Triwizard Tournament , trying to prevent Cedric Diggory 's death, using the Time-Turner they had stolen from Rose's mother and helped by the mysterious Delphini .
However, their actions ultimately altered the timeline and prevented Ron and Hermione from falling in love, erasing Rose and her brother from reality, a fact which greatly distressed Scorpius.
Later, after they corrected their mistakes and discovering that she was back, Scorpius tried to hug an unknowing Rose after she called him "Bread head", but she kicked him in the shin.
Rose and Albus have their first civil conversation in three years

Rose did seem to mellow a little after Scorpius and his father helped her family to stop Delphini, who had been manipulating the two boys in an attempt to bring back her secret father, Lord Voldemort .
Later, Scorpius gathered his courage and asked Rose out, but she refused, giving him a somewhat look of pity.
However, Scorpius was happy, seeing Rose's stare as a sign that she was becoming receptive to his advances and as the first step of their future together.

Indeed, as he was recounting it to Albus, Rose passed by and spoke to Albus and a stunned Scorpius, before calling him "Scorpion King", his nickname in an alternate reality in which he was popular, and leaving with an amused smile.
Physical description
Rose was said to have inherited her father's red hair , the hair colour famously shared by most of the Weasley clan.
When Albus and Scorpius travelled back through time, Scorpius mistook a young Hermione for Rose, hinting that there was a strong resemblance between Rose and her mother.
Personality and traits
Rose was said to have inherited her mother's intelligence as well as her rumoured photographic memory.
It was also noted that she put on her robes before needed, like her mother did at her age.
If her father 's encouragement to beat Scorpius Malfoy academically had any effect, she may have also turned out to be rather competitive and academically excellent like her mother.
She seemed to be quite close to her cousin Albus Potter , who was about the same age and who shared her anxiety about where he would be sorted at school.
When she arrived at King's Cross Station Albus was "immensely relieved" to see her, and Rose beamed at him.
Rose embodied just a little bit of her mother - Rose was ambitious; and since her mother was Hermione Granger , meaning she had quite a lot to live up, in terms of achievement.
She was quite similar to her mother in the fact that she put a lot of pressure on herself and how she just wanted to do the right thing.
Rose was like her mother, but more secure and more grounded.
She was born to a wizarding family and knew her place in the world.
Rose had a biased side to her, however.

She was dismayed that her cousin, Albus, was sorted into Slytherin and didn't approve of his friendship with Scorpius whom Rose unfairly judged for coming from a family that had included Death Eaters.

As a result, Rose distanced herself from her cousin as she became popular while Albus was scorned and belittled by others, and only acted kind and civil to him when they were in front of their families.
It reached the point where Albus rebuffed her halfhearted attempts to reconcile because he knew it wasn't sincere; indeed, Rose had only attempted to do so at the request of her parents.

Ultimately, after learning of what Albus and Scorpius had been through and all they'd done to do the right thing, Rose truly endeavoured to make amends with her cousin and no longer judged Scorpius unfairly, going as far as to nickname the latter "Scorpion King".
From then on, she developed a kinder attitude and came to be on friendly terms with both Albus and Scorpius.
Magical abilities and skills
Relationships
Family
Rose appears to have a strong relationship with her father, Ron Weasley , as they were joking about the Hogwarts sorting.
Rose was also thought to be close to her mother, Hermione Granger , as they had many of the same qualities, such as intelligence.
She seemed to have a good relationship with her younger brother Hugo Granger-Weasley .
Potter family

Rose had a good relationship with her cousin Albus prior to them going to Hogwarts, but after Albus was sorted into Slytherin and became friends with the son of a former death-eater , she chose to distance herself from him.
However, she manages to reconcile with Albus several years later.
Rose was assumed to have a good relationship with her other cousins.
Additonally, she grew an even stronger previous bond than before.
Scorpius Malfoy
Scorpius Malfoy
Rose became a classmate of Scorpius , who is in the same year as her and Albus.
Her father told her not to get too friendly with him and to beat him academically, though her mother did not want them to be pitted against each other.
Rose developed a dislike for Scorpius very early on, on the basis that his father made remarks about her parents when they were young.
After Scorpius helped to stop the Dark Lord 's daughter , it appears that she became kinder towards him.
Etymology
Rose was most likely named after the eponymous flower ; which is widely prized for its beauty and fragrance.
Roses are often considered symbols of love and have historically been associated with goddesses such as Isis and Aphrodite.
This may symbolise her parents' relationship with each other.
The rose is also the national flower of England .
Red roses are particularly associated with romance, and could allude to the trademark Weasley red hair.
It is also possible that Ron and Hermione wanted their children to have the same initials as their parents; R and H .
Interestingly, both children also have names that are four letters long.
