title: Tudor period
paragraphs: A Malfoy, during the Tudor period
The Tudor period occurred in England and Wales between 1485 and 1603 .
History
The architecture of the Map Chamber was "Tudor-style".
Tudor wizards
During the Tudor period, the following wizards and witches were known to have been alive:
Notes and references

title: Beasts (class)
paragraphs: Beasts , also known as Beast Studies , was a subject taught at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry between the 15th century and the 1890s .
The subject taught students about magical beasts and creatures both at the Hogwarts grounds and across the wizarding world .
It is unknown whether this class was a core or elective class.
At some point between 1891 and 1969 , Beasts class was replaced by Care of Magical Creatures and ceased to be a part of the Hogwarts curriculum.
Curriculum
1890-1891 school year
In the 1890-1891 school year , fifth-year students had to brush and feed Puffskeins and Kneazles .
The new fifth-year student was also tasked to capture one Diricawl and one Giant Purple Toad with their nab-sack .
Creatures studied in-class
Known professors
Notes and references

title: Percival Rackham
paragraphs: Professor Percival Rackham (fl.
1470s ) was a Scottish wizard that worked as a Divination professor at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the Tudor period , and was the leader of the Keepers .
Biography
Early life

Born into a family of unknown wizarding descent sometime before the Tudor era, Percival Rackham grew up to discover that he possessed the rare ability to perceive and master ancient magic , and like others like him, eventually received a late acceptance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , having begun his magical education as a fifth-year student.
When he arrived at the school, Percival was Sorted into Hufflepuff House .
He was implied to have been a gifted student, as he at one point said that in order to fully master said gift, one first had to be well-versed in the other magic taught at Hogwarts.
Given his own talent in the field , Percival presumably excelled in Divination class .
Teaching career

Sometime after he left Hogwarts, Percival returned and became the school's Divination professor, and at one point worked under then Headmistress Niamh Fitzgerald , and becoming a colleague of Charles Rookwood and San Bakar .

Aware of Percival's unique ability, as well as the potential dangers if the knowledge of how to wield ancient magic fell into the wrong hands, together, Percival and his co-workers formed a small circle of trust known as the Keepers , who devoted themselves to the protection of ancient magic.

Around 1485 , Professor Rackham commissioned the goblins of the then recently established Gringotts Wizarding Bank with the construction of a vault that was given the number twelve , which he, along with Charles Rookwood , converted into a test that could only be passed by those who, like himself, had the innate power to see and control ancient magic.

If completed successfully, they would be granted access to a pensieve and a small, crystal bottle that contained Percival's extracted memory of setting up the challenge, as well as a portal that would take them to Hogwarts.
Mentoring Isidora

When Isidora Morganach , a young witch who had not only possessed the same innate abilities for ancient magic as himself, but also began her attendance at Hogwarts in her fifth year , just like he had, Professor Rackham encouraged her to become his apprentice in the ways of ancient magic.
Physical description
In his elder years, Percival was an elderly wizard with pale white skin, grey hair with a beard that brushed his chest, and brown eyes.
Personality and traits
Percival was an elegant man that respected intelligence and ambition, and was known to be reserved in his movements.
Magical abilities and skills
Notes and references

title: Niamh Fitzgerald
paragraphs: Professor Niamh Fitzgerald (fl.
1470s ) was a witch who once served as the Headmistress at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and lived during the Tudor period .
She was one of the Keepers , a secret society dedicated to the protection of ancient magic .
Biography
Early life
In her youth, she began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry where she was sorted into Ravenclaw house.
As Headmistress of Hogwarts
She eventually became the Headmistress of Hogwarts in her adulthood.
She also became a member of the Keepers , a secret society dedicated to protecting ancient magic .
In these roles, she was first seen by a young Isidora Morganach restoring her hamlet of Feldcroft from a drought alongside the other Keepers.

Isidora, like Niamh's colleague Percival Rackham , was able to see traces of ancient magic, and when she was enrolled into Hogwarts as a late-coming fifth-year student, Niamh saw to her education and mentorship under the Keepers.
When Isidora Morganach graduated, Niamh granted her a position as the Professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts at the school.

Niamh and the other Keepers were invited to Isidora's house in Feldcroft to witness Isidora's new , groundbreaking spell : one that could extract pain from humans , which she experimented with on her father .
Niamh was quite taken aback by this use of magic .
On a stroll in the Hogwarts grounds, she asked Isidora to stop, but Isidora then extracted some of Niamh's pain without her permission.
Niamh and the Keepers preparing to duel with Isidora Morganach

Niamh eventually confronted Isidora, alongside the other Keepers, in a duel in the Keepers' Caverns , where she defended Percival Rackham as he urged Isidora to stop using her pain extraction spell on students.
Isidora refused, casting an explosive spell at the Keepers which rendered Niamh unconscious, but still alive.
Post-mortem
Niamh's portrait in the Headmaster's office
Niamh eventually died and had a funeral , which was attended by many people, some of whom expressed that she had died too young.
Niamh had a portrait of herself located in the Headmaster's office at Hogwarts Castle to advise future headteachers of the school.
She also had a portrait in the secret Map Chamber beneath the castle.

In the 1890-1891 school year , Niamh gave a trial to an unidentified student who had the power to see and use ancient magic to test if they would go down the same path as Isidora, or if they were trustworthy.

To this end, she tasked the student to access her book in the Headmaster's office, which the student managed to do after using Polyjuice Potion to disguise themselves as the incumbent Headmaster, Phineas Nigellus Black , in order to ask Scrope for the office's password .
Niamh Fitzgerald's Pensieve statue
The book gave the student a storytelling of Niamh's funeral and a fight with Death from The Tale of the Three Brothers .
When the student finished the sequence of puzzles laid out within the story, they used a Pensieve to witness Niamh's memories of her days as a Headmistress.
The trial was then considered complete.
Eventually, Niamh (and the other Keepers) allowed the student to access the Keepers' Caverns and defend Hogwarts from the invasion of Ranrok .
After the Battle of Hogwarts , she was most likely among those who congratulated Harry Potter on his defeat of Lord Voldemort , along with the other headteachers of Hogwarts.
Physical description
Niamh was a woman with fair skin, light brown/strawberry blonde hair tied up in a braided bun and blue eyes.
Personality and traits
Niamh was a natural leader and protector that feared more for the individual students for whom were in her care.
She inspired courage and compassion among her colleagues, and drove the group to continue the search for answers, even when hope seemed dim.
Niamh was level-headed, she thought before she spoke and noticed everything.
Niamh was known for her grace, wisdom, kindness, and confidence.
Magical abilities and skills
Notes and references

title: Charles Rookwood
paragraphs: Professor Charles Rookwood (fl.
1470s ) was a Scottish wizard and a member of the Rookwood family .
At some point during the Tudor period , he was the Professor of Transfiguration at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and a member of the Keepers .
Biography
Early life
Charles was born into the wealthy wizarding Rookwood family sometime in the Tudor period , and was raised at Rookwood Castle in Scotland , the seat of the Rookwood family.
In his youth, he attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry where he was sorted into Slytherin House .
Later life

Some time after finishing school, he became the Professor of Transfiguration at Hogwarts, During his lifetime, he was a close friend of Percival Rackham , the leader of a secret society dedicated to the protection of ancient magic , of which Charles himself was also a member, alongside Niamh Fitzgerald and San Bakar .
He built Vault 12 alongside Rackham.
While Rookwood was a professor, the Keepers oversaw the education and ancient magical training of Isidora Morganach , a student.

When Morganach graduated and became a professor herself, Rookwood served as one of her colleagues, visiting her house on one occasion to witness her pain extraction spell in action on Morganach's father .

As the Keepers became increasingly concerned with Morganach's out-of-control, irrational pursuit of power through the manipulation of people's pain into ancient magic, Rookwood confronted her alongside the other Keepers in a duel in the Keepers' Caverns .
There, Rookwood fought Morganach and it was San Bakar who eventually killed her, using the Killing Curse .
By 1890 , Rookwood was long since dead, with his portrait hanging inside the Map Chamber beneath Hogwarts Castle .
His portrait advised a student centuries later, who had the ability to perform ancient magic, as well as his mentor Eleazar Fig .
At the same time, Rookwood's descendant Victor Rookwood aimed to untap the power of ancient magic to further his own materialistic ambitions.
Personality and traits
Rookwood considered himself a man of " science " and was guided by hard facts.
He was pragmatic, direct, and focused.
He was keenly observant and fascinated by the ways in which magic could be altered and used.
Magical abilities and skills
Possessions
Notes and references

title: Keepers
paragraphs: The Keepers were a small group of witches and wizards in the Tudor period who were devoted to guarding the secret of ancient magic .
All of them served as professors at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry during the time period.
The group was led by Divination professor, Percival Rackham , who was born with an innate ability to perceive traces of ancient magic.
Its other members included Transfiguration professor Charles Rookwood , Beasts professor San Bakar , and the Headmistress of the day, Niamh Fitzgerald .
They once had a protégé who was born with the same ancient magic ability as Rackham, Isidora Morganach .
She became Defence Against the Dark Arts professor and joined their group after her graduation from Hogwarts.
However, she betrayed their mission and used ancient magic to pursue her own ambitions.

The Keepers had an instrumental role in safeguarding the two known ancient magic repositories that existed in the world: one beneath Rookwood Castle , and another in the Keepers' Caverns beneath Hogwarts Castle .
In order for a future wielder of ancient magic to access the latter, they had to undergo a series of trials to prove their worth.
History
Isidora Morganach
Isidora conjuring stone pillars under Percival Rackham's supervision
The Keepers dated to the Tudor period .
They were first seen by Isidora Morganach when they replenished her hamlet of Feldcroft from a drought.
Later, Isidora discovered she was able to use ancient magic , and apprenticed to Percival Rackham, although she did not become a Keeper herself.
The Keepers attempted to instil Isidora with their view that ancient magic should be kept secret.
However, she rebelled against this after creating a spell that enabled her to extract pain and negative emotions from others.
She brought the Keepers to her house in Feldcroft , where she experimented this spell on her father , much to Professor Rackham's shock.
In the coming years, Isidora became the professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts at the school, where she would begin a systematic process of healing the negative emotions of students.
As her stores of collected ancient magic simply became too numerous, she commissioned a repository of goblin silver from Bragbor the Boastful , a goblin metalworker.
Duel in the Keepers' Caverns
The Keepers' suspicions over Isidora reached a climax when they confronted her in the Keepers' Caverns and asked her to stop her way of life.
By then, Isidora was already fully set in her conviction, and was unwilling to abide by the Keepers' secrecy any longer.
A duel started between the five, resulting in Isidora's death at the hands of San Bakar .
After Isidora's death, the Keepers decided that they would not allow another person to understand their secrets without completing their personal trials, not wanting to have her mistakes repeated.
They constructed Vault 12 , a highly secretive vault at Gringotts Wizarding Bank , and designed an elaborate series of steps in order to access it.
They also built the Map Chamber beneath Hogwarts Castle , which served as a home for their portraits and as a gateway to the Keepers' Caverns below.
The Keepers' portraits were apparently more sentient than most, as they were capable of rational, independent thought, and could manipulate the Map Chamber.
Ranrok's goblin rebellion

In 1890, the portraits were introduced to a new fifth-year student who shared Rackham's and Isidora's gifts of ancient magic , and sent the student to take part in the Keepers' trials to make them understand the reponsibility of guarding the repositories.
Notes and references

title: Ancient magic
paragraphs: Ancient magic
Ancient magic was a very old, mysterious and powerful form of magic , the ways of which had been all but forgotten in the wizarding world by the late 19th century .
Those who could perceive and had an affinity for wielding it were seen as having a unique and exceedingly rare ability.
It was not greatly understood, even by Professors of Hogwarts .
Nature
A student attacks one of Ranrok's Loyalists using ancient magic

A far older, deeper, and more fundamental form of magic than conventional spell-casting ; ancient magic was tied to the world itself and existed externally to the innate magic of wizards, and was therefore also accessible to other magical creatures , such as dragons and goblins .

It could manifest involuntary and independently of a wizard's intent or efforts through certain incalculably powerful acts, such as willingly giving one's life to save a loved one but it could also be mastered and deliberately wielded, though this required great skill and knowledge to accomplish.

Rather than generating and channeling one's own innate magic to cast a spell, however, ancient magic was invoked , and rather than bewitched things using ancient magic, things touched by it were instead described as being imbued with it.

Ancient magic had the potential to move individuals across space, as well as restrict certain spaces , and also create seemingly interdependent dimensions : i.e., 'portals' that could effectively transport people to different versions of the same space.

Some ancient magic spells, such as the pain extraction spell , left "traces" behind, which agonised the Keepers as they did not know what damage these traces could do to their environment, so they needed to be contained .
A wizard could also harness ancient magic to augment their own magical abilities.
The force could be used productively, as it was by the Keepers, but it was also capable of being abused, as evidenced by the case of Isidora Morganach .
A skilled wizard could also deliberately invoke ancient magic to produce effects that worked in tandem with independent manifestations .

Besides those who learned to wield ancient magic through time and study, there were also a select few witches and wizards who were born with a unique ability to use ancient magic, capable of seeing traces or "whispers" of ancient magic.
To them, it resembled swirling clouds of smoke which were blue in colour.
Of the three known inherent wielders of ancient magic, they all began schooling at Hogwarts in their fifth year , linking the ability with late blooming .
Corruption
It was possible for ancient magic to become corrupted through malicious intentions and unholy experimentation that meddled with things that should never have been messed with.
Corrupted ancient magic was an extremely dangerous and powerful type of dark magic , and the traces of such magic were different from regular ancient magic traces.
Goblins empowered by corrupted ancient magic were known as corrupted goblins .
History
Hogwarts Castle, a stronghold of ancient magic
Hogwarts Castle was said to have been built by and was itself a stronghold of ancient magic, defended by countless ancient protective enchantments .

During the 1988-1989 school year , Merlin's portrait described the fabled Cursed Vaults as wreaking a punishment upon the denizens of Hogwarts for having " abandoned the ways of ancient magic ", implying ancient magic and its practice was more common in medieval time and antiquity than modern times.

During the Tudor period , four Hogwarts professors, including the Headmistress of the day, formed a group known as the Keepers , practitioners of ancient magic with a self-appointed mission to protect it and prevent its secrets from falling into the wrong hands.
The leader of the group was Professor of Divination Percival Rackham , who was born with a special ability to perceive traces of ancient magic.
The Keepers later met a gifted student, Isidora Morganach , who was born with the same ancient magic ability as Professor Rackham.
They mentored her, and she later returned to Hogwarts as Defence Against the Dark Arts Professor and joined them.
However, she began to misuse the power of ancient magic to extract emotional pain .
The act of manipulating human emotions was a most depraved action in the first place, and the spell itself had a horrific side effect.
When she refused to stop, the Keepers confronted her, leading to a conflict .
San Bakar killed Isidora during the battle, sealed her repositories, and created trials to test future inheritors of their secret.
In 1783 , Flannery , who was on a murderous rampage, supposedly used an "ancient spell" to track down the location of his murder victim, Hamish Steed , despite Steed being under Ministry protection.
By the late 19th century , Ranrok , a goblin rebel, sought ancient magic repositories for power, killing Miriam Fig to further his goal.

Her husband, Eleazar Fig , and his magically gifted student uncovered her research and worked to stop Ranrok, complete the Keepers' trials, and protect the final repository from Ranrok, who was eventually defeated during the battle for the final repository .
The death of Lily Potter, invoking sacrifical protection
In 1981 , Lily Potter sacrificed her life to save her son, Harry , from being murdered by Lord Voldemort .
The subsequent sacrificial protection unwittingly put on Harry, shielding him from harm, was a form of ancient magic.
Both Albus Dumbledore and Voldemort were aware of this ancient magic, and Voldemort was known to " despise " it.
Indeed, Dumbledore was able to willingly invoke a form of ancient magic, a bond of blood charm , to protect Harry Potter so long as he was in the Dursley family 's care.
Xenophilius Lovegood believed that love was a great blessing bestowed upon the world by the practitioners of ancient magic.

In 1994 , Harry Potter discovered from a book in the Hogwarts Library that the impervious hides of dragons were imbued with ancient magic as he prepared for the first task of the 1994-1995 Triwizard Tournament .

On 2 May 1998 , Harry Potter sacrificed his life by accepting Voldemort's Killing Curse in order to confer sacrifical protection on the countless Hogwartians in the Battle of Hogwarts , just as Harry's mother had done for him.
Practitioners of ancient magic
Some had the rare ability to perceive traces of ancient magic upon objects or surfaces, and to interact with those traces appropriately.

For others, it was possible for ancient spells and charms to be learned, (provided the witch or wizard was talented enough to fully understand its complex faculties) or even involuntarily exercised under rare circumstances.
The following is a list of all individuals who were known to perform ancient magic at some point in their lives:
Notes and references

title: Isidora Morganach
paragraphs: Professor Isidora Morganach (fl.
1470s ) was a Scottish Dark witch who served as Professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the Tudor period .
Born in Feldcroft , Scotland , she possessed the rare and unique ability to perceive and use ancient magic , which did not truly develop until she was fifteen years old .

Her life was marked by her mentorship by the Keepers , four Professors at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry who undertook the responsibility of safeguarding and concealing ancient magic from the wider wizarding population .
Forever the subject of her mentors' suspicions, Isidora fundamentally disagreed with this and took it upon herself to use her powers to heal the pain and suffering of those whom she came across.
Despite her well-intentioned goals, her actions had irreversible consequences, doing more than taking away the pain and suffering, and she was viewed as a dangerous enemy by the Keepers.
She was eventually killed by Professor San Bakar , her former mentor and colleague.

The existence of the repository she built, which stored her extracted emotional magic, would become the Keepers' highly shrouded secret, eventually fading into myth, only to be learned about and become the envy of Ranrok and his goblin rebellion centuries later.
Biography
Early life
A young Isidora with her family, watching the Keepers
Isidora was born into a family of unknown wizarding descent sometime during the Tudor era.
Born with the rare ability to detect and wield ancient magic , she grew up in the hamlet of Feldcroft where she lived with her father and brother .
As a young child, the hamlet was struck by a drought which made life difficult for its inhabitants.

The Keepers - a group of Hogwarts professors comprising Percival Rackham , Niamh Fitzgerald , Charles Rookwood , and San Bakar - used magic to put an end to the drought in a matter of minutes, transforming the hamlet into fertile land.
Isidora saw the whispers of ancient magic wielded by Percival while she and her family were trying to get water out of a well.
At some point, her brother died.
Hogwarts years
Isidora conjuring pillars with ancient magic, supervised by her mentor, Percival Rackham
As her ancient magic abilities developed late , like those of Percival Rackham several decades earlier, she attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry starting in her fifth-year .
She was sorted into Ravenclaw .
Shortly after, she was called to meet the Headmistress , Niamh Fitzgerald , along with the Keepers.
They told her she was the first person after Percival to show her rare ability with ancient magic, and that she had to learn how to wield it properly.
Percival took her under his wing as his apprentice, and under his guidance, she learned how to control her power.
Healing mission
Professor Morganach at Hogwarts
After completing her studies, Isidora returned to Hogwarts as the Professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts .
Charming and approachable, she was a very popular teacher in her time.
In her role, she started to experiment independently with her ancient magical abilities, straying from the path of secrecy that the Keepers had attempted to instil within her.

As her father had never recovered from her brother's death, she created a spell that had the capacity to extract pain , which she used on her father in front of her colleagues to showcase the power of ancient magic, much to their surprise and distaste.
She later used the spell on Niamh Fitzgerald without the latter's permission, but was stopped before any major damage could be done.

The Keepers became gradually more suspicious of Isidora and attempted to temper her desire to change the world, urging that ancient magic should be kept secret, but Isidora was reluctant to abandon her philosophy.
She started to experiment further, extracting pain from the people that she came across and storing it within her home .
As the sheer scale of her stored pain became too large, she commissioned Bragbor the Boastful , a goblin , to create the final repository , a goblin silver storage unit for the extracted pain.
This repository was kept in the Keepers' Caverns beneath Hogwarts Castle , where Isidora regularly took Hogwarts students to heal them from their emotional pain.
Sensing the growing suspicion and enmity of the Keepers, Isidora set out a series of clues with the hope that a future student who shared her gift could learn about her life and follow down her path.
These clues took the form of a triptych in the Undercroft which had two canvases torn out, with the remaining canvas being a hint to the location of the next, and so on.
These canvases were located in two of Isidora's hideouts: one in the Overlook , and another in Tower Tunnel .
Both of these places would be explored centuries later.
Death
Isidora's duel in the Keepers' Caverns
The Keepers recognised that Isidora had gone too far and united against her within the Caverns, attempting to finally stop her.
In self-defence, Isidora rendered Niamh Fitzgerald unconscious, which started a duel between her, Percival Rackham , and Charles Rookwood .
The duel was ended swiftly when San Bakar cast the Killing Curse , ending Isidora's life.
Post-mortem
A portrait of Isidora Morganach, kept within her house , was intentionally burned , though it was unknown by whom.

Centuries later, when an unidentified 19th-century Hogwarts student also developed ancient magical abilities, the Keepers guided them in portrait form and used Isidora Morganach as their key example of how not to use magic.

Isidora's triptych was discovered by this student and their friend, Sebastian Sallow , the latter of whom urged the student to use their ancient magical powers to heal his sister, Anne (an act which would contravene the message of the Keepers).

Meanwhile, Ranrok and Victor Rookwood were determined to unlock the secrets of the final repository for their own independent purposes: the elevation of goblinkind above wizardkind , and the reclamation of the Rookwood family legacy, respectively.

After Ranrok used his stolen wand to destroy the final repository, thus allowing Isidora's stored emotion to escape, the student could have chosen to repair the repository or consume the magic within.
If they did the latter, they would argue that Isidora was right all along, and justified her actions.
Physical description
Isidora was a woman with fair skin, dark brown hair tied up in a bun, and black eyes.
Personality and traits
Isidora was " confident, relatable, and wry ", and moved " gracefully and intensely ".
She was very charming, leading to her becoming notably popular in her role as a professor.

She was fiercely dedicated to the removal of pain and suffering from those with whom she interacted, and was determined to use her ancient magic abilities for the betterment of her community, even if this conflicted with the views of her mentors .
However, her desire for power and want to remove pain from others eventually led to her using it on others against their will and taking power for herself.
She went so far as to remove all emotion from her own father and began forcing it on students, showing how far she had fallen from her good intentions in pursuit of power.
Magical abilities and skills
Notes and references

title: Graduation ceremony
paragraphs: This ceremony was a yearly ritual performed at the end of the school year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .

The graduating seventh-year students would meet their professors and fellow students at an outdoor banquet hosted at the Training Grounds , before leaving the castle in a poetic and symbolic way, as they departed via the enchanted boats that had taken them to Hogwarts prior to the start of their first year .
It was probable that students obtained a Certificate of Graduation during this ceremony.
Notes and references

title: Lord of the Shore
paragraphs: The Lord of the Shore was a Graphorn .
By adulthood, he was the last of a long line of Graphorns.
Unusually large and strong, he inhabited Clagmar Coast in isolation, under the constant threat of poaching from the countless poachers who scouted the area.
Biography

In 1891 , the Lord of the Shore was successfully subdued by the new fifth-year student of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , who was undertaking the trial of former Beasts Professor and member of the Keepers , San Bakar , to test a a potential successor to the secrets and role of guardianship of ancient magic .
The trial required one to tame a Graphorn and have it stand on a stone platform in order to unlock the entrance to the cave where one could find the Pensieve with Professor Bakar's memories .
After a perilous duel, the Lord of the Shore submitted to the student, recognising their strength and need for aid.
The graphorn helped the student in opening the entrance of San Bakar's Pensieve chamber before entering their nab-sack , becoming one of their mounts.
Notes and references

title: Repository
paragraphs: A repository was a storage unit used to hold magical power of a certain form, notably ancient magic as well as the emotional magic that had been extracted by Isidora Morganach during the 15th - 16th century .
The construction of these repositories was done by Bragbor the Boastful , a Tudor-period goblin metalsmith, and he recorded their creation within his journals .
History
The seizure of the repositories was the main method through which Ranrok attempted to establish goblin supremacy in his rebellion .
He justified this through the fact that, as the repositories had been created by a goblin, they belonged to goblinkind.
Known repositories
Notes and references

title: Duel in the Keepers' Caverns
paragraphs: This duel occurred in the Tudor period as a consequence of Isidora Morganach , the professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , extracting the pain of countless students at the school.
The Keepers , a coalition of Isidora's mentors, considered this to be a grave misuse of the powers of ancient magic , and pleaded her to stop.
As Isidora refused, a duel broke out between the five of them, resulting in Isidora's death.
Events
The Keepers confronted Isidora Morganach in the Keepers' Caverns , a vast cave network beneath Hogwarts Castle , which she had long been using to extract pain from the students of the school.
Though well-intentioned, the Keepers considered this to be an abuse of the ancient magic that they had sworn to protect.
Isidora claimed that she would allow no-one to feel pain again: " not my father , not my students. "
Percival Rackham asked Isidora to set down her wand , only to be told that he had encouraged her to hone her powers, not to throw them away.
In response, Percival cast the Disarming Charm .
Isidora deflected Percival's Disarming Charm before it could reach her, and nonverbally hurled an explosive spell at the Keepers, sending them backwards, and rendering Niamh Fitzgerald unconscious.
The other Keepers regained their composure, and Percival sent an unknown spell at Isidora, only for her to lock spells with Percival and start sending it back to him.
The death of Isidora Morganach
Charles Rookwood joined the fight, locking spells with Isidora on Percival's side, and for a brief moment, starting to overpower her.
An incredibly powerful witch , however, she started to regain the upper hand.
The duel was cut short when San Bakar , after tending to Niamh, shot the Killing Curse at Isidora, ending her life.
Percival and Charles looked relieved at San's intervention, though still quite shocked at the usage of the Unforgivable Curse .
While Charles and San went to check on Niamh's health, Percival went over to Isidora's corpse and observed her wand.
Notes and references

title: Keepers' Caverns
paragraphs: The Keepers' Caverns were an underground cave network beneath Hogwarts Castle .
They could be accessed through a concealed door below the Map Chamber .

A deeper chamber within the Caverns, protected by two large, ancient magic sentries, housed the final repository , a store of ancient magic constructed by Isidora Morganach and Bragbor in the Tudor era.
History
15th-16th century
In the 15th - 16th century , Isidora Morganach , a Professor at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , used the Caverns to hold the final repository .
This was a store of corrupted ancient magic in the form of 'emotions' and 'pain' that she had extracted from the school's students, constructed by Bragbor .
When her activities-and the Caverns-were discovered by the Keepers, Percival Rackham , Niamh Fitzgerald , Charles Rookwood , and San Bakar , they urged her to stop.
When she refused, a duel broke out between them, resulting in Isidora's death at the hands of San Bakar.
Duel in the Keepers' Caverns
Following this, the Caverns were shut by the Keepers, forever locked beneath the map in the Map Chamber .
The Keepers swore that they would only open it to an individual who possessed the gift of ancient magic, but understood the power and responsibility that they wielded.
Ranrok's invasion
In 1891 , Ranrok , a goblin rebel and Bragbor's descendant, invaded the Caverns by drilling into Hogwarts's foundations, in his quest to unlock the final repository.
A battle ensued within the Caverns between the defending forces of Hogwarts and the invaders.
Although successful in releasing the power of the final repository, Ranrok was defeated by an unidentified student , resulting in his demise.
The Repository was possibly rebuilt afterwards.
Notes and references

title: Marwan Salama
paragraphs: Marwan Salama is an American voice actor who voiced Professor San Bakar in Hogwarts Legacy .

title: Hogwarts Legacy
paragraphs: Hogwarts Legacy is an open-world action role-playing game set in the late 19th century within the wizarding world .

Developed by Avalanche Software and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment under the Portkey Games label, the game was released on 10 February 2023 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. It was originally scheduled to be released on 4 April 2023 on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, but the release date was changed to 5 May 2023 .
It was released on the Nintendo Switch on 14 November 2023 .
It was released on the Nintendo Switch 2 on 5 June 2025 , as a launch title for the console.

Despite the boycott the game received due to a recent controversy , 22 million copies of Hogwarts Legacy had been sold by the end of 2023 and had hit 34 million by March 2025 and 40 million in late December , making it the second best-selling video game in the 2020s and 19th in all video game history.
It also is one of the top three most-played single-player games on PS5, the other two being Assassin's Creed Valhalla and God of War Ragnarök .
Plot
Players create a character capable of seeing and harnessing ancient magic who begins attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry as a fifth-year student in the 1890s .
During the gameplay reveal trailer in March 2022, a newspaper can be seen dated 1 September 1890.
Players experience the life of the student as they "live the unwritten" and embark on a dangerous journey to uncover a hidden truth of the wizarding world.

Besides the protagonist, there are companion students such as Natsai Onai , a brave and justice-seeking Gryffindor, Poppy Sweeting , a kind and beast-loving Hufflepuff, and Sebastian Sallow , a charismatic and optimistic Slytherin.
Villains include Ranrok (a goblin staging a rebellion against wizardkind ) and Victor Rookwood (a Dark wizard operating in and around Hogsmeade ).
Development
The game was originally leaked on Reddit in October 2018 alongside a now-deleted unofficial trailer that showed extensive character creation, spell-casting, magical creatures, and exploration.
No official comment was given by either Warner Bros. nor J. K. Rowling , although many reputable sources inside WB Avalanche, including high ranking employees, teased or claimed to know of the game.
The game was announced via a video game showcase stream by Sony on 16 September 2020 .
It was set to be available to players in 2021 , but the date was later delayed twice, first to 2022 , then to 10 February 2023 to continue developing the game for a better experience for players.
On 17 March 2022, PlayStation revealed a State of Play presentation that featured 20 minutes of gameplay and behind the scenes content.
Community manager Chandler Wood revealed that the game will not have any microtransactions.
On 18 May 2022, Avalanche released an ASMR video showing some additional footage of the Hogwarts grounds, Hogsmeade, and an unidentified area which included a store called the Magic Neep.
While it did not include any additional story information, it did confirm several locations including Zonkos, Dervish and Banges, and Steeply and Sons tea shop.
On 24 May 2022, PlayStation revealed that PS5 will have exclusives relating to the Dual Sense controllers.
The game had started development with actors portraying characters in the games.
Actors were cast and were scheduled to start when the COVID-19 pandemic occurred.
As a result, actors were forced to stay at home.
The cast were forced to use the company Beyond Capture in Vancouver and employ Canadian actors.
They used actors who were able to perform multiple actors; Direction and communication via Zoom.

On 12 August 2022, the official release date was revealed to be 10 February 2023 for PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S and Xbox Series X. The Switch version would be ported later on.
A new exclusive trailer was unveiled at Gamescon on 23 August 2022 , with a pre-order date on 25 August .
A Digital Deluxe version was revealed in the same trailer, with a collector's edition revealed on 24 August.
On 13 December 2022, Avalanche delayed the game for Xbox One and PlayStation 4 until 4 April 2023.
On 6 March , the game on Xbox One and Playstation 4 was delayed from 4 April to 5 May .
Gameplay
Gameplay includes detailed character creation, spell-casting, exploration, stealth, and elements of both the action and role-playing genres.
As it is common for non-free console and PC games, no system of microtransactions is used, unlike the similar mobile game Harry Potter: Hogwarts Mystery .
The player is able to develop their own duelling style by combining different spells.

They are also able to make specific allies; it is possible to become a Dark wizard or witch instead of following a hero path, though the ending will still be the same as the protagonist is lauded as a hero for saving Hogwarts.
The game is set in the Scottish Highlands , including Hogwarts and a vast territory around it.
Broom flight can be used to reach farther locations, which includes wizard villages such as Hogsmeade.
The developers have also confirmed a fast-travel system known as " Floo Flames ".
The scenery and other environments are highly detailed and intricate, weather events affect the environment, and the four climatic seasons are reflected in the landscape.
A Wizard's Field Guide is provided to the player which keeps track of their level.
It also includes their map, quests, owl post , settings, challenges, collections, talents (which unlocks through the main story), inventory and gear.

title: Vault 12
paragraphs: Vault 12 was a vault located in the deepest part of Gringotts Wizarding Bank .
The vault had an Anti-Disapparition Jinx placed on it.
History
Vault number twelve was commissioned by Percival Rackham and Charles Rookwood shortly after Gringotts was founded (some time after 1474 ).
They created a path to it that only one with the ability to detect ancient magic could successfully follow to discover their secrets, including a key which served as a Portkey .
They left instructions that once those with the key entered it, the door was to be locked.
Nobody opened it for hundreds of years.
The vault's entrance
On 1 September 1890 , Eleazar Fig and his new fifth-year student visited this vault after using the Portkey left by the late Miriam Fig .
They travelled through ancient ruins where they crossed a never-used portal to Gringotts.
A goblin banker gave them access then threw away the key, using the same instructions that had been left to him hundreds of years ago.
It appeared that Fig and his student had to " earn their way out ".
The vault appeared to be empty, but the student used their ability of seeing ancient magic to get to another area.
After some fights with animated Guardian statues, they looked into a Pensieve there showing Percival and Charles setting up the vault from a locket that contained the memory of them.
The goblin Ranrok then entered and attempted to duel Fig, but an animated knight came out and fought against him, allowing Fig and the student to escape with the locket.

title: Hogwarts Legacy
paragraphs: Hogwarts Legacy is an open-world action role-playing game set in the late 19th century within the wizarding world .

Developed by Avalanche Software and published by Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment under the Portkey Games label, the game was released on 10 February 2023 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. It was originally scheduled to be released on 4 April 2023 on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, but the release date was changed to 5 May 2023 .
It was released on the Nintendo Switch on 14 November 2023 .
It was released on the Nintendo Switch 2 on 5 June 2025 , as a launch title for the console.

Despite the boycott the game received due to a recent controversy , 22 million copies of Hogwarts Legacy had been sold by the end of 2023 and had hit 34 million by March 2025 and 40 million in late December , making it the second best-selling video game in the 2020s and 19th in all video game history.
It also is one of the top three most-played single-player games on PS5, the other two being Assassin's Creed Valhalla and God of War Ragnarök .
Plot
Players create a character capable of seeing and harnessing ancient magic who begins attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry as a fifth-year student in the 1890s .
During the gameplay reveal trailer in March 2022, a newspaper can be seen dated 1 September 1890.
Players experience the life of the student as they "live the unwritten" and embark on a dangerous journey to uncover a hidden truth of the wizarding world.

Besides the protagonist, there are companion students such as Natsai Onai , a brave and justice-seeking Gryffindor, Poppy Sweeting , a kind and beast-loving Hufflepuff, and Sebastian Sallow , a charismatic and optimistic Slytherin.
Villains include Ranrok (a goblin staging a rebellion against wizardkind ) and Victor Rookwood (a Dark wizard operating in and around Hogsmeade ).
Development
The game was originally leaked on Reddit in October 2018 alongside a now-deleted unofficial trailer that showed extensive character creation, spell-casting, magical creatures, and exploration.
No official comment was given by either Warner Bros. nor J. K. Rowling , although many reputable sources inside WB Avalanche, including high ranking employees, teased or claimed to know of the game.
The game was announced via a video game showcase stream by Sony on 16 September 2020 .
It was set to be available to players in 2021 , but the date was later delayed twice, first to 2022 , then to 10 February 2023 to continue developing the game for a better experience for players.
On 17 March 2022, PlayStation revealed a State of Play presentation that featured 20 minutes of gameplay and behind the scenes content.
Community manager Chandler Wood revealed that the game will not have any microtransactions.
On 18 May 2022, Avalanche released an ASMR video showing some additional footage of the Hogwarts grounds, Hogsmeade, and an unidentified area which included a store called the Magic Neep.
While it did not include any additional story information, it did confirm several locations including Zonkos, Dervish and Banges, and Steeply and Sons tea shop.
On 24 May 2022, PlayStation revealed that PS5 will have exclusives relating to the Dual Sense controllers.
The game had started development with actors portraying characters in the games.
Actors were cast and were scheduled to start when the COVID-19 pandemic occurred.
As a result, actors were forced to stay at home.
The cast were forced to use the company Beyond Capture in Vancouver and employ Canadian actors.
They used actors who were able to perform multiple actors; Direction and communication via Zoom.

On 12 August 2022, the official release date was revealed to be 10 February 2023 for PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S and Xbox Series X. The Switch version would be ported later on.
A new exclusive trailer was unveiled at Gamescon on 23 August 2022 , with a pre-order date on 25 August .
A Digital Deluxe version was revealed in the same trailer, with a collector's edition revealed on 24 August.
On 13 December 2022, Avalanche delayed the game for Xbox One and PlayStation 4 until 4 April 2023.
On 6 March , the game on Xbox One and Playstation 4 was delayed from 4 April to 5 May .
Gameplay
Gameplay includes detailed character creation, spell-casting, exploration, stealth, and elements of both the action and role-playing genres.
As it is common for non-free console and PC games, no system of microtransactions is used, unlike the similar mobile game Harry Potter: Hogwarts Mystery .
The player is able to develop their own duelling style by combining different spells.

They are also able to make specific allies; it is possible to become a Dark wizard or witch instead of following a hero path, though the ending will still be the same as the protagonist is lauded as a hero for saving Hogwarts.
The game is set in the Scottish Highlands , including Hogwarts and a vast territory around it.
Broom flight can be used to reach farther locations, which includes wizard villages such as Hogsmeade.
The developers have also confirmed a fast-travel system known as " Floo Flames ".
The scenery and other environments are highly detailed and intricate, weather events affect the environment, and the four climatic seasons are reflected in the landscape.
A Wizard's Field Guide is provided to the player which keeps track of their level.
It also includes their map, quests, owl post , settings, challenges, collections, talents (which unlocks through the main story), inventory and gear.

title: Corrupted ancient magic
paragraphs: Ranrok absorbing a mass of corrupted magic
This magic was ancient magic that had been corrupted by malicious intent or dangerous experimentation, and manifested in the form of magical energy that glowed dark red, sometimes with black hues.
The power of corrupted ancient magic was so great that the eyes of practitioners would sometimes glow bright, eerie red when they invoked and wielded it.
Corrupted ancient magic was a form of Dark magic .
History
Professor Morganach
The final repository created by Bragbor the Boastful

In the Tudor period , Isidora Morganach , a professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts , had used an ancient spell to extract pain and, unintentionally, emotions from her father , the local people, and even her students, storing these pains in a jar until it became uncontrollable.
She had then tasked Bragbor the Boastful with creating the final repository out of goblin silver to contain the corrupted magic, which she placed beneath Hogwarts Castle .

Isidora was killed by Professor San Bakar to stop her harmful actions when she started using the spell indiscriminately on the students, and the corrupted magic was divided and stored at Rookwood Castle by Bakar and the other Keepers .
The repository of this corrupted magic was eventually forgotten.
Ranrok's rebellion
By the end of the 19th century , Ranrok , a descendant of Bragbor, had led a goblin rebellion and set out to find the corrupted magic.
He discovered a fragment of it and shared it among his loyal goblins .
Ranrok turning into a dragon

Eventually, the goblins , under Ranrok's leadership, circumvented Hogwarts's protective measures by drilling under the school, which the protective enchantments did not cover at the time, and reached the repository.
Ranrok destroyed it, absorbing vast amounts of corrupted ancient magic into his body, and transformed into a mass of dark energy in the shape of a giant dragon .
Ranrok was about to emerge from the underground to wreak havoc but was successfully killed by a student wielding ancient magic .
Notes and references

title: Final repository
paragraphs: The final repository was a storage unit made of goblin silver , buried deep within the Keepers' Caverns beneath Hogwarts Castle .
History
It was constructed by Bragbor the Boastful at the behest of Professor Isidora Morganach to contain the extracted pain from Hogwarts students.
By the time of Isidora's death , it had become a vast store of ancient magic that if ever released, could threaten the wizarding world as a whole.

To safeguard and against it possibly corrupt influences, the Keepers kept it a secret from the rest of Hogwarts, burying it deep underneath the Map Chamber , where they would permit it to be discovered by an unidentified Hogwarts student centuries later.
There was another repository beneath Rookwood Castle , but it was significantly smaller than the one in Keepers' Caverns.

The existence of the Repository became known to Ranrok , a goblin rebel and descendant of Bragbor, who worked with the criminal kingpin Victor Rookwood , after learning about its exact location in Bragbor's last journal .
However, he had been aware of its existence long before, as he had depleted the Rookwood Castle repository and was hungry for more ancient magic.
Ranrok had amassed an army of Loyalists , and constructed large drills , with the hope of penetrating the rock foundation of Hogwarts and stealing the Repository's power for himself.
Concurrently, the student was determined to prove themselves to the Keepers and show that they were worthy enough to defend it.
The Repository was ultimately destroyed in a battle conducted by Ranrok and his Loyalists in the 1890-1891 school year .
Ranrok consumed the magic within and transformed into a dragon .
He was eventually defeated by the student, who possibly reconstructed the Repository, or possibly ingested its power themselves.
Notes and references

title: Bragbor the Boastful
paragraphs: Bragbor the Boastful was a male goblin and a talented artisan who lived during the 15th and 16th centuries .
He was well known for his metalwork with iron and silver , and was an ancestor of Ranrok and Lodgok .
Biography

Because of his famous skills, he was commissioned by Professor Isidora Morganach to construct a repository for the emotional magic she had extracted from her students at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .

The repository was claimed hundreds of years later by his descendant, Ranrok , a rebel goblin who argued that because it had been created by goblins, it was owned by goblins, a statement that held true in goblin culture, even if not in Wizarding law .
Bragbor's history was revealed through the memories of Isidora to the new fifth-year student and Sebastian Sallow through a Pensieve in the 1890-1891 school year .
He was also referred to as Bragbor the Boastful during one of Professor Cuthbert Binns 's History of Magic classes.
Notes and references

title: Isidora Morganach's father
paragraphs: Mr Morganach (fl.
1470s ) was a Scottish man who lived in Feldcroft .
He was the father of Isidora Morganach , a medieval Professor of Defence Against the Dark Arts at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , as well as a son , who predeceased him.
Biography
Due to the psychological trauma following his son's death, he started to display total mutism .
This made Isidora, a witch , determined to find a 'cure' for his pain.
She invented a pain extraction spell , which she used on him in front of her Hogwarts colleagues, the Keepers .
After this, he was able to speak again.
With time, however, he became unresponsive once again, as all emotion had been drained from him.
After losing his emotion, he eventually became blind , returned to his former state of mutism, and entered into a vegetative state .
Notes and references

title: Goblin-wrought silver
paragraphs: Goblin-wrought silver (also known as goblins' silver and goblin-made , or goblin-forged silver ) was pure silver , forged and enchanted by goblins using goblin magic .
They had been making it for at least a thousand years.
Goblin-made silver possessed properties that wizardkind were incapable of reproducing.
Properties
According to Professor Phineas Nigellus Black , goblins' silver repelled mundane dirt, meaning it did not require cleaning.
It imbibed "only that which strengthens it".

When Harry Potter killed a Basilisk with a weapon made from goblin-wrought silver by stabbing it through the roof of the mouth, this property caused the sword to absorb the properties of Basilisk venom and therefore become capable of destroying things that were vulnerable to Basilisk venom, even if the object in question was otherwise invulnerable to anything else.

Goblins' silver was able to contain ancient magic , which Professor Isidora Morganach used to her advantage in the Tudor period after having used her power of ancient magic to draw pain from many different people.
The pain that she was left with, which was magical in nature, was powerful, but also volatile and dangerous.
She stored it inside of giant spherical repositories made out of goblin silver in the Scottish Highlands around Hogwarts .
According to Hagrid , goblins were able to make "indestructible" armour.
Presumably this referred to goblin-wrought silver.
However, Mundungus Fletcher believed he would be able to remove the engraving on the Black family 's goblin-wrought silver goblets , although he never actually did so.

Goblin-wrought silver was likely extremely valuable, as the notoriously tight-fisted Caractacus Burke considered 500 Galleons a fair price for a suit of armour made from it, and even then he was rebuffed.
Mundungus Fletcher considered it valuable enough to steal, and was excited to discover some.
The Lestrange family stored helmets made from it among their valuables at Gringotts Wizarding Bank .
A thousand years ago, Ragnuk the First coveted the sword he had made from silver and rubies so much that he sent minions to steal it back.
Despite this value, goblin-wrought silverware seemed to be relatively common.
It was the standard cutlery used at Hogwarts, used by at least a thousand students and expected by Madam Rosmerta to be common enough for people to find it in a scavenger hunt on Valentine's Day .
Known examples
Goblin Griphook with the Sword of Gryffindor
Notes and references

title: Rookwood Castle
paragraphs: Rookwood Castle was a castle that overlooked the hamlet of Feldcroft in the Highlands of Scotland .
By 1890 , it was a ruin.
Description

The ruins of the castle was where former Hogwarts Professor of Transfiguration and member of the Keepers , Charles Rookwood set up his test for a potential successor to the secrets and role of guardianship of ancient magic .
The trial was accessible through a secret, ancient magic doorway in the castles basement.
To open the door to the basement, one had to blast several targets on the wall in rapid succession.
Once there, the person taking the trial had to proceed alone.
The trial consisted of exploring and navigating an underground labyrinth filled with enchanted architecture and magical puzzles.

There were two common themes in the labyrinth; first was a magical archway in which the room was different depending on which side of the arch on was on, on one side, pillars were tall and could be climbed, but too heavy to move.
On the other side of the arch, the pillar was short and easy to move, but could not be climbed anywhere.
The other theme was a target on the wall that once blasted caused the floor to spin and the arch to get turned around.
The labyrinth was also guarded by suits of enchanted armour that attacked anyone who passed through.

The Pensieve Sentinels and Pensieve Sentrys were regular sized suits of armour with no noteworthy abilities, the Pensieve Protectors were larger suits capable of fast and powerful attacks, and the final armour, the Pensieve Guardian , was gigantic and capable of magic attacks.
Only after this final armour was defeated was one able to reach the Pensieve at the end of the labyrinth and view the memories Professor Rookwood left behind.
History
The castle was the home of Charles Rookwood , the professor of Transfiguration at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry during the Tudor period .
It became the home of successive generations of the Rookwood family .
A repository of ancient magic was hidden beneath the castle.
Another view of the castle
It was presumably abandoned by the 1880s , as Miriam Fig was able to set up an improvised research site at the castle.
She had acquired an interest in the location during her research into the secrets of ancient magic.
There, she met Lodgok , and permitted him to search the castle on his own.
Lodgok located the repository beneath the castle and brought Ranrok's Loyalists to the site.
Ranrok used the repository to give himself the power of ancient magic, and by 1890 , it had been fully depleted, though Ranrok's Loyalists still had an active presence in the area.
During the 1890-1891 school year , Eleazar Fig and his student infiltrated the castle at the behest of Charles Rookwood's portrait .
Together, they saw the depleted repository and then ascended to the upper storeys so that the student could complete Charles's 'trial'.
Notes and references

title: Ranrok's goblin rebellion
paragraphs: Ranrok's goblin rebellion was a goblin rebellion led by Ranrok that took place throughout the late 1880s until its conclusion in 1891 .
Throughout his campaign, Ranrok made an uneasy alliance with the Rookwood Gang , a criminal faction of Dark wizards led by Victor Rookwood , Europe 's most powerful wizard criminal at the time.
The earliest known event within the rebellion was the attack on Feldcroft in the late 1880s , which saw the cursing of Anne Sallow at the hands of Victor Rookwood .
While Rookwood's goals were at first profit-oriented, Ranrok sought to supplant wizardkind with goblinkind as the dominant magical race, as well as acquiring wands for his species.

To accomplish this, he investigated the history of Isidora Morganach and the Keepers , as well as the subject of ancient magic as a whole, to track down the final repository , a store of ancient magic buried beneath Hogwarts Castle .
Ranrok built large drills to penetrate the base of the Castle and steal the Repository, which he successfully did in 1891 .
Concurrent to the rebellion, Professor Eleazar Fig and his student , who had the ability to control ancient magic, led an independent mission to actualise his student's potential.

With the aid of the Keepers , they managed to defeat Victor Rookwood in a duel , as well as defeating Ranrok himself in a battle for the final repository , where they were helped by multiple Hogwarts professors.
The rebellion received little awareness from the British Ministry of Magic , who were oblivious to its true gravity.
Meanwhile, The Daily Prophet also treated it as a rumour.
Background
Isidora Morganach was a Dark witch and a wielder of ancient magic in the 15th - 16th century .
She used a repository constructed by Bragbor , Ranrok's ancestor, made of goblin silver , to store " pain " from Hogwarts students.
By the time Isidora died , the energy stored within the repository was so great that it had to be contained by the Keepers .

The Keepers developed trials so that if anyone in the future also wielded ancient magic, they would have to prove themselves before the Keepers' Caverns , which held the power source, could be opened.
By the 1890s , this individual presented themselves in the form of a Hogwarts student.
Ranrok had heard of Isidora's legacy and acquired an interest in the power source, desperate to supplant wizardkind with goblins.
Thus began Ranrok's own quest to unlock the repository, concurrent to the student's quest to prove himself worthy enough to defend it.
The student was supported by Eleazar Fig in his journey to pass the Keepers' trials.
Timeline of events
Raid on Feldcroft
In the late 1880s , Victor Rookwood and Ranrok acquired a mutual interest in Isidora Morganach 's estate.
They attacked the village of Feldcroft , where it was located, causing Anne Sallow to rush out to help the wounded.
She was cursed by Rookwood, who uttered " children should be seen and not heard ", and bore the scars of the curse for many years after.
In the 1890s , rebellion steadily caused concern in the wizarding world with opinions differing to how big of a threat Ranrok was.
George Osric had difficulties persuading the British Ministry of Magic to be aware of how dangerous Ranrok was.
Attack on Eleazar Fig and George Osric
Eleazar Fig and the new student falling from the carriage
On 1 September 1890 , in his determination to acquire the Vault 12 key , Ranrok unleashed a possessed dragon on the carriage that held the new fifth-year student , Eleazar Fig , and George Osric .
The attack resulted in the death of Osric, but the escape of all other parties.
Skirmish in Vault 12
Also on 1 September 1890 , some time after the carriage attack, Ranrok found his way into Vault 12 through the machinations of a Gringotts Guard who was loyal to him.
There, he found the new student with Eleazar Fig .
Although Ranrok personally murdered a banker during the attack, he was himself subdued by a Pensieve Guardian before he could manage to apprehend Fig or the student.
Troll attack on Hogsmeade
On 2 September 1890 , Ranrok partnered with Victor Rookwood to unleash two trolls into the village of Hogsmeade with the hope of creating a distraction.

The trolls caused a significant amount of property damage and chaos within Hogsmeade, before being stopped by Ruth Singer , the new student, at their friend (either Sebastian Sallow or Natsai Onai ), after which the new student was dubbed the 'Troll Dispatcher', 'Troll Vanquisher', 'Troll Slayer', and 'Troll Whisperer'.
Duel at Lower Hogsfield

As the Loyalists had allied with the Rookwood Gang , and their joint branches of the Ashwinders and the Poacher Pack , the student found themselves and Onai to be harassed by Rookwood's gang at Lower Hogsfield , resulting in a small duel there.
Infiltration into San Bakar's Tower
Infiltration into the Collector's Cave
Infiltration into Rookwood Castle
Skirmish at the Overlook Mine
Infiltration into the Mine's Eye
Skirmish at Tower Tunnel
Infiltration into the Coastal Mine
Victor Rookwood's last stand
This duel between the new student and Victor Rookwood , one of Ranrok's defected allies, saw the demise of the Rookwood Gang and the death of Victor Rookwood himself.
Battle for the final repository
The arrival of the Hogwarts professors during the battle

Near the end of the 1890-1891 school year , this was the final battle between Ranrok's Loyalists and the fifth-year student, who was fighting alongside the professors of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry .

The battle took place in the Keepers' Caverns beneath the school, and was focused solely on controlling the final repository , a major source of ancient magical power that had been constructed by Isidora Morganach and Bragbor the Boastful centuries before.
Other events
This skirmish occurred at Feldcroft on an unknown date, resulting in the death of an unidentified goblin who had been forced to commit suicide by Sebastian Sallow , who was using the Imperius Curse .
Notes and references

title: Ranrok's Loyalists
paragraphs: Ranrok's Loyalists were a militant group of goblins led by Ranrok during his rebellion in the late 19th century .
History
The Loyalists wholeheartedly shared their leader's disdain for wizardkind , and shared his vision of a future where goblins would depose wizards as the dominant race of the magical community .
They were not above directing their wrath towards other goblins who did not share their values, considering them "traitors".
Empowered by a corrupt form of ancient magic , goblins among the Loyalists possessed glowing red eyes and a level of aggression unheard of in previous goblin rebellions.
The Loyalists wore dark red tunics with gold accents, and were equipped with weapons and armour presumably forged from goblin-wrought silver .

Ranging from grunt warriors to formidable spell casters, as well as tamed trolls equipped with the enchanted armour and reinforced clubs, Loyalists were a force to be reckoned with and had terrorised much of the regions surrounding Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry by 1891.
Even after Ranrok's death during the battle for the final repository , the Loyalists remained active, though their leadership structure following Ranrok is unknown.

title: Pain extraction spell
paragraphs: This healing spell ( incantation unknown ) could remove the feeling of pain , mental and presumably also physical, from another person and draw it onto the tip of the caster's wand .
The spell was tied to ancient magic .
However, it also appeared to drain the target of all emotion if it was used too much.
The energy drained turned into corrupted ancient magic .
The spell was a form of Dark magic .
According to Niamh Fitzgerald , the spell left "Dark" traces.
Known uses
Isidora Morganach created and performed this spell within her lifetime to remove the pain of her brother 's death from her father .
Eventually, this caused him to become blind and mute.
She also attempted to use this spell on Niamh Fitzgerald without her permission.
In the 15th - 16th century , Isidora used this spell to extract pain and emotions from the students of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , where she worked as a professor .
She stored these emotions in the final repository , a storage unit constructed of goblin silver .

These emotions were eventually released during the invasion of Ranrok in the 1890-1891 school year , giving him not only the unnatural ability to transform into a dragon when absorbed, but also near-invincibility and extraordinary offensive and defensive power.
Known practitioners
Notes and references

title: Isidora Morganach's brother
paragraphs: Mr Morganach (fl.
1470s ) was the brother of Isidora Morganach .
He predeceased his sister and father .
Biography
During his childhood years, he was present when a drought affected his village of Feldcroft .
He witnessed the Keepers relieve the village of the drought, but was seen sputtering and coughing, visibly sick.
He needed a walking stick to stand.
He died from an unknown cause, but his death left such an impact on his father that he was unable or unwilling to speak.
This led to Isidora Morganach creating an ancient magic spell that extracted the feeling of pain from somebody.
She used this spell on their father, 'curing' him.
Notes and references

title: Blindness
paragraphs: Blindness is a term used for somebody who has complete or nearly complete vision loss.
The reasons behind blindness can differ greatly, and although it is usually treatable, it cannot be cured.
History
Isidora Morganach's father became blind after his daughter extracted pain from him using her signature pain extraction spell .
Ominis Gaunt was a pure-blood blind wizard alive during the late 19th century , and he used a sentient wand that guided him around and allowed him to duel .
His blindness could not be cured by any means.
This likely involved some magical cause, because mundane nature could easily be corrected.
A wizarding speakeasy owned by Gnarlak the goblin , which was located in New York during the 1920s , was called The Blind Pig .

During the 1990-1991 school year , Verucca Buckthorn-Snyde blinded Jacob with a variation of the Conjunctivitis Curse that was purple in colour in Knockturn Alley , intending the curse for his father Peregrine .
Jacob was hospitalised in St Mungo's as a result, and Healers could not cure his blindness with the Oculus Potion .
By early 1993 , Rubeus Hagrid 's pet Acromantula , Aragog , had become blind.
Later, on 29 May 1993, Fawkes blinded the Serpent of Slytherin by clawing at its eyes in the Chamber of Secrets .
Blind individuals

title: Battle for the final repository
paragraphs: This battle occurred in the Keepers' Caverns beneath Hogwarts Castle in an area that was not protected by Hogwarts's defensive charms .
It marked the conclusion of Ranrok 's goblin rebellion and his attempt to elevate goblins above wizardkind , whom he intended to wipe out.
Background

In the 15th - 16th century , Isidora Morganach extracted emotions from students at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and contained them in the final repository , a goblin silver storage unit in the Keepers' Caverns built by Bragbor .
Ranrok discovered the repository's existence by hunting down various sites that Isidora had used within her lifetime and constructed massive drills to pierce the mountains of Hogwarts.
Meanwhile, an unidentified Hogwarts student with the ability to use and perceive ancient magic had started Hogwarts in their fifth year .

Throughout the year, they had been tutored by Eleazar Fig and the portraits of the Keepers with the hope of continuing to safeguard ancient magic against abuse from outsiders, but also to use their powers to protect the wizarding world from Ranrok's incursions.
In the end, this battle was the final opportunity to end Ranrok once and for all.
Events

Ranrok began his invasion by drilling through the mountain on which Hogwarts Castle was built, which were not defended by the same defensive charms that guarded the castle itself, bringing his Loyalists and various trolls with him.
The arrival of the professors
Eleazar Fig had informed his colleagues, the professors of Hogwarts, about the attack.

Professors Matilda Weasley , Mudiwa Onai , Aesop Sharp , Abraham Ronen , and Dinah Hecat promptly arrived to help Fig and his student , who had the ability to use and perceive ancient magic , to defend the cavern.
This student was also in possession of the Keepers' wand , a device necessary to open the door to the final repository, which Victor Rookwood had earlier unsuccessfully attempted to steal.
After this student and Fig entered the repository chamber, Ranrok appeared and, using Miriam Fig's wand , broke open the final repository and inhaled its emotions, acquiring unrivalled power.
He transformed into an invincible dragon -like creature and started a final duel with the student, crushing Eleazar Fig with debris.
Ranrok's dragon form
The student painstakingly defeated Ranrok and possibly used the Keepers' wand to create a new cage in which to trap the excess emotion.
The student also possibly consumed and wielded the emotional magic themselves by opening the repository.
Professor Fig afterwards died and was laid to rest.
A memorial ceremony was held for him in the Great Hall following the battle.

title: Zaccaria Innocenti
paragraphs: Zaccaria Innocenti (fl.
79 AD ) was an ancient Roman warlock who lived during the 1st century AD .
Biography

He misused the Dancing Feet Spell in 79 AD , conjuring a 'dance' within Mt. Vesuvius , resulting in its eruption, which destroyed the Roman cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum , killing at least 1500 people.
His improper usage of the spell was what he and the spell were most remembered for.
Whether or not he was one of the eruption's casualties is unknown.
Magical abilities and skills
Etymology
"Zaccaria" is the Italian form of Zechariah, a Hebrew name meaning "God remembers", while Innocenti is an Italian surname that derives from the Italian word for "innocent" ( innocente ).
Neither is consistent with the naming conventions of ancient Rome, but this may be explained as wizarding names not necessarily adhering to non-magical naming conventions.
Notes and references

title: Mount Vesuvius
paragraphs: Mount Vesuvius is a volcano in the province of Naples in Italy .
In 79 AD , Zaccaria Innocenti made inappropriate use of the Dancing Feet Spell , "conjuring a 'dance'" within the volcano that resulted in its eruption.
This disaster destroyed the Roman cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum , killing at least 1500 people, but made Innocenti's improper usage of the spell legendary.
Notes and references

title: Coliseum
paragraphs: The Coliseum is an amphitheatre in the centre of Rome , Italy , built in the 1st century by the Romans.
History
Orabella Nuttley repairing the columns of the Coliseum

In 1754 , the Coliseum was selected as the finishing line in a broom race from Aberdeen to Rome between famous fliers Torquil McTavish and Silvio Astolfi , and government representatives and supporters gathered there to await their arrival.
However, just as the pair were seen flying toward the ancient amphitheatre, a clash broke out between rival factions of fans.
During the fight, an explosion was somehow set off, leaving the Coliseum in ruins.
Orabella Nuttley stepped forward and repaired a few columns with the Mending Charm she had invented .

Amazed, the assembled ministers asked her to teach them how to perform it, and the damage to the Coliseum was undone by the time that Muggles woken up by the sound of the explosion arrived at the scene.
Notes and references

title: Rome
paragraphs: Rome is the capital of Italy as well as the country's largest and most populous city.
History
In 1754 , celebrated broom fliers Silvio Astolfi , of Italy, and Torquil McTavish , of Scotland , agreed to hold a race from Aberdeen to Rome.
Fans of both racers gathered at the Colosseum , where the finishing line was located, and a fight broke out between them.
During the scuffle, an explosion was somehow set off, leaving the Colosseum in ruins.

Thanks to Orabella Nuttley , who stepped forward to repair a few columns with the Mending Charm she had invented, the damage to the ancient amphitheatre was undone by the time that Rome's Muggle citizens arrived at the scene.
Notes and references

title: The Diagon Dispensary
paragraphs: The Diagon Dispensary was an apothecary based in Diagon Alley , London , and established in A.D. 236 .
Among their range of products were Purest Extract of Snakeweed and Purifying Concentrate of Spleenwart .

title: Annual broom race
paragraphs: The annual broom race was held in Sweden and had been contested since the tenth century .
Entrants raced a course of just over 300 miles (48 Swedish miles) from Kopparberg to Arjeplog .
The course ran through a Swedish Short-Snout dragon reservation , and the enormous silver trophy was in the shape of a Swedish Short-Snout .
History

The race evolved into an international event, with wizards and witches from all over the world attending, seeing off the competitors at Kopparberg, then Apparating to Arjeplog to welcome the survivors.
The 1956 Annual Broom Race was held on 21 December .
By 2009 , Zola Farrell had competed at least once in the race; she didn't win, but she said to her son that it was a blast.

Before 2009, Ambrose Turner , together with his daughter Lottie , visited the Swedish dragon reservation to try to do a painting, but they Apparated there on the same day the race was taking place, and were unable to paint at all.
Notes and references

title: Sweden
paragraphs: Sweden , officially called the Kingdom of Sweden , is a Scandinavian constitutional monarchy in Northern Europe .
Sweden borders Norway , Finland and Denmark .
Its capital city is Stockholm .
History

Xenophilius and Luna Lovegood believed that Crumple-Horned Snorkacks were native to Sweden and went on an expedition to find them there in the summer of 1996 , using the money the Daily Prophet paid them in order to re-print Harry Potter 's account of Lord Voldemort 's return.
The Swedish Short-Snout was a dragon native to the country.
During the 1994 Triwizard Tournament held at Hogwarts , Cedric Diggory tried to steal a golden egg from a Swedish Short-Snout during the first task of the tournament.
Magical education
Durmstrang Institute may have been located in Sweden.
Magical games and sports
Sweden hosted the annual broom race which dated from the tenth century.
The competitors flew from Kopparberg to Arjeplog .
The winner received a trophy shaped like a Swedish Short-Snout .
While the Nordic National Quidditch team sometimes represented the country in international Quidditch tournaments, Sweden also fielded their own national team .
