title: French Ministry of Magic Records Room
paragraphs: The records room was located at the French Ministry of Magic .
Description
The records room had a beautiful atrium, and was found behind towering Art Nouveau doors that were carved to look like trees.
There was a desk guarding these doors, and an archivist had to check an ancient book that had the name of every family who had a record in the room before granting access.
The records room was very dark, and had acres of shelves carved to look like trees holding records: rolls of parchments and a few prophecies, trunks and boxes.
A record owner wishing to access their record would have to say the name of their family, and the shelves would shift and bring their record to them.
Using Circumrota would turn the shelves.
If the archivist found someone in the room who they felt should not be in there, they could call for the Matagots who guarded the French Ministry of Magic .
The shelves would spin to apprehend the intruder, and retract into the floor to expose their whereabouts in an empty room.
Using Ascendio would cause the shelves to go back up.
History
The Lestrange family kept records in this room until they relocated them, leaving a note in place of the box informing the reader of the new location.

In September 1927 , Melusine was an archivist working in the records room, when Newton Scamander and Tina Goldstein pretended to be Leta Lestrange and her fiancé to access the Lestrange family records.
Their purpose was to find out why Gellert Grindelwald was interested in Credence Barebone .
The real Leta went in to the Records Room intending to destroy any record of her brother Corvus Lestrange 's death before someone found it, and found Newt and Tina in there.
Melusine called for Matagots because of Newt and Tina's intrusion.

The shelves in the room tried to stop them by descending into the ground and exposing their location, but Newt helped Leta and Tina escape by putting them in his suitcase and using a Zouwu to get out of the Ministry.
Known employees
Notes and references

title: Gellert Grindelwald's Paris rally
paragraphs: Gellert Grindelwald's Paris rally was a short but fateful skirmish during Grindelwald's campaign of violence across Europe.
History
Grindelwald calling his followers
Arriving in Paris three months after his escape, Grindelwald gathered like-minded wizards to a rally in the Lestrange Mausoleum in the Père Lachaise Cemetery .
Laying a trail of breadcrumbs for wizards to follow, he drew Leta Lestrange , Newt Scamander , Tina and Queenie Goldstein , and Yusuf Kama to his rally.

However, the most important of Grindelwald's 'guests' was the Obscurial Credence Barebone , a wizard who had been abused by his adoptive mother for his magic and whose power was great enough to allow him to survive the attack of MACUSA's Aurors in New York.

Most of all, Grindelwald hoped to convert Credence to his cause, as he needed his power to defeat the only wizard who represented a threat to his cause: Albus Dumbledore , his old friend and former lover.
Visions of the future
In the Mausoleum, Grindelwald was welcomed with incredible enthusiasm.
Grindelwald addressed his followers about his vision for the future.
Despite the presence of countless pure-bloods, he did not reciprocate their belief that the Muggles were 'vermin', but that they would have their own place in the new world he intends to build.
But that, for the greater good of the world at large, wizards needed to rise up and take over the world before the future happens.
Gellert Grindelwald 's vision of the future
Using a mysterious skull artefact , he shared the vision of the future that he had had: another world war , far more destructive than the previous one had been.

The gathered wizards witnessed the imprisonment of millions of people into concentration camps, the destruction of Muggle cities by destructive weapons such as war planes and tanks, and the use of the first atomic bomb.

Once the vision had dissipated, Grindelwald identified the enemy they were facing not as the Muggles themselves but as the barbarity and lust for power that motivated them to wage against one another with ever greater means of destruction.

And he questioned how long it would be before wizards themselves would be threatened by the destructiveness of those weapons, stoking the very fears that had plagued the wizarding world since the end of the First World War.
Arrival of the Aurors
As his speech was concluding and the vision had dissipated, a group of Aurors from the French and British Ministries of Magic arrived to arrest Grindelwald and his followers.
Openly recognising the battalion of Aurors, Grindelwald invited them into the circle.
Noticing a young witch staring contemptuously at an Auror, he described how the Aurors had fought them mercilessly, killing his followers simply for believing.
When the girl went for her wand, the Auror murdered her with the Killing Curse, proving Grindelwald's point.
The girl who was killed at the rally

Grindelwald martyred the girl, instructing her friends to return her to her family and spread the word that, in spite of the Ministries' claims, he and his allies were not the ones to spread the violence.
The wizards who had attended the rally Disapparated, leaving Grindelwald and his acolytes alone in the Mausoleum with the Aurors.
Choosing sides
Vinda Rosier joining Grindelwald

On Theseus Scamander 's orders, the Aurors prepared to arrest Grindelwald but the Dark wizard conjured a circle of protective fire : those who entered with complete fidelity and belief in his cause would survive; those who did not, would be engulfed and perish.
Vinda Rosier , who had been standing by his side during the rally and who still held the skull artefact, was the first to join him, and she followed quickly.
Only Krall , an unfaithful acolyte who had been challenging his plans recently, was consumed by the flames.
As his acolytes Disapparated, leaving only himself and Rosier in the circle of black flames, Grindelwald invited the Aurors to join him in his quest for wizarding dominance and freedom.
Those who would not would die.
Several Aurors made to flee but Grindelwald unleashed the flames of his spell and the fleeing Aurors were consumed instantly.
Credence Barebone, who had attended Grindelwald's speech with his Maledictus companion Nagini , decided to join him to find out the truth about his identity, despite Nagini's protests.
He crossed the circle of flames into Grindelwald's open arms, who whispered that everything he had done had been for Credence's sake.
Seduced by the idea of a world where she would be free to marry Jacob Kowalski, Queenie Goldstein joining Grindelwald, despite her lover's pleading.

At the same time, Queenie Goldstein , who had been conflicted about her loyalties due to her desire to marry the No-Maj Jacob Kowalski and the stigma it carried in the wizarding world, had come to believe Grindelwald's cause was the only way to get what they wanted.
She tearfully asked Jacob to join her but he refused, knowing that Grindelwald's cause was not what it appeared to be.
Heartbroken, Queenie turned her back on him and, despite his protests, crossed the circle.
Although she screamed as she crossed and it appeared that she would be consumed, she made it through safely, joining Grindelwald and Disapparating to join his other followers.
As more Aurors fell to Grindelwald's flames, unable to even leave the Mausoleum by Disapparating, several Aurors who had followed Theseus Scamander to Père-Lachaise joined Grindelwald.
Grindelwald casting the black flames towards the Aurors
The Dark wizard then turned on the Scamander brothers, asking Newt whether Dumbledore would mourn for him when he was killed.

As the brothers focused their combined power into a double spell to deflect the attacking black flames and protect those behind them, Leta Lestrange, who had remained hidden until this moment, appeared and ordered Grindelwald to cease his attack on her fiancé and her childhood friend .
He complied, recognising Leta for who she was; the unloved and hated child of a despised family.
He complimented her on her bravery despite the adversity she had faced in her entire life.
He invited her to join him and she seemed to accept, taking his outstretched hand and appearing ready to follow him.

However, she betrayed him immediately; as Grindelwald returned to the circle, she turned to the Scamander brothers and sadly professed her love for them both, one last time, before attacking the Dark wizard.
Grindelwald kills Leta
With a point of her wand, Leta made the skull explode, which blasted Rosier backwards.
The substances contained within the skull seemed to react to the enchanted flames, causing them to threaten the entire Mausoleum.
As Theseus fought against the flames to reach his fiancée, Leta was engulfed by Grindelwald's flames, killing her.
The flames started to spread the whole Mausoleum, threatening everyone inside with death.
Grindelwald and Rosier Disapparated, allowing the out of control spell to grow until it would be powerful enough to destroy the whole city.
Newt pulled a struggling Theseus out of the Mausoleum, while Tina Goldstein saved Jacob and Yusuf Kama helped Nagini out.
Saving Paris
Newt and Theseus stop Grindelwald's black flames

Outside the Mausoleum, Newt, Theseus, Tina, Yusuf, Nagini and Jacob tried to stop the spell but their counter-curses were ineffective against the unstable magic, which started taking the form of dragon-like, black-flamed creatures.
As the spell started to grow large enough to engulf the entire Mausoleum, Nicolas Flamel arrived and instructed the wizards to form a circle around the spell and plant their wands into the earth.

Flamel, the Scamander brothers, Tina and Yusuf conjured a counter-spell of such power that bright orange flames appeared and slowly engulfed the conjured fire creature, destroying Grindelwald's spell and saving Paris from destruction.
Aftermath
Grindelwald gives Credence the name Aurelius Dumbledore
The Paris rally was a massive victory for Grindelwald.

Not only had he gained the loyalty of several new followers, including Queenie Goldstein and several Aurors, he had also publicly demonstrated the true brutality of the governments of the magical world in their efforts to stop him.
But, most importantly, he had finally gained the support of the Obscurial Credence Barebone, a vital part of his plans to defeat Albus Dumbledore.
At his base Nurmengard Castle in Austria , Grindelwald presented Credence with a wand of his own and finally revealed to Credence his supposed true identity: Aurelius Dumbledore.
Newt and Dumbledore at Hogwarts after Newt tells Dumbledore the blood pact
However, the Paris rally would also cost Grindelwald the vial that held his Blood Pact with Dumbledore, stolen by Teddy .

With the loss of Leta Lestrange, Newt was finally compelled to openly join the fight against the most dangerous Dark Wizard of his age and when he travelled to Hogwarts Castle along with the rest of the group, to meet with Dumbledore, where Scamander gave Dumbledore the aforementioned vial, surmising that its blood pact was the reason that Dumbledore could not face Grindelwald himself.
Blood pact breaking

In 1932 , during Grindelwald's attempt to become Supreme Mugwump of the International Confederation of Wizards , the Blood Pact would finally be broken when Albus and Aberforth Dumbledore blocked Grindelwald's attempt to kill Credence, restoring Dumbledore's ability to fight Grindelwald directly.

At the same time, Grindelwald would be abandoned by a remorseful Queenie and Credence turned on him as well after Dumbledore realised that Credence was actually Aberforth's long-lost son from a relationship that he had the same summer that Dumbledore had fallen in love with Grindelwald.

The recovery and ultimate destruction of the vial would allow Dumbledore to best Grindelwald in the so-called greatest battle of magic ever recorded in 1945 and bring about the end of Grindelwald's revolution, making the Paris rally ultimately a forthcoming to the doom of Grindelwald.
Notes and references

title: Attack in the Tianzi Mountains
paragraphs: This attack occurred in the Tianzi Mountains in Kweilin , China , during which Newton Scamander fought with Gellert Grindelwald's acolytes for a baby Qilin that he had found.
History
Credence, Rosier and Carrow in China

In 1932 , Aurelius Dumbledore , Vinda Rosier , and Carrow went to the forests of China under the orders of Gellert Grindelwald to capture a newborn Qilin , where they saw Newt Scamander next to a mother Qilin and her newborn was surprised.
Although Newt was able to run away with the newborn Qilin and his suitcase, Carrow managed to catch him after chasing him, but Newt threw her away with the help of the natural resources around him.
Newt was stunned and fell into the lake and the acolytes took the Qilin, but they didn't know that another Qilin was born - a twin .
Notes and references

title: Tianzi Mountains
paragraphs: Tianzi Mountains
The Tianzi Mountains are located on the outskirts of Kweilin , China .
Qilins were known to have lived in these mountainous areas.
History
In 1932 , Newton Scamander rescued a baby Qilin in these mountains after its mother was killed and its twin was taken hostage by acolytes of Gellert Grindelwald .
Notes and references

title: Unidentified green spell
paragraphs: This spell ( incantation unknown ) was a dark charm that was capable of assaulting and mortally wounding the target.
History
During the attack in the Tianzi Mountains in 1932 , Gellert Grindelwald 's acolytes Vinda Rosier and Carrow used the spell on a Qilin mother to mortally wound her.
Known practitioners
Notes and references

title: Carrow (Acolyte)
paragraphs: Carrow was a Dark witch who lived in the 1920s , and was a member of the Carrow family .
She was a member of Gellert Grindelwald 's Alliance , and one of the devoted acolytes that formed his inner circle.
Biography
Carrow became an ardent follower of Gellert Grindelwald at some point prior to 1927 and became one of his acolytes .
Carrow seconds before killing a Non-Magique child

She accompanied Grindelwald to Paris and she took part along with the other acolytes in murdering a Non-Magique man and woman , along with their infant son , whom she murdered personally on Grindelwald's orders with the Killing Curse .
After murdering the family, they used their home as a temporary headquarters and safe house as they searched for Credence Barebone .

She attended Grindelwald's rally at the Cimetière du Père-Lachaise in the Lestrange Mausoleum and disapparated away after crossing the enchanted fire that tested one's loyalty following the entrance of Aurors and did not participate in the subsequent battle after that.
Credence Barebone, Vinda Rosier and Carrow in China
In 1932 , the force of acolytes under the command of Credence Barebone and Vinda Rosier were dispatched to the forests of China under the orders of Gellert Grindelwald to capture a Qilin .
In the company of Vinda, Carrow chanced upon a grotto in which Newt Scamander was assisting a mother Qilin in giving birth to her young .

As they paused, eying the infant of their desires hungrily, Carrow, after a brief glance at her comrade, again turned back to the Magizoologist and stood by as Rosier swiftly struck down the mother, only to be halted by the magical shield Newt had conjured.
The spell, however, was short-lived in the face of Credence's powers; he swiftly tore through the barrier, sending the group surging forwards.

As Newt, the infant Qilin and his suitcase in hand, ran with the suitcase, Carrow managed to briefly catch up to him whilst chasing him, only to be sent flying away by Newt with the help of the natural resources around him, crashing back into the bamboo.
In the end, however, a spell to the back sent Newt falling into the lake and the acolytes, after gathering, swiftly took the Qilin and Disapparated to Nurmengard.

They did not know, however, that another Qilin was born that fateful night - a twin - and when they arrived in the headquarters of the Alliance, they believed they had the only child belonging to the murdered mother.
Carrow, standing in silence, was dismissed along with the other acolytes (bar Credence) and left Grindelwald to speak with his young protégé alone.
Carrow and Zabini hold Newt

A few night later, Carrow and Vinda Rosier, both dressed in flowing blue robes, attended an election rally at the German Ministry of Magic and inconspicuously entered the crowds of Santos supporters, whereupon Carrow, at a signal from Vinda, set a Santos campaign banner alight with a whispered spell.
She attended the Candidates' Dinner together with Grindelwald's allies .
She was in Bhutan for the walk of the Qilin , during which she walked alongside Zabini who knocked Newt out on the way to the top of the Eyrie .
Personality and traits
Carrow was a dedicated follower of the Dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald and his beliefs in wizarding supremacy .
She was obedient to her master, and was even willing to commit the murder of an innocent child when instructed to do so.
When she and several other acolytes seized control of a Parisian home belonging to a non-magical family, the task of murdering the infant boy fell to Carrow.
No verbal command was spoken, but she deduced Grindelwald's desire, and did not flinch from the task; executing the child swiftly with little to no display of emotion.
Magical abilities and skills
Notes and references

title: German Ministry of Magic
paragraphs: The German Ministry of Magic ( German : Deutsches Ministerium für Magie ) was the governing body of the wizarding community in Germany .
History
The German Ministry of Magic was founded before 1791, more than 80 years before the foundation of Germany.
The last burning of a witch happened 1793 in South Prussia, implying the new form of governance grew in influence and success.
The German Ministry introduced strict controls to limit the number of Erkling killings.
In 1932 , the German Minister for Magic, Anton Vogel , also held the office of Supreme Mugwump of the International Confederation of Wizards ; his term ended in 1932 .
The German Ministry at this time was infiltrated by supporters of Gellert Grindelwald , including Auror Helmut and even Vogel himself.
The German Ministry also operated the prison Erkstag , which housed a bloodthirsty Manticore that devoured the prisoners.
Notes and references

title: Vicência Santos
paragraphs: Minister Vicência Santos was a Brazilian witch who reigned as the Minister for Magic of the Brazilian Ministry of Magic (1930s-) and the Supreme Mugwump of the International Confederation of Wizards the position which she received from the 1932 election that took place in Bhutan .

When she was a candidate for the Supreme Mugwump position, Vicência ran for the Confederation's highest office alongside Liu Tao and Gellert Grindelwald , and at the end of the elections, the walk of the Qilin ceremony was held in which she was chosen by the true Qilin to become the Supreme Mugwump, after Albus Dumbledore , who was initially chosen, refused to take the same position.
Biography
Vicência Santos and her supporters at the tea ceremony
By the 1930s , she was the Minister for Magic of the Brazilian Ministry of Magic .

And with that position, she ran in the elections for the position of Supreme Mugwump of the International Confederation of Wizards in 1932 , which took place at one of the oldest and most important temples of magic, located in Bhutan .

Running for the post alongside Santos were China's Minister for Magic, Liu Tao , and the infamous Gellert Grindelwald , who could only run for the post because of corrupt deals with the Supreme Mugwump at the time.
Santos was deemed the favourite to win according to Theseus Scamander .
Santos observing the poisoned wine

Throughout her campaign for the post, it was known that she was present at diplomatic events hosted by the German Ministry of Magic and organised by Anton Vogel , the Minister for Magic of Germany and who was also the current Supreme Mugwump during the elections in 1932.

At the candidates' dinner, she was greeted by Gellert Grindelwald , whom she was cordial but guarded with in response, both complimenting each other politely over the enthusiasm displayed by their separate supporters.

During the dinner itself, she was served a glass of poisoned red wine , in an assassination attempt orchestrated by members of Grindelwald's Alliance , most likely since she and her unspoken but likely chance of victory posed the biggest threat to Grindelwald's election.

Fortunately, the attending Eulalie Hicks was able to save Santos by casting a spell at the wine as it rose from the glass to attack her, following which her attendants hurried the Brazilian Minister to safety.
The Qilin bows before Santos

Thanks to the Magizoologist Newton Scamander , the 1932 election candidates would have to be evaluated by a Qilin , who would choose who would be the next Supreme Mugwump, considering the purity and good intentions of each candidate.

However, Anton Vogel, revealed to be one of Gellert Grindelwald's acolytes and a supporter of his supremacist ideas, worked to rig the election to try to get Grindelwald to win the Confederacy's top office with a reanimated Qilin, and that in fact worked, and temporarily elected Gellert Grindelwald as the new leader of the wizarding world.
During his speech, Grindelwald briefly tortured Jacob Kowalski with the Cruciatus Curse ; Santos relieved him of the pain with a nonverbal spell when she could see he was hurting.
Thanks to the efforts of Newt Scamander, the falsity of the election was proven, and Grindelwald's election was immediately nullified.
The real Qilin bowed before Albus Dumbledore and as a result, selected him as Supreme Mugwump.
While honoured by the Qilin's selection, Dumbledore declined to assume office.
The Qilin then selected Santos as the next Supreme Mugwump.
Celebrations on Santos' victory at Parque Lage

After being elected, her victory was seen being celebrated at the British Ministry of Magic , Magical Congress of the United States of America , the French Ministry of Magic and in the Brazilian Ministry of Magic , located in Parque Lage , in the then capital of Brazil , Rio de Janeiro .
Its supporters shot yellow sparks into the sky and a symbol shaped like the symbol of the Brazilian Ministry of Magic.
Personality and traits
Santos relieving Jacob Kowalski of the pain of the Cruciatus Curse, showing her kind and pure heart
Santos was a good witch with a pure heart, as deemed by the Qilin that is why she bowed to her.
She was kind enough to relieve Jacob Kowalski from the pain of the Cruciatus Curse when she could see he was hurting, defying the then Supreme Mugwump in the process.
It also appeared she was at least tolerant if not friendly in regard to Muggles, given her compassion towards Jacob, compared to other wizards.
She was peaceful enough to compliment Gellert Grindelwald (albeit frostily) on his well-sounding supporters, and after Grindelwald won, she also seemed to accept it with respect.
This, however, did not stop her swiftly undoing Grindelwald's Cruciatus Curse that he placed on Jacob, showing how unlike Vogel, Santos possessed the conscience to choose right over easy.
Furthermore, as the Qilin moved towards Grindelwald, she and Liu Tao exchanged appalled glances.
Magical abilities and skills
Possessions
Etymology
Notes and references

title: Candidates' Dinner
paragraphs: The Candidates' Dinner was hosted by the International Confederation of Wizards , sometime in 1932 in the Grand Hall of the German Ministry of Magic to house a dinner for the three final candidates for the 1932 International Confederation of Wizards' Supreme Mugwump election .
History
Background information

Before this dinner was held, Albus Dumbledore was 'quite certain' that an event such as an assassination attempt would happen at the dinner, and he told Eulalie Hicks and Jacob Kowalski to quell an attempt if it happened before anyone noticed.
Events
Tea Ceremony
Vogel speaks
The tea ceremony started in the evening.

Newt and Theseus walked in and he was told nothing by his brother except a few things, Newt had a message to deliver from Albus Dumbledore to Anton Vogel , to which he delivered saying to do what is right, not what is easy, meaning by while passing over the position of leader to not do anything stupid in which he did, choose what is easy by letting Gellert Grindelwald stand in the election .
The Alliance started to walk in during the dinner, in which Theseus Scamander and Newton Scamander noticed.

Vinda Rosier walked by them while Vogel announced that all of Grindelwald's alleged crimes would be absolved since insuffiencent evidence could be found meaning so he can be able to run for the election.
Theseus confronted Rosier and several other disciples of Grindelwald and threatened to arrest the lot of them but was stunned by his fellow Auror, Helmut .
They took him away to Erkstag .
The Candidates' Dinner
Ahead of the elections for the international confederation, a dinner for the candidates was held at the German office.
At the dinner the candidates and representatives from each country dined; Albus Dumbledore asked Eulalie Hicks and Jacob Kowalski to go to the dinner in light of the danger that might occur.
While Grindelwald entered with Vinda Rosier and his entourage, Jacob recognised his former love Queenie , he stood up and greeted her and she ignored him.
Grindelwald complimented Santos on her "sounding good" supporters and Santos replied with guarded politeness that his did the same.
Jacob told Hicks that one of the diners looked like his uncle Dominic and Hicks asked him if his uncle was the Minister for Magic of Norway, Jacob replied in the negative.
The poisoned wine having been foiled
Gellert Grindelwald and his followers plotted to have rival candidate Vicência Santos assassinated at the dinner, as to clear the way for his ascension, using poisoned red wine .

Waiter Karl , a follower of Grindelwald, on the directions of Vinda Rosier , served a glass of poisoned red wine to Santos, but Hicks, following Dumbledore's earlier advice, intercepted the glass with a nonverbal spell , which exposed its poisonous contents to the dinner guests, saving Santos's life.
Notes and references

title: Anton Vogel
paragraphs: Minister Anton Vogel , S.C.O.W. was a German wizard who, in the early 1930s , was the German Minister for Magic and, concurrently, the Supreme Mugwump of the International Confederation of Wizards .
His term as Supreme Mugwump ended in 1932 , setting the stage for the contended election that was held that year .
He was also a secret supporter of Gellert Grindelwald and assisted him with his dark activities, while displaying an innocent facade to the rest of the wizarding world.
Biography
Global Wizarding War
Vogel speaking at the German Ministry of Magic

In 1932 , at the German Ministry of Magic in Berlin , after having been spoken to by Newton Scamander about doing the right thing, having been forwarded a message from him from Albus Dumbledore , Vogel shockingly announced that the International Confederation of Wizards had decided to acquit Gellert Grindelwald of all his crimes against the non-magic world , on the grounds of insufficient evidence against him, much to the horror, disgust and disbelief (due to his arrest at the hands of MACUSA in 1926, and his rally in Paris in 1927) of most wizards present.
He also announced that Grindelwald was being allowed to stand as a candidate for the position of Supreme Mugwump of the ICW, the highest office in the wizarding world .

He later claimed to other delegates that this was to give wizards a democratic vote on the issue and that he did not want Grindelwald to win, but that he feared suppressing Grindelwald's supporters would lead to violence.
The Qilin in Vogel's hands

However, Vogel was secretly a supporter of Grindelwald and his Alliance , and witnessed first-hand his revival of a dead Qilin with necromancy in water at Nurmengard Castle with Credence Barebone and Vinda Rosier .

He was present at the walk of the Qilin , where he pronounced Grindelwald as the new leader of the wizarding world once the reanimated Qilin falsely bowed before him, knowing of Grindelwald's deception.
Once Newt had announced that the Qilin was dead, Vogel attempted to prove the Qilin was alive, only for it to expire in his arms, as a result of the necromancy having worn off.
He witnessed Grindelwald be defeated by Vicência Santos and his departure.
It is unknown if his corruption and efforts in defrauding the election were exposed.
Legacy
By the late 20th century , Vogel was immortalised on a Chocolate Frog Card , having been a famous wizard.
Personality and traits
Vogel was described as "benign-looking".

Although he presented himself as politically impartial, fair, honest and tolerant, he was in reality corrupt and dishonest, and a secret supporter of Gellert Grindelwald , having knowingly helped him with electoral fraud to have Grindelwald elected.

He also appeared to be rather charismatic, given his ability to seem genuine to others, even other Ministers for Magic, for extended periods of time without arousing suspicion, despite his real intentions.
Even during his mandate, the draconian Erkstag prison was reopened, which by law should be closed, and where there was little security due to the lack of wands and the lack of guides.
Etymology
"Vogel" is a surname in German and Dutch-speaking countries, and it also means " bird ".
Notes and references

title: Nagel
paragraphs: Nagel was a wizard who lived during the early 20th century .
He was a member of Gellert Grindelwald 's Alliance , and was among the Dark wizard 's foremost acolytes.
Biography
Nagel joined Gellert Grindelwald at some point prior to 1927 , and became one of Grindelwald's seven trusted acolytes .
Under Grindelwald's orders, Nagel was told to visit the Circus Arcanus ' performance, so as to keep an eye on the Obscurial Credence Barebone .
Magical abilities and skills
Etymology
Notes and references

title: Unidentified Qilin mother
paragraphs: This female Qilin lived in the Tianzi Mountains in Kweilin , China in 1932 .
Biography
The mother Qilin falling
This female Qilin gave birth to twin daughters in the Tianzi Mountains in 1932 .
Newton Scamander assisted her in giving birth, however, Gellert Grindelwald 's acolytes interrupted the scene and brutally killed the mother Qilin by firing spells at her, flaying her hide.
She died, with one of her children by taken by Grindelwald's acolytes, and the other , unbeknownst to the acolytes, by Newt.
Newt comforted the Qilin as she died, when he realised that she had given birth to twins .
Notes and references

title: Vinda Rosier's wand
paragraphs: This wand was of unknown length , wood, and core material.
It belonged to Vinda Rosier , a French witch who was a loyal acolyte of Gellert Grindelwald .
History
In 1932 , she used this wand to kill the Qilin mother during an attack in the Tianzi Mountains by flaying her hide with spells .
Notes and references

title: German Ministry of Magic headquarters
paragraphs: The headquarters of the German Ministry of Magic were located behind a wall in Berlin , Germany .
History
The German Ministry of Magic watching the walk of the Qilin
In 1932 , election rallies were held at the headquarters of the German Ministry of Magic ahead of the election for the International Confederation .
At the headquarters, Rosier and Carrow burned a sign of Santos 's supporters.
During the walk of the Qilin , there were huge magic screens in the headquarters broadcasting the ceremony.
Notes and references

title: Aurelius Dumbledore's phoenix
paragraphs: This unnamed phoenix was found and taken care of by Credence Barebone in 1927 during his time in Paris .
He began serving him during this time and followed him around.
Biography
Credence nurturing the baby chick
In September 1927 , Credence and Nagini met at and stole some birdseed from the bird market in Paris .
Later that afternoon, on top of a derelict rooftop, Credence fed the birdseed to the phoenix chick.

After Credence joined Gellert Grindelwald at Nurmengard Castle in late 1927, when the two were discussing Credence's heritage, the phoenix chick stepped onto Gellert's palm, who eagerly threw it into air, erupting it into a burst of flame , birthing the phoenix.
After Credence, with his newfound identity as "Aurelius Dumbledore", cast his first spell, his phoenix stood beside him.
His phoenix flying outside Nurmengard
In the 1930s , the phoenix was nearing the end of its life.
It continued to follow Aurelius around.
Outside Nurmengard, while they spent time together, Grindelwald and his acolyte Vinda Rosier secretly observed them through a window.
Vinda asked why the bird followed him, to which Grindelwald replied he "sensed" what Aurelius was about to do: to go and kill Albus Dumbledore .
At the beginning of Aurelius's duel with Albus Dumbledore, the phoenix flew past Albus and Aurelius, and Aurelius said that the phoenix was there for him, not Albus.
After Aurelius was defeated, the phoenix appeared and spread ashes over him, confirming to Albus that Aurelius really was a Dumbledore - his brother Aberforth 's son.
Dumbledore later told Newton Scamander that Aurelius was dying and that was the reason that the phoenix came to Aurelius and spread its ashes over him.
Dumbledore recognised the signs from when his sister Ariana , who was also an Obscurial , was being slowly poisoned to death by her nature.
The phoenix following Aurelius and his owner's father back home in 1932
During the Supreme Mugwump election in 1932 , when Aurelius revealed Grindelwald's election fraud using a dead Qilin , the phoenix flew overhead and dropped an ash onto the Dark wizard's face.
Aurelius then smeared the ash with his thumb.
After Aurelius reunited with his father , the phoenix followed the young man and Aberforth home.
Notes and references

title: Gellert Grindelwald's car
paragraphs: This luxurious black car belonged to the Dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald in the 1930s .
The car ornament was in the shape of G, Grindelwald's symbol.
History

After being allowed to stand as a candidate for the position of Supreme Mugwump of the International Confederation of Wizards , Gellert Grindelwald headed to the German Ministry of Magic headquarters in Berlin to attend the Candidates' Dinner via his car.
Upon his arrival, he told his loyal acolyte Vinda Rosier to roll the car window down.
After the window was rolled down, Grindelwald was lifted up by his supporters.
Notes and references

title: Newton Scamander's Qilin
paragraphs: This female Qilin was owned by Newton Scamander .
Biography
In 1932 , Newton Scamander encountered this Qilin's mother near a waterfall in the Tianzi Mountains , Kweilin , China .

He helped her give birth to this Qilin and a twin sister , but members of Gellert Grindelwald 's inner circle , including Credence Barebone , Vinda Rosier and Carrow , interrupted the event, killed the Qilin mother and managed to steal the Qilin's sister.
They were unaware that the mother gave birth to twins, and Grindelwald later killed and revived the twin at Nurmengard .
Newt took ownership of this orphaned Qilin, and looked after her in his suitcase of magical beasts .
Newt and his friends observed the young Qilin in the Hog's Head Inn with joy, as they complimented its pure and playful nature.
The Qilin before Albus Dumbledore

This Qilin was later taken to the walk of the Qilin ceremony in Bhutan , where she tried to communicate with her twin sister, but because she was dead and reanimated, her sister did not recognise her.

After Grindelwald was exposed for cheating, it was her job to properly identify the right Supreme Mugwump ; she initially bowed to Albus Dumbledore , sensing his purity of heart, but he politely refused the position, and she then bowed to Vicência Santos , who was then elected.

Trotting alongside Santos as she and most of the wizards present advanced on Grindelwald, the Qilin beheld Grindelwald's escape, then later was carried by Bunty to meet with Newt, who returned her to his briefcase.
Physical appearance
Being a Qilin, she had golden bronze scales and some appendage dangling from her nose.
Notes and references

title: Jacob Kowalski
paragraphs: Jacob Kowalski (born c. 1900 ) was a Polish -born American No-Maj , who lived at 435 Rivington Street in New York during the 1920s .
Jacob fought in the First World War .
After returning home to the United States, he found work in a cannery , but dreamt of becoming a baker.
On 5 December 1926 , he went to Steen National Bank to apply for a loan of $2300, but was turned down.
While at the bank he met Newt Scamander , a British wizard who stopped in New York City on his travels to find and document magical beasts .
Through Newt he was exposed to the magical world , but had his memories wiped as was required by wizarding law.
Jacob would later go on to own a very successful bakery subconsciously inspired by his experiences with Newt Scamander's beasts and financed through silver from Occamy eggs provided by Scamander.
It was later discovered that the memory modification largely didn't work and Jacob ended up back together with Queenie Goldstein .
Though the two were happy together, Queenie disagreed with Jacob's stance on his not wanting her to take a chance on him by breaking the law in marrying him.
She bewitched him to make him want to be engaged to her, but the truth was revealed to him when they paid a visit to Newt Scamander.
Following an argument with Queenie, he left with Scamander on another adventure, ultimately reuniting with Queenie, who had fallen under the influence of the philosophy of Gellert Grindelwald .

While Queenie felt that Grindelwald's aims would allow the two of them to be together, Jacob was repulsed by Grindelwald, and watched sadly as Queenie joined with the Dark Wizard, leaving him behind, devastated and initially wanting nothing more to do with the wizarding world.

The urgings of Eulalie Hicks , however, prompted Jacob to re-enter the conflict , joining Dumbledore's first army and playing a role in thwarting Gellert Grindelwald's campaign to become Supreme Mugwump , despite his No-Maj status.
In the aftermath of the election , Jacob married Queenie, who had defected back to his and Newt's side.
Biography
Early life and family
Jacob was born around the year 1900 in Poland .
He emigrated to the United States when he was young.
He had at least one brother .
He also had a grandfather who kept pigeons , and a grandmother who passed on her recipe for Pączki to him and instilled in him a love of baking.
Military service and post-war life
Jacob fought in the First World War .
He served in France as part of the American Expeditionary Forces , and remained stationed there for six years, not realising the war had ended.
He later found out that it ended and returned to the United States in 1924 .
His brother also fought in the war, but was killed at some point.

Still being in Europe, he travelled to his home, Poland and gathered his relatives to a safe place and collected his family recipes from his grandmother and headed straight to United States of America on the first boat.
The extended length of his military service left him able to find only a menial job at the Moreton Dale Canning Factory in his post-war life.
He thus applied for a loan on 5 December 1926 in the hope of getting the money he needed to realise his dream of opening a bakery.
Jacob talking to Mildred before she broke up with him
By late 1926 , he was engaged to Mildred , but the engagement ended, as Mildred decided to break up with Jacob after he failed to gain a loan from the bank.
Global Wizarding War
Jacob and Newt at Steen National Bank
While visiting the Steen National Bank to secure a loan to set up his own bakery, Jacob met Newt Scamander when he arrived to find the Niffler that had escaped his suitcase .
As Newt left suddenly to chase his Niffler, Jacob noticed that he accidentally left his Occamy egg behind.
Before he could return it, Jacob was summoned to banker Gilbert Bingley 's office.

Jacob presented Bingley with his suitcase full of pastries, but Bingley questioned how Jacob would return the loan and pointed out that his proposed bakery would not produce the same revenue as a factory and thus rejected his application .
Jacob and Newt watch as the egg hatches after leaving the bank

As he left the office, Jacob noticed that the egg was about to hatch and called out to Newt, who pulled the egg, and Jacob accidentally, with a Summoning Charm and Disapparated them onto the stairwell near the bank vault.
Just as Newt recaptured his Niffler, Bingley arrived at the vault and, seeing the pilfered deposit boxes, mistakenly assumed that Jacob was trying to rob the bank, and sounded the alarm.
Newt quickly placed a Full Body-Bind Curse on Bingley and Disapparated himself and Jacob to the outside of the bank just as the guards arrived.
Subsequently, Newt tried to Obliviate Jacob, but the No-Maj unknowingly grabbed Newt's briefcase, hit him with it, and fled.
When Jacob returned to his apartment without a bank loan, his fiance Mildred left him.
Shortly afterwards, Jacob placed the case down on his bed only to hear something protesting inside.
As Jacob approached it, the lid opened and several magical creatures escaped, including a murtlap that attacked and bit Jacob.
Following escaped billywigs , Newt and Tina Goldstein arrived at Jacob's apartment, finding it half destroyed and Jacob unwell due to a reaction to the Murtlap bite.
Newt repaired Jacob's apartment to its original state, and Tina agreed to take Jacob with them to her place .
Jacob interacting with the creatures in Newt's case
At Tina's house, Jacob met Queenie Goldstein who made them dinner and strudel .
He and Queenie instantly connected with each other.
In the evening, he watched Newt walk down into his suitcase and followed him after Newt invited him in.
He met Newt's collection of creatures and heard about how Newt hoped to care for them as they were rejected by the wizarding world.
Jacob wandered through various landscapes as Newt did a headcount of each creature to see which he needed to find.
Jacob found an Obscurus which Newt described as a dark entity and advised Jacob not to touch it.
They decided they needed to retrieve the missing Erumpent first and left the suitcase.
Newt and Jacob successfully retrieve the Niffler
However, Newt soon found out that his Niffler had escaped again.
As they passed by a jewellery store, Newt spotted his Niffler inside.

While Newt furiously attempted to capture the Niffler, Jacob noticed that a latch on Newt's suitcase had popped off and by the time he sealed it, Newt and the Niffler fell through the store's glass window.
Subsequently, they were confronted by a squad of policemen , who were puzzled by the sight of the Niffler.
Jacob then directed their attention to a lion wandering right by them, giving him and Newt the opportunity to Disapparate away.
Jacob, Tina and Newt being arrested

Passing an ostrich in Central Park , they soon discovered the cause of the loose animals: the Erumpent had broke into the Central Park Zoo , setting many of the animals free, in its search to mate with the zoo's hippopotamus.

Newt provided Jacob with a helmet and vest to protect himself from the Erumpent and left the No-Maj to hold a vial of Erumpent musk while he performed a mating dance to lure the creature back into his suitcase.

Unfortunately, Jacob accidentally spilled musk on himself when he was hit by a fish thrown by an escaped seal , prompting the Erumpent to chase him out of the zoo and into the frozen park pond before Newt managed to contain the Erumpent.

However, when they got in the suitcase, Tina, who had followed them, locked them in and took them to headquarters of the Magical Congress of the United States of America , where they, including Tina, were arrested by Seraphina Picquery and Percival Graves .
Queenie helping Jacob escape a MACUSA Obliviator
As he was being escorted by Sam , an Obliviator , to have his memory erased, Jacob was saved by Queenie, who managed to blackmail Sam.

Subsequently, they tried to break into Graves' office to retrieve Newt's suitcase, along with his and Tina's wands; Queenie unsuccessfully tried to use an Unlocking Charm , forcing Jacob to kick down the door.
They subsequently ran into Newt and Tina, who had managed to escape execution.
Queenie then had everyone hide in the suitcase so she could smuggle them out of MACUSA.
Jacob and Queenie in the Blind Pig
They journeyed to a wizarding speakeasy, The Blind Pig , where the friends met Gnarlak , a goblin gangster, to find information about Newt's escaped Demiguise named Dougal .
While trying to get a drink at the bar, the bartender house-elf asked if Jacob has never seen a house-elf; Jacob blithely retorts that of course he has, his uncle is a house-elf.
After discovering that Gnarlak had turned them in to MACUSA for the reward money, Jacob punched him in the face so Newt could retrieve his bowtruckle Pickett .
They were forced to apparate away as a group of MACUSA agents mounted a raid.
Demiguise jumping on Jacob Kowalski in Ginzberg Delaunay
Following up on information gained from Gnarlak, they found the Demiguise at the Ginzberg Delaunay department store.
Following it led to a hatched Occamy that was not accounted for, which had expanded itself to fill the entire storeroom.
Queenie then hit a Christmas ornament with her foot and caused the Occamy to stress out and move around.
Jacob helped to shrink the Occamy by luring it into a teapot with a cockroach .
After returning the beasts to Newt's case, Jacob went with the group to investigate the Obscurus that was demolishing the city.
Although Queenie wanted Jacob to stay out of the way, he insisted on helping and through her Legilimency skill, she saw the conflicts he endured during the First World War .
Jacob standing in the obliviation rain after saying goodbye
Following a battle against Graves, Seraphina stated that Jacob's memory needed to be erased and gave Newt, Tina, and Queenie a moment to say goodbye to him.
Jacob then stepped into the Obliviating rain, with Queenie giving him one last kiss under an umbrella spell from her wand before leaving him standing there alone and confused.
Jacob in his bakery
Jacob returned to his job at the Moreton Dale Canning Factory .
One day, he bumped into a passerby .
Upon trying to lift his now extremely heavy suitcase, he found silver Occamy eggshells provided anonymously by Newt as collateral for a bank loan.
By March 1927 , Jacob had opened his bakery, Kowalski Quality Baked Goods .
He baked various pastries and confections in the form of fantastic creatures, unconsciously modelling them after the beasts he encountered on his adventures with Newt.
He was unaware of their origins, claiming that they came to him in dreams.
The whimsical treats proved extremely popular and his bakery did a brisk business.
One day, Queenie visited the shop, possibly sparking Jacob's memories of his time with her.
Newt breaking the love charm that Queenie put on Jacob
Shortly after, Jacob was bewitched by Queenie and taken by her to Great Britain to get married, as the British Ministry of Magic allowed marriage with non-magical partners.
They made their way to 9 Sherringford Square in London , where Newt was living to tell him of the news.
Jacob told Newt that he had mostly good and average memories of what happened in New York and Queenie filled him in on what he did forget.
Newt quickly realised that Jacob was under a love charm and broke it.
Jacob was shocked and Queenie left the apartment in sadness.
Newt informed him that he was in London, much to his shock.
He caught up with Queenie and said that he loved her, but he knew that she would be arrested if they get married.
His reluctance, and almost calling her crazy caused her to Disapparate, leaving him alone on the street.
Devastated, he went back inside Newt's apartment to his friend packing after he found letter from Tina to Queenie.
He realised that Tina was in Paris to search for Credence, who survived the battle in New York.
He also promised Jacob that he would help him find Queenie, whom he guessed had travelled to France to find Tina.
Jacob and Newt using the Portkey
Next day Jacob travelled with Newt to Dartmoor , where Scamander gave fifty galleons to a Portkey tout and they both left England via Portkey .
In Place Cachée Newt located the feather from the hat of a mysterious man and enchanted it to locate the man.
Jacob and Newt followed the feather and it brought them to the café, where the French wizard introduced himself to them as Yusuf Kama .
Kama took them to the Parisian sewers, where in his hideout he had imprisoned Tina.
He also did the same with Newt and Jacob and said that he will release them, when Credence Barebone will be dead.
Unfortunately, Kama unexpectedly fainted, so Newt released Pickett to unlock the lock in the gate freeing himself, Tina and Jacob.
Coming to the unconscious wizard they heard a powerful Zouwu's roar coming from above their heads.
Jacob with unconscious Kama
They pulled Kama out to the Alexander III Bridge , where Newt caught the beast into his suitcase.

Kowalski holding unconscious Kama, seized along with Goldstein, Scamander's hand, thanks to which they apparated on Rue de Montmorency to Nicolas Flamel's house , the "safe house" address which Albus Dumbledore had given Newt.
Jacob with Flamel watching future events in crystal ball
Newt pursued angry Tina, so Jacob stayed at Flamel's house to watch over Yusuf, especially after Scamander used tweezers to pull a water dragon parasite from Kama's eye.
Jacob met Nicolas Flamel there and mistook him for a ghost , due to alchemist's age.
Flamel's crystal ball informed him and Nicolas that Gellert Grindelwald called a rally for his followers at the Lestrange Mausoleum on Père-Lachaise cemetery , and that Queenie was going there.
The ball also showed Credence heading to the Mausoleum when Jacob noticed that Kama had escaped, so he went to the cemetery despite Flamel's strong protests.
Jacob reacting to the war bomb
In the mausoleum Jacob was discovered by Yusuf.
Kama ordered him to be quiet, because he was hunting Credence.
When Credence and Nagini arrived, Kama wanted to kill Credence, but he was interrupted by Newt, Tina, and Leta Lestrange .
Jacob witnessed Leta's story about how the Dark wizard Corvus Lestrange put Kama's mother, Laurena , under the Imperius Curse , and married her.
She subquently gave birth to a girl named Leta.

Jacob also witnessed the story of how Yusuf made the Unbreakable Vow with his father, Mustafa , to kill the person Corvus loved the most; how Corvus married his second cousin, Clarisse Tremblay , who gave birth to his son , who was supposed to be Credence Barebone, and how Leta proved that Credence wasn't Corvus because she switched the babies on the ship, while admitting to unintentionally killing Corvus.
Queenie leaving Jacob heartbroken at the rally
Jacob attended Grindelwald's rally, which took place in the mausoleum.

When Aurors under command of Theseus Scamander infiltrated the rally and one witch was killed, Grindelwald sent his followers to spread the word and began the fight by conjuring a circle of black flames around himself to divide friend from foe.

Despite having seen a horrifying vision of the future Second World War , and being promised that Grindelwald would help prevent it from ever happening, Queenie urging Jacob to join Grindelwald and walk with her.
Jacob tearfully refused Queenie, denouncing her new alliance and stood heartbroken.
When Grindelwald attacked both Scamander brothers, Leta sacrificed herself to give Jacob and others time to escape.
Tina seized Jacob and disapparated outside the mausoleum with him.

As Queenie goes with Grindelwald, Jacob witnessed Newt Scamander saving Paris from the Protego Diabolica spell and followed him to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , joining in the alliance against Grindelwald.
After Queenie left Jacob and went over to Grindelwald's side, he was left distraught and lost, with no direction.
He briefly sought assistance from a therapist , but was ridiculed when he relayed that he had been interacting with witches and wizards.
Eulalie and Jacob sit on a bench in New York
One night, while standing in his bakery, Jacob imagined seeing Queenie there.
Moments later, across the street, he saw Eulalie Hicks reading a book and men seemingly harassing her.
Kowalski left the bakery to help her, but Lally knocked out one the attackers with the Full Body-Bind Curse .
It turned out the gang leader was Hicks' cousin Stanley , who owed her a favour.
Jacob was furious, saying he was fed up with wizards, but Hicks eventually convinced him that since Queenie was on Grindelwald's side, they would need Jacob's help.
The book Lally was reading opened and it turned out to be a Portkey .
Jacob gets the wand from Newt
Lally and Jacob were late for the Great Wizarding Express , so they used a Portkey to get onto it.
In the train they met Newt Scamander , Theseus Scamander , Yusuf Kama and Bunty Broadacre .
It turned out that Albus Dumbledore had gifted Newt with items that Scamander had given to each of them.
Jacob got a wand from Snakewood with no core, so it had no power.
After arriving in Berlin, Yusuf and Bunty separated from the group, while Jacob, Newt, Theseus and Lally went to the German Ministry of Magic .
There was going to be an event organised by the International Confederation of Wizards .
Theseus, however, was kidnapped by Grindelwald's henchmen.
Jacob, along with Newt and Lally, was trying to find out where Theseus had been taken.
He suddenly spotted Helmut , Grindelwald's acolyte, who had ordered the kidnapping of Theseus.
The man, however, was gone.
Later, Jacob, Newt, and Lally met with Dumbledore, who commissioned Jacob and Lally to go to the Candidates' Dinner , as he suspected an assassination attempt might take place there.
Jacob points a wand at Grindelwald
Jacob and Lally went to dinner at German Ministry.
Grindelwald soon arrived with his entourage, including Yusuf and Queenie .
Jacob was calling for Queenie, but she didn't even look at him.
Kowalski drank a glass of something stronger, ran into Grindelwald, and took out his wand.
At the same time, Lally noticed that someone brought a drink to Vicência Santos .
Jacob approached Grindelwald and ordered him to let Queenie go.
Grindelwald, however, casted a spell on Jacob under the table, which made it look as if Kowalski had attacked him.
Hicks saved Vicência's life because she broke a glass, the drink spilled on the wall and burned in it.
Grindelwald made Jacob a murderer, telling everyone that he attacked him, and this was precisely the reason why the wizards had to unite against Muggles .
Jacob and Lally used the Portkey book again to save themselves.
Jacob Kowalski is sitting in the Great Hall
Jacob and Lally waited in the Great Hall .
While at Hogwarts , Jacob sat down at the Ravenclaw table and ate with some students.
A student tried to grab his wand but he had to describe that it was very dangerous and it shouldn't be touched by anyone.
Suddenly, Jacob saw Newt and Theseus who had just entered the Great Hall.
Kowalski said how nice the children were and that a bunch of Slytherin students had given him sweets - as it turned out, they were Cockroach Clusters .
Jacob Kowalski using the Qilin Ceremony Portkey in the Room of Requirement
Jacob, along with Newt, Theseus, and Lally went to Hogwarts.
In the Room of Requirement , Dumbledore was waiting there with Bunty.
They were to be transported to the ceremony in Bhutan by the Qilin Ceremony Portkey, which was in the centre of the room.
There were also five suitcases, one of which contained a Qilin .
The remaining suitcases contained enchanted books, Bludgers, or Jacob's pastries.
In case of trouble, they were to drop the suitcases, and the enchanted items would attack Grindelwald's henchmen.
Jacob and Queenie speaking in Bhutan
After reaching Bhutan, he separated from Albus.
On the way, he saved Newt from two of Grindelwald's henchmen by hitting them with the suitcase.
He also met Queenie, who he wanted to persuade to return, but she insisted that it was too late for that.
Moments later, they were covered by Grindelwald's acolytes who are commanded by Vinda Rosier and led to the ceremony.
Jacob being tortured by Grindelwald
During the ceremony, the reanimated Qilin bowed to Grindelwald, making him the new Supreme Mugwump .
Jacob was dragged into the middle by Grindelwald as an example.
After Rosier takes from him the wand Dumbledore had given to him and hands it to her master, Grindelwald said that Jacob was a Muggle who dared to fall in love with a witch.
Something like that, according to Grindelwald, stained the magic blood and could not be allowed to, so he cast the Cruciatus Curse on Jacob.
The curse was stopped by Santos swiftly, however, leaving Jacob panting in Queenie's arms as she tearfully comforts him.
When Newt pulled a second Qilin out of the suitcase brought by Bunty, Grindelwald's lie was revealed.

The real Qilin bowed to Vicência, and there was a fight between Dumbledore and Grindelwald, which resulted in the latter escaping after he was confronted by the dozens present (bar his own followers of course), Jacob standing beside Queenie as she joins the confronters.
Jacob and Queenie 's wedding
Soon after, Jacob's wedding to Queenie took place at Kowalski's bakery in New York.

Their wedding was attended by several friends, including Newt (who Jacob, because of their friendship, asks to be his best man), Theseus , Lally , Bunty and Tina , who has recently been busy in work roles, but had travelled to New York to attend the wedding as her sister's maid-of-honor.
They stood in front of a wedding officiant with their friends behind them and took their vows, Jacob becoming husband to Queenie.
Meanwhile, Albus Dumbledore watched them and their wedding from outside the store, before leaving the street.
Physical description
When he was a man in his mid- to late-twenties, he was of average height for a man of his time and had a stocky build.
He had dark brown curly hair that was usually kept brushed and a matching moustache.
He had dark brown eyes.
Personality and traits

Jacob was extremely warm, welcoming, compassionate, and friendly, with Newt Scamander noting that people tend to like Jacob, and with Jacob claiming that he wishes to become a baker to make people happy, despising having to work in a canning factory, due to that job being joyless.

Hence, Jacob managed to swiftly befriend Queenie Goldstein , the somewhat socially awkward Newt Scamander, the somewhat prim Tina Goldstein , and later even the most famous alchemist in history, Nicolas Flamel .

While initially disturbed by magic, Jacob, unlike most No-Majes , quickly came to admire and love wizardry, and was excited to learn more about the Wizarding world during his adventures with Newt, Tina, and Queenie.

Jacob seemed to adjust to extreme situations relatively quickly, as he wasn't mentally disturbed after almost getting killed by an Erumpent or contending with an Occamy , and quickly overcame his fear of Nicolas Flamel 's gaunt appearance, politely claiming that the ancient alchemist looked young for his age.
Jacob seemed to have poor self-esteem, viewing himself as unintelligent, and thinking that there "are loads [like him]," but Queenie assured Jacob that he is unique, before their first kiss.

Jacob's unique ability to accept other people is a testament to this, as the likes of Henry Shaw Jnr were openly hateful of those lesser than themselves, while Jacob was pleasant and friendly to his fellow men.
Moreover, Jacob had a good sense of humour, remarking that Gnarlak reminded him of his foreman after punching the goblin in the face.

Jacob was also very selfless, with a strong sense of morality, and an incorruptible spirit, shown when he willingly stepped out into the rain for Obliviation, when he refused to endanger his beloved Queenie by marrying her, and when he wasn't swayed by Gellert Grindelwald 's visions of a future Second World War (despite being horrified by them, as a veteran of the First World War ), and tearfully refused to join his beloved Queenie among Grindelwald's forces.
The incredible bravery and fortitude demonstrated by Jacob in Paris , as well as the loss Jacob suffered, seemingly earned him the admiration and sympathy of Theseus Scamander and Nicolas Flamel.

While he initially appeared timid and shy, Jacob is in fact, exceptionally brave, having served in the First World War , willingly braving many adventures at Newt Scamander's side, and even refusing to join Gellert Grindelwald 's forces , despite the fearsome black fire threat as the alternative.
Indeed, had Jacob been a wizard and attended Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry , he would have been Sorted into the house Wampus .
Abilities and skills
Possessions
Jacob Kowalski with his wand
Etymology
